It now becomes obvious that someone is harvesting something from the alien bodies and thus will most likely be coming back at some point to collect it. Also judging from the probable battle damage on the alien ship and the condition of the crew it seems very likely that who ever these collectors are they probably aren't too friendly.

Taking this into account should we continue our voyage and not risk a confrontation or should we stay and try to find away to contact the homeworld of the derelict ship?
STH_expedition.503.name: The faith of the crew
STH_expedition.505.desc: With hailing frequencies opened it is discovered that the crew of the ship haling us is infact of the same species as the ones discovered on the derelict ship. The aliens seem puzzled in finding our ship next to their damaged vessel that send a distress call back to their homeworld and seem to be powering weapons. This might take some explaining to do.
STH_expedition.505.name: An alien ship is hailing us
STH_expedition.506.desc:
After a lengthy exchange of communications between the ships we managed to explain to the aliens that we were not responsible for attacking their ship as our technology doesn't match the weapon damage on the derelict ship's hull or the collecting equipment found on board of it.

Thankful of our attempts to both try and help the derelict vessel and also for contacting them when the faith of the crew was discovered the aliens offer us a small reward and take their damaged vessel in tow back to their homeworld.
STH_expedition.506.name: The aliens power down weapons
STH_expedition.507.desc:
We have detected a ship dropping out of warp very close to our current position. The ship appears to be equipped with similar weapon systems that were used against the derelict vessel.

However before we have time to react the ship opens fire and lands a couple of direct hits on our engines disabling our warp drive. At the same time a scanning beam coming from the alien vessel is detected on board the ship possibly trying to find out if our crew would also be suitable for the collecting operation.

With our weapons now online we manage to land a few hits on the alien ship, but the damage seems to be minimal. This will clearly be a very tough fight.

During the first exchange of fire between the ships a third ship appears at the scene. This new ship appears to be similar to the original derelict alien ship. Perhaps we could show them that we send the distress call and convince them to help us in the fight?
STH_expedition.507.name: An alien ship is closing fast
STH_expedition.508.desc:
It seems that our attempts to convince the new ship were successful as after asking it to scan both our and the attacking alien ship and to compare the results to the technology used against the derelict ship it too opens fire against our attackers.

By coordinating the fire of the two ships against a specific area of the attacking ship our ships are successful in penetrating the enemy's defences and cause significant damage to it. After taking a couple of such hits the hostile alien ship gives up the fight and withdraws quickly.

Thankful of our attempts to both try and help the derelict vessel and also for contacting them when the faith of the crew was discovered the aliens offer us a small reward and take their damaged vessel in tow back to their homeworld.
STH_expedition.508.name: The new ship opens fire on our attackers
STH_expedition.509.desc: It seems that our attempts of convincing the new ship to help us were unsuccessful as unsure of who is who in the ongoing battle the ship withdraws all together. Worse still while trying to convince the new aliens of our innocence the hostile alien ship attacking us has scored several critical hits on our ship and after violent chain of explosions our ship is destroyed.
STH_expedition.509.name: The new ship withdraws from battle
STH_expedition.510.desc:
We have detected a ship dropping out of warp very close to our current position. The ship appears to be equipped with similar weapon systems that were used against the derelict vessel.

However before we have time to react the ship opens fire and lands a couple of direct hits on our engines disabling our warp drive. At the same time a scanning beam coming from the alien vessel is detected on board possibly trying to find out if our crew would also be suitable for the collecting operation.

With our weapons now online we manage to land a few hits on the alien ship, but the damage seems to be minimal. This will clearly be a very tough fight.
STH_expedition.510.name: An alien ship is closing fast
STH_expedition.511.desc: Several rounds of shots are exchanged with the hostile alien ship. After which our ship has already sustained heavy damage while the damage to the alien attacker is only light. With the hostile ship continuing its fire several heavy explosions rock our ship before it is finally completely destroyed.
STH_expedition.511.name: Our ship is taking heavy damage
STH_expedition.512.desc:
After a couple of shots with minimal damage done to the alien attackers the captain of our ship orders power to be transferred from weapons to scanners and to do a detailed scan of the enemy ship's power usage when it fires it weapons the next time.

While a fresh wave of enemy weapon fire rocks the ship and knocks even more systems off-line the scan reveals a potential weakness on the enemy ship. A faint reading of an energy conduct junction where energy is channelled from the ship's powercore to various weapon systems is detected on the ship's hull.

However with our ship already in such a weak condition it is likely we will only get one shot at this. The captain orders the ship to move to an ideal firing angle.
STH_expedition.512.name: Minimal damage done to the alien ship
STH_expedition.513.desc:
When the ship has achieved optimal firing angle the captain gives the order to concentrate the fire of all available weapons on the detected energy conduit junction and to give it everything the ship has got, knowing that this will most likely be the last chance they have left.

With multiple weapons hitting the junction at once a violent explosion strikes the alien ship with power levels seemingly fluctuating on board of it. The alien vessel turns slowly around, with seemingly it's weapons disabled, and engages its warp drive leaving the system.
STH_expedition.513.name: Big explosion on the hostile alien vessel
STH_expedition.600.desc: Our flagship has returned home to [Root.GetHomeWorldName] and the experiences gained by [sth_expedition_Leader_flag.GetName] and their crew will be invaluable. Once the crew has rested and recovered they are free to start their next adventure.
STH_expedition.600.name: Flagship 3-Year Mission Year 3: Home
STH_expedition.9999.desc: A new Star Cluster has been discovered and with it a whole host of new stars complete with strange new worlds to explore and new civilisations to meet. Once we are able to handle the sometimes treacherous conditions within the Star Cluster, we will be able to send in an expedition and then later a 3-5 year mission.
STH_expedition.9999.name: Star Cluster Expeditions
STH_expedition_1.1002.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am receiving reports that following a battle we have picked up reports of [Root.GetName] escape pods and debris coming from the last known location of our expeditionary fleet. We have dispatched a team to retrieve the survivors and bring them home.
STH_expedition_1.1002.name: Ship Destroyed, escape pods found!
STH_expedition_2.1002.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am receiving reports that following a battle we have picked up reports of [Root.GetName] escape pods and debris coming from the last known location of our expeditionary fleet. We have dispatched a team to retrieve the survivors and bring them home.
STH_expedition_2.1002.name: Ship Destroyed, escape pods found!
STH_expedition_4.500.desc:
Captains Log: Captain [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] updating whilst on an expedition, my communications officer has reported we have received the location of a previously undiscovered empire. 

Should we proceed with First Contact?
STH_expedition_4.500.name: New Empire Discovered!
STH_expedition_4.510.desc: Captains Log: Captain [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] reporting in from our expedition. Whilst exploring a previously unclaimed region of space we have been approached by a vessel from [expedition_4_tresspass_country.GetName], they have not stated their intentions, but their demeanor is clearly not friendly.
STH_expedition_4.510.name: Ship Approaching
STH_expedition_4.511.name: Inbound Communications
STH_expedition_4.512.name: Inbound Communications
STH_expedition_4.513.name: Inbound Communications
STH_expedition_4.514.name: Inbound Communications
STH_expedition_4.520.desc: Captains Log: Captain [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] reporting in from our expedition. whilst traversing deep space we have been contacted by [STH_expedition_4_rival_1.GetName] and [STH_expedition_4_rival_2.GetName]. Two rival empires who are spiralling closer and closer to the brink of war. We have been asked to facilitate a conference between the two sides in a bid to stablise the region.
STH_expedition_4.520.name: Diplomatic Conference
STH_expedition_4.521.desc: We have been approached by [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] of the [From.GetName] offering to host a conference between us and our rivals [STH_expedition_4_rival_2.GetName].
STH_expedition_4.521.name: Diplomatic Conference
STH_expedition_4.522.desc: We have been approached by [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] of the [From.GetName] offering to host a conference between us and our rivals [STH_expedition_4_rival_1.GetName].
STH_expedition_4.522.name: Diplomatic Conference.
STH_expedition_4.523.desc: Despite the best efforts of [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] and their crew, it appears [STH_expedition_4_rival_1.GetName] are unwilling to engage in talks with their rivals, it seems that they are not interesting in talking with their foes.
STH_expedition_4.523.name: Diplomatic Conference Rejected
STH_expedition_4.524.desc: Despite the best efforts of [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] and their crew, it appears [STH_expedition_4_rival_2.GetName] are unwilling to engage in talks with their rivals, it seems that they are not interesting in talking with their foes.
STH_expedition_4.524.name: Diplomatic Conference Rejected
STH_expedition_4.525.desc: It appears [STH_expedition_4_rival_2.GetName] are unwilling to engage in talks with us, perhaps they are too afraid to engage with us.
STH_expedition_4.525.name: Diplomatic Conference Rejected
STH_expedition_4.526.desc: It appears that both [STH_expedition_4_rival_1.GetName] and [STH_expedition_4_rival_2.GetName] have been persuaded by [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] to come together for peace talks hosted onboard [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName]'s ship.
STH_expedition_4.526.name: Diplomatic Conference Accepted
STH_expedition_4.527.desc: The diplomatic conference has been agreed and both sides will be in attendance.
STH_expedition_4.527.name: Diplomatic Conference Accepted
STH_expedition_4.528.desc:
Following an intense series of discussions with [STH_expedition_4_rival_1.GetName] and [STH_expedition_4_rival_2.GetName] a major breakthrough has been made providing a significant improvement in the relationship between both countries. 

Envoys from both side credit the work done by [sth_expedition_hero_Leader_1.GetName] as having a huge influence on the success of the talks.
STH_expedition_4.528.name: Diplomatic Success
STH_expedition_4.529.desc: As all parties leave the conference room, it is clear that no agreement has been reached, with the situation possibly even having worsened. The likelihood of peace being brokered anytime soon seems further away following the meeting.
STH_expedition_4.529.name: Diplomatic Failure
STH_expedition_4.530.name: Intelligence Report Received
STH_expedition_situations.1050.name: Five Year Mission Available
STH_expedition_situations.50.name: Expedition to the Lembatta Cluster
STH_expedition_situations.55.name: Expedition to Cluster Complete
STH_federation_council.1.name: United Federation of Planets Council Session
STH_federation_council.10.desc: The emergency council session on [ufp_member_war_concerns.capital_scope.GetName] was a success thanks in part to the efforts of [ufp_envoy.GetName] and [ufp_ship_leader.GetName]. The experience of the team was able to convince the politicians that whilst war is never the desired result sometimes a stance must be taken. The Federation council is once again united.
STH_federation_council.10.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.100.desc: With the formation of the United Federation of Planets, the founding members establish the Federation Council, a democratic voice with a seat for all members of the Federation. The council can be called for an extraordinary session to enact matters of importance to the Federation and Starfleet.
STH_federation_council.100.name: Federation Council Formed
STH_federation_council.102.name: Federation Council Session
STH_federation_council.11.desc: The emergency council session on [ufp_member_war_concerns.capital_scope.GetName] was a failure despite the efforts of [ufp_envoy.GetName] and [ufp_ship_leader.GetName]. The government of [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] remain steadfast in their view that all war is wrong and they remain vocal in this view at every opportunity.
STH_federation_council.11.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.110.desc:
Greetings President, I am [ufp_war_member.GetName] leader of the pro-war faction within the Federation Council, we have won the vote on providing extra support to aid us in the war. 

We can provide a small bonus which should help Starfleet prevail.
STH_federation_council.110.name: Federation Council Session
STH_federation_council.111.desc:
Greetings President, I am [ufp_war_peace.GetName] leader of the pro-peace faction within the Federation Council. We have won the vote and we cannot provide an additional offensive bonus in this war, which is costing the lives of many of our brave officers. 

We have agreed on a small defensive bonus to help ensure our forces can protect our brave citizens.
STH_federation_council.111.name: Federation Council Session
STH_federation_council.12.desc: Failure to attend the conference set up to discuss the war effort has led to [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] feeling undervalued and unappreciated as part of the Federation council, they have made it clear that should they continue to be made to feel this way they will strongly consider their place within the United Federation of Planets.
STH_federation_council.12.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.15.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]! 

We want to commend the success of Starfleet in their recent victory and let them know that all of the Federation is behind them and the people of [ufp_war_good.GetName] support the brave efforts of our troops! Let's win this war for all of the United Federation of Planets.
STH_federation_council.15.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.20.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we wish to discuss the ongoing plans to bring [fed_pacifist_state.GetName] into the United Federation of Planets, we have researched the ethics of this state and have some concerns about their pacifistic views and whether this will weaken the position of Starfleet and allow other nations to take advantage of the United Federation of Planets. 

I look forward to your response [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_federation_council.20.name: Federation Council Session
STH_federation_council.200.desc:
With the Federation Council in place, the council sets about the business of bringing the founding worlds together as one organisation. 

The construction of a new Starbase, simply called Starbase 1 on the site of one of the oldest starbases in our home system seems both logical and symbolic.
STH_federation_council.200.name: The First Federation Starbase
STH_federation_council.21.desc:
Federation councils have arranged a conference between [fed_pacifist_state.GetName] and the concerned dignitaries from Member World [fed_concerned_state.GetName] to be held on the homeworld of [fed_pacifist_state.capital_scope.GetName]. 

The Federation ambassador for [fed_concerned_state.GetName] needs to be escorted from their homeworld to meet with [fed_pacifist_state_leader.GetName].
STH_federation_council.21.name: Federation Diplomatic Escort
STH_federation_council.22.desc:
Federation councils have arranged a conference between [fed_military_state.GetName] and the concerned dignitaries from Member World [fed_concerned_state.GetName] to be held on the homeworld of [fed_military_state.capital_scope.GetName]. 

The Federation ambassador for [fed_concerned_state.GetName] needs to be escorted from their homeworld to meet with [fed_military_state_leader.GetName].
STH_federation_council.22.name: Federation Diplomatic Escort
STH_federation_council.23.desc:
The crew of the [diplomatic_ship.GetName] have successfully picked up the diplomats from [fed_concerned_state.capital_scope.GetName] and are now prepared to escort them to the awaiting conference that has been arranged on [fed_new_state.capital_scope.GetName]. 

All of the Federation are eagerly awaiting the results of the conference and the resumption of a united federation council.
STH_federation_council.23.name: Federation Diplomatic Escort
STH_federation_council.24.desc: Federation diplomats met with the potential new Federation member to discuss the concerns and it looks like the spirit of the Federations original charter was able to help both sides understand the different philosophies and how they strengthen the ideals the Federation was built on by it's founders.
STH_federation_council.24.name: Federation Diplomatic Escort
STH_federation_council.25.desc:
Failure to attend the planned conference has resulted in insult to both sides and a lot of anger being vented back in the Federation Council chambers. 

Hopefully our diplomatic service can undo some of this damage.
STH_federation_council.25.name: Federation Diplomatic Escort
STH_federation_council.26.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we would like to take some time to discuss the ongoing plans to bring [fed_military_state.GetName] into the United Federation of Planets, we have understand that this new state are not afraid of taking the military route and we have some concerns about whether this will create a dangerous tone within the United Federation of Planets. 

Your urgent response would be appreciated [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_federation_council.26.name: Federation Council Session
STH_federation_council.27.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we would like to take some time to discuss the ongoing plans to bring [fed_auth_state.GetName] into the United Federation of Planets, the rights of all members of this great union is at the core of our egalitarian beliefs and we find it hard to understand what [fed_auth_state.GetName] will bring to the table or how they will fit into the federation family. 

Please help us understand.
STH_federation_council.27.name: Federation Council Session
STH_federation_council.28.desc:
Federation councils have arranged a conference between [fed_auth_state.GetName] and the concerned dignitaries from Member World [fed_concerned_state.GetName] to be held on the homeworld of [fed_auth_state.capital_scope.GetName]. 

The Federation ambassador for [fed_concerned_state.GetName] needs to be escorted from their homeworld to meet with [fed_auth_state_leader.GetName].
STH_federation_council.28.name: Federation Diplomatic Escort
STH_federation_council.3.desc: Following the outbreak of the war against [ufp_war_country.GetName] the Federation council representative on behalf of the member world [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] has requested an urgent session of the Federation council to be held to discuss their concerns about the war. They have requested that we contact them immediately via the Contact screen to discuss their concerns.
STH_federation_council.3.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.301.desc:
Dear [Root.GetName], we come to you in need of aid, we have critical resource shortages and we request your aid to deliver these much-needed supplies to our capital. 

We hope you live up to your end of our subject agreement.
STH_federation_council.301.name: Request for Aid
STH_federation_council.302.name: Resource Convoy Arrives
STH_federation_council.303.desc: You have failed to provide us with the agreed aid as we have discussed, and this has seriously impacted our faith in you!
STH_federation_council.303.name: Failed to provide agreed aid
STH_federation_council.304.desc: A band of pirates have intercepted the convoy before it can reach its destination. Defend the shipment and ensure that it reaches its destination.
STH_federation_council.304.name: Pirates Attack
STH_federation_council.4.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerName] we have considered your impassioned speech and whilst our stance on war remains unchanged, we understand that this attack against the principles in which the Federation holds most dear cannot remain undefended. We ask that our brave Starfleet officers do their best to end this conflict swiftly and with minimal casualties.
STH_federation_council.4.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.5.desc: Hello [Root.GetRulerName] we have considered the message given in the last Federation council meeting and whilst we understand the reasoning on why you feel you must lead this Federation into a war, we must stand firm behind our pacifist views and lodge an official protest against this war.
STH_federation_council.5.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.6.desc: The [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] have accepted our offer to send an envoy escorted by one of our Starships. The team will attempt to offset the fears of the [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] government and despite the ongoing war this is a vitally important mission to for the Federation council to ensure that it remains unified during this trying time. Our envoy [ufp_envoy.GetName] will accompany the ship and crew to [ufp_member_war_concerns.capital_scope.GetName].
STH_federation_council.6.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.7.desc: The [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] have rejected our offer further discuss the ongoing war efforts and have formally lodged a complaint at the Federation council, this lack of cohesion within our member worlds will only seek to embolden our enemies efforts to undermine Starfleet's efforts.
STH_federation_council.7.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.8.desc: Federation member world [ufp_member_war_concerns.GetName] has formally lodged an objection against the ongoing war and feel they have been brought into a war against their wishes. Their view of the United Federation of Planets has been harmed as a result.
STH_federation_council.8.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_council.9.desc: What started off as a small debate over the ongoing war effort has escalated as the government on [ufp_member_war_concerns.capital_scope.GetName] have been lobbying against the war. They have gained a number of key allies in the Federation council chambers as fellow member worlds [ufp_member_war_concerns_1.GetName], [ufp_member_war_concerns_2.GetName] have joined their voices together against the war and protesting against how the situation has been handled by the Federation leadership and Starfleet's admiralty.
STH_federation_council.9.name: Federation War Council Emergency Session
STH_federation_flavour.1.desc:
La posición única de la que [bajoran_republic.GetSpeciesName] Faith disfruta entre los [bajoran_republic.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ha planteado en ocasiones un problema para los diplomáticos y los funcionarios públicos que participan en el proceso de acceso de [bajoran_republic.Capital.GetName]. 

Mientras la mayoría de los problemas que han surgido se resuelven rápidamente, un punto aparentemente menor se ha intensificado hasta el punto de que el líder de [bajoran_republic.GetSpeciesName] Faith, Kai [bajoranKai.GetName], ha solicitado una audiencia con [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] para resolver el problema. 

El problema se refiere al código de vestimenta de la Flota Estelar y su enmienda para permitir que los oficiales de [bajoran_republic.GetSpeciesNamePlural] usen los aretes familiares, que forman uno de los componentes más visibles de su religión.
STH_federation_flavour.1.name: [bajoran_republic.GetName] Proceso de adhesión
STH_federation_flavour.10.desc: [diplomacy_leader.GetName]'s efforts on [From.GetName] have been successful and the previous objections to the ongoing integration of the Ferengi have been dropped. The strength and unity of the Federation continues to grow.
STH_federation_flavour.10.name: Successful Negotiations
STH_federation_flavour.100.desc:
Saludos [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. Las conversaciones para llevar a las personas [accessionState.GetSpeciesName] a [Root.GetName] están progresando, pero aún quedan varias preguntas sobre las diferentes ... visiones del mundo que tenemos en ciertas áreas. 

Se nos dice que la diversidad es la fuerza Pero, ¿cómo podemos conciliar la tendencia de mi pueblo hacia un estado decisivo y un orden social jerárquico con su "igualitarismo"? 

Estoy abierto a cualquier sugerencia que pueda tener.
STH_federation_flavour.100.name: [accessionState.GetName] Proceso de adhesión
STH_federation_flavour.101.desc:
Saludos [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. Las conversaciones para llevar a las personas [accessionState.GetSpeciesName] a [Root.GetName] están progresando, pero aún quedan varias preguntas sobre las diferentes ... visiones del mundo que tenemos en ciertas áreas. 

Se nos dice que la diversidad es la fuerza , pero ¿cómo podemos conciliar la tendencia de mi pueblo hacia el uso de la fuerza para lograr la paz con su 'pacifismo'? 

Estoy abierto a cualquier sugerencia que pueda tener.
STH_federation_flavour.101.name: [accessionState.GetName] Proceso de adhesión
STH_federation_flavour.102.desc:
Saludos [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. Las conversaciones para llevar a las personas [accessionState.GetSpeciesName] a [Root.GetName] están progresando, pero aún quedan varias preguntas sobre las diferentes ... visiones del mundo que tenemos en ciertas áreas. 

Se nos dice que la diversidad es la fuerza , pero ¿cómo podemos conciliar la desconfianza de mi pueblo hacia los extraterrestres y las culturas alienígenas con tu 'xenofilia'? 

Estoy abierto a cualquier sugerencia que puedas tener.
STH_federation_flavour.102.name: [accessionState.GetName] Proceso de adhesión
STH_federation_flavour.105.desc: Greetings, I am [accessionStateLeader.GetName] representing [accessionState.GetName], as you well know we are a proud society with a strong and proud military, many amongst our admiralty have raised concerns about your ability to protect our planet, with Starfleet being seen as more of a scientific organisation and not fit to protect our interests.
STH_federation_flavour.105.name: [From.GetName] Membership Process
STH_federation_flavour.106.desc: After a fine demonstration of fleet power and coordination by [diplomacy_leader.GetName] onboard [This.GetName], the integration of our potential member world can now continue with both sides pleased with the outcome of the fleet activity.
STH_federation_flavour.106.name: Fleet Operations Successful
STH_federation_flavour.107.desc: Despite a good display of our fleet capabilities [diplomacy_leader.GetName] could not convince our integration target of the abilities of Starfleet. This is a significant setback to the membership process.
STH_federation_flavour.107.name: Fleet Operations Failed
STH_federation_flavour.108.desc: Greetings, I am [accessionStateLeader.GetName] representing [accessionState.GetName], as you know we value peace and we have seen our peaceful ways taken advantage of over the years, we are keen for reassurance that Starfleet will be able to protect us without becoming a war mongering society.
STH_federation_flavour.108.name: [From.GetName] Membership Process
STH_federation_flavour.109.desc: After a fine demonstration of the skill and abilities of [diplomacy_leader.GetName] onboard [This.GetName], the integration of our potential member world can now continue with both sides pleased with the outcome of the fleet activity.
STH_federation_flavour.109.name: Fleet Operations Successful
STH_federation_flavour.11.desc: [diplomacy_leader.GetName]'s efforts on [From.GetName] have failed to resolve the member world's concerns and harmed the overall efforts to integrate the Ferengi into the [Root.Owner.GetName].
STH_federation_flavour.11.name: Failed Negotiations
STH_federation_flavour.110.desc: Despite a good display of our fleet capabilities [diplomacy_leader.GetName] could not convince our integration target of the abilities of Starfleet, it's unclear if they saw the display as too aggressive or not going far enough to protect them, but it has set back the integration process.
STH_federation_flavour.110.name: Fleet Operations Failed
STH_federation_flavour.111.desc:
Captain's Log - Captain [accessionStateLeader.GetName]: With the ongoing negotiations to bring [From.GetName] into [Root.GetName] in full swing, Starfleet has tasked us with an important diplomatic mission to [From.capital_scope.GetName] to provide some additional impetus to the ongoing discussions and help smooth out some of the sticking points. 

We shall make our way to their homeworld and demonstrate the best that [Root.GetName] has to offer.
STH_federation_flavour.111.name: Diplomatic Mission
STH_federation_flavour.112.desc: Reports are in from [diplomacy_leader.GetName] with word returning that the recent diplomatic conference went well, [diplomacy_leader.GetName] was able to demonstrate the finer nuances of [Root.GetName], even managing to smooth out many issues within the negotiation process.
STH_federation_flavour.112.name: Successful Diplomatic Mission
STH_federation_flavour.113.desc: Concerning reports are being raised by [diplomacy_leader.GetName], despite a series of long conversations and diplomatic meets the Captain and their team were unable to add any momentum to the integration talks, and more concerning a number of new issues have now been raised.
STH_federation_flavour.113.name: Unsuccessful Diplomatic Mission
STH_federation_flavour.114.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerName], I am representing the Trill Symbiosis Commission, for a long time we Trill have kept the nature of our symbiotic nature existence, but with our joining the Federation, we feel the need to declare the secrets of the Trill. 

We require your support to ensure the continued existence of our way of life and our very nature.
STH_federation_flavour.114.name: Trill Symbiosis Commission
STH_federation_flavour.115.name: High Profile Leader Backs Federation Integration
STH_federation_flavour.116.name: High Profile Leader rejects Federation Integration
STH_federation_flavour.117.desc:
Qapla' Federation allies! As we unite our forces to create a new power in the quadrant, we must first agree on how we tackle our Great Houses, many warriors operate the Great House fleets who would be eager and deserve the chance to join the ranks of Starfleet. 

Agreeing to this will transfer all Great House military fleets to [Root.GetName] control within the next year.
STH_federation_flavour.117.name: The Great Houses
STH_federation_flavour.118.desc: As per the agreement in the Integration of the Klingon Empire process, the Great House military assets have now been transferred to Starfleet control.
STH_federation_flavour.118.name: The Great House Fleets
STH_federation_flavour.12.name: Federation Membership
STH_federation_flavour.120.name: Gender Policy Concerns
STH_federation_flavour.121.name: Gender Policy Concerns
STH_federation_flavour.122.name: Gender Policy Reformed
STH_federation_flavour.123.name: Gender Policy Rejected
STH_federation_flavour.124.desc: President! We wish to strongly object to your agreement to allow these misandrist views within the Federation, our union stands for equality for all and your decision makes a mockery of all that we stand for!
STH_federation_flavour.124.name: Formal Objection from [STH_federation_flavour_120_country.GetName]
STH_federation_flavour.125.desc: President! We wish to strongly object to your agreement to allow these misogynist views within the Federation, our union stands for equality for all and your decision makes a mockery of all that we stand for the females in our culture have not fought for their rights for centuries to stand alongside an empire that treats them in such a way.
STH_federation_flavour.125.name: Formal Objection from [STH_federation_flavour_120_country.GetName]
STH_federation_flavour.126.desc: President [Root.GetRulerName] we must formally object to the Federation's continued discussions with [From.GetName], their misandric views are an affront to what many within the [Root.GetName] believe in!
STH_federation_flavour.126.name: Member State Objections
STH_federation_flavour.127.desc: President [Root.GetRulerName] we must formally object to the Federation's continued discussions with [From.GetName], their views and treatment of the female gender are an affront to what many within the [Root.GetName] believe in!
STH_federation_flavour.127.name: Member State Objections
STH_federation_flavour.128.desc: President [Root.GetRulerName] we simply cannot believe you are allowing [From.GetName] to join the Federation, allowing these criminal lowlife into the UFP is a security risk and a danger to our citizens, we formally object and demand this is discussed further.
STH_federation_flavour.128.name: Member State Objections
STH_federation_flavour.129.desc: Thanks to the efforts of [diplomacy_leader.GetName] our talks have been successful and harmony has again been restored to the member worlds of [Root.GetName] and a trust that the diplomatic service knows what is is doing.
STH_federation_flavour.129.name: Talks Successful
STH_federation_flavour.130.desc: Despite the efforts of [diplomacy_leader.GetName] our talks to bring harmony to the member worlds of [Root.GetName] has failed, as multiple Ambassadors formally announce their frustration at our latest new addition.
STH_federation_flavour.130.name: Talks Fail
STH_federation_flavour.131.desc:
Hello, [accessionStateLeader.GetName] we have had disturbing reports about the criminal underworld and activity that makes up much of your society, the [Root.GetName] has established a community free from violence and crime that plagues your empire. 

In order to progress your membership you must rid yourselves of these criminal elements and we will help you.
STH_federation_flavour.131.name: Criminal Underworld Concerns
STH_federation_flavour.132.name: Criminal Underworld Concerns
STH_federation_flavour.133.desc: [temp_target.GetName] has agreed to work with [Root.GetName] authorities to tackle the criminal underworld and root out the criminal organanisations that are rife across this empire.
STH_federation_flavour.133.name: [temp_target.GetName] agrees to remove crime
STH_federation_flavour.134.desc: [temp_target.GetName] has requested a hefty amount of Latinum to rid their empire of the criminal syndicates, whilst many diplomats see this as a clear attempt at bribery, it would allow the talks to continue and achieve our goals of tackling the criminal problem.
STH_federation_flavour.134.name: Bribe Requested
STH_federation_flavour.135.desc: [temp_target.GetName] has refused to remove the criminal elements of their society and have ended their ongoing efforts to join us a a Member World.
STH_federation_flavour.135.name: [temp_target.GetName] refuse to change
STH_federation_flavour.136.desc: Attention President [Root.GetRulerName] we formally object to your clear bias and foolish tactics in allowing these undesirable traits into the harmony that is the [Root.GetName], this clear failure in leadership has not gone unnoticed.
STH_federation_flavour.136.name: Message from Member World
STH_federation_flavour.137.desc: Hello, [accessionStateLeader.GetName] we have had disturbing reports that you enslave your population and curtail the freedoms of your people, this is a practice that cannot be allowed within [Root.GetName] and must stop for you to continue this journey.
STH_federation_flavour.137.name: Slaving Concerns
STH_federation_flavour.138.name: Slaving Concerns
STH_federation_flavour.139.desc: [temp_target.GetName] have agreed to abandon their slavery practices, as per our agreement we will help them adapt their society and help those enslaved find a new life as citizens of [Root.GetName].
STH_federation_flavour.139.name: [temp_target.GetName] agrees to change
STH_federation_flavour.140.desc: [temp_target.GetName] have told us that they will not change and abandon their slaving ways, as a result, they have abandoned their attempt to join us as a Member World.
STH_federation_flavour.140.name: [temp_target.GetName] refuses to change
STH_federation_flavour.144.desc: As part of the integration process into the Federation, there is an opportunity for many of the leaders who have served [From.GetName] to request a transfer to Starfleet once [From.GetName] has completed the membership process.
STH_federation_flavour.144.name: Transfer Leaders to Starfleet
STH_federation_flavour.145.desc: As part of the transfer of fleet control to Starfleet, our Starbase will be transitioned to Starfleet control, except the Starbase belonging to our Capital. If we wish to control all Starbases it can be agreed here.
STH_federation_flavour.145.name: Starbase Control
STH_federation_flavour.147.desc: Joining the Federation is not for every state, and on this occasion, the differences between the two sides were too great for the diplomats to overcome, and both parties agreed to leave the talks, with the option of re-attempting open in the future.
STH_federation_flavour.147.name: Federation Membership Process Abandoned
STH_federation_flavour.149.desc: Greetings from across the border from your neighbours in the Cardassian Union, it has come to our attention that you are looking to welcome the Bajorans into your empire, let this be a friendly warning, the Bajorans cannot be trusted and from our experience are little more than petty terrorists, we would be more than willing to help you put them in their place should the need arise.
STH_federation_flavour.149.name: Message from Cardassia Prime
STH_federation_flavour.2.desc:
Saludos niño, soy Kai [bajoranKai.GetName]. Gracias por permitirme expresar mis preocupaciones sobre este asunto. 

Los aretes familiares que usa mi gente son una faceta clave de la expresión de su fe en los Profetas.
STH_federation_flavour.2.name: Transmisión entrante desde Kai [bajoranKai.GetName]
STH_federation_flavour.3.name: Bajor Backs out of Federation Membership
STH_federation_flavour.4.desc:
Our diplomats engaged in bringing the Klingon Empire into the [Root.GetName] has encountered a recurring issue that is circling with little progress. 

The Klingon warriors are very proud of their Great House system and demonstrate their allegiances on their uniforms, this runs counter to our uniform policy, however the issue has reached the point it now requires direct management.
STH_federation_flavour.4.name: Klingon House Markings
STH_federation_flavour.5.desc: It is an honour to meet you [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am [klingonLeader.GetName]. I can see that you are a notable warrior willing to discuss this topic with me, many would not... Our warriors are wary of giving up the Klingon way of life and submitting to the Federation, and whilst we can see the benefits of a stronger future together, I need something to take back to the uncertain elements within the Empire who fear the loss of our culture.
STH_federation_flavour.5.name: Meeting with the Chancellor
STH_federation_flavour.500.desc:
[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] ha aumentado rápidamente en las tablas de la liga de campeonato Anbo-jytsu de la flota, y ahora se prepara para enfrentar al campeón actual [anboJytsuChampion.GetName]. 

Anbo-jytsu, considerado por muchos como la mejor forma de artes marciales [Root.Leader.Species.GetName], es al mismo tiempo visto por algunos como un pasatiempo tontamente peligroso. 

 Tomando lugar en una arena circular donde dos oponentes compiten entre sí, ambos competidores usan una armadura protectora ligera y un casco que efectivamente ciega a los participantes. Se utiliza un bastón como arma, con un sensor de proximidad en un extremo y un pequeño cojín esférico en el otro.
STH_federation_flavour.500.name: Anbo-jytsu
STH_federation_flavour.501.desc:
Después de un combate intenso, [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] ha derrotado a [From.GetName] para convertirse en el campeón de la flota Anbo-jytsu. 

Aunque parecía que [From.GetName] presionaría [From.GetHerHis] ventaja para una victoria fácil varias veces en el partido, fue la persistencia de [Root.Leader.GetName] la que finalmente ganó el campeonato para [Root .Leader.GetHerHim].
STH_federation_flavour.501.name: Anbo-jyutsu
STH_federation_flavour.502.desc:
Después de un intenso combate, [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] ha sido derrotado por [From.GetName], quien retiene el título [From.GetHerHis] como campeón de la flota Anbo-jytsu. 

Aunque parecía que [Root.Leader.GetName] tenía varias oportunidades para mejorar [From.GetHerHis], fue la experiencia de [From.GetName] la que finalmente ganó el campeonato por [From.GetHerHim]. 

 Peor, [Root.Leader.GetName] parece haber agravado una lesión previa que resulta en una función motora reducida en [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] brazo izquierdo.
STH_federation_flavour.502.name: Anbo-jyutsu
STH_federation_flavour.6.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] I come from a proud race, a fierce race, and your refusal to allow us a small token of our culture is seen as too big an insult for many of our warriors to stand. The Klingon way is proud and spirited and your position demonstrated there is too big a gap between us for the Empire to join your alliance of Planets. Maybe we can resume the talk at a later date, but not today. Qapla'.
STH_federation_flavour.6.name: The Klingons back out of Federation Membership
STH_federation_flavour.602.desc:
Después de un largo tiempo en las profundidades del espacio,  [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName]  ha comenzado a tener dificultades para recordar el propósito original de [Root.Leader.GetHerHis]. La vida de la tripulación de  [Root.GetFleetName]  se han vuelto rutinarios y rutinarios. 

Otros podrían apuntar a este modelo de eficiencia, pero para la Flota Estelar, la moral y el bienestar de una tripulación son primordiales. 

 [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha comenzado a considerar organizar actividades de la tripulación para proporcionar un descanso de lo mundano.
STH_federation_flavour.602.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.604.desc:
No ha tomado mucho tiempo organizar una orquesta improvisada fuera del equipo de  [Root.GetFleetName] § !, ya que un sorprendente número de miembros del equipo tiene al menos algo de experiencia con un instrumento musical. 

Después de un mes de preparación, la tripulación ha creado algo notable. Si bien las actuaciones pueden carecer de cierta sofisticación técnica, están inculcadas con una pasión reservada solo para aquellos que han visto las profundidades del espacio. 

Más importante que eso, la tripulación se ha unido más fuerte que nunca.
STH_federation_flavour.604.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.605.desc:
stá empezando a sonar enojado de nuevo. Tal vez necesites otro tratamiento. 

'Lo que necesito es salir de esta celda. He estado encerrado aquí por días. Has controlado todos mis movimientos. ¡Me has dicho qué comer, qué pensar y qué decir, y luego, cuando muestro un atisbo de pensamiento independiente, me abrochas! Me inyectas drogas. ¡Lo llamas un tratamiento! ' 

La organización de un grupo dramático aficionado a bordo del [Root.GetFleetName] ha demostrado ser una distracción bienvenida para la tripulación.
STH_federation_flavour.605.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.606.desc:
El holodeck proporciona una amplia gama de experiencias, pero se necesita un talento único para crear en lugar de consumir su producción. 

Los miembros aburridos de la tripulación entusiasmados por las historias antiguas de sus mundos natales se han encargado de hacer precisamente eso. 

El resultado fue bien recibido, y finalmente involucró a casi todos los miembros de la tripulación de  [Root.GetFleetName]  incluyendo [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle]  [Root.GetLeaderName] § !. 

El programa se grabó y distribuyó desde entonces en toda la flota.
STH_federation_flavour.606.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.607.desc:
No ha tomado mucho tiempo organizar una orquesta improvisada fuera del equipo de  [Root.GetFleetName] § !, ya que un sorprendente número de miembros del equipo tiene al menos algo de experiencia con un instrumento musical. 

Después de un mes de preparación, la tripulación ha creado algo notable. Si bien las actuaciones pueden carecer de cierta sofisticación técnica, están inculcadas con una pasión reservada solo para aquellos que han visto las profundidades del espacio. 

Más importante que eso, la tripulación se ha unido más fuerte que nunca.
STH_federation_flavour.607.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.608.desc:
Combinando teatro, literatura y escultura junto con técnicas de narración que se remontan a los días de los antiguos juegos electrónicos, la creación de una holo-novela interactiva es una forma de arte como ninguna otra. 

Trabajando juntos, la tripulación del  [Root.GetFleetName]  han creado algo único: tejer una historia que se basa en parte en sus propias aventuras y descubrimientos, y en parte en el resultado de su amplia imaginación colectiva, lo que permite a todos crear su propia aventura interestelar.
STH_federation_flavour.608.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.609.desc:
La tripulación del  [Root.GetFleetName]  aprobó rápidamente la idea de participar en un combate amistoso. 

Un miembro de la tripulación buscó profundamente en los archivos y encontró un antiguo juego de cartas de la Tierra que parecía adecuado: el póker. Organizando un sistema complejo que permitiría a cada oficial participar en varios combates antes de encontrar su clasificación y competir contra sus compañeros, la tripulación pasó todo el mes en feroces preparativos y combates de eliminación más feroces. 

El ganador final recibió una caja de brandy saurio, pero prometió compartirlo con la tripulación en la oportunidad más cercana.
STH_federation_flavour.609.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.610.desc:
Siempre práctico, la tripulación del  [Root.GetFleetName]  Tomó la noticia de su tiempo de inactividad con equidad y estableció un estricto régimen de capacitación. 

Para hacerlo más atractivo y encajar con la orden del [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] de relajarse, la tripulación decidió convertir el ejercicio de entrenamiento de tiro en una competencia. 

El ganador, una transferencia reciente a seguridad, recibió una caja de brandy saurio que rápidamente se compartió entre el departamento.
STH_federation_flavour.610.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.620.desc:
Los oficiales de la  [Root.GetFleetName]  han declarado hoy como  [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName]  Día. 

Ornaments, se han planeado una gran cantidad de dulces y bebidas de la ciudad natal de [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] y una variedad de coloridos carteles.
STH_federation_flavour.620.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.621.desc: Tras el éxito del anterior  [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName]  Celebración del día, la tripulación del  [Root.GetFleetName]  he decidido continuar la tradición en este año una vez más.
STH_federation_flavour.621.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.630.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.631.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.632.name: Actividades a bordo
STH_federation_flavour.7.desc:
Ferengi culture carries a great deal of differences from what the citizens of the Federation, the acquisition of personal wealth, and the need to display and be judged on this fortune are deeply embedded in the Ferengi society. 

The Grand Nagus and their team of delegates have approached our integration team to discuss what joining us would do to these customs.
STH_federation_flavour.7.name: [ferengi_alliance.GetName] Accession Process
STH_federation_flavour.700.desc: El transporte de grandes cantidades de material y personal a Luna para reparar el daño causado a la Colonia Minera Orpheus está completo, y la plataforma de perforación móvil está operativa una vez más.
STH_federation_flavour.700.name: Colonia Minera Orfeo
STH_federation_flavour.701.desc:
El pequeño asentamiento de Armstrong City en la luna se ha ampliado enormemente con nuevos edificios y colonos. Los colonos continúan acudiendo en masa a las nuevas oportunidades en Luna, y se cita a uno de ellos diciendo que fue la noche lunar de un mes. 

'La gente dice que es tan árido y duro, pero no lo es. es bonito. El amanecer es tan impactante en la luna. En un minuto estás en la noche más oscura que puedas imaginar, y al instante siguiente, el sol se levanta y esta luz gloriosa y pura explota en la superficie '.
STH_federation_flavour.701.name: Armstrong City
STH_federation_flavour.702.desc: El pequeño asentamiento de Tycho City en la luna se ha ampliado enormemente con nuevos edificios y colonos. La población lunar ahora está prosperando, y dentro de unos años, la ciudad será uno de varios hitos lunares lo suficientemente grandes como para ser vistos desde la Tierra durante el día.
STH_federation_flavour.702.name: Tycho City
STH_federation_flavour.703.desc: The upgraded Academy complex in San Francisco will be the pinciple of education across the Federation, training young officers and imparting the knowledge and skills for future captains for generations to come.
STH_federation_flavour.703.name: Starfleet Academy
STH_federation_flavour.704.desc: The small settlement of New Berlin on the moon has been expanded greatly with new buildings and colonists. The lunar population is now thriving, and within a few years the city will be one of several lunar landmarks large enough to be seen from Earth in the daytime.
STH_federation_flavour.704.name: New Berlin City
STH_federation_flavour.705.desc: The Omega training mission exercise on Titan was rapidly becoming a notorious training scenario for Starfleet recruits, the expansion of this facility to a state of the art survival training centre creates a tougher breed of officer entering Starfleet.
STH_federation_flavour.705.name: Titan Training Facility
STH_federation_flavour.706.desc: The Daystrom Institute, also known as the Daystrom Institute of Advanced Robotics, Daystrom Research Institute, Daystrom Institute of Technology, and Daystrom Technological Institute, is a Federation establishment based in Okinawa, Japan. It is considered a department within Starfleet. The Institute is named after Doctor Richard Daystrom, who invented the duotronic computer and unsuccessfully attempted to create the first multitronic computer. The institute employs both Starfleet personnel and civilians who are scientific and research specialists in their fields of study.
STH_federation_flavour.706.name: The Daystrom Institute
STH_federation_flavour.750.desc:
El Proyecto Atlantis, la creación de un nuevo subcontinente artificial fuera de la Cordillera del Atlántico Medio, ha sido durante mucho tiempo un sueño del Director [atlantis_manager.GetName]. La viabilidad del proyecto ha sido rechazada en el pasado, ya que uno de los desafíos era acelerar la acumulación en la parte inferior del manto sin aumentar el estrés en las placas tectónicas. 

Con el Director [atlantis_manager.GetName] a cargo del equipo de investigación, se ha desarrollado una nueva técnica para utilizar potentes resonadores armónicos para aliviar la presión tectónica en las placas sin causar eventos sísmicos masivos. Según las proyecciones de [atlantis_manager.GetHerHis], el proceso llevaría varios años, pero aumentaría sustancialmente la cantidad de masa de tierra utilizable en la Tierra.
STH_federation_flavour.750.name: Nueva Atlántida
STH_federation_flavour.8.desc:
Greetings, greetings! I am Grand Nagus [ferengiLeader.GetName] as excited as the citizens of [ferengi_alliance.capital_scope.GetName] are to join the mighty [Root.GetName], we do have some minor ... contractual concerns to discuss. 

The appropriation of wealth and profit is essential to every warm-bodied Ferengi and we would be looking for some form of concession to our culture, perhaps limited to our headskirts?
STH_federation_flavour.8.name: Message from the Nagus
STH_federation_flavour.9.desc:
Hello [Root.GetRulerTitle], we are aware of the concessions that the Federation is being forced to make to appease the Ferengi, but we ask why. 

Why compromise our values for the sake of these latinum seeking cretins? We lower our high standards to allow the Ferengi into our community at the cost of our morals. The line must be drawn, here and no further!
STH_federation_flavour.9.name: Urgent Message from [objecting_country.GetName] Ambassador
STH_federation_story.1.desc:
Desde hace varias semanas, [Root.GetName] Security ha estado intentando rastrear una serie de piratas informáticos ilegales. Las intrusiones parecen tener una cosa en común: todas han apuntado a ubicaciones conocidas por almacenar información histórica clasificada sobre las Guerras Eugenias de finales del siglo XX, donde los humanos genéticamente aumentados casi reclamaron la dominación total sobre la Tierra. 

Por qué alguien querría desenterrar los fantasmas del pasado sigue siendo desconocido.
STH_federation_story.1.name: Actividad inusual
STH_federation_story.10.desc:
Habiendo llegado a la estación de investigación en órbita [augment_research_target_2.GetName], es rápidamente evidente que no todo está bien en la estación. 

Varias infracciones de casco se detectan, y varios cuerpos flotan muertos a lo largo de la estación. 

Como un equipo de seguridad se prepara para abordar la estación, las alertas de proximidad se activan. Los buques de un enjambre de diseño alienígena de su posición en el lado lejano de la estación, las armas enganchadas.
STH_federation_story.10.name: Realidades Aumentadas
STH_federation_story.1001.desc:
Greetings my Chancellor, I am Azetbur of House Makok, I come before the high council with a grave warning, but also a solution. 

The destruction of Praxis has left our homeworld in grave danger from the debris that falls towards our home and threatens our atmosphere. Klingons make fine warriors but poor scientists, but solution lies with our former enermies, the United Federation of Planets, for they have the technology to save our world.
STH_federation_story.1001.name: A new beginning for the Empire
STH_federation_story.1002.desc: Hail Chancellor, I am General Chang! I have fought many battles against these Federation and I feel I know them better than any warrior in the Empire. I volunteer to escort you on this mission. On my honour you will be save my lord.
STH_federation_story.1002.name: General Chang
STH_federation_story.1003.desc:
Greetings Admiral [fed_undiscovered_leader.GetName] we have recieved a diplomatic invitation from the Klingon Empire, a chance for lasting peace between our worlds. 

The Empire needs our help and we require peace and a future where we can call the Klingons allies. Rendevouz with the Klingon Chancellor and pave a way for lasting peace.
STH_federation_story.1003.name: A Brave New World
STH_federation_story.1005.desc: Starfleet have agreed to meet with us, they are sending their Flagship and one of their finest leaders to meet with us.
STH_federation_story.1005.name: The Undiscovered Country
STH_federation_story.1010.desc: The Federation Starship [ufp_undiscovered_country_ship.GetName] has entered the system and is hailing us, they have invited us over to experence the best hospitality the Federation has to offer.
STH_federation_story.1010.name: The Undiscovered Country
STH_federation_story.1011.desc: General Chang, Lady Azetbur and Chancellor [vi_tuc_klingons.GetRulerName] have arrived onboard and are expecting to be treated as honoured guests as we begin diplomatic discussions.
STH_federation_story.1011.name: Guess who's coming to dinner?
STH_federation_story.1012.name: Federation Hospitality
STH_federation_story.1013.name: The Undiscovered Country
STH_federation_story.1015.name: Klingon Ship attacked
STH_federation_story.1016.name: Klingons call for aid
STH_federation_story.1017.desc: The Starfleet captain and their doctor beam over to our Flagship with a set of medical supplies. The doctor immedialy goes to work attempting to save the lives of our injured crew and leadership...
STH_federation_story.1017.name: Federation Doctor arrives
STH_federation_story.1018.desc: Admiral [leader_name_ref.GetName] returns with the news that they were unsuccessful in their attempts to save the Klingon injured who passed from their wounds in the early hours. Worryingly the damage to the Klingons and their ship appears to be consistant with Starfleet weaponary, to make matters worse the Klingons are demanding we hand over [leader_name_ref.GetName] for crimes against the Empire.
STH_federation_story.1018.name: [klingon_killed_leader.GetName] dies
STH_federation_story.1019.desc: The Starfleet officer and his medical doctor have been handed to us. They will be sent to the prison planet of Rura Penthe where they will be the rest of the accursed days digging Dilithium from that hellish rock and regretting their crimes against our people.
STH_federation_story.1019.name: Rura Penthe
STH_federation_story.1020.name: Demand Compensation
STH_federation_story.1021.desc:
Following what we believe to have been failed peace talks the United Federation of Planets and the Klingon Empire have now gone to war. 

The impact of this war will be felt across the quadrant.
STH_federation_story.1021.name: Klingon Empire & UFP go to War
STH_federation_story.1022.desc: The High Council has met following the events of recent days and have agreed that although the outcome could have been worse, the insult against the Empire should be repayed with some form of tribute and recompense from the Federation.
STH_federation_story.1022.name: Demand Tribute
STH_federation_story.1023.desc:
The Klingon Empire is demanding that we pay tribute as a form of recompense for the attack apon their ship. They are refusing to continue the peace talks unless we pay them these fund to repair the damage and apology for this insult. 

Whilst the crew claim they took no actions against the Chancellor's ship, many think that we should accept the punishment and continue the peace talks.
STH_federation_story.1023.name: Tribute Demanded
STH_federation_story.1024.desc:
The howls from the Klingon warriors alert the honoured dead in Sto-vo-Kor that a new warrior is travelling to dine in the mighty halls. [klingon_killed_leader.GetName] joins the list of the honoured dead, despite the efforts from the Starfleet team. 

Honour must be restored and the Federation must pay for this act of betrayal and hand over the Admiral.
STH_federation_story.1024.name: [klingon_killed_leader.GetName] dies
STH_federation_story.1025.desc:
As both ships settled into the night shift the calm was disrupted by the sounds of torpedoes slamming into the unshielded hull of the Klingon envoy ship. The tactical officer on the night shift was able to wrestle the shields up before any further strikes could be made against the Flagship. Critically damaged, but still operational an alarm triggers indicating intruders have beamed onto the ship. Sending a contingent of warriors to intercept the would-be assassins allows us to capture a trio of Starfleet officers.

Before they can be questioned each officer ingests a suicide capsule, at least they have enough honour to refuse to be captured alive...
STH_federation_story.1025.name: Assassination attempt prevented
STH_federation_story.1026.desc:
The Klingon vessel appears to have surived whomever attacked the ship, General Chang appears on screen accusing our ship of firing on his ship. Our Science Officer cannot explain the scenario that played out just minuits ago, the Klingons were clearly fired on, but no such order came from our ship. 

To make matters worse the bodies of three Starfleet crew members were found onboard the Klingon ship, however they killed themselves before they could be questioned. 

General Chang has declared the talks over and that we have not heard the last of this insult.
STH_federation_story.1026.name: Klingons Attacked
STH_federation_story.1027.desc:
In the early hours of the morning, the on duty security officer picked up a tripped alarm on a storage locker, with nothing else to do the officer sends a secuirty team to investigate. 

On arriving at the destination they find a small team of officers attempting to break into a weapons locker, caught off-guard the trio of officers engage an emergency transporter and vanish.

All evidence suggests that we have managed to stop some sort of covert assassination attempt, presumably on the Klingon vessel. With no further evidence to go on, all we can do now is wait for the next stage of talks and be thankful nothing worse came from this.
STH_federation_story.1027.name: Asassination attempted foiled
STH_federation_story.1028.desc:
After an uneventful nightshift, General Chang resumes command the next morning. The bridge officers comment that the General appears to be in a foul mood, but then a Klingon not engaged in combat is never full satisfied. 

The High Council gives the order to return to the homeworld and prepare for the next phase of talks.
STH_federation_story.1028.name: Time to depart
STH_federation_story.1030.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am [suggested_rura_Leader1.GetName] and I come to you with worrying news. The attack against the Klingon vessel, for which our officers were arrested was a hoax. 

We have found evidence of a plot by members of Starfleet and the Klingon Defence Force to disrupt the peace talks and frame [ufp_undiscovered_country_leader_rura_penthe.GetName] for the murders on the Klingon Flagship. 

We request permission to extract [ufp_undiscovered_country_leader_rura_penthe.GetHerHim] from the prison world of Rura Penthe and then onto Khitomer to expose this plot!
STH_federation_story.1030.name: Plot against the Khitomer Conference
STH_federation_story.1031.desc: Life on the frozen prison world is every bit as challenging as the Klingon's stated it would be, the cold, the guards and the gruelling manual labour are all potential killers. However [ufp_undiscovered_country_leader_rura_penthe.GetName] has faced challenged throughout their career. Managing to join forces with another inmate the prisoners were able to escape to the frozen surface of the planet and just as all hope of escape was about to be lost, the familiar tingle of a transporter beam and freedom.
STH_federation_story.1031.name: Escape from Rura Penthe
STH_federation_story.1032.desc: The warden on Rura Penthe has reported that our Federation prisoners have escaped, with the aid of a Starfleet ship. The Federation ambassador has promised to explain all and that the future of the Khitomer Conference is at stake.
STH_federation_story.1032.name: Prisoners escape Rura Penthe
STH_federation_story.1033.desc:
Following repeated scans of the planets surface, no signs of life could be found. A detailed scan finds a faint trace of the hidden transponder, but no sign of the Admiral or doctor. 

Unable to wait any longer we can only assume they did not manage surive the inhospitable conditions on the surface, sadly we must now consider them dead and continue onward to Khitomer.
STH_federation_story.1033.name: Rescue attempt fails
STH_federation_story.1034.desc: The warden on Rura Penthe has filed a report indicating a mysterious signal was reported in orbit of the prison planet. A Bird-of-Prey was dispatched, but did not pick up anything out of the normal. With the Khitomer Conference on the horizon security should be at its tightest.
STH_federation_story.1034.name: Mysterious singal over Rura Penthe
STH_federation_story.1035.desc: As [khitomer_conf_ship.GetName] enters orbit above Camp Khitomer, the bridge crew beam down determined to uncover the plot taking place at the peace talks. With dignitories from across the Federation member worlds, Klingon Empire and observers from other major powers all in attendance it seems as if the eyes of the galaxy are on the events taking place on the planet.
STH_federation_story.1035.name: The Khitomer Conference
STH_federation_story.1036.desc:
Following the anthems of the Klingon Empire and Federation of Planets, the opening talks begin. Foreign dignitories from across the sector are in attendance to join the talks and witness this historic occassion. 

Planetary security has noted that the [khitomer_conf_ship.GetName] has entered orbit unannouced, General Chang has insisted on returning to his warship to monitor the situation.
STH_federation_story.1036.name: The Khitomer Conference
STH_federation_story.1037.desc:
Seeing the leaders of both countries lining up to speak, [khitomer_conf_leader.GetName ] orders their crew to fan out and search for a potential assassin, the staged murder of the Federation President could bring both countries to a state of war.

To make matters more urgent all communications with [khitomer_conf_ship.GetName] have been lost...
STH_federation_story.1037.name: Wrong us... shall we not revenge?
STH_federation_story.1038.desc:
A small red scope dot dances across the chest of [ufp_ruler_khitomer.GetName] unoticed by all except [khitomer_conf_leader.GetName], diving for the assassin and knocking them through the overlooking window to the ground below. 

Gasps of concern ring out from the conference participants as a Klingon and his sniper rifle fall to the ground, however all is not as it seems, pulling the mask from the Klingon's face to reveal a Starfleet General and with a final triumphant shout the General shouts 'Chang will complete the mission'.
STH_federation_story.1038.name: Constant as the northern star…
STH_federation_story.1039.desc:
The assassin is able to fire two quick shots from his sniper rifle before the Starfleet crew are able to take the assailant down. The cries from the crowd are enough to confirm that the shots have found their targets and that the Klingon Chancellor and Federation President are both dead. 

With the attacker's job now complete, they are revealed to be a Klingon before they beam away.
STH_federation_story.1039.name: Both Leaders Killed
STH_federation_story.1040.desc: The source of the commotion is quickly identified as a hidden assassin, a Klingon male, opens fire from a sniper rifle, the shots hit the rulers of the Klingon Empire and Federation killing both instantly. Looking over at the attacker the telltale sign of a Klingon transporter beam whisks him away.
STH_federation_story.1040.name: Leaders Assassinated
STH_federation_story.1041.desc:
The assassin is able to fire off a single shot from his sniper rifle before the Starfleet crew are able to take the assailant down. The cries from the crowd are enough to confirm that the shot successfully found its target and the Federation President [khitomer_conf_ufp_leader.GetName] lay dead beside the podium. 

With the attacker's job now complete, they are reveal themselves to be a Klingon before beaming away.
STH_federation_story.1041.name: President Assassinated
STH_federation_story.1042.desc: The source of the commotion is quickly identified as a hidden assassin, a Klingon male, who opens fire from a sniper rifle, the shot successfully strikes the Federation President before the bodyguards can protect them.
STH_federation_story.1042.name: Federation President Killed
STH_federation_story.1043.desc: The Federation team's mission is finally reviewed, it appears they were hunting an assassin in the crowd. The assassins location revealed, the attacker takes aim as Starfleet officers rush in to prevent the killer from taking his shot.
STH_federation_story.1043.name: Assassin Revealed
STH_federation_story.1044.desc:
As the Assassin takes aim to fire, [ufp_khitomer_captain.GetName] heroically leaps in front of the shot in a desparate bid to knock the assassin off his aim. 

The Assassin is knocked backwards and the rifle blast fires harmlessly passed the gathered leadership. The Assassin is revealed to be a human general disguised as a Klingon, before he is pulled away by security he vows that Chang will complete the mission!
STH_federation_story.1044.name: Leaders Saved
STH_federation_story.1045.desc: Be honest, Captain, warrior to warrior. You do prefer it this way, don't you, as it was meant to be? No peace in our time. 'Once more unto the breach, dear friends'.
STH_federation_story.1045.name: Cry havoc, and let slip the Dogs of War
STH_federation_story.1046.desc: General Chang's ship finally defeated explodes in a ball of fury, in life the General's hatred for the Federation and desire to return to the ways of war had fueled his desire to betray his own people. However with the General now dead and the Starfleet officers behind the plot either dead or behind bars, maybe now there is a chance for peace.
STH_federation_story.1046.name: General Chang defeated
STH_federation_story.1047.desc: With the traitor Chang defeated, it is time to once again turn attention back to the Khitomer Summit. Many Klingons will have supported his crusade against the Federation, and it is clear that many within Starfleet shared his views, but the Empire must evolve, new threats will emerge, is it time to put aside our difference and find an ally in Starfleet?
STH_federation_story.1047.name: Will there be peace
STH_federation_story.1048.desc: Our diplomats have withdrawn from Khitomer, the acts over the last few weeks have all but destroyed any chance that the Klingons would sign the peace treaty and as feared they have pulled out of the talks and ordered all Federation envoys from their space. Our attempts to tame the Undiscovered Country has failed, the relationship between [Root.Capital_scope.GetName] and Qo'nos are perhaps worse than ever.
STH_federation_story.1048.name: Klingon's Reject the Accords
STH_federation_story.1049.desc: This is a historic day for all members of the Federation and warriors of the Klingon Empire! After years of open hostility and fierce wars both countries have signed the Khitomer Accords, which will bring each empire closer together and open the way to forge a peaceful future together.
STH_federation_story.1049.name: Khitomer Accords Signed
STH_federation_story.1050.desc:
The Federation and Klingon Empire appear to have signed a historic treaty bringing each empire closer together and ending a century of on and off violence between the two major powers. 

We shall see what this means for the rest of the Alpha and Beta Quadrants.
STH_federation_story.1050.name: Historic Agreement between Federation and Klingons
STH_federation_story.1051.desc:
Those cowards on the Starfleet ship not only appear to have attacked us, but now refuse to help us during our time of need. This act of cowardice must not go unpunished and the dealths of our warriors must be avenged.

These peace talks are over!
STH_federation_story.1051.name: Federation refuse to help
STH_federation_story.1052.desc:
Our failure to offer aid to the Klingons has only further inflamed an already tense situation, the Empire has departed the system and cut communications with us. 

Our admiralty have warned us to prepare for the threat of open war with the Klingons.
STH_federation_story.1052.name: Klingons depart, furious
STH_federation_story.1053.name: The Undiscovered Country
STH_federation_story.1054.desc:
It is a rare feat to see such bravery from another species, but the actions of [ufp_khitomer_captain.GetName] were worthy of the most enthusiastic song! The Admiral, without a thought to their own safety, dives in to tackle the would be assassin blocking the shot and saving the delegates. 

Security forces rush in to reveal a disguised human who is loudly declaring that our General Chang will finish the mission. Could Chang have betrayed us?
STH_federation_story.1054.name: Assassin Captured!
STH_federation_story.1055.desc: The Starfleet Officers that beamed in appear to have captured an armed Klingon male. Dragging the individual in front of the security agencies it appears he was here to assassinate the conference leadership! Before being dragged away the agent reveals that General Chang was behind the plot and a traitor to the Empire.
STH_federation_story.1055.name: Assassin Captured!
STH_federation_story.1056.desc: After searching throughout the main conference room, the crew notice a locked door overlooking the podiums, a security officer lying unconcious hidden to the side of the room. Rushing into the room [ufp_khitomer_captain.GetName] confronts an assassin preparing to fire a sniper at the President and Klingon Chancellor. The attack must be stopped.
STH_federation_story.1056.name: Stop the Assassins
STH_federation_story.1060.desc: President! I can no longer stand by whilst the Starfleet I have served so loyally betrays its values by aligning with those Klingon animals and I am not alone, like-minded individuals across both empires will align to ensure the lasting security of the countries we love.
STH_federation_story.1060.name: We've been Betrayed!
STH_federation_story.11.desc:
La flota enemiga que atacó la estación de investigación en órbita [augment_research_target_2.GetName] ha sido destruida. 

Los intentos de recuperar sobrevivientes han proporcionado una serie de candidatos potenciales en los restos, que ahora deben ser investigados ...
STH_federation_story.11.name: Realidades Aumentadas
STH_federation_story.1100.desc:
Los rumores de disturbios civiles nos han llegado desde el muy avanzado pero recluido Reino de Skorr. 

Sin embargo, no hay más información disponible, aunque dada la superioridad tecnológica que el Reino demuestra sobre los poderes más involucrados en la galaxia debemos permanecer cautelosos ante todas las posibilidades.
STH_federation_story.1100.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1101.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1102.desc:
Al llegar a [From.From.GetName] [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] se ha unido a un equipo de especies cruzadas asignado a cazar el Alma de Alar, que se ha detectado en una luna en el sistema de L'Karedari. 

Tchar, Príncipe de Skorr y Maestro de la Eyrie dirige la misión. El ingeniero reptil Sord, el ladrón insectoide Em / 3 / Green, la cazadora humanoide Lara y el Tzscci tianiano también han sido reclutados y presentados el uno al otro, el equipo se prepara para partir.
STH_federation_story.1102.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1103.desc:
Transmitiendo a la luna de L'Karedari Yoali a través de un transportista de larga distancia Skorr, el equipo pasa varias horas revisando sus suministros y cargandolos en el skimmer proporcionado. 

Resupply resultará difícil ya que las tormentas iónicas a través del sistema de L'Karedari impiden que las ventanas de acercamiento y transporte sean fugaces. 

 Empezando en la dirección de los sensores del skimmer colocar el alma en, el equipo pasar varias horas en discusión - ¿quién ganaría de robar el alma? - a través de un paisaje volcánico misterioso. Una roca callejera golpea las naceles antigravía del skimmer que lo envían lentamente descendiendo al suelo. 

Several cientos de metros de la skimmer el resplandor rojo de lava pulgadas hacia el equipo.
STH_federation_story.1103.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1104.desc:
Los conocimientos de ingeniería natural de Sord han llegado en buen uso, y con minutos para ahorrar las nacelles antigravios del skimmer son completamente operacionales. 

El equipo continúa hacia la señal del Alma.
STH_federation_story.1104.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1105.desc:
Los conocimientos de ingeniería natural de Sord cuentan poco, mientras que otras rocas golpean al skimmer y eliminan otros sistemas clave. [Skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] y el resto de la lucha del equipo para reparar el vehículo, y con momentos para ahorrar las nacelles del antigrav del skimmer son completamente operacionales. 

Reinserción del skimmer de nuevo, [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] es golpeado en el brazo por una roca más pequeña rebotando desde el casco del skimmer, hiriendo [skorr_jihad_leader.GetHerHim]. 

El equipo continúa hacia la señal del Alma.
STH_federation_story.1105.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1106.desc:
Los conocimientos de ingeniería natural de Sord han llegado en buen uso, y con minutos para ahorrar las nacelles antigravios del skimmer son completamente operacionales. 

El huelga de desastre, sin embargo, al intentar entrar en el vehículo de nuevo una roca de tamaño puño rebotes del casco del skimmer y golpea a Sord plana en la cara. Sangre derrama de la herida, y el equipo arrastra a Sord en el skimmer donde no lo reviven. 

El equipo continúa hacia la señal del Alma, mientras busca un lugar de enterramiento adecuado.
STH_federation_story.1106.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1107.desc:
Los conocimientos de ingeniería natural de Sord cuentan poco, mientras que otras rocas golpean al skimmer y eliminan otros sistemas clave. [Skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] y el resto de la lucha del equipo para reparar el vehículo, y con momentos para ahorrar las nacelles del antigrav del skimmer son completamente operacionales. 

Introduciendo el skimmer de nuevo, [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] empuja Sord al suelo antes de que sea golpeado por una roca que se recupera del casco del skimmer lo suficientemente grande como para matarlo. 

El Sord agradecido le ofrece [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] sus agradecimientos y se compromete a pagar la deuda. 

El equipo continúa hacia la señal del Alma.
STH_federation_story.1107.name: Alma del Alar
STH_federation_story.1108.desc:
Los conocimientos de ingeniería natural de Sord cuentan poco, mientras que otras rocas golpean al skimmer y eliminan otros sistemas clave. [Skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] y el resto de la lucha del equipo para reparar el vehículo, y con momentos para ahorrar las nacelles del antigrav del skimmer son completamente operacionales. 

Introduciendo el skimmer de nuevo, [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] empuja Sord al suelo antes de que sea golpeado por una roca que se recupera del casco del skimmer lo suficientemente grande como para matarlo. 

La roca pierde Sord, pero golpea [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] en la pierna, dañando gravemente [skorr_jihad_leader.GetHerHim]. 

El equipo continúa hacia la señal del Alma, tratando la herida de [skorr_jihad_leader.GetName] en el skimmer.
