En cambio, parece que hace más de 100 millones de años, una colección de pequeños reinos y aldeanos adoptaron lentamente un solo panteón sincrético. Los dioses locales de la ciudad y los mitos de la creación se integraron entre sí, lo que permitió que surgiera un único ethos unificador. Antes de su extinción, todas las políticas de D'Arsry compartían muchos ideales en artes, filosofía y teología, manteniendo sus propias historias, idiomas, gobierno y moneda únicos. 

A pesar de esta individualidad, dos nombres continúan apareciendo constantemente en casi todos los artículos que publicamos. se han recuperado del archivo: Masaka y Korgano, la diosa principal y dios del panteón pan-global D'Arsay. Parece que esos dioses tenían más que una simple importancia simbólica, ya que esos nombres incluso aparecían en documentos gubernamentales. Además, las principales tendencias del mercado y las decisiones políticas fueron asignadas, o incluso aparentemente culpadas, a uno de esos dos. Exactamente por qué eso sigue siendo un misterio. Se requiere más investigación.
STH_galactic_features.1040.name: Informe de investigación D'Arsay: resumen antropológico
STH_galactic_features.1041.desc:
El grupo de idiomas D'Arsay continúa desconcertando incluso nuestros algoritmos de traductor universal más avanzados y redes neuronales de autoaprendizaje. El nivel de complejidad y densidad de información que ofrece el script pictográfico de D'Arsay podría explicar los elementos corruptores abrumadores que encontramos cuando activamos el Archivo por primera vez. 

Cada pictografía puede corresponder a cientos de significados diferentes, dependiendo de sutiles matices de sintaxis, dialecto , modo de enfoque e incluso la posición social relativa del hablante con respecto al lector potencial del texto. Los sabios eruditos y los maestros de la sabiduría a menudo no solo juegan trucos con el uso de palabras arcaicas, sino también reglas arcaicas de gramática y modos de referencia que pueden cargar un texto de aspecto simple con simbolismo y portentos. Solo podemos imaginar el tipo de dispositivos de comunicación y algoritmos de autoaprendizaje necesarios para que la cultura moderna de D'Arsay tenga sentido para sí misma. ¿A qué podría haber evolucionado esta civilización si alguna vez hubiera tenido la oportunidad y logrado descubrir la tecnología Warp?
STH_galactic_features.1041.name: Informe de investigación D'Arsay: Idioma
STH_galactic_features.1042.desc:
Nuestros investigadores están llegando lentamente a una sorprendente conclusión sobre las personas de D'Arsay: eran poiquilotérmicos, lo que significa que sus cuerpos y estados mentales estaban muy influenciados por la fluctuación de la temperatura. Esto podría explicar su obsesión con el sol, o por qué Masaka, su diosa del sol, estaba tan ligada a tiempos de acciones brutas, sacrificios y guerras. 

 Llegamos a esta conclusión a partir de un cuidadoso estudio de los registros holográficos de D'Arsay. de sus antiguas ciudades. Está claro que la gestión del calor era primordial: edificios de piedra diseñados para transmitir calor hacia arriba, cámaras grandes, abiertas y fluidas destinadas a distribuir cuidadosamente el calor y la luz solar. La distinción drástica entre las cámaras aireadas y frías de Korgano y las fortalezas sofocantes de Maska ahora también tenía sentido. La propia arquitectura de los edificios y la forma en que canalizaban el calor darían forma al comportamiento de todos en el edificio.
STH_galactic_features.1042.name: Informe de investigación D'Arsay: fisiología
STH_galactic_features.105.name: El enjambre
STH_galactic_features.108.desc: La flota de enjambres de Altamid ha sido destruida y con ella la amenaza de [altamidLeader.GetName] a [Root.GetName].
STH_galactic_features.108.name: El enjambre
STH_galactic_features.109.desc: Después de la derrota de [FromFrom.GetName] por parte de [FromFromFrom.GetName], los analistas de [Root.Capital.GetName] han identificado una debilidad clave en la coordinación del enjambre. Una transmisión de alta amplitud podría, en teoría, interrumpir por completo el enjambre.
STH_galactic_features.109.name: El enjambre
STH_galactic_features.110.desc:
Los científicos de [Root.Capital.GetName] han identificado con éxito una modulación de señal y una frecuencia que interrumpirá la coordinación del enjambre de Altamid. 

 Ahora se empleará en todos los encuentros futuros con el enjambre.
STH_galactic_features.110.name: El enjambre
STH_galactic_features.111.desc:
El [FromFrom.GetName] ha activado el [FromFromFrom.GetName], con los efectos de la transmisión de interrupción del enjambre funcionando como se esperaba. 

El daño contra el enjambre aumenta significativamente.
STH_galactic_features.111.name: Saboteando el enjambre
STH_galactic_features.1500.desc:
Al acercarse al sistema [FromFrom.Solar_System.GetName], los sensores recibieron lecturas intermitentes en la órbita del tercer planeta. Poco después de abandonar la urdimbre, las lecturas aumentaron y una enorme estación espacial de composición y diseño indeterminado apareció como de la nada. 

Los intentos para comunicarse con los ocupantes de la estación no han tenido éxito hasta ahora.
STH_galactic_features.1500.name: Guardián Rubicun
STH_galactic_features.1510.desc: DIGA SU PROPÓSITO. \ ¿Y POR QUÉ ESTÁ AQUÍ? ¿QUÉ PRETENDES HACER A MIS HIJOS A CONTINUACIÓN? NO INTERFIERAS CON ELLOS.
STH_galactic_features.1510.name: Guardián Rubicun
STH_galactic_features.1521.desc:
A medida que se construye el puesto avanzado en el sistema [FromFrom.Solar_System.GetName], el enorme guardián de la estación espacial que orbita el tercer planeta aumenta su potencia de forma exponencial. 

Sin un medio de comunicación es imposible saber por qué lo ha hecho, pero el capitán de [FromFromFrom.GetFleetName] cree que puede ser una respuesta directa a la ubicación del puesto avanzado.
STH_galactic_features.1521.name: Guardián Rubicun
STH_galactic_features.1525.desc: SUS ESTRUCTURAS NO ESTÁN PERMITIDAS AQUÍ. SE LE DIJO NO INTERFERIR.
STH_galactic_features.1525.name: Guardián Rubicun
STH_galactic_features.2.desc:
Los sensores han detectado un recipiente de configuración desconocida que entra en órbita alrededor del planeta [doomsdayMachinePlanet.GetName], en el sistema [doomsdayMachineSystem.GetName]. 

 [Root.GetName] los estrategas están instando al envío de una nave estelar para investigar.
STH_galactic_features.2.name: Lecturas extrañas
STH_galactic_features.2000.desc:
El estudio de [Root.GetFleetName] de [From.GetName] ha revelado la presencia de extensos depósitos de pergium muy por debajo de la superficie del mundo árido. 

Aunque las técnicas de minería convencionales serían insuficientes para explotar los depósitos, los ingenieros a bordo del [Root.GetFleetName] creen que se puede acceder con una modesta inversión en tiempo y equipo. 

Enables $ decision_janus_mining_expansion_1 $ decisión sobre [De .GetName] una vez que se ha construido un puesto avanzado.
STH_galactic_features.2000.name: Depósitos extensos
STH_galactic_features.2001.desc: La expansión del complejo minero subterráneo en [From.GetName] se ha aprovechado con éxito en una rica veta de minerales raros.
STH_galactic_features.2001.name: Depósitos explotados
STH_galactic_features.2002.desc: La expansión del complejo minero subterráneo en [From.GetName] se ha aprovechado con éxito en una rica veta de pergium y otros minerales raros.
STH_galactic_features.2002.name: Depósitos explotados
STH_galactic_features.2003.desc: La expansión del complejo minero subterráneo en [From.GetName] se ha aprovechado con éxito en una rica veta de pergium y minerales electrodinámicos.
STH_galactic_features.2003.name: Depósitos explotados
STH_galactic_features.2004.desc: La expansión del complejo minero subterráneo en [From.GetName] se ha aprovechado con éxito en una rica veta de mineral de pergio entremezclado con gas de deuterio.
STH_galactic_features.2004.name: Depósitos explotados
STH_galactic_features.2005.desc: El equipo minero asignado para expandir los complejos subterráneos en [From.GetName] ha desaparecido en circunstancias misteriosas. Si bien no se ha detectado evidencia de sabotaje, los mineros restantes han comenzado a armarse al atravesar la red de cuevas.
STH_galactic_features.2005.name: Desastre minero
STH_galactic_features.2006.desc: La mayoría de la tripulación minera asignada para expandir los complejos subterráneos en [From.GetName] han desaparecido, y un solo sobreviviente informó que fueron víctimas de criaturas hostiles similares a rocas en lo profundo de la red de cuevas.
STH_galactic_features.2006.name: Diablo en la oscuridad
STH_galactic_features.2010.desc: El equipo científico enviado para investigar las criaturas aparentemente hostiles en [From.GetName] no pudo informar como se esperaba. Las fuerzas de seguridad locales creen que todos los involucrados han sido víctimas de criaturas similares a rocas, y a la luz de la acción hostil han recomendado una respuesta armada a la amenaza.
STH_galactic_features.2010.name: Diablo en la oscuridad
STH_galactic_features.2011.desc:
En lo profundo de las cavernas de [From.GetName], el equipo científico enviado para descubrir más sobre las criaturas detrás de los recientes ataques al programa de minería ha encontrado un llamado 'demonio en la oscuridad' que guarda un pequeño grupo de huevos esféricos y metálicos. 

Mientras el traductor universal no puede identificar el habla convencional, la criatura se muestra inteligente después de grabar las palabras 'no matar a I' en el piso de piedra. 

Las criaturas, reveladas como el 'Horta' silicoide, se comunican mediante sofisticadas emisiones químicas. Con los nuevos parámetros conocidos, un traductor universal a medida tiene cierto éxito al abrir un diálogo con la raza. 

Con la intención de aprender más sobre la galaxia más amplia, los Horta ofrecen sus servicios como mineros a [Root.GetName] con la condición de que puedan dirigir la expansión futura en [From.GetName] para evitar sus cámaras de guardería.
STH_galactic_features.2011.name: Diablo en la oscuridad
STH_galactic_features.2020.desc:
La mayoría de los equipos tácticos asignados para cazar a los llamados 'demonios en la oscuridad' que atacan las operaciones mineras en [From.GetName] han sido asesinados después de varios días de lucha. Las criaturas, muy resistentes a las armas de energía, atacaron ferozmente. 

Aunque los mineros restantes en [From.GetName] ahora están a salvo, el costo en vidas ha sido significativo.
STH_galactic_features.2020.name: Diablo en la oscuridad
STH_galactic_features.2021.desc:
Un pequeño número de los equipos tácticos asignados para cazar a los llamados 'demonios en la oscuridad' que atacan las operaciones mineras en [From.GetName] han sido asesinados después de varios días de lucha. Las criaturas, muy resistentes a las armas de energía, atacaron ferozmente. 

Los mineros restantes en [From.GetName] ahora están a salvo, aunque el costo en vidas ha atenuado el estado de ánimo.
STH_galactic_features.2021.name: Diablo en la oscuridad
STH_galactic_features.3001.desc: We have received a distress call from two transport vessels carrying a group of refugees belonging to a species calling themselves the El-Aurians. Should we send a vessel to attempt a rescue?
STH_galactic_features.3001.name: Refugee Transports in Danger
STH_galactic_features.3002.desc: With no attempt to rescue to Transport ships they are quickly overwhelmed by the forces within the Nexus and destroyed with the loss of all refugees and crew.
STH_galactic_features.3002.name: Transports destroyed
STH_galactic_features.3004.desc: Proximity to the Nexus was always going to be dangerous, and so it proved to be for the [nexus_ship.GetName] a stray band of energy was attracted by the [nexus_ship.GetName]'s warp core and the ship was destroyed with all hands.
STH_galactic_features.3004.name: Ship destroyed by the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3005.desc: Sitting back at a safe distance the [nexus_ship.GetName] is able to gather some useful scans of the Nexus, which will prove extremly useful to our scientists. As expected the two Transport ships were unable to survive the forces within the Nexus and were quickly destroyed.
STH_galactic_features.3005.name: Research gained
STH_galactic_features.3006.desc:
The crew of the [nexus_ship.GetName] were able to traverse the outer layers of the Nexus with skill and safely approach the stranded El-Aurian vessels. A quick scan reveals that there hulls are in a dangerous state and all aboard appear to be in a strange state of flux.

The crew offer a number of solutions, move the ship closer to the stricken ships at risk to all aboard the [nexus_ship.GetName] or attempt a long distance transport.
STH_galactic_features.3006.name: Entering the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3007.desc: Travelling so deep within the subspace Nexus was always going to be dangerous and so it proved for the [nexus_ship.GetName], the forces within Nexus soon overwhelmed the hull of ship destroying it with the loss of all onboard.
STH_galactic_features.3007.name: Ship destroyed by the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3008.desc: Thanks to the efforts of those onboard [nexus_ship.GetName] the passengers and crew of the El-Aurian ships were rescued from their transports. The El-Aurians dazed and confused officially asked for a new home within our borders or a sample of their collective wisdom if they were not welcome on any of our planets.
STH_galactic_features.3008.name: El-Aurians Rescued
STH_galactic_features.3009.desc:
Having rescued the El-Aurian survivors the crew were able to safely back out of the Nexus and return to the safety of normal space. 

As the Nexus resumes its journey through space, it leaves behind more of a mystery.
STH_galactic_features.3009.name: Leaving the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3010.desc:
In a bid to escape the clutches of the Nexus [lost_leader.GetName] made their way to deflector control in a bid to use the ships deflector to free the ship. As the ship was leaving an errant wave of energy struck the ship resulting in hull breach not far from [lost_leader.GetName]'s location.

There is no sign of the captain following the breach.
STH_galactic_features.3010.name: [lost_leader.GetName] lost to the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3011.desc:
Having rescued the El-Aurian survivors the crew were attempting to leave the Nexus and return to the safety of normal space. 

As the ship was nearly clear a stray wave of energy lept from the Nexus striking the ship causing significant damage.
STH_galactic_features.3011.name: Ship damaged within the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3012.name: Into the Nexus
STH_galactic_features.3013.desc: As feared the transporter was unable to secure a strong enough lock on the transport vessels at this distance. Forcing the [nexus_ship.GetName] deeper into the Nexus. Leaving only limited options left to the crew to save the refugees and escape the Nexus.
STH_galactic_features.3013.name: Rescue attempt failed
STH_galactic_features.3014.desc: Failure to attempt to rescue the El-Aurian survivors has led to the destruction of their ships and possibly the last remaining El-Aurians left in the galaxy.
STH_galactic_features.3014.name: Transport ships destroyed
STH_galactic_features.3015.desc:
Upon arriviing at the scene, the [nexus_ship.GetName] came across an unusal sight. A giant ribbon in space travelling across the sector.

Within the ribbon, dubbed the Nexus, two small transport ships appear to be stuck and adrift, their hulls dangerously close to collapsing.
STH_galactic_features.3015.name: Energy ribbon in space
STH_galactic_features.3017.desc:
We are receiving word that [exploding_star.GetName] has exploded without warning, the star was considered to be a mainstream star with millions of years of life left within in it. 

The shockwave produced by the star has destroyed all planets and objects within the system. 

Our scientists are unable to explain what occured, but were able to pick up a small trilithium signiture.
STH_galactic_features.3017.name: Star Explodes Unexpectedly
STH_galactic_features.3018.desc: We have received another report of a star exploding without warning, again this has come as a complete surprise with no warning or indication the star was going to go supernova. Scans show that all nuclear reactions in a star stopped, thereby causing its collapse, the only unusual reading from the system picked up the galactic phenomenon known colloquially as the Nexus passing through the region.
STH_galactic_features.3018.name: Another Star Explodes
STH_galactic_features.3020.desc:
The [amargosa_ship.GetName] arrives at the stricken observatory too late to stop the attack, but were able to pick up faint life signs from within the complex. Sending an away team down to investigate, they find a number of scientists including the Research Team director, Dr. Tolian Soran, an El-Aurian with notable work into the life-cycle of stellar objects. 

Despite objections from the Doctor the scientists are recovered and brought back aboard [amargosa_ship.GetName].
STH_galactic_features.3020.name: Observatory Under Attack
STH_galactic_features.3021.desc:
Hurrying to retrieve Dr.Soran from the Observatory, [amargosa_ship_leader.GetName] and Security Officer find the Doctor in a previously hidden section of the station. The Doctor looks up from a console having just fired an unknown device towards the sun and past the unexpecting Starfleet ship in orbit. 

The Doctor draws a weapon from beneath his cloak and fires at the away team, offering the team the chance to leave before the shockwave hits the outpost or risk all attempting a futile effort to capture him.
STH_galactic_features.3021.name: Time is the fire in which we burn
STH_galactic_features.3022.desc:
After a short phaser fight, the Doctor is beamed away from the battle by a previously cloaked Bird-of-Prey, looking around [amargosa_ship_leader.GetName] finds evidence of other Trilithium torpedoes with pre-programmed destinations as well as a series of notes containing details about a ribbon in space, called the Nexus. 

Whatever the Doctor was doing here will have to wait as the shockwave from the exploding star is approaching the observatory.
STH_galactic_features.3022.name: The Doctor Escapes
STH_galactic_features.3023.desc:
The Doctor is apparently prepared to defend his research with fierce determination and equipped with a deadly hand phaser, he is able to injure [amargosa_ship_leader.GetName]. As the Security Chief rushes to aid his Captain, Soran escapes to a hidden Bird-of-Prey. 

The Captain has the presence of mind to direct his officer to scan some of the remaining torpedoes and they recover some limited knowledge of a space entity named the Nexus and these Trilithium Torpedoes that lay scattered about. 

With the shockwave from the exploding sun fast approaching the away team beam away from the station.
STH_galactic_features.3023.name: Crew Member Wounded
STH_galactic_features.3024.desc:
The Doctor is apparently prepared to defend his research with fierce determination and equipped with a deadly hand phaser, firing a swift volley he hits [amargosa_ship_leader.GetName] in the chest killing him immediately. Soran escapes to a hidden Bird-of-Prey as the Security Chief rushes to her Captain. 

The Security Officer has the presence of mind to direct their tricorder to take a scan of the remaining torpedoes and they recover some limited knowledge of a space entity named the Nexus and these Trilithium Torpedoes that lay scattered about. 

With the shockwave from the exploding sun fast approaching the remaining members of the away team beam back to the ship.
STH_galactic_features.3024.name: [amargosa_ship_leader.GetName] Killed
STH_galactic_features.3025.desc:
With little time to react to the events at the observatory the mysterious torpedo strikes the [amargosa_destination_sun.GetName] Sun and suddenly all nuclear reactions within the star stopped, causing the star to explode and sending out a level 12 shockwave easily capable of destroying everything within the star system. 

The crew has no choice but to retreat and regroup.
STH_galactic_features.3025.name: Star Explodes
STH_galactic_features.3026.name: An Appointment with Eternity
STH_galactic_features.3028.desc: As the star that [generations_crash_1.GetName] explodes, the shockwave pushes the energy ribbon known as the Nexus towards the planet, where Doctor Soran weights with arms outstretched, oblivious to the loss of life to those within the system.
STH_galactic_features.3028.name: Failed to Reach Soran in Time
STH_galactic_features.3029.desc: Arriving at the planet and running a full scan it is clear to the crew that they have made the wrong choice and Soran and his weapon are not on the planet. Judging by the amount of time remaining we will have one final chance to pick the right location and stop the Doctor.
STH_galactic_features.3029.name: Wrong Choice of Planet
STH_galactic_features.3031.desc: The [veridian_ship.GetName] arrives in orbit, scanning the planet reveals that Soran is already at the launch site preparing the torpedo, with the Bird-of-Prey nowhere in sight. [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] beams down to the planet in a last ditched attempt to stop the mad doctor from unleashing his plan.
STH_galactic_features.3031.name: It's like a predator; it's stalking you
STH_galactic_features.3032.desc: Back in orbit of the planet, an old Klingon Bird-of-Prey decloaks and opens fire on the Starfleet ship taking it by surprise. The Klingon ship is captained by the Duras Sisters, Lursa and Be'tor who would love nothing better than to take down a Starfleet ship by notorious means.
STH_galactic_features.3032.name: Time is going to hunt you down... and make the kill
STH_galactic_features.3033.desc:
As the Duras Sister's ship explodes in a fireball, the [veridian_ship.GetName] begins to access the damage, the first shot having previously taken the shields down resulting in extensive damage across the ship's key systems. 

The Chief Engineer frantically calls the bridge about the last torpedo which hit the ship.
STH_galactic_features.3033.name: Duras Sisters Defeated
STH_galactic_features.3035.desc: The Duras Sister's first attack disabled the shields and from there the attack relentlessly pummeled the ship's hull until a fatal shot hit the warp core. In a last-gasp effort to save the ship and crew the Commander attempts to 'land' the ship on the planet below.
STH_galactic_features.3035.name: Duras Sisters Victorious
STH_galactic_features.3036.desc:
As the battle rages above them, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] makes their way toward Soran's location. 

Overcoming a menacing red forcefield the Captain approaches the Doctor's position and prepares to stop him.
STH_galactic_features.3036.name: Time is the fire in which we burn
STH_galactic_features.3037.desc:
Soran with grace and speed that defies his years, spots the incoming Captain, as the two battle atop the mountain with time running down. 

 [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] gets the upper hand and manages to reach the launch pad, but it is too late the torpedo fires from the chamber and soars into the sky, mere seconds later the Sun goes dark, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] has failed and the Nexus is coming.
STH_galactic_features.3037.name: So many things unfinished in our lives
STH_galactic_features.3038.desc: [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] opens [veridian_ship_leader.GetHisHer] eyes to the bright lights and warm glow of a fireplace, glistening with the fine decorations of a Christmas Day. With their family and friends around them, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] smiles with pure joy, this sort of family love is something they could only ever have dreamed of.
STH_galactic_features.3038.name: Time has no meaning there
STH_galactic_features.3039.desc: As the lights dance back and forth invitingly and the sound of carols can be heard mixed with the welcoming chorus of laughter and love, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] cannot imagine a time when they felt happier or more content.
STH_galactic_features.3039.name: Time has no meaning there
STH_galactic_features.3040.desc: The single glint from a red bauble brings back the memory of a life once led, the image of a mountainside and the red firey crackle of a ribbon echoing alongside the Christmas tinsel. [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] wonders if there is something else they should be doing.
STH_galactic_features.3040.name: You could stay forever...
STH_galactic_features.3041.desc: Breaking free of the Nexus' grasp [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] finds themself in another person's experience, exploring further they find [leader_stuck_in_nexus.GetName], thought lost many years ago. Approaching the lost hero [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] attempts to convince the lost hero to return with them to face Soran and save the galaxy one last time.
STH_galactic_features.3041.name: Who am I to argue with history?
STH_galactic_features.3042.name: Sometimes it takes courage to try
STH_galactic_features.3043.desc: As the dust settles on the battle, the torpedo remains locked in the firing chamber, Soran lies defeated, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] looks around to celebrate with [leader_stuck_in_nexus.GetName]. Unable to find the returning hero, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] calls out and to their horror finds them lying injured, having given their life to once again save the lives of the innocent. uttering a final 'oh my' as they pass, having once again proven to be a hero.
STH_galactic_features.3043.name: Never let them take you off the bridge of that ship
STH_galactic_features.3044.desc: As the dust settles on the battle, the torpedo remains locked in the firing chamber, Soran lies defeated, [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] looks around to celebrate with [leader_stuck_in_nexus.GetName] finding them, the two leaders embrace knowing that they have saved the lives of an innocent civilization, who may never even know their names.
STH_galactic_features.3044.name: Never let them take you off the bridge of that ship
STH_galactic_features.3045.desc:
Despite all the team has been through, the sound of the torpedo launching from the pad roars out hurtling toward the sun, Soran might have been defeated but it has all been in vain. For what feels like an eternity the projectile heads upwards into the sky, before reaching its target. 

The sun blinks out of existence, and the deadly shockwave will soon follow, knowing there will be no third chance [veridian_ship_leader.GetName] settles to face the end.
STH_galactic_features.3045.name: History Repeats itself
STH_galactic_features.3046.desc: [veridian_ship.GetName] hurtles towards the planet's surface at incredible speeds, and only the skills of the helms person manage to level the descent and prevent further disaster. As the ship hits the planet's surface gauging a deep wound into the surrounding forest and sliding for miles before coming to its final resting place.
STH_galactic_features.3046.name: Crash Landing
STH_galactic_features.3047.desc: We are receiving a distress call from one of our Stellar Observatories which hosts a group of talented scientists working on stellar observations. It appears they are under attack from unknown forces. We should send them aid as soon as possible.
STH_galactic_features.3047.name: Distress Call from Observatory
STH_galactic_features.3050.name: Shore Leave
STH_galactic_features.3051.desc: After a memorable few days relaxing [holiday_leader.GetName] and [holiday_leader.GetHerHim] crew are feeling relaxed and ready to return to duty with an extra spring in their step.
STH_galactic_features.3051.name: Shore Leave
STH_galactic_features.3052.desc: Not every holiday is a good one, sometimes the weather ruins it, sometimes a band of thugs desguise themselves as beautiful dancers and tie you up and leave you overnight without your uniform. Whatever the reason this was not a good shore leave for the crew of [holiday_fleet.GetName] and a few days they would rather forget.
STH_galactic_features.3052.name: Shore Leave
STH_galactic_features.3100.desc: One of our research teams on the planet [mugato_world_planet.GetName] has failed to check in, they were investigating deep within the jungles of that planet. There last report indicated there were wild Mugato loose within the jungles. The planetary authorities are calling in [Root.GetName] to assist and deal with the situation.
STH_galactic_features.3100.name: Wild Mugato!
STH_galactic_features.3101.desc:
The plan to round up the wild Mugato has gone terribly wrong, the beasts were not willing to go quietly and an effort to capture the animals [mugato_leader.GetName] was struck by one of them and severly wounded. Medical teams were able to save their life.

Our only remaining option is to send in the army to secure the area.
STH_galactic_features.3101.name: Leader injured by Mugato
STH_galactic_features.3102.desc:
The plan to round up the wild Mugato has gone horrifically wrong, the beasts were not willing to go quietly and an effort to capture the animals [mugato_leader.GetName] was struck by one of them, the poison acted quickly and despite the efforts of the medical units they were unable to save [mugato_leader.GetName].

Our only option now is to send in the army.
STH_galactic_features.3102.name: Leader killed by Mugato
STH_galactic_features.3103.desc:
Our efforts to contain and round up the Mugato has been a success, despite initial resistance the beasts were subdued by [mugato_leader.GetName] without harming any of the creatures. 

We now have a couple of options, we can convert the area into a nature reserve, where a conservation team can care and protect them or we can transport them offworld to a safe location.
STH_galactic_features.3103.name: Mugato rounded up
STH_galactic_features.3104.desc: On closer investigation our teams have uncovered a smuggler ring on [mugato_world_planet.GetName] right under our noses! The ground team successfully manage to disrupt the operation, however the ring leader manages to escape to their ship and in an attempt to flee the planet runs into [mugato_ship.GetName] waiting in orbit.
STH_galactic_features.3104.name: Smuggler Ring Found
STH_galactic_features.3105.desc:
[mugato_ship.GetName] successfully reports the capture of the smuggler command ship, faced with superior firepower the smugglers quickly surrender. 

We now have a couple of options, we can convert the area into a nature reserve, where a conservation team can care and protect the Mugato or we can transport the creatures offworld to a safe location.
STH_galactic_features.3105.name: Smugglers Captured
STH_galactic_features.3106.desc: The smuggler ship manages to send a feedback pulse which disrupts [mugato_ship.GetName]'s tractor beam. To make matters worse they manage to send out a call for aid and are joined by a band of mercenaries. Keen to avoid capture and relinquishing their prize specimens they prepare to attack our ships.
STH_galactic_features.3106.name: Reinforcements arrive for the Smugglers
STH_galactic_features.3107.desc:
Following an intense battle our forces were successfully able to defeat the smugglers and recover the stolen Mugato.

We now have a couple of options, we can convert the area into a nature reserve, where a conservation team can care and protect them or we can transport them offworld to a safe location.
STH_galactic_features.3107.name: Smugglers Defeated
STH_galactic_features.3108.desc:
Our army under the careful leadership of [army_mugato_leader.GetName] manage to succeed where our previous efforts failed and our teams have managed to round up the wild Mugato. 

We now have a couple of options, we can convert the area into a nature reserve, where a conservation team can care and protect them or we can transport them offworld to a safe location.
STH_galactic_features.3108.name: Army successfully Capture Mugato
STH_galactic_features.3200.desc:
A command officer's life is normally all work and little play, however there are sometimes odd occassions following a tough assignment or conference that there is a small window for officers to get together and let their hair down. 

It just so happens that such a window has opened at [starbase_meeting_point.GetName].
STH_galactic_features.3200.name: Command Level Social
STH_galactic_features.3201.desc: On arrival at [starbase_meeting_point.GetName] [party_leader_1.GetName] is greeted by a fine array of food dishes and beverages across [Root.GetName] space. It is time to relax and enjoy the company of their fellow officers and wait for any additional arrivals.
STH_galactic_features.3201.name: Command Level Social
STH_galactic_features.3202.desc: At arriving at the front door of the venue, [party_leader_1.GetName] is greated by a dower looking bouncer, who checks a list and shakes their head refusing access to the venue. Frustrated [party_leader_1.GetName] has no choice but to leave and complain about their treatment.
STH_galactic_features.3202.name: Entry Refused
STH_galactic_features.3203.desc:
On arrival at [starbase_meeting_point.GetName] [party_leader_2.GetName] is suitably impressed by the ongoing celebration surrounded by all the finer things from within [Root.GetName] space. They spot [party_leader_1.GetName] and head over to mingle. 

It is time to relax and enjoy the company of their fellow officers and wait for any additional arrivals.
STH_galactic_features.3203.name: Time to Party
STH_galactic_features.3204.desc:
At arriving at the front door of the venue, [party_leader_2.GetName] is greated by a dower looking bouncer, who checks a list and shakes their head refusing access to the venue. Despite several exclamations asking if they knew who [party_leader_2.GetSheHe] was, [party_leader_2.GetName] is forced to reluctantly give up. 

Before they can return to their ship the first officer suggests they look for a local venue to try and salvage the night.
STH_galactic_features.3204.name: Entry Refused
STH_galactic_features.3205.desc:
After searching the Starbases expansive promenade [party_leader_2.GetName] and [party_leader_2.GetHerHis] team find a small unassuming establishment. They are welcomed inside by a team of lower deckers who are already inside and having a fun night. 

Senior Officers and Lower Deck crew share an thoroughly fun evening leaving morale at an all time high.
STH_galactic_features.3205.name: A good night after all
STH_galactic_features.3206.desc: Unable to find another venue, the Captain and [party_leader_2.GetHerHis] guests decide that the outing is over. Each of them feeling it has been a waste of a trip, they return to their vessel and prepare to head off on their next assignment.
STH_galactic_features.3206.name: A disappointing night
STH_galactic_features.3207.desc: On arrival at [starbase_meeting_point.GetName] [party_leader_3.GetName] joins the celebration as it is in full swing, laughing and enjoying the company of their fellow officers. Beckoned over by [party_leader_1.GetName] and [party_leader_2.GetName] now the celebration can begin!
STH_galactic_features.3207.name: Time to Party
STH_galactic_features.3210.name: A celebration to remember
STH_galactic_features.3211.desc: Not every opportunity can be taken and the chance to relax and enjoy the social interaction with fellow officers would have been a nice way to spend an evening.
STH_galactic_features.3211.name: An opportunity missed
STH_galactic_features.4.name: Planeta Eater
STH_galactic_features.5.name: Planeta Eater
STH_galactic_features.6.name: Planeta Eater
STH_galactic_features.7.desc:
El arma alienígena ha sido destruida y un posible escenario apocalíptico evitado para todos los mundos habitados en este sector de la galaxia. 

Cuando queda poco de la propia arma, una serie de haces procesados ​​de los diversos planetas que había consumido han sobrevivido a la batalla.
STH_galactic_features.7.name: Día del juicio final
STH_galactic_features.8.name: Lecturas extrañas
STH_galactic_war.101.desc:
Greetings my Chancellor, I am T'Kuvma of the House T'Kuvma and I come to you with a request on behalf of my house. The House of T'Kuvma has fallen from power and I seek to return us to our former position of strength, I set out to seek the ship of my ancestors, the Ship of the Dead.

With this ship I promise great things for the Empire and for T'Kuvma.
STH_galactic_war.101.name: An audiance with the House of T'Kuvma
STH_galactic_war.103.desc:
My Chancellor, I have recovered the ship of my ancestors and now I know my true purpose. For two long we have lost what it truly means to be Klingon as our neighbours claims worlds that should be ours and our warriors grow fat and dull fighting amongst themselves. 

We have strayed from the path that Kahless set out for us and lost what it is to Remain Klingon, grant me your bless to go forth and light the beacon and unite the houses in glorious combat against a common foe.
STH_galactic_war.103.name: The House of T'Kuvma
STH_galactic_war.104.desc: Our attempts to kill T'Kuvma and his heretic House have failed and he has rebelled against his Empire and Chancellor, we cannot let this act of dishonour go unpunished, send the fleets to put this targ down.
STH_galactic_war.104.name: T'Kuvma Rebels
STH_galactic_war.105.desc: The traitor T'Kuvma and his House of crazed fools has been crushed in glorious combat against the true warriors of the Klingon Empire. Let this be a lesson to any House that feels it is bigger than the Empire.
STH_galactic_war.105.name: T'Kuvma Defeated
STH_galactic_war.106.desc: Our operatives have successfully executed the traitor T'Kuvma ending his heretical views and his challenge to the Empire.
STH_galactic_war.106.name: T'Kuvma Executed
STH_galactic_war.108.desc: One of our long range relay stations in the Eagle-12 system has stopped reporting in. The relay is orbitting a binary star system with some extreme conditions as the two stars clash and form new worlds. The Starfleet Corp of Engineers believe the station has probably suffered a technical malfunction and are requesting a ship be sent to bring the station back online.
STH_galactic_war.108.name: Contact lost with remote relay station
STH_galactic_war.109.desc: [battle_binary_leader_selected.GetName] has reported back in from Eagle-12 with concerning news, on investigating the relay it appears that the equipment was deliberately targeted by disruptor weaponary, the station is completely inoperable and will need to be replaced. Recommend we investigate further.
STH_galactic_war.109.name: Binary Stars
STH_galactic_war.11.desc:
After years of over zealous expansion those soft-skinned fools in the United Federation of Planets have finally pushed and bullied themselves into a position that puts them in contact with our borders, colonising several worlds that by rights should belong to us. 

Many senior figures back on Cardassia Prime believe we have been too passive for too long, whilst this Federation clearly builds up a military presence along our borders and within striking distance of our worlds.
STH_galactic_war.11.name: Federation-Cardassian Border Tension
STH_galactic_war.110.desc: Having left the safety of their ship [battle_binary_leader_selected.GetName] entered the asteroid field around the Binary Stars to investigate who or what caused the damage to the probe, the mission was progressing smoothly until another contact entered the location. Armed only with a long sleek metallic sword the intruder attacked [battle_binary_leader_selected.GetName]. Barely escaping with their lives the Captain was able to identify their attackers as...
STH_galactic_war.110.name: The Vulcan Hello
STH_galactic_war.111.desc: We have become complacent in the time since we last battled the Federation at Donatu V. Our purity is a threat to them. They wish to drag us into the muck where Humans, Vulcans, Tellarites, and filthy Andorians mix... Great leaders, everything I say will come to pass. Look to the stars…our destiny has arrived. Here it comes. Their lie…
STH_galactic_war.111.name: Battle of the Binary Stars
STH_galactic_war.112.desc: A conflict has broken out between the forces of Starfleet and the Klingon Empire in a Binary Star system. Battles between these two powers are often fiercly fought and we shall soon see how the balance of power shifts in the quadrant following this engagement.
STH_galactic_war.112.name: Skirmish between Klingon and Federation Forces
STH_galactic_war.113.desc: House T'Kuvma has engaged in open conflict with the Federation fleets at the Binary Stars, our long range reports suggest the battle is raging across the system with casualties on both sides. We shall wait on the output before directing our next move.
STH_galactic_war.113.name: Battle of the Binary Stars
STH_galactic_war.114.name: Battle of the Binary Stars
STH_galactic_war.115.desc: The Beacon of Kahless has been lit signalling other Houses to join T'Kuvma in his crusade to purify the Klingon Empire. Warriors across the Empire are eager to seek glory and victory against the Federation.
STH_galactic_war.115.name: Fleets flock to T'Kuvma
STH_galactic_war.118.desc: Despite putting up a fierce fight the Klingon leader known as T'Kuvma of the House T'Kuvma has been defeated on the battlefield by Starfeet forces. During his crusade a great number of Klingon warriors have flocked to his cause to maintain the purity of the Klingon species. It remains to be seen what impact this will now have on the Klingon Empire.
STH_galactic_war.118.name: T'Kuvma Defeated
STH_galactic_war.12.desc:
Our operatives within the Obsidian Order have identified an oppertunity to strike at a key meeting being held within Federation space, our agents report that they are hosting a war summit with their allies discussing their plans to attack our borders and arm their colonies to use them as staging grounds in a war against the Union. 

The Obsidian Order recommeneds commissioning a covert operation to sabotage this conference and disrupt their plans.
STH_galactic_war.12.name: Federation War Conference
STH_galactic_war.120.desc:
Our death toll continues to rise following the Battle of the Binary Stars, including the tragic loss of [battle_binary_leader_selected.GetName] their service to Starfleet and the Federation will never be forgotten. 

The Empires victories seem to enspired many to pick up the cause and join T'Kuvma's crusade.
STH_galactic_war.120.name: Federation Loses
STH_galactic_war.121.name: Remain Klingon
STH_galactic_war.122.desc: The Klingon Empire has declared war against us, it is clear their attack on our forces at Eagle-12 was provocation to build an anger against us. Their belief that to Remain Klingon is to challenge and defeat other powers is a threat to not only our civilisation, but all that stand between them and they glory thet seek.
STH_galactic_war.122.name: Klingons Declare War
STH_galactic_war.123.desc: Whilst many on the Federation Council feared the worst following the ambush at Eagle-12 it seems that cooler heads have prevailed within the High Council on Qo'nos and they have backed away from war. Our relations with the Empire remain strained.
STH_galactic_war.123.name: Klingons Back Down
STH_galactic_war.126.desc: True to his word T'Kuvma has discovered the Beacon of Kahless within the space of the Federation, this fabled Beacon is said to unite the Houses in a common goal and against a common foe to bring the ultimate glory to the whole empire.
STH_galactic_war.126.name: The Beacon of Kahless
STH_galactic_war.127.desc: The Beacon of Kahless has been lit by House T'Kuvma. The glorious light shines across the galaxy signalling other Houses to join T'Kuvma in his crusade to purify the Klingon Empire. Warriors across the Empire are eager to seek glory and victory against the Federation.
STH_galactic_war.127.name: The Beacon of Kahless
STH_galactic_war.129.desc: We have become complacent in the time since we last battled the Federeation at Donatu V. Our purity is a threat to them. They wish to drag us into the muck where Humans, Vulcans, Tellarites, and filthy Andorians mix... Great leaders, everything I say will come to pass. Look to the stars…our destiny has arrived. Here it comes. Their lie…
STH_galactic_war.129.name: Battle of the Binary Stars
STH_galactic_war.131.desc: The Ship of the Dead, the Duj Heg, has been discovered lying abandoned on the surface of some forgotten world. The engineers of the House of T'Kuvma have worked to restore the ancient vessel to its former glory a ship of extreme power ready to restore the glory back to the House and to the Empire.
STH_galactic_war.131.name: Ship of the Dead recovered
STH_galactic_war.133.desc: The end to this war may be in sight, our forces have managed to defeat the Klingon war leader Kol in battle, if our intelligence is to be believed Kol is instrumental in unifying the Klingon Houses in their war efforts against us. With Kol dead we only hope the Klingons thirst for battle is ended.
STH_galactic_war.133.name: Klingon War Leader Killed
STH_galactic_war.134.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] our war leader Kol has been slain in battle and with it ends the Beacon of Kahless, our warriors now believe the crusade to be over and honour to have been satisfied.
STH_galactic_war.134.name: Kol Killed in combat
STH_galactic_war.135.desc: The Cardassian Union has accepted our proposal to form a new DMZ between our two states, the Federation council has pledged to help anyone wishing to relocate to a federation world, but with the majority of colonists wishing to stay under the terms of the treaty we cannot aid them.
STH_galactic_war.135.name: DMZ Created
STH_galactic_war.14.desc: As part of our drive for continued peace and in the spirit of further coperation our diplomatic corp has arrange a conference with [cardassian_federation_border_war_neighbour.GetName] on [cardassian_federation_border_war_bombing_planet.GetName] . Starfleet is requested to dispatch a ship and crew to help facilitate the conference.
STH_galactic_war.14.name: Federation-[cardassian_federation_border_war_neighbour.GetName] Peace Summit
STH_galactic_war.15.desc: It appears the Federation may have gotten wind of our plans and have cancelled their conference, but all is not lost as our agents were able to infiltrate one of their starbases on the border of Cardassian space and destroy one of their starbase facilities orbitting [bw_ufp_planet_target_01.GetName], this will cause them a significant impact in any operations they maybe running against us in this system.
STH_galactic_war.15.name: Sabotage Operation
STH_galactic_war.16.name: Starbase over [bw_ufp_planet_target_02.GetName] sabotaged!
STH_galactic_war.17.name: Embassy Bombing
STH_galactic_war.18.desc: Our efforts to dissuade the vile Federation from continuing to encroach on our territory have so far failed to keep them in their own home system, it is now time to give them a direct warning that even those feeble minded fools can understand.
STH_galactic_war.18.name: Federation-Cardassian Border Tension
STH_galactic_war.19.desc:
Attention [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], this is your first and final warning from the Cardassian Union. You will cease all operations along our border, the arming and provokation of your colonists will end immediately and your activities in our border region will hault. 

Should you continue to test our resolve you will see that the Cardassian Union has teeth, just ask your recent wounded.
STH_galactic_war.19.name: Incoming Transmission from Cardassia Prime
STH_galactic_war.2.desc:
Dev Note: We have introduced a new feature to STNH called Canon Galactic Wars, by enabling this mode a number of events will spawn throughout your playthrough that can lead to one of the wars seen through Star Trek history. 

Each situation has a set of triggers that will cause it to fire, so the state of your STNH galaxy will directly influence which wars you may see and the outcome of each war will have a knock-on to how your game progresses. 

If you prefer a more random and natural playthough we recommend you do not active this game mode. 

The mode can be switched on or off at any time via the Stellaris console by running event STH_galactic_war.2 or speak with Q via the contacts menu.
STH_galactic_war.2.name: Galactic Wars
STH_galactic_war.20.desc:
An outbreak of the Tanerian Plague has been reported on [border_war_plague_planet.GetName] in the [border_war_plague_planet.Solar_System.GetName] system. 

While the local quarantine has so far succeeded in containing the infection within a handful of settlements on the planet, it may soon spread if untreated. 

Authorities on [border_war_plague_planet.GetName] have requested the dispatch of a medical team to the planet immediately.
STH_galactic_war.20.name: Healthcare Emergency declared on [border_war_plague_planet.GetName]
STH_galactic_war.21.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] reports from our field operatives have uncovered further evidence of the Federation delivering weapons to a ilitary outpost along our border, their claims that the ships is on a mission of mercy should be dismissed as desperate lies of a weak people.
STH_galactic_war.21.name: Federation Arming Civillians
STH_galactic_war.22.name: [cardassia_ufp_border_ship_violation.GetName] destroyed whilst on humanitarian mission
STH_galactic_war.24.desc:
Over the last few months tensions between the Federation and Cardassia have been rising and this week culminated with the suspected attack on a Federation vessel by a Cardassian squadron. 

Whilst the Cardassians have not formally accepted responsibility most powers in the region agree they are the likely culprits.
STH_galactic_war.24.name: Tension rises between the UFP and Cardassia Prime
STH_galactic_war.25.name: Transmission from Starfleet
STH_galactic_war.26.desc: [Root.GetRulerName], our latest reports in from Obsidian Order agents strongly show that the Federation has built a new military defence post on [bw_massacre_planet.GetName], this can only be for a singular purpose, as a staging ground for an attack against our border. Our miltary commanders have prepared a plan off attack against this world and we should strike whilst they are unprepared for an attack.
STH_galactic_war.26.name: The final straw
STH_galactic_war.27.desc:
Federation fools, your attempts to hide your true intentions on [bw_massacre_planet.GetName] have not gone unnoticed by the watchful guys of our Cardassian superiors, consider the world of [bw_massacre_planet.GetName] and the surrounding colonies of [ufp_border_planet_01.GetName], [ufp_border_planet_02.GetName], [ufp_border_planet_03.GetName], [ufp_border_planet_014.GetName] as properties of the Cardassian Union. 

You will swiftly experience the might of the Cardassian military forces.
STH_galactic_war.27.name: A declaration of War
STH_galactic_war.28.desc: After months of speculation and rising hostility open warfare has been declared between Starfleet and Cardassia Prime following the invasion of one of their border colonies by Cardassian forces.
STH_galactic_war.28.name: War between Cardassia and the Federation
STH_galactic_war.29.desc: The rising hostility between the Federation and Cardassia ended today when the Federation President ceded a number of border worlds to the Cardassian government and agreed the creation of a DMZ between the two powers.
STH_galactic_war.29.name: UFP cedes worlds to Cardassia
STH_galactic_war.31.desc: Reports are coming in from across the remote world of [bw_massacre_planet.GetName] the Cardassians have launched an unprovoked and savage attack against this planet, claiming it to be a first strike against our forces. We must send aid to [bw_massacre_planet.GetName] as soon as possible and end this massacre against our colonists.
STH_galactic_war.31.name: Massacre on [bw_massacre_planet.GetName]
STH_galactic_war.33.desc:
Greetings, [root.owner.GetRulerName] from across the border, this tension along our borders has gone on for far too long. It does neither of us any good to be at this heightened state of alert for such a long period. 

We propose a peace deal to end this conflict.
STH_galactic_war.33.name: Peace Achieved
STH_galactic_war.34.desc:
Greetings, [root.owner.GetRulerName] from across the border, this tension along our borders has gone on for far too long. It does neither of us any good to be at this heightened state of alert for such a long period. 

We propose a peace deal to end this conflict.
STH_galactic_war.34.name: Peace Achieved
STH_galactic_war.35.desc: An agreement has been reached between the governments on Cardassia and Earth to form a Demilitarized Zone between the Federation and Cardassian Union in an attempt to end the open hostility between the two major powers.
STH_galactic_war.35.name: Demilitarised Zone Created
STH_galactic_war.36.desc:
The DMZ separating the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] has been dismantled, following the agreed cut-off date in the establishing treaty. 

Systems ceded to the Zone have been returned to their previous owners.
STH_galactic_war.36.name: [Root.GetName] - [From.GetName] DMZ Dismantled
STH_galactic_war.40.desc:
Following the border wars with [From.GetName] many on the Federation security council are pressing for the declaration of a Demilitarised zone between the Federation and Cardassian Union with both sides seeding their claims to the worlds within the zones. 

Whilst this may displease those who live within the region, the lasting peace will secure their safety.
STH_galactic_war.40.name: Time to set up a demilitarized zone
STH_galactic_war.42.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained as a result of the recent border war. As such, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has proposed the establishment of a DMZ along the shared border, lasting for a period of 5 years. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] will be temporarily ceded to establish the Zone.
STH_galactic_war.42.name: Proposed DMZ
STH_galactic_war.43.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained as a result of the recent border war. As such, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has proposed the establishment of a DMZ along the shared border, lasting for a period of 10 years. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] will be temporarily ceded to establish the Zone.
STH_galactic_war.43.name: Proposed DMZ
STH_galactic_war.44.desc:
Relations with the [From.GetName] have been strained as a result of the recent border war. As such, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has proposed the establishment of a DMZ along the shared border, lasting for a period of 15 years. 

Note: Systems along the border of both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] will be temporarily ceded to establish the Zone.
STH_galactic_war.44.name: Proposed DMZ
STH_galactic_war.45.desc: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have agreed to establish a new DMZ in order to de-escalate the risk of military confrontation.
STH_galactic_war.45.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] DMZ Established
STH_galactic_war.46.desc: The [From.GetName] has rejected [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s offer to establish a DMZ in order to de-escalate the risk of military confrontation.
STH_galactic_war.46.name: [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] DMZ Rejected
STH_galactic_war.51.desc:
Qapla' my Chancellor, I bring you news of great importance to the safely of our glorious Empire. For many months now I have had my suspicions about those miserable petaQ governing that pathetic excuse for an empire, the Cardassians. 

However now I have proof that they have been infiltrated by the Dominion's Changelings as part of prelude to an invasion of the Alpha and Beta Quadrants. For the safely of the Empire I emplore you to strike and wipe the changeling filth from this side of the wormhole.
STH_galactic_war.51.name: Suspicious Activities within the Cardassian Union
STH_galactic_war.52.desc:
I am [klingon_empire.ruler.GetName] of the Klingon Empire and this will be your one and only warning, we know that your government has been infiltrated and you are led by Changeling imposters. Your efforts to invade the Alpha and Beta quadrants will end in your destruction at the hands of the mighty Klingon Empire. 

This is your only warning, hand your leaders over for execution and we may yet spare the lives of your civilians and innocents.
STH_galactic_war.52.name: Incoming Message from Q'onoS
STH_galactic_war.53.desc:
It appears there has been a mass culling of the Cardassian Union's leadership under the strong recommendation of the Klingon Empire. 

It seems that the upper leadership on Cardassia Prime had been replaced by Changeling infiltrators from the Dominion as part of an ambitious move from the Delta Quadrant power. This move by Cardassia will seriously set back any of their ambitions againt the Alpha Quadrant.
STH_galactic_war.53.name: Cardassia executes its leaders
STH_galactic_war.54.desc:
Our spies within Cardassian space have reported that the leadership on Cardassia Prime has rejected an ultimatum from the Klingon Empire to handover its leadership for execution.

The Klingon's suspect that the Cardassian leadership has been infiltrated, but those in power on the Cardassian homeworld would rather risk the wrath of the Klingons than turn over their leaders for execution.
STH_galactic_war.54.name: Cardassia defies the Klingon Empire
STH_galactic_war.55.desc: My Chancellor, there is worrying news from the [changeling_klingon_fleet.GetName] it appears that one of our Generals, [klingon_changeling_infiltrator.GetName] lost their mind and dishonorable opened fire on our ships taking them by surprise, the attack was ended when [klingon_changeling_infiltrator.GetHerHis] ship self destructed destroying the rest of the fleet.
STH_galactic_war.55.name: Fleet destroyed by renegade warrior
STH_galactic_war.56.desc: Our colony on [klingon_bombed_planet.GetName] has suffered a devastating and cowardly attack, a large scale bomb detonated in a public area taking many warriors and honourable Klingons to their death. These Klingons may never know the joys of Sto-Vo-Kor. Whomever is responsible for this act will suffer our wrath.
STH_galactic_war.56.name: Cowardly attack on [klingon_bombed_planet.GetName]
STH_galactic_war.57.desc: Reports in from the front line fleets, one of our warships has been sabotaged killing many fine warriors and depriving our empire of the ships service. At present our internal security forces cannot find any cause behind this disaster.
STH_galactic_war.57.name: Ship Sabotaged
STH_galactic_war.58.desc:
As expected those cowards running the Cardassian Union have handed over their leaders for execution rather than face the full might of the Klingon Empire. 

The quadrant is once again safe thanks to the honour of the Klingon warriors and those fools from across the Wormhole will have to fight with honour if they wish to challenge us.
STH_galactic_war.58.name: Cardassia Caves to our demands
STH_galactic_war.59.desc: It appears those miserable petaQ on Cardassia have more of a backbone then we gave them credit for, either that or the Founders have given them some fighting spirit. Their refusal to give up their leadership is just more evidence that they have been replaced by Changelings. We should make good on our promise of war, our warriors are eager for the taste of battle.
STH_galactic_war.59.name: Cardassia rejects our demands
STH_galactic_war.60.desc: Cardassian Fools! We offered to take care of your Changeling problem, but you rejected our offer. Now you will face us on the battlefield where the songs of our victories against your ships will fill the halls of Sto-Vo-Kor with songs for years to come. Prepare to meet your end! To War!
STH_galactic_war.60.name: Incoming Message from Q'onoS
STH_galactic_war.62.desc: Our warriors need no assistance in defeating these Cardassian Ha'DIbaH, however we fight for the future of the quadrant our allies should be given a chance to join us in the glorious conquest of the Cardassians and deal a mighty blow against the Dominion.
STH_galactic_war.62.name: Call ally to war
STH_galactic_war.63.desc: Greetings honoured ally from your friends in the Klingon Empire. Today we declared war on the Cardassian Union in a bid to purge their empire of the honourless shapeshifters from The Dominion. We invite you to share in the glory of this conquest so that we can share a bottle of blood wine on Cardassian soil. Will you join us?
STH_galactic_war.63.name: Incoming Message from Q'onoS
STH_galactic_war.64.desc: Our intelligence services have reliable intel that confirms that [war_ally_target.GetName] will be joining the Klingons in their war against Cardassia.
STH_galactic_war.64.name: Ally joins the War
STH_galactic_war.65.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] I am [klingon_cardassian_concerned.GetName] and bring you worrying news from the Klingon Empire. My sources suggest that a prominant leader within the Klingon Empire has been replaced by a Changeling and they are attempting to destablise the quadrant, as a prelude to war, by driving a war between Cardassia and the Klingon Empire. 

We request permission to go on an undercover mission to reveal the full nature of this infiltration of the Klingons.
STH_galactic_war.65.name: Concerning news from Q'onoS
STH_galactic_war.66.desc:
[klingon_cardassian_concerned.GetName] has reported back from the Order of the Bat'leth ceremony they have uncovered a changeling spy masquerading as [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName], a leader who has been a big supporter and influencer on the Klingon war efforts. 

Exposing the Changeling could well convince the Klingons to back down from their war if they become aware that they have gone to war under false pretences.
STH_galactic_war.66.name: Changeling Presence Revealed
STH_galactic_war.67.desc: We have been approached by [klingon_changling_exposer.GetName], they are telling us they had a team of operatives undercover at the Order of the Bat'leth ceremony where they have evidence that [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName] is infact a Changeling spy. If true this calls into question all of the evidence presented against the Cardassian Union and poses clear evidence that The Dominion is targetting our own Empire.
STH_galactic_war.67.name: Changeling uncovered in our ranks!
STH_galactic_war.68.desc: It appears the Klingon Empire has agreed to withdrawn from their war against us and pull their ships and troops from our territory. It appears that they have uncovered new evidence in the case of Dominion involvement this side of the wormhole.
STH_galactic_war.68.name: Klingons withdraw from War
STH_galactic_war.69.desc: It appears the Klingon Empire has agreed to withdrawn from their war and pull their ships and troops from Cardassian territory. It appears that they have accepted our evidence and executed [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName] before pulling out of all active wars to ensure that no further leaders have been compromised.
STH_galactic_war.69.name: Klingons withdraw from War
STH_galactic_war.70.desc:
Mixed news is emerging from our sources within the Klingon Empire, it appears they have executed [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName] for their crimes against the Empire, yet the Klingon War effort has not been halted. 

It looks like the Klingon lust for violence has won the day and the Empire will continue to battle on.
STH_galactic_war.70.name: Klingons remain at war
STH_galactic_war.71.desc: Our ambassador on the Klingon First City has reported back bad news, having reviewed the evidence our team provided the Klingons have rejected our evidence and dismissed our claims as lies. They remain at war with Cardassia and our relations with Q'onoS have suffered as a result.
STH_galactic_war.71.name: Klingons remain at war
STH_galactic_war.72.desc:
News back from Q'onoS is not good, our teams attempted to infiltrate the Order of the Bat'leth ceremony within the halls of the Klingon high chambers however they were caught and arrested by a team of security agents from the Klingon Defence Force led by [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName]. 

After several hours negotiations our team have been returned to us alive, but our credibility has been severely damaged.
STH_galactic_war.72.name: Covert team fails in its mission
STH_galactic_war.73.desc: A team of clandestine operatives from the cowardly [klingon_cardassian_failed_expose_1.GetName] have been captured attempting to sneak into the prestigous Order of the Bat'leth ceremony, on questioning they claim to have evidence that one of our leaders have been replaced by a Changeling. General [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName] agrees that this is just a futile attempt to derail our war efforts and now is the time to show our strength.
STH_galactic_war.73.name: Undercover team captured
STH_galactic_war.74.desc: Our failure to complete our operation in Klingon space has meant that we have missed our small window of opertunity to expose any Changelings within the Klingon High Command. Additionally we have lost a small amount of support from those within the Empire who were willing to help us get agents onto their planet.
STH_galactic_war.74.name: Failed to complete Operation
STH_galactic_war.75.desc:
We have been presented compelling evidence that one of our very own Generals, [klingon_cardassian_leader_01.GetName] is in fact a Changeling spy! Despite our war with Cardassia having been concluded it appears the Dominion may not yet be done with meddling in our affairs if we are to believe [klingon_cardassian_failed_exposer.GetName].

What action should we take?
STH_galactic_war.75.name: Changeling in our ranks?
STH_galactic_war.77.desc: The quadrant has been shock into chaos as the Klingon Empire has declared war on the Cardassian Union with the aim of eliminating the Cardassian Leadership and creating a regime change on their homeworld.
STH_galactic_war.77.name: The Klingon Empire declares war against Cardassia
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.1.desc:
Tras haber salido a la superficie, el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante preparan alojamientos temporales para apoyar la misión de la expedicion. Las estructuras prefabricadas se completan en tres horas y el equipo comienza el proceso de mapeo de los depósitos en el área inmediata. 

Varios días pasan y se ha vuelto cada vez más difícil confirmar cualquiera de las lecturas de minerales detectadas desde la órbita. Peor aún, varios miembros de la tripulación mueren y resultan más heridos cuando un temblor sísmico causó que una hendidura se derrumbara sobre sí misma, atrapando a quienes exploraban la red de cavernas anexa. 

La misión termina con los depósitos de duranita confirmados que han sido causados ​​por un fallo en la matriz de sensores [Root.GetFleetName].
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.1.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.10.desc:
Los tres Proveedores hablan rápidamente entre sí, cada uno mostrando cierto interés en la oferta del Capitán. Después de varios minutos sin embargo, se hace evidente que no hay apetito entre el grupo de riesgo de perder a sus esclavos. 

El capitán, al ver que el argumento se pierde, se agarra en el frasco más cercano pero se mantiene congelado en su lugar de alguna manera. Un zumbido se puede oír construyendo hasta momentos más adelante una oleada eléctrica arcos del tarro a través de [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName], matando [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHim] inmediatamente.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.10.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.11.desc:
Los tres Proveedores hablan rápidamente entre sí, cada uno mostrando cierto interés en la oferta del Capitán. Después de varios minutos los tarros anuncian al capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName]:

Muy bien. Tendrás que enfrentar a nuestros guerreros más fuertes, a oleadas contra vosotros. Si ganas, te liberaremos '. 

Y con eso una luz cegadora llena el pasillo y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] es transmitido de nuevo a los terrenos de entrenamiento de superficie.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.11.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.12.desc:
Varios días más pasan antes de que el Maestro Thrall regrese y conduce a la tripulación del capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] al enorme coliseo en el centro de la ciudad. Los muchos miles de asientos están vacíos, pero para tres orbes brillantes igualmente espaciados a lo largo del círculo del edificio, mientras que cientos de guardias alienígenas están a la atención alrededor del centro. 

Un gong se escucha y un número de alienígenas de muchas razas vierten en la arena, gritando mientras corren desarmados hacia el equipo visitante. 

Los dos grupos se enfrentan en combate de mano a mano [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] superan en número a dos a uno. La lucha es sangrienta y viciosa. 

El equipo visitante consigue incapacitar a la mayoría de sus atacantes, antes de que suene un segundo gong y una nueva ola de alienígenas entre en la arena. Exhausto, el equipo visitante es reducido uno por uno hasta que sólo el capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] permanece en pie [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis]. 

Agotado, [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetSheHe] se defiende por lo que parece una eternidad, hasta que por fin [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetSheHe] es golpeado inconsciente. 

Los atacantes alienígenas se mueven entre los miembros del equipo visitante, rompiendo el cuello de los que no están muertos.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.12.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.13.desc:
Varios días más pasan antes de que el Maestro Thrall regrese y conduce a la tripulación del capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] al enorme coliseo en el centro de la ciudad. Los muchos miles de asientos están vacíos, pero para tres orbes brillantes igualmente espaciados a lo largo del círculo del edificio, mientras que cientos de guardias alienígenas están a la atención alrededor del centro. 

 Se escucha un gong y los alienígenas de muchas razas se lanzan a la arena, gritando mientras corren desarmados hacia el equipo visitante. 

Los dos grupos se enfrentan en combate de mano a mano, [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] superan en número a dos a uno. La lucha es sangrienta y viciosa. 

El equipo visitante consigue incapacitar a la mayoría de sus atacantes, antes de que suene un segundo gong y una nueva ola de alienígenas entre en la arena. Exhausto pero decidido, el equipo visitante vence a la segunda oleada uno por uno hasta que por fin sólo permanecen en pie ellos. 

El más lejano de los grandes orbes resplandecientes ilumina y la voz de un Proveedor se escucha: 

'Tú has actuado bien. Honraremos nuestro acuerdo ahora. Un destello de luz llena el coliseo y el equipo visitante desaparece. 

Capitan [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] se despierta en medio del campamento de exploración mineral en [triskelion_original_planet.GetName], comunicador [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] con un mensaje de la nave.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.13.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.14.desc:
Las semanas pasan y la tripulación [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHim] han seguido el intenso régimen de entrenamiento que el Maestro Thrall les ha proporcionado con vigor. 

Una tarde después de una desafiante sesión de combate en grupo contra otro grupo de esclavos extraterrestres, [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] es abordado por Galt y le dijo que lo siguiera. 

Siguiendo al Master Thrall fuera de los terrenos de entrenamiento y en un edificio cercano, se le dice a [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetSheHe] que se pare en lo que parece ser una plataforma transportadora de alguna variedad. 

Entra en la plataforma, una luz cegadora destella y el Capitán desaparece de la cámara.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.14.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.15.desc:
[Triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] despierta una vez más, habiendo sido transportado dentro de una gran caverna. La iluminación débil llena un gran salón, donde en los plintos en el soporte del centro qué parecen ser tres cerebros suspendidos en jarros grandes. Un cerebro comienza a brillar intensamente y una voz dice: 

'Tú demuestras una gran promesa. Cuéntanos tu valor, para que podamos pujar entre nosotros por tu esclavitud. 

El Capitán discute con los cerebros durante varios minutos, aprendiendo que son los restos de la civilización Triskelion - los Proveedores - habiendo abandonado la necesidad de su Cuerpos físicos.

Se vuelve evidente que los cerebros viven ahora por poco más que la oportunidad de apostar sumas de dinero en concursos entre extranjeros capturados. 

Considerando esto, el capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] ofrece una propuesta.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.15.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion

STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.16.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion

Y con eso una luz cegadora llena el pasillo y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] es transmitido de nuevo a los terrenos de entrenamiento de superficie.

STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.19.desc:
El capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] pide una audiencia con el Maestro Thrall, que a regañadientes obliga. 

Estate su negocio ", dice. 

¿Hay que haber algún modo de llegar a un acuerdo mutuamente beneficioso? [Triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] dice, antes de enumerar una serie de operaciones valiosas [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetSheHe] estaría dispuesto a hacer a cambio de la liberación de la tripulación. Galt parece indiferente, hasta que una luz cegadora los envuelve a ambos. 

[triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] despierta una vez más, habiendo sido transportado dentro de una gran caverna. La iluminación débil llena un gran salón, donde en los plintos en el soporte del centro qué parecen ser tres cerebros suspendidos en jarros grandes. Un cerebro comienza a brillar y una voz dice: 

Habla ahora.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.19.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.2.desc:
Tras haber salido a la superficie, el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante preparan alojamientos temporales para apoyar la misión de la expedicion. Varios días pasan y se ha vuelto cada vez más difícil confirmar cualquiera de las lecturas de minerales detectadas desde la órbita. Peor aún, varios tripulantes resultan heridos cuando un temblor sísmico provocó que una hendidura se derrumbara sobre sí misma, atrapando a quienes exploraban la red de cavernas anexa. 

La misión termina con los depósitos de duranita confirmados que han sido causados ​​por un fallo en la matriz de sensores [Root.GetFleetName].
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.2.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.20.desc:
Ahora, ¿tengo una oportunidad de negocio para usted? El capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] le dice a los tres cerebros, antes de hablar largamente de las oportunidades de transferencia de tecnología, los rescates que el [From.GetName] estaría dispuesto a pagar y vagas amenazas a Triskelion si la tripulación no regresara a [From.GetName ] espacio. 

Los cerebros no están convencidos, y una ráfaga de luces se puede ver como discuten entre sí en cuanto a la manera más rápida de matar [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName]. El Capitán, al ver que el argumento se pierde, se agarra en el frasco más cercano pero se mantiene congelado en su lugar de alguna manera. Un zumbido se puede oír construyendo hasta momentos más adelante una oleada eléctrica arcos del tarro a través de [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName], matando [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHim] inmediatamente.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.20.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.21.desc:
Ahora permítanme contarles sobre el lucrativo mundo de la franquicia Dabo ', [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] dice a los tres cerebros, antes de hablar largamente sobre la emoción del juego y el juego que implica. 

Con cada detalle adicional los cerebros murmuran murmullos de aprobación hasta que por fin se enciende y se pide iniciar el comercio de la libertad de la tripulación para la instalación de un salón totalmente equipado Dabo. 

Capitan [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] está de acuerdo y se establece un enlace de comunicaciones con el buque, donde se confirman los detalles del tratado del comercio. 

La tripulación es transportada fuera de Triskelion y de vuelta al sitio de prospección de minerales en [triskelion_original_planet.GetName], donde una serie de cajas llenas de equipo Dabo se transportan de vuelta a Triskelion.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.21.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.22.desc:
Ahora déjenme decirles sobre el juego de Chula ', [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] dice a los tres cerebros, antes de hablar extensamente sobre la emoción del juego y el juego que implica. 

Con cada detalle adicional los cerebros murmuran murmullos de aprobación hasta que por fin se ilumina y se pide iniciar el comercio de la libertad de la tripulación para la instalación de una mesa totalmente equipada Chula. 

Capitan [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] está de acuerdo y se establece un enlace de comunicaciones con el buque, donde se confirman los detalles del comercio. 

La tripulación es transportada fuera de Triskelion y de vuelta al sitio de prospección de minerales en [triskelion_original_planet.GetName], donde una serie de cajas llenas de equipo Chula son transportadas de vuelta a Triskelion.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.22.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.3.desc:
Traspasando la superficie, el capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y el equipo visitante preparan alojamientos temporales para apoyar la misión de la expedicion. Las estructuras prefabricadas se completan en tres horas y el equipo comienza el proceso de mapeo de los depósitos en el área inmediata. 

Varios días pasan y se ha vuelto cada vez más difícil confirmar cualquiera de las lecturas de minerales detectadas desde la órbita. El capitán ordena a [Root.GetFleetName] que entre en una órbita inferior para aumentar la efectividad de sus sensores, pero cuando el barco completa el maniobre, se detecta un gran pico de energía desde la superficie. 

El [Root.GetFleetName] intenta ponerse en contacto con el capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName], pero parece que todo el equipo visitante ha desaparecido de [From.From.GetName]. 

La nave pasa varios días escaneando la superficie, pero no se encuentran pistas para explicar lo que le pasó a la tripulación desaparecida.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.3.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.4.desc:
Capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] equipo de distancia despierto de la inconsciencia para encontrarse transportados a un mundo desconocido. El sol en el cielo traiciona que ya no están en [triskelion_original_planet.GetName], y una extraña vegetación desierta pinta el paisaje. 

Máximos después de componerse, el equipo visitante está acosado por un grupo de extraterrestres armados con espadas primitivas y vistiendo túnicas simples de tela. Las armas de energía resultan ineficaces en el ambiente local, sus baterías drenaron, y el equipo es rápidamente dominado.
