El equipo visitante es llevado a través del desierto a la entrada de una ciudad rodeada por un gran muro de piedra. Una figura calva les espera, vestida con una túnica negra y roja. 

 Soy Galt, Maestro Thrall de Triskelion, este mundo. ' Le dice a [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName]. "Deben ser elogiados por su espíritu de lucha. Los Proveedores harán buen uso de ti ... '
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.4.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.5.desc:
El espectáculo de desafío no mueve a Galt, quien simplemente asiente con la cabeza a un alienígena armado con espada. El extranjero agarra al más cercano de la tripulación de [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName], un alférez mayor de edad, y con un corte rápido de la espada le abre el cuello. El resto de equipo visitante, se callan a medida que el Thrall Maestro ruge: 

Puede que la situación se ha aclarado. ¡No se tolerará la desobediencia!
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.5.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.6.desc:
El capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName], enfurecido por la muerte de [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis] oficial se lanza a Galt. Se enfrentan mientras el resto de la tripulación se ocupa de los extranjeros que manejan espadas. 

 A pesar de su formación avanzada, la tripulación es incapaz de soportar la embestida y son asesinados uno por uno. 

Galt y el Capitán continúan luchando por un momento, hasta que finalmente los extraterrestres arrastran [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHim] y atraviesan su corazon con una espada [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHis].
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.6.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.7.desc:
El capitán se compromete a someterse y el equipo visitante es conducido a través de las puertas de la ciudad en un cuadrado de cuarteles de piedra, donde son despojados de sus uniformes y armas y vestidos con las mismas túnicas de tela que los extranjeros usan. 

El día pasa y se encuentran de nuevo con el Galt. 

Usted se entrenará para el combate. Armados, desarmados, solos y en grupos. Esto lo harás por la voluntad de los Proveedores. Sirve y puedes vivir. 

El grupo se divide y se lleva a una serie de campos de entrenamiento por toda la ciudad.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.7.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.8.desc:
Las semanas pasan y la tripulación de [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] y [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetHerHim] han seguido el intenso régimen de entrenamiento que Galt les ha proporcionado sin vacilar, mientras venían a aprender más de Triskelion a través de los otros esclavos que se guardaban en la ciudad. 

Una tarde después de una sesión de combate de grupo desafiante, [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] es capaz de escapar de los terrenos de entrenamiento e investigar varios de los edificios cercanos antes de atravesar lo que parece ser una plataforma transportadora de alguna variedad. 

Entra en la plataforma, una luz cegadora parpadea y el capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] desaparece de la cámara.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.8.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.9.desc:
[Triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] despierta una vez más, habiendo sido transportado dentro de una gran caverna. La iluminación débil llena un gran salón, donde en el centro hay lo que parecen ser tres cerebros suspendidos en jarros grandes. Un cerebro comienza a brillar intensamente y una voz dice: 

'Tú demuestras una gran promesa. Cuéntanos tu valor, para que podamos optar por ser tu dueño.

El Capitán discute con los cerebros durante varios minutos, aprendiendo que son los restos de la civilización Triskelion - los Proveedores - que han abandonado la necesidad de sus cuerpos físicos . Se hace evidente que los cerebros viven ahora por poco más que la oportunidad de apostar sumas de dinero en los concursos entre extranjeros capturados. 

Considerando esto, el capitán [triskelion_enslaved_leader.GetName] ofrece una propuesta.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_event.9.name: Los Juegos de Triskelion
STH_gamma.110.desc: The crew of the [gamma_ship_name.GetName] have picked up an unusual planet on long range scanners that warrants further investigation. The science officer recommends setting course.
STH_gamma.110.name: Gamma Quadrant... Intresting Planet on sensors
STH_gamma.111.desc: On arriving in orbit of the mysterious planet, our science teams have found evidence of a primitive pre-warp race undergoing a technolgical and sociological revolution. The assembled science teams have requested a closer look at the species on the planet's surface. An undercover mission would enable us get better readings from the colony.
STH_gamma.111.name: Primitive Culture Found
STH_gamma.112.desc:
After a week studying the colony the crews of the [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] have brought back a wealth of information about the civilisation which will keep the anthropologists back in the [Root.GetName] occupied for years.

With the information collected it is time to resume the mission.
STH_gamma.112.name: Mission Successful
STH_gamma.113.desc:
[Root.GetRulerName] reports in from the [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] are troubling, the away team who went in disguised as the natives have been captured by forces on the planet. 

Believing the away team to be part of an enemy faction. Our security forces have put together a plan to retrieve them, however it could lead to casualties on both sides.
STH_gamma.113.name: Away team captured!
STH_gamma.114.desc:
The mission was successful and our security forces were able to rescue the hostages and safely return them to the fleet without harming the natives or blowing our cover. 

Whilst we were unable to gather as much information as we had hoped the team did manage to at least to find out about their justice system...
STH_gamma.114.name: Away team rescued
STH_gamma.115.desc:
The mission to retrieve the away team has ended in failure, whilst attempting to infiltrate the stronghold one of the team was spotted by the guards resulting in a fire fight. 

Sadly not all of the away team were retrieved alive and a number of the native population were injured in the attempt.
STH_gamma.115.name: Mission a disaster
STH_gamma.116.desc: [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] have uncovered a thriving civillisation on the planet and whilst they are are significantly smaller than us, they were able to provide our teams with vital information about the region and were kind enough to provide valuable research to our teams.
STH_gamma.116.name: New Culture Discovered
STH_gamma.117.desc:
Not every world holds the recipe for adventure and unfortunately this newly discovered planet offers our teams nothing in the way of excitement. A barren world, with no life or remarkable features. 

At least the crew got the chance to stretch their legs.
STH_gamma.117.name: A lifeless planet found
STH_gamma.118.desc: Whilst the newly discovered planet does not harbour any advanced lifeforms, our engineering teams are pleased to confirm that the planet does host an exceptionally rich amount of resources that we can harvest an return home with.
STH_gamma.118.name: MIneral rich planet found
STH_gamma.120.desc: [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] has detected an M-Class planet on long range sensors which appears to support a warp capable civilisation with deposits of Dilithium and evidence of advanced mineral refinement. It is possible we maybe able to trade for some of their resources.
STH_gamma.120.name: The Quickening
STH_gamma.121.name: The Quickening
STH_gamma.122.name: The Quickening
STH_gamma.124.name: Unable to find a cure for the Quickening
STH_gamma.125.desc: Mighty Founder, our listening posts have detected outsiders from [gamma_mission_teplan.GetName] attempting to cure the Teplan Blight we inflicted upon the unruly Teplan people. It seems a team of their medical experts beamed down to the planets surface and spent a number of days seeking to undo the punishment we applied. The fleet left the system before we could send in the Jem'Hadar who took appropriate action to remind the Teplan's of our might.
STH_gamma.125.name: Interference detected on Teplan
STH_gamma.126.name: Incoming Transmission from the Dominion
STH_gamma.127.desc: Our actions on the planet Teplan have clearly not won us any additional support in the Gamma Quadrant and we appear to have angered one of the major powers in the sector. We should order the fleet to continue their expedition, but remain wary of any further actions against the native races.
STH_gamma.127.name: Response to our message
STH_gamma.129.desc: Our medical team and scientists believe they have found a major breakthrough in deciphering the Teplan blight. With this hard work our Chief Medical Officer believes future generations of Teplans may be immune to the effects of this terrible disease. [gamma_leader_name.GetName] feels that the fleet has lingered to long in hostile territory and having helped the stricken Teplans we should move on before we are detected.
STH_gamma.129.name: The Quickening, a cure found
STH_gamma.130.name: Unusual Asteroid Detected
STH_gamma.131.desc:
Our away team has returned from the facility with a wealth of new research on the stellar phenomenon occurring within the system.

We have collected the information and will send it back to our scientists at home for further investigation.
STH_gamma.131.name: Asteroid Facility
STH_gamma.132.desc: Our away team has returned from the facility disappointed, the previous occupants appear to have wiped all the facilities data banks and taken all information with them. Whilst it was an interesting experience for the crew, there is little scientific benefit from the mission.
STH_gamma.132.name: Asteroid Facility
STH_gamma.133.desc: On beaming down to the colony, the colony leader introduced themselves to [gamma_leader_name.GetName] as being part of an advanced team from a species called the Stakoron who had left their homeworld many year ago. The Stakorons seem extremely pleased to have met the away team and offer them a rare crystal that forms naturally on this asteroid, seemingly unaware of its importance.
STH_gamma.133.name: Asteroid Colony
STH_gamma.134.desc: The crew from the [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] are introduced to the leaders of the colony, who explain that they are the frequent victims of pirate raids, which explains their reluctance to engage the fleet in open communication. Once the colonists are convinced we mean them no harm, they offer the away team a hearty meal, warm hospitality and a sample of the Deuterium they have been refining. Our tactical officer advised that with a sample of the fleets boronite the colony could improve their defences and stand a better chance of repelling further attacks.
STH_gamma.134.name: Asteroid Colony
STH_gamma.135.desc:
The colony appears to be home to a group of vicious thugs who attempt to ambush our away team, in an attempt to ransom them back to [Root.GetName], luckily the away team were able to defend themselves without taking too much damage. 

A number of the landing party were unfortunately injured and will carry the scars of what happened down on the asteroid.
STH_gamma.135.name: Asteroid Colony
STH_gamma.136.desc: The attack on [gamma_ship_name.GetName] was vicious and wild, but the suprior training and firepower of the [Root.GetName] vessels and crew was sufficent to repel the attack and beat back the agressors, who after taking severe casulties retreated leaving their ill-gotten cargo behind.
STH_gamma.136.name: Fleet Under Attack
STH_gamma.137.desc:
The attack on [gamma_ship_name.GetName] took the Captain and crew by surprise, the smugglers managed to get in several lethal shots to the [gamma_ship_name.GetName] warp drive before they could raise their shields. Unfortunately the damage was severe and the ship was lost with all hands. 

The Admiralty board has ordered the fleet to return to the Alpha Quadrant, the mission is over.
STH_gamma.137.name: Fleet Under Attack
STH_gamma.141.desc: [gamma_fleet_name.GetName]'s course through the Gamma Quadrant has taken them via a new type of nebula that has never been observed back in the Alpha Quadrant, the ship and crew spend several days cataloguing the findings and preparing the data to bring home to [Root.GetName].
STH_gamma.141.name: A new nebula discovered
STH_gamma.142.desc:
[gamma_fleet_name.GetName]'s course through the Gamma Quadrant has taken them via a nebula rich in Deuterium.

Harvesting the resource should not take too long and can be put to good use by [Root.GetName].
STH_gamma.142.name: A new nebula discovered
STH_gamma.143.desc: The [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] has been ambushed whilst exploring a nebula within the Gamma Quadrant, it appears a group of local pirates have been using the sensor blocking effects of the Nebula to catch unsuspecting vessels that get too close.
STH_gamma.143.name: Ambush at the Nebula
STH_gamma.144.desc: [gamma_ship_name.GetName] proved to be too powerful for the attackers and was able to defeat them in a decisive battle in the Nebula. A fine victory for [gamma_leader_name.GetName] and their crew.
STH_gamma.144.name: Fleet Victory
STH_gamma.145.desc:
The attack on [gamma_ship_name.GetName] took the Captain and crew by surprise, the ambushers quickly overwhelmed the [gamma_ship_name.GetName].

 The damage was severe and the ship was lost with all hands. 

The Admirality board has ordered the fleet to return to the Alpha Quadrant, the mission is over.
STH_gamma.145.name: Fleet Defeat
STH_gamma.150.name: Fleet Under Attack
STH_gamma.151.desc: [gamma_ship_name.GetName] proved to be too powerful for the attackers and was able to defeat them in a decisive battle over their foes. A fine victory for [gamma_leader_name.GetName] and their crew.
STH_gamma.151.name: Fleet Victory
STH_gamma.152.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] I am saddened to report the lost of [gamma_leader_name.GetName] and the crew of [gamma_ship_name.GetName] in battle against their enemy. 

This puts a serious dent in the expedition and the Admiralty board have decided to terminate the mission and order the fleet back home.
STH_gamma.152.name: Fleet Defeated
STH_gamma.2.desc: The discovery of the Bajoran Wormhole has opened up a new quadrant to explore. Our Admirals and Scientists are queuing up to explore the far reaches of this new frontier, exploring the sectors way from the major empires. Our teams have prepared our fleets for an expedition into unknown territories. Shall we set course for adventure?
STH_gamma.2.name: Expedition to the Gamma Quadrant
STH_gamma.210.desc: The [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] has encounted a group of Karemma Traders, the fleet has opened communications and the Karemman Captain is willing to trade a number of high profile materials in exchange for Latinum.
STH_gamma.210.name: Karemma Traders
STH_gamma.220.desc:
We are receiving an SOS on our long range scanners, we are unable to tell who is calling for aid at this range, but it is our duty to respond to any call for help.

Shall we set course?
STH_gamma.220.name: SOS Call Recieved
STH_gamma.222.name: SOS Call Recieved
STH_gamma.223.name: SOS Call Recieved
STH_gamma.224.name: SOS Call Recieved
STH_gamma.225.desc: [gamma_ship_name.GetName] proved to be too powerful for the attackers and was able to defeat them in a decisive battle over their foes. A fine victory for [gamma_leader_name.GetName] and their crew.
STH_gamma.225.name: Fleet Victorious
STH_gamma.226.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] I am saddened to report the lost of [gamma_leader_name.GetName] and the crew of [gamma_ship_name.GetName] in battle against their enemy. 

This puts a serious dent in the expedition and the Admiralty board have decided to terminate the mission and order the fleet back home.
STH_gamma.226.name: Fleet Defeated
STH_gamma.230.desc:
Greetings [gamma_leader_name.GetName] my name is Eav'oq, I am contacting you in need of assistance, we are the Tosk, the hunted. I have escaped with a number of my race, we have been hunted for as long as we can remember. 

I must get my people to freedom and we need your help.
STH_gamma.230.name: Communications from the Tosk
STH_gamma.231.desc: You have our Tosk and we want them back, they belong to us to hunt. This will be your only warning, return them to us now!
STH_gamma.231.name: Inbound Communications
STH_gamma.232.desc:
Rejecting the Oschean Hunters was a risky decision and they have not responded positively, launching a swift attack on the [gamma_ship_name.GetName] quickly disabling the warp drive and boarding the ship. [gamma_leader_name.GetName] quickly sounds the intruder alert and calls for security teams to repel the boarders. 

The Oschean's remind us that they are only after the Tosk and there is still time to hand them over.
STH_gamma.232.name: Fleet under Attack
STH_gamma.233.desc: Following a fierce firefight down the corridors of [gamma_ship_name.GetName] led by [gamma_leader_name.GetName] the [Root.GetName] forces were able to defend the ship and push the invaders back and force them into a full retreat just in time for the engineering teams to restore power to the engines to allow the fleet to make an escape to warp.
STH_gamma.233.name: Ship defence complete
STH_gamma.234.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] we have had a report back from the Executive Officer of the [gamma_ship_name.GetName], the report confirms that the ship was boarded and following a firefight the Commanding Officer and an alien guest Eav'oq were killed by an invading party whilst trying to protect an alien species. 

Without a leader and with the ship heavily damaged it is clear the mission cannot continue and must be recalled.
STH_gamma.234.name: Ship's defences breached
STH_gamma.235.desc: Once clear of danger the Tosk representative Eav'oq approaches [gamma_ship_name.GetName] formally asking for asylum for his people within the borders of [Root.GetName]. Once a suitable planet has been found the small community of Tosk will relocate and look to become productive members of [Root.GetName] society.
STH_gamma.235.name: Freedom for the Tosk
STH_gamma.310.desc: The Chief Science Officer of the [gamma_ship_name.GetName] has identified a planet of note in a nearby system. Deciding this mission only required the use of a single ship [gamma_leader_name.GetName] directs their ship to investigate the mysterious planet, whilst any remaining ships continue to survey a local stellar cluster.
STH_gamma.310.name: Children of Time
STH_gamma.311.desc:
As the ship approaches the planet the ship is hit by a quantum energy barrier which causes the ship to shutter violently and damages the inertial dampers and the gyromagnetic stabilizers meaning that the ship will be unable to leave orbit for a few days. 

Scanning the planet the crew pick up [Root.GetSpeciesName] life signs on the planet below!
STH_gamma.311.name: Children of Time
STH_gamma.312.desc: The crew beam to the planet's surface and come face to face with a small colony of races all found within the [Root.GetName]. The colony leader confirms that they are the descendants of [gamma_ship_name.GetName] which was thrust back in time when they attempted to leave the planet's orbit. The crew are reassured that their descendants have a plan that will ensure the survival of their colony and allow [gamma_leader_name.GetName] and their crew to return home.
STH_gamma.312.name: Children of Time
STH_gamma.313.desc: As [gamma_leader_name.GetName] sits in the command chair readying the ship for departure following the shield modification agreed on the planet below a last minute adjustment is sent in from an unknown source. Presenting the Captain with a choice between the original plan and this last minute change.
STH_gamma.313.name: Children of Time
STH_gamma.314.desc:
After a period of violent shaking the ship passes through the mysterious barrier with only minor damage, but no casulties. Scanning the planet's surface to speak with the colony the communications officer reports that the planet below is uninhabited with no sign that a colony ever existed on the surface. 

The crew saddened by the loss of those they had gotten to know over the last few days, they set course to rejoin the fleet and continue the expedition.
STH_gamma.314.name: Children of Time
STH_gamma.315.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we have recieve a report from one of our fleets in the Gamma Quadrant, the flagship of the expedition fleet the [gamma_ship_name.GetName] has been reported missing in action. They were last seen investigating a planet with a mysterious energy barrior, but when a ship was sent to investigate we could find no sign of the ship or life on the planet. The only strange readings came in the form of 200 year old scattered debris on the northen continent.
STH_gamma.315.name: Children of Time
STH_gamma.4.desc:
[gamma_mission_leader.GetName] has arrived in the Bajor System onboard the [gamma_ship_name.GetName] of the [gamma_fleet_name.GetName], final preparations have been made at the nearest Starbase and the crew are prepared to embark on the expedition. 

The course and destination are now available to select.
STH_gamma.4.name: Expedition to the Gamma Quadrant
STH_gamma.400.desc:
Every great expedition must come to an end eventually and so it is time for the [gamma_fleet_name.GetName] to return back to the Idran System and back through the Bajoran Wormhole. 

The fleet will now recall their science teams and return home.
STH_gamma.400.name: Time to return home
STH_gamma.401.desc:
The mission is complete and all that remains is to debrief the Captain and crew. A lot of experience will have been gained from the Gamma Quadrant, with many lives impacted for better or worse.

The expedition leader is free to return to duty and the fleet is now unlocked and ready to resume service.
STH_gamma.401.name: Fleet has returned home
STH_garidian.1.desc:
Hace mil años, el Legislador escribió cuatro pergaminos para establecer la estructura de la sociedad garidiana. Los pergaminos definen cosas como el código de honor, gobierno, religión de Garid, así como los privilegios de la clase patricia. 

También hay una vieja leyenda sobre el quinto pergamino que supuestamente describía los privilegios y las responsabilidades de los plebeyos. clase. Sin embargo, como dice la leyenda, el Legislador se vio obligado a abandonar el planeta antes de que pudiera revelar el quinto pergamino. 

Esta historia se ha vuelto especialmente popular entre las clases bajas de garidianos.
STH_garidian.1.name: El quinto pergamino
STH_gomtuu.1.desc:
[Root.GetRulerName], nuestros escaneos de largo alcance han detectado un avistamiento galáctico raro, creemos que hemos encontrado la última ubicación conocida del organismo conocido por muchos como la Criatura Estelar o 'Hombre de Hojalata'. 

 Esto podría presentar un Oportunidad única de estudiar una maravilla de la galaxia.
STH_gomtuu.1.name: El hombre de hojalata encontrado
STH_gomtuu.10.desc: La criatura, que se identifica como 'Gomtuu' toma suavemente el control de [gomtuu_leader.GetName] y explica que tiene poderes telepáticos y necesitará comunicarse a través de nuestro líder. Nos invita a hacer preguntas.
STH_gomtuu.10.name: Comunicación de Gomtuu
STH_gomtuu.11.desc:
Antes de que Gomtuu pueda responder la pregunta, la criatura es interrumpida por la repentina llegada de una banda de piratas espaciales. 

Estas formidables naves parecen estar fuertemente armadas y hostiles y se intentan llamarnos. Parecen ser del mismo clan que nos atacó antes.
STH_gomtuu.11.name: Piratas vistos
STH_gomtuu.12.desc: Atención buque [Root.GetSpeciesName], soy [gomtuu_pirate_leader.GetName] y reclamamos este barco como nuestro. No nos peleamos, pero si se interponen entre nosotros y nuestro premio, no dudaremos en abrir fuego. ¡Vete ahora si deseas irte con tu bonita nave en una sola pieza!
STH_gomtuu.12.name: Mensaje entrante
STH_gomtuu.13.desc: Los Piratas atacan, pero no parecen preocupados por cuál es su objetivo, lo que está claro es que deben ser derrotados antes de que podamos reanudar nuestra conversación con Gomtuu.
STH_gomtuu.13.name: El ataque de los piratas
STH_gomtuu.16.desc: [Root.GetName], hemos derrotado con éxito a Tin Man en la batalla y la criatura parece estar muerta, nuestros escaneos indican que hay una abundancia de tecnología e información dentro de sus bancos de memoria, que a nuestros científicos les encantaría obtener. Alternativamente, podríamos abordar el barco e intentar salvarlo agregándolo a nuestra flota.
STH_gomtuu.16.name: Gomtuu derrotado
STH_gomtuu.17.name: Gomtuu sale solo
STH_gomtuu.18.name: Gomtuu se acerca una vez más
STH_gomtuu.19.desc:
Parece que Gomtuu recuerda nuestra falta de apoyo y muestra poca distinción entre atacante y transeúnte. 

La nave masiva está decidida a enfurecer cualquier cosa en su camino y eso incluye nuestras naves y planetas. ¡Debemos defendernos!
STH_gomtuu.19.name: Gomtuu busca venganza
STH_gomtuu.2.desc:
Nuestros científicos han estado rastreando las últimas coordenadas conocidas de la ubicación de la criatura conocida como Tin Man. 

 Lamentablemente, parece que no somos las únicas personas que rastrean a la criatura: la carrera está en marcha ...
STH_gomtuu.2.name: Carrera para encontrar el hombre de hojalata
STH_gomtuu.20.desc:
Insatisfecho con los eventos que han tenido lugar, Gomtuu enciende su Bio-drive y se prepara para salir del sistema. La tripulación investigadora no recibe más noticias de la criatura que se aleja rápidamente a gran velocidad. 

Nuestros escaneos de largo alcance no pueden encontrar rastro de Gomtuu. Parece que se ha ido para siempre, dejándonos solo los escaneos tomados mientras estuvo aquí.
STH_gomtuu.20.name: Gomtuu se va infeliz
STH_gomtuu.21.desc:
A medida que [gomtuu_leader.GetName] transporta a bordo de Gomtuu, nuestro antiguo líder aparece en la pantalla de visualización confiado en la elección realizada. Explican que este es el comienzo de un nuevo viaje para el par de ellos y con nuevos mundos para explorar están ansiosos por comenzar este nuevo viaje. 

 [gomtuu_leader.GetName] explica que a Gomtuu le gustaría dejar un regalo final para decir gracias por recordarles lo que la vida tiene para ofrecer. Nos despiden y en un instante ambos se han ido.
STH_gomtuu.21.name: [gomtuu_leader.GetName] y Gomtuu salen juntos
STH_gomtuu.22.desc:
Gomtuu transmite un mensaje final a través de [gomtuu_leader.GetName], explican que este es el comienzo de un nuevo viaje y que se da cuenta de que todavía hay mucho por ver y que nuevos mundos se han inspirado al conocernos. 

 [gomtuu_leader .GetName] explica que Gomtuu quisiera dejar un regalo final para agradecerles por recordarles lo que la vida tiene para ofrecer. Con eso completo, el barco gira su bio-drive y así se fue.
STH_gomtuu.22.name: Gomtuu sale solo
STH_gomtuu.23.desc:
Gomtuu transmite un mensaje final a través de [gomtuu_leader.GetName], explican que este es el comienzo de un nuevo viaje y que se da cuenta de que todavía hay mucho por ver y que se han inspirado nuevos mundos al conocernos. [gomtuu_leader.GetName] explica que a Gomtuu le gustaría dejar un regalo final para agradecerles por recordarles lo que la vida tiene para ofrecer. Con eso completo, el barco hace girar su bio-drive y justo así se ha ido. 

 Habiendo sido forzado a permanecer, está claro que [gomtuu_leader.GetName] no está contento con la decisión tomada en su nombre y ellos no Ya no tienen la motivación para progresar a su ritmo anterior, es poco probable que puedan alcanzar su máximo potencial.
STH_gomtuu.23.name: Gomtuu sale solo
STH_gomtuu.24.desc:
La tripulación observa cómo los piratas abren fuego contra la vieja criatura, el casco parece resistir el ataque, pero la antigua nave parece incapaz o no está dispuesta a defenderse. 

A medida que el casco prístino se oscurece bajo el ataque, esto es difícil ver. Deberíamos dejar a la criatura a su suerte. ¿Quién sabe cómo impactará el encuentro en cada lado de la batalla?
STH_gomtuu.24.name: Gomtuu bajo ataque de piratas
STH_gomtuu.25.desc: Hemos recogido una señal que parece coincidir con el Gomtuu que encontramos el año pasado. Es imposible saber si es la misma criatura u otro miembro de la especie, pero está actuando de manera hostil. Claramente no es feliz que haya sido atacado mientras estaba en nuestro espacio, y está en un enfoque de ataque.
STH_gomtuu.25.name: Devoluciones Gomtuu
STH_gomtuu.26.desc:
Hemos recogido una señal que parece coincidir con los piratas que encontramos el año pasado. Parecen haber sido afectados fisiológicamente por su encuentro con Gomtuu. 

 ¿Quién sabe lo que les hizo? ¡Los sensores indican que parecen haber mejorado sus naves y están en curso directo hacia uno de nuestros planetas!
STH_gomtuu.26.name: ¿Gomtuu adorando a los piratas?
STH_gomtuu.28.desc: Después de una feroz batalla, los piratas adoradores de Gomtuu han sido derrotados. Deberíamos echar un vistazo a sus naves para buscar cualquier salvamento útil.
STH_gomtuu.28.name: Piratas derrotados
STH_gomtuu.3.desc:
¡Señor! Hemos encontrado los escombros de un barco, no parece lo suficientemente grande como para pertenecer al Hombre de hojalata, pero no podemos estar seguros. informa a un oficial. 

 Se requerirá más investigación para comprender lo que ha sucedido aquí. Deberíamos escanear los escombros para obtener más información.
STH_gomtuu.3.name: Escombros encontrados
STH_gomtuu.30.desc: Gomtuu ha superado su batalla contra los piratas, no habrá pasado desapercibido que no acudimos en su ayuda. Solo podemos preguntarnos cuál será su próxima acción, podría ocurrir hoy, mañana, simplemente no lo sabemos.
STH_gomtuu.30.name: Gomtuu derrota a los piratas
STH_gomtuu.4.desc:
Al comenzar nuestras investigaciones, está claro que se ha establecido una trampa y hemos caído en ella. Como se predijo, no somos los únicos barcos que siguen al Hombre de hojalata. 

 Los piratas están en curso directo con nuestra flota y parecen tener la intención de luchar. Si queremos localizar a esta misteriosa entidad, primero tendremos que derrotar a estos piratas.
STH_gomtuu.4.name: ¡Es una trampa!
STH_gomtuu.5.desc:
Durante la batalla, nuestro Oficial Científico localizó el núcleo de la computadora de uno de los barcos piratas. Si nuestros científicos pueden obtener los datos almacenados dentro de este núcleo, deberíamos ser capaces de reconstruir lo que sucedió y rastrear hacia dónde ha huido nuestro objetivo. 

 Siempre que sea seguro hacerlo, debemos llamar una nave de ciencia para investigar esta pista.
STH_gomtuu.5.name: Una pista vital encontrada
STH_gomtuu.6.desc:
Los escaneos detallados de los restos indican que fue destruido por una descarga eléctrica masiva, que contiene una firma única. Nuestros científicos creen que podemos usar esto para reducir la ubicación de nuestro objetivo. 

 ¿Quién sabe en qué estado estará cuando lo encontremos? Esperemos que no sea demasiado tarde.
STH_gomtuu.6.name: Tin Man localizado!
STH_gomtuu.8.desc:
Hemos logrado rastrear a la criatura, que parece ser un barco vivo. La entidad no parece ser peor por su terrible experiencia a manos de los piratas. 

La criatura se acerca y de repente el oficial al mando puede sentir que la criatura se extiende telepáticamente. 

Podemos responder y hablar con la criatura o usar Esta oportunidad de atacar.
STH_gomtuu.8.name: Tin Man encontrado seguro
STH_gomtuu.9.desc:
Hemos logrado rastrear a la criatura, que parece ser un barco vivo. La entidad parece haber sufrido daños por su encuentro con los piratas. 

La criatura se acerca con cautela, cuando de repente el oficial al mando puede sentir que la criatura se extiende telepáticamente. 

Podemos responder y hablar con la criatura o usar Esta debilidad como nuestro momento para atacar.
STH_gomtuu.9.name: Tin Man encontrado herido
STH_gorn_mechanics.12.desc: We have received news that some of the Gorn armies that landed on [This.GetName] are ruthlessly attacking the civilian population and spreading fear and destruction in their wake. As a result of this recently one of the buildings on the planet´s surface was ruined.
STH_gorn_mechanics.12.name: Gorn armies terrorising the population!
STH_gorn_mechanics.13.desc: We have received news that some of the Gorn armies that landed on [This.GetName] are ruthlessly attacking the civilian population and spreading fear and destruction in their wake. As result of this a pop has been killed.
STH_gorn_mechanics.13.name: Gorn armies terrorising the population!
STH_gorn_mechanics.14.desc: Our infant hordes have succeeded in their terror operations on [From.GetName] and ruined a building.
STH_gorn_mechanics.14.name: Our infant hordes are doing their job
STH_gorn_mechanics.15.desc: Our infant hordes have succeeded in their terror operations and killed a pop on [From.GetName].
STH_gorn_mechanics.15.name: Our infant hordes are doing their job
STH_gravity.2.desc:
Arriving at the scene all of sudden a gravity well opens up directly below the [Root.GetName] pulling the ship violently towards it. By quickly venting plasma from the engines while at the same time increasing power to the impulse engines [Root.GetName] narrowly avoids getting sucked into the well. 

After escaping the pull of the gravity well [Root.GetName]´s sensors are able to detect a planet located in a pocket of subspace inside the gravity well. Sending a probe in to further explore the planet it is discovered that on its surface there are several alien vessels that most likely fell victim to the well and crashed there. However no life signs are detected coming from the vessels. 

We could explore the option of trying to lift the crashed alien ships up from the surface of the planet and exploit their resources and possible new technologies.
STH_gravity.2.name: Crashed ships detected
STH_gravity.3.desc:
Arriving at the scene of the unusual readings all of sudden a massive gravity well appears seemingly out of nowhere, and despite of [Root.GetName] crew´s best efforts the ship is sucked in while having just enough time to send a distress call out. 

The distress call states that an entire solar system with 3 uninhabitable planets were detected on the other side of the gravity well existing in a subspace pocket. It is estimated that the crew of [Root.GetName] has enough rations to last for a year, assuming that the ship survived the entry into the well. 

Should we start a rescue mission for the lost crew and [gravity_leader.GetName]?
STH_gravity.3.name: Our ship has crashed
STH_gravity.4.desc: By first scanning the gravity well in detail and then heavily modifying some of our shuttlecrafts and their engines we were successful in entering the well and lifting up the remains of the alien ships. Both the materials gained and the knowledge of alien ship designs should benefit our future efforts.
STH_gravity.4.name: Lifting the remains of alien ships successful
STH_gravity.5.desc:
After arriving at the scene and scanning the massive gravity well it is clear that this is a monodirectional phenomenon, meaning that no ship going in can get out. However by sending a reinforced probe inside the well [Root.GetName]´s crew are able to first locate the missing leader and most of the crew of our crashed ship alive. And then by using the probe as a signal transmitter slowly beam them out of the gravity well in small groups. The survivors seem to have suffered only minor injuries and some malnourishment while waiting to be rescued. 

The rescued leader assumes command of [Root.GetName].
STH_gravity.5.name: Saving crew successful
STH_gravity.6.desc: We have failed to rescue our leader and the crew of the crashed ship in time from the gravity well. It is estimated that by now all possible survivors have run out of supplies.
STH_gravity.6.name: Saving crashed ship's crew failed
STH_hazards.3.desc:
Whilst traversing the plasma storms in the region known as the [badlands_ship_damaged_minor.solar_system.GetName] the [badlands_ship_damaged_minor.GetName] has taken minor damage from one of the many plasma storms that occupy the region.

The risk of further damage will only increase the longer the ship remains in proximity to the area. [Root.GetName] Fleet Control recommends immediate withdrawal from the vicinity.
STH_hazards.3.name: [badlands_ship_damaged_minor.GetName] damaged in Hostile Region
STH_hazards.4.desc:
The [badlands_ship_damaged_major.solar_system.GetName] are a hostile and dangerous region of space and unfortunately the [badlands_ship_damaged_major.GetName] has suffered severe damage at the hands of one of the graviational anomalies that exist in the region.

The risk of further damage will only increase the longer the ship remains in proximity to the area. [Root.GetName] Fleet Control recommends immediate withdrawal from the vicinity.
STH_hazards.4.name: [badlands_ship_damaged_major.GetName] suffers serious damage in the Badlands
STH_hazards.5.desc: Many ships have been lost whilst attempting to travel within the region of space known as the Badlands and we have lost all contact with the [badlands_ship_destroyed.GetName], long range scans have picked up signs of debris along the last known coordinates of the ship. We must sadly assume the vessel was destroyed and hope that some of the crew were able to make it to safety.
STH_hazards.5.name: [badlands_ship_destroyed.GetName] lost in the Badlands
STH_hazards.50.desc:
The [This.GetName] has reached a galactic barrier, this signifies a tremendous distance across a vast stretch of space, and through the dangerous galactic barrier. 

Before [This.GetName] begins the journey do you wish to abandon the venture across this void.
STH_hazards.50.name: The edge of the Galaxy
STH_hazards.6.desc:
There has been some good news following the destruction of their ship, [badlands_ship_leader.GetName] and a number of their crew have been found alive in escape pods drifting on the outskirts of the storms. 

Despite the Captain and crew being severally shaken, there were in generally good health despite their experience.
STH_hazards.6.name: Crew Recovered
STH_hazards.7.desc:
We have lost all contact with [caretakered_ship.GetName] whilst they were traversing the region known as the Badlands. 

There has been no sign of the ship or its crew and no wreckage has been spotted. Plasma storms in the region are making any further investigation too dangerous and we can only assume the ship was lost with all hands.
STH_hazards.7.name: Ship Lost in the Badlands
STH_hero_age.21.desc: Following her joining with the Dax symbiont over 10 years ago, Ezri Dax has undergone a real transformation, both host Ezri and Dax have grown in confidence together and may see a future outside of the science division. A recent opportunity to take command has left Dax wondering if a transfer to the command division is in order.
STH_hero_age.21.name: Ezri Dax takes command
STH_hero_age.22.desc: Since being liberated from the Borg, the ex-drone, known now as simply 'Seven' has continued to demonstrate her exceptional skills and the admiralty believes the time has come to promote her to the command track.
STH_hero_age.22.name: Fun will now commence
STH_hero_age.29.desc: Following years of dedicated service to Starfleet, the Android known as Data has put in a request for a promotion and a command of his own. Data has an implecable service record, but not everyone in the fleet would be comfortable following the command of an artificial lifeform.
STH_hero_age.29.name: First Android in Starfleet
STH_hero_age.35.desc: Following years of dedicated service to Starfleet security, Worf has demonstrated leadership and the ability to command a crew his peers are recommending that he switches to the command division and put his considerable skills to use in this area.
STH_hero_age.35.name: An honourable opportunity
STH_hero_age.41.desc:
Following her rescue from her transport ship as a young girl, the young La'an Noonien-Singh was determined to repay Starfleet by joining the fleet and serving alongside Starfleet's finest.

Is there a position within the fleet for Cadet Noonien-Singh?
STH_hero_age.41.name: La'an Noonien-Singh
STH_hero_age.44.desc: Having served with distinction during the expedition alongside their commanding officer [From.GetName], Nurse Chapel has excelled in her duties and has been recommended for a promotion form [From.GetName].
STH_hero_age.44.name: Nurse Chapel I presume?
STH_hero_age.45.desc: Having served with distinction during the expedition alongside their commanding officer [From.GetName], Lt Ortegas has excelled in her duties and has been recommended for a promotion form [From.GetName] and a command of their own on her return to Earth.
STH_hero_age.45.name: Lt Ortegas
STH_hero_age.50.desc:
Admiral Spock has served Starfleet with distinction for more years than almost any other commander in the fleet. As a distinguished officer, it is time for him to make the career decision that he has earnt. 

Remain within Starfleet, use his considerable political might as an Ambassador (governor) or retire from public life. The needs of the many really do outweigh the needs of the few... or the one.
STH_hero_age.50.name: The Logical Next Step
STH_hero_age.51.desc: Robert April is one of Starfleet's most decorated officers, his role on the bridge of the Enterprise and other notable Starships has become legend. Is now the time for his next career move?
STH_hero_age.51.name: This bridge is more like home than anywhere else
STH_hero_leader.20.desc: Georgiou attended Starfleet Academy from 2220 to 2224, meeting and befriending other notable Starfleet admirals such as Christopher Pike, who described her as the sharpest tool in the shed and a force to be reckoned with. He also remembered her drinking Pike and their fellow cadets underneath the table, but also for having every Starfleet regulation down by the second week. As a young Lieutenant, Georgiou was serving aboard the USS Archimedes and was involved in numerous first contacts. As a rising star in the fleet, many knew it wouldn't be long before this promotion came about. Should Georgiou become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.20.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.21.desc: Having been convinced to join Starfleet by renowned Starfleet admiral Alexander Marcus, Christopher Pike soon rose up the ranks, serving as a test pilot and served with distinction on at least three ships before earning this promotion. Brave and honourable Pike embodies what it means to be 'Starfleet'. Should Pike become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.21.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.22.desc: James Tiberius Kirk was the descendant of late 19th century American frontier pioneers and was inspired to join Starfleet due to the actions of his father. During his time in the Command Training Program, Kirk became famous for being the only cadet in history to beat the 'no-win' Kobayashi Maru scenario, and earning a commendation for original thinking. Should Kirk become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral!?
STH_hero_leader.22.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.23.desc: Jean-Luc Picard caused a stir in rural France when he left his family's vineyard to join Starfleet Academy, he became one of the most successful cadets in his class becoming an expert in archeology and command. Picard served on a number of prominent ships before taking the initiative during a crisis on the USS Stargazer and saving the lives of the crew with the now famous 'Picard Manoverver'. Should Picard become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.23.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.24.desc: John Harriman II, son of former Commander-in-chief 'Blackjack' Harriman, is an exceptional student who has risen up the ranks rapidly - in only a small part due to his father's influence. Born onboard the USS Sea of Tranquility, Harriman has spent only weeks planetside with most of his life spent onboard starships. Now, with his training complete, should Harriman become a Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship, or instead a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.24.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.25.desc: Rachel Garrett was born in Madison, Indiana on Earth. She has served with distinction on numerous vessels, though the psychological profile shows that her family life could be strained. Should Garrett become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.25.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.26.desc: Georgiou attended the Imperial Starfleet Academy from 2220 to 2224. Through flattery and seduction she gained a lot of influential allies among notable Starfleet admirals, including Christopher Pike himself, who credited her as a 'dependent, but effective weapon of destruction'. With such connections it did not take her too long to graduate from the Academy and be assigned to the ISS Archimedes. As a Lieutenant, Georgiou participated in numerous combat engagements against alien fleets, while also steadily climbing the ranks, removing the obstacles with favours and assassinations. With her achievements appearing more and more in Starfleet Command's internal documentation, her accelerated promotion to the highest ranks was just a matter of time. Should Georgiou become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.26.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.27.desc: Joining the Imperial Starfleet on Admiral Alexander Marcus' recommendation, Christopher Pike quickly rose through the ranks - some say that he has been pushed by Starfleet Command to become a poster boy for the Empire, but his impressive kill record is a simple enough explanation. Ruthless and ambitious, Pike embodies what it means to be a Terran. Should Pike become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.27.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.28.desc: James Tiberius Kirk was the descendant of late 19th century American naval officers and joined the Imperial Starfleet for sake of the prestige and power he could obtain in the military. One of his very first achievements was eliminating more than two hundred Imperial officers, including Captain Stephen Garrovick, in what is now known as 'The Farragut Incident'. Should Kirk become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral!?
STH_hero_leader.28.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.29.desc: A dedicated Starfleet officer, Commander Archer's desire for his own command landed him in the center seat of an advanced starship. However, his quest for power and glory, and his ultimate desire to take over the Terran Empire were both his biggest strength and biggest weakness. Should Archer become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.29.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.30.desc: Captain Maximilian Forrest was a notable Terran leader in the 2150s. He was the commanding officer of the ISS Enterprise, developing an adversarial relationship with his first officer, Commander Jonathan Archer. Although more harsh and stern than his counterpart in the prime universe, relatively speaking, Forrest seemed to honestly care about the overall well-being of his ship and crew, and was legitimately concerned when a Terran Empire task force was destroyed fighting rebels at Tau Ceti. Should Forrest become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.30.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.31.desc:
Self-serving and cruel, few would have predicted Sato's rise to power. Before serving on the Enterprise, Sato had been a teacher in Brazil. Serving mainly as Captain Forrest's woman, Sato had previously been involved with Jonathan Archer but left him for Forrest when he was promoted to a position of higher power.
Should Sato become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.31.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.32.desc: Very few people could be considered as determined as Erika Hernandez. Having been passed up for command of Earth's first warp 5 starship, Hernandez vowed never to come in second place again and that she would take any means to ensure this she never did. Should Hernandez become a heroic Scientist capable of commanding a Flagship or a heroic Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.32.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.33.desc: Seven of Nine (full designation: Seven of Nine, Tertiary Adjunct of Unimatrix 01) was a former Borg drone, born Annika Hansen, a Human female. Assimilated by the Borg at the age of six, Seven was liberated by the crew of the USS Voyager in 2374. She was both a brilliant scientific mind and possessed considerable leadership skills forged through her service within the Fenris Rangers. Should Seven of Nine become a Scientist or an Admiral?
STH_hero_leader.33.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_leader.34.desc: Bruce Maddox has had a chequered past: once a promising scientist in the field of cybernetics, his objection to giving Androids the status of living beings was well known within the scientific community. Since that point he has come to revere the work of Soong and Graves and can now be considered a leading mind in the field of positronic research.
STH_hero_leader.34.name: Synthetic expert recruited from the Daystrom Institute
STH_hero_leader.35.desc: We have been approached by a young warrior from the planet Capella, a number of years ago during an expedition to the planet one of our leaders saved the young man's life. He wishes to apply for Starfleet Academy and serve the country which saved his life all those years ago.
STH_hero_leader.35.name: Young Capellan Hero
STH_hero_leader.36.desc: Young Capellan, Leonard James Akaar has completed his training in Starfleet Academy with exemplary scores. Ready to take his place in the fleet and bring honour to his name.
STH_hero_leader.36.name: Capellan graduates with honours
STH_hero_leader.37.desc: Having served as Voyager's Physician during its long journey home, the EMH has returned to Starfleet as a one of the most advanced and experienced Holograms in the fleet and after convincing many of his doubters wrong and thus earning recognition as a lifeform in his own right, the Doctor is ready to serve.
STH_hero_leader.37.name: Hero of the Delta Quadrant
STH_hero_leader.38.desc: Despite managing to serve Voyager's tour of the Delta Quadrant as an Ensign, the unsung hero of the Starship Voyager Harry Kim has finally earned himself that promotion.
STH_hero_leader.38.name: Hero of the Delta Quadrant
STH_hero_leader.39.desc: The former Starfleet dropout and former Maquis engineer, B'Elanna Torres has been described by many as one of the finest engineers in the business. Torres' half-klingon temper often gets her in trouble, but her undoubted skills and abilities saved the crew more times than they could count, quickly earning her a full commission on Voyager's return.
STH_hero_leader.39.name: Hero of the Delta Quadrant
STH_hero_leader.40.desc: Regarded as some as the best pilot in the fleet, and by others as a no good rogue Tom Paris has had a troubling career thus far. Son of famed Admiral Owen Paris and kicked from Starfleet for covering up a tragic accident, Paris has reformed his ways and served Voyager with distinction. His return to home and glowing references have convinced the Admiralty to give him another chance.
STH_hero_leader.40.name: Hero of the Delta Quadrant
STH_hero_leader.41.desc: Once considered a promising officer before he defected to the Maquis to defend his homeland against the Cardassians, Chakotay served as Voyagers second in command throughout its journey home. Not afraid to challenge his captain, but fiercely loyal Chakotay was welcomed back into the fleet with open arms upon Voyager's return.
STH_hero_leader.41.name: Hero of the Delta Quadrant
STH_hero_leader.42.desc: A man of many talents Neelix served as guide, cook and moral officer... not always with permission! Far from his home, but with plenty to offer Neelix has the skills to govern and host his own banquets.
STH_hero_leader.42.name: Hero of the Delta Quadrant
STH_hero_leader.43.desc:
As Earth propels itself into the stars, the role of Starfleet becomes ever more important as it begins the process of rolling Earth's other military organisations into a singular spacefaring entity. 

Balthazar Edison, hero of United Earth's multiple early conflicts whilst serving with the MACOs is seeking a new role within Starfleet. 

Edison is one of many war veterans seeking a place in an unfamiliar world.
STH_hero_leader.43.name: A new role for a decorated Military Hero
STH_hero_leader.45.desc:
Despite two of the finest captains in Starfleet going into battle for Seven, Starfleet's concerns and prejudices were not easily overcome, leaving Seven feeling that she could do more good to the galaxy outside of Starfleet and the Federation. 

Seeing the work that organisations such as the Fenris Rangers are doing in the border regions, Seven head to the frontier to change lives.
STH_hero_leader.45.name: Seven of Nine
STH_hero_leader.46.desc: It wasn't an easy conversation, but Seven had some high profile backers within the ranks of Starfleet and so, as a result the Admiralty have agreed that her exceptional skills and experience would only aid the Federation, offering her a fast-tracked position within the fleet.
STH_hero_leader.46.name: Seven of Nine
STH_hero_leader.47.desc: Considered by many to be one of the most decorated captains in Starfleet history, Robert April was responsible for launching the careers of many of Starfleet's greats, such as Pike, Number One & the Enterprise herself. Not to be outshone by others April was considered a pioneer of Starfleet and a commanding presence amongst the Admiralty.
STH_hero_leader.47.name: Robert April
STH_hero_leader.50.desc:
The death of noted Federation scientist Richard Daystrom has left a noticeable hole in the scientific community. 

A sizeable group of scientists have expressed a wish to set up a new scientific research institute named in honour of Dr Daystrom, it will become the leading light in scientific research and a place for the very best minds in Starfleet and the civilian sector to come together to produce the finest research for the federation.
STH_hero_leader.50.name: Death of noted Scientist Richard Daystrom
STH_hero_leader.60.desc: A mysterious presence living on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] has come forward, for thousands of years, the alien Lanthanites have been living amongst our people, undetected and unobserved... they now feel the time is right to reveal their society and are asking to join us formally.
STH_hero_leader.60.name: Lanthanites Revealed
STH_hero_leader.61.desc: Commander Pelia was a female Lanthanite Starfleet officer who lived on Earth from the 6th century BC through at least the 23rd century. She served as an instructor at Starfleet Academy before being assigned to Operational Support Services as chief fleet inspector, and later transferred to the USS Enterprise as chief engineer.
STH_hero_leader.61.name: I'm a Lanthanite. I've lived for thousands of years
STH_hero_mechanics.10.desc: After years of serving United Earth, there are many calls for Jonathan Archer to help [Root.Owner.GetName] in a new manner. The world of politics awaits and many would love to see Starfleet's hero take a leading role in governing and helping decide the future.
STH_hero_mechanics.10.name: Time for jonathan Archer to decide what's next
STH_hero_mechanics.11.desc:
After a long and impressive career in service of [Root.Owner.GetName], [hero_retire.GetName]'s thoughts turn to [hero_retire.GetHerHis] future. Even though others may advise to never leave the bridge of your ship. Sometimes other opportunities to serve present themselves.

Some leaders are suited to being Ambassadors, governors or serving as Fleet Admirals. Alternatively returning to the Academy as a lecturer maybe the right decision.
STH_hero_mechanics.11.name: Decision to be made for [hero_retire.GetName]
STH_hero_mechanics.15.desc: After treating many patients from many different species, [doctor_retire.GetName] has the opportunity to look at what they want to do in the future. What choice should they make?
STH_hero_mechanics.15.name: Time for our Doctor to decide
STH_hero_mechanics.150.desc:
Our colony on [bajoran_rebels_target.GetName] has been attacked, reports from our local Obsidian Order operatives suggest that it was orchestrated by a Bajoran cell, not yet ready to move on from the past. 

What is more concerning it appears they used Federation technology to carry out this attack!
STH_hero_mechanics.150.name: Terrorist Attack on [bajoran_rebels_target.GetName]
STH_hero_mechanics.151.desc: Our intelligence services report that the Cardassian colony on [bajoran_rebels_target.GetName] suffered a significant terrorist attack, with preliminary reports suggesting a rogue Bajoran cell being to blame for the destruction.
STH_hero_mechanics.151.name: Cardassian planet attacked
STH_hero_mechanics.152.desc:
Greetings Starfleet, you will no doubt by now be aware of the callous attack on our innocent civilians on the peaceful colony world of [bajoran_rebels_target.GetName]. 

Our reports suggest that your 'allies' the Bajorans have not moved on from the events of the past and continue to habour a grudge for the missgivings of the past. We invite you to deal with this situation before we send our fleets in to make a more permanent solution.
STH_hero_mechanics.152.name: Incoming Message from Cardassia Prime
STH_hero_mechanics.153.desc: Those cowards in the Federation have refused to condemn those Bajoran fools and will not stand with Cardassia in the face of these attacks. This insult will not go unpunished or forgotten by those on Cardassia Prime.
STH_hero_mechanics.153.name: Federation refuse our Request
STH_hero_mechanics.154.desc: The Federation has seen sense and condemned the acts of those Bajorans fools, pledging their support to track down the source of the leaked weapons and bring a stop to these senseless attacks on our planets.
STH_hero_mechanics.154.name: Federation condemns the Bajoran Republic
STH_hero_mechanics.155.desc: The Federation has expressed a desire to fully investigate the matter to determine who launched the attack on us and how they obtained the use of Starfleet-grade weapons. The Central Government has allowed them limited time to investigate on the condition that when they reach the logical conclusion, they act swiftly and decisively.
STH_hero_mechanics.155.name: Federations wishes to investigate
STH_hero_mechanics.156.desc:
Greetings I am [hero_choice_1.GetName] and I am preparing to lead the investigation into the bombings on [bajoran_rebels_target.GetName]. 

 Starfleet has provided the services of a Bajoran national, Ro Laren, currently serving time in a penal colony for causing the deaths of a number of her crew mates whilst on a mission with the USS Wellington. Our diplomatic services believe that Ro would be able to provide valuable insights into the Bajoran cell but be warned of her reputation with her fellow officers. Many believe she has no right to be free from her confinement.
STH_hero_mechanics.156.name: Ro Laren
STH_hero_mechanics.157.name: Contact made with Bajorans
STH_hero_mechanics.158.desc: Unfortunately Keeve Falor was unable to provide any meaningful evidence or information about the attacks, either he is unwilling to provide answers, or more likely has been left out of the loop. We must inform the Cardassians of our failure... they will not be pleased.
STH_hero_mechanics.158.name: Dead End...
STH_hero_mechanics.159.desc: The Starfleet officer in charge of investigating the attacks on our planet has reported that they have been unable to identify who was responsible for the bombing of our planet. We have no choice but to hold any and all Bajorans responsible for the atrocities and our faith in Starfleet remains justifiably low.
STH_hero_mechanics.159.name: Federation Failure
STH_hero_mechanics.16.desc: One of our honoured soldiers who has answered the call of the warrior over many years has the chance to serve the Empire in new ways. [hero_retire_kdf.GetName] has defeated all enemies in their way over many years now and new challenges await them within the Empire.
STH_hero_mechanics.16.name: Honoured Warrior
STH_hero_mechanics.160.desc:
The away team is directed to a hidden facility in the hills overlooking the Bajoran camp and introduced to an individual known only as 'Orta', who appears to head up the remains of a cell. By the looks of his scarred appearance, it would seem he has been battling the Cardassians for most of his life. 

Orta explains that his cell is in no longer in a fit state to continue their operation against the Cardassians and that they have knowledge that heavily implies that the attack against the Cardassians was a setup, by a small corner of the Obsidian Order, intending to turn the Federation against the Bajorans and allow the Cardassians to blame them and retaliate and wipe out those who resisted during the Occupation.
STH_hero_mechanics.160.name: Meeting with Orta
STH_hero_mechanics.161.desc: The Starfleet investigation into the recent attacks indicates that the Bajoran sect we suspected of the attacks is not responsible and is in no fit condition to have attacked anyone. Despite our inquiries, the Starfleet Captain claims they were unable to record the location of this cell, either that or they are unwilling to share. The likelihood of this being an internal job seems unlikely, but the Obsidian Order stands ready to investigate.
STH_hero_mechanics.161.name: Message from Starfleet
STH_hero_mechanics.162.name: Response from Cardassia
STH_hero_mechanics.163.desc: Following the conclusion of the mission, Starfleet are after a recommendation on what they should do with Ro Laren, many in Starfleet would prefer that she is ushered out of the service, but she clearly has a method of getting things done.
STH_hero_mechanics.163.name: The Future of Ensign Ro
STH_hero_mechanics.164.desc: Starfleet has returned from their investigations with a prisoner in tow and ready to hand over to us! It appears the humans have apprehended a pitiful Bajoran terrorist with dreams of harming their former masters, whilst it seems a bit suspicious that this rag-tag group could have caused the amount of damage sustained in the attack a full set of questions by the Obsidian Order should reveal more and flush out the remains of his group and any resources they might have.
STH_hero_mechanics.164.name: Report from Starfleet
STH_hero_mechanics.165.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetLeaderName], we thank you for turning over your captive and are pleased by your cooperation and assistance during this unfortunate event. Rest assured our operatives will take this investigation from here and we will see no further attacks from this group. 

Incoming Message: From Ensign Ro Lare... Please accept this message as formal resignation from Starfleet, and you can all formally go to he... Message Terminates.
STH_hero_mechanics.165.name: Response from Cardassia
STH_hero_mechanics.18.desc: Calls within the High Council for more proactive leadership are starting to gather momentum, with notable General Martok, famous for many victories becoming a strong candidate to move from the battlefield to a role within Klingon politics.
STH_hero_mechanics.18.name: General Martok
STH_hero_mechanics.2.desc:
After a long and distinguised career within [Root.Owner.GetName], it is time for [potential_retirement_leader.GetName] to consider their career options and potential retirement. 

[potential_retirement_leader.GetSheHe] may decide to retire from service, continue their service, move into academia - to help train the next generation or move into a senior role within their chain of command and behind the scenes.

What decision should be made?
STH_hero_mechanics.2.name: Career decision to be made
STH_hero_mechanics.20.desc:
For many years the loyal 'Number One' of Christopher Pike has served her Captain with dedication and loyalty. 

Following a recommendation from Pike a new command awaits Commander Una Chin-Riley and a chance to step into the captain's chair.
STH_hero_mechanics.20.name: Number One
STH_hero_mechanics.201.desc: While serving alongside [recruitment_leader.GetName] during their expedition Dr Selar has been recognised for her exemplary work as part of [recruitment_leader.GetName]'s medical staff. Earning the opportunity to make her own name amongst the fleet.
STH_hero_mechanics.201.name: Dr Selar Reporting for Duty
STH_hero_mechanics.202.desc: During [recruitment_leader.GetName]'s most recent mission on their current expedition one young nurse stood out amongst the medical staff, Nurse Ogawa has proven to be more than just another 'Lower Decker' and has been recommended for a promotion and a notable position amongst the fleet.
STH_hero_mechanics.202.name: Nurse Ogawa
STH_hero_mechanics.203.desc: Having served aboard the USS Voyager and learning his trade in the Delta Quadrant, Lt. Vorik has once again served with distinction on [recruitment_leader.GetName]'s current deep space mission, earning himself a deserved promotion.
STH_hero_mechanics.203.name: Engineer Vorik
STH_hero_mechanics.204.desc: Lon Suder has undergone an extreme journey whilst aboard the USS Voyager, but through hard work and mentoring from [recruitment_leader.GetName] during their current mission on the far reaches of [Root.GetName] space they are ready to play a larger part in fleet operations.
STH_hero_mechanics.204.name: Watch out Suder's About
STH_hero_mechanics.205.desc: Ranul Keru was an unjoined Trill with a reputation for fierce loyalty and unwavering devotion to his crew. This service has gained the notice of his commanding officer [recruitment_leader.GetName] and a promotion come the end of the current expedition.
STH_hero_mechanics.205.name: Security Officer Keru
STH_hero_mechanics.206.desc: Christine Vale has served with many of the finest Captains in Starfleet, before being promoted to XO, her recent service record, and acts of great service during [recruitment_leader.GetName]'s expedition has earned her a chance to take the Captain's chair herself.
STH_hero_mechanics.206.name: Ms Vale, I presume?
STH_hero_mechanics.207.desc: Xin Ra-Havreii was responsible for the design of the Luna Class Warp Core before a number of setbacks pushed him back into a Chief Engineer's role, but under the command of [recruitment_leader.GetName] Xin is ready to once again make a name for himself in Starfleet.
STH_hero_mechanics.207.name: Dr Xin in the House
STH_hero_mechanics.208.desc: Raffi has served loyally under Jean-Luc Picard for many years, becoming his new number one and whilst certain temptations always remain close to the surface, few have as keen an eye as Raffi for spotting suspicious activity. If 'J.L' believes she is ready to take the next step, perhaps a greater role in the fleet has been earned.
STH_hero_mechanics.208.name: The Star Gazer
STH_hero_mechanics.209.desc: The former Chief of Security onboard the USS Enterprise-D has pulled herself up the ranks of Starfleet, starting with so little but making a name of her own. Whilst serving alongside [recruitment_leader.GetName] Yar once again demonstrated her great value.
STH_hero_mechanics.209.name: Tasha Yar reporting for duty
STH_hero_mechanics.21.desc: Cadet Uhura was regarded as a bit of a communications prodigy at the academy securing a prestigious position within the fleet. Her recent performances whilst on expedition have earned her the right to be promoted.
STH_hero_mechanics.21.name: Open Hailing Frequences
STH_hero_mechanics.210.desc: Marked from a young age as a potential genius, Wesley Crusher served as a provisional ensign onboard the Federation's flagship even before attending the academy, Now is his chance to shine on the galactic stage.
STH_hero_mechanics.210.name: Shut up Wesley!
STH_hero_mechanics.211.desc: Lieutenant Commander Airiam was a female Human cyborg, a Starfleet science officer who lived during the mid-23rd century. Beginning in 2256, she served aboard the USS Discovery as the spore drive ops officer.
STH_hero_mechanics.211.name: Lieutenant Commander Airiam
STH_hero_mechanics.212.desc: Rhys was appointed chief tactical officer aboard the USS Discovery. In 2257, in recognition of his role in ending the Federation-Klingon War, Rhys was awarded the Starfleet Medal of Honor.
STH_hero_mechanics.212.name: Gen Rhys
STH_hero_mechanics.213.desc: Having earned her pilot's license at age 12, Keyla Detmer soon became one of the fleet's most promising young helm officers.
STH_hero_mechanics.213.name: Keyla Detmer
STH_hero_mechanics.214.desc: Lieutenant Commander Joann Owosekun, nicknamed 'Owo', was a female Human Starfleet officer who served during the mid-23rd century and the late 32nd century. Owosekun was raised in a Luddite collective on Earth and at the age of 15 she watched her best friend die without being able to help, which drove her decision to join Starfleet.
STH_hero_mechanics.214.name: Joann 'Owo' Owosekun
STH_hero_mechanics.215.desc: Ronald Altman Bryce was a male Human Starfleet communications officer who served on the USS Discovery in the mid-23rd century. As a child he listened to old radio emissions in space with his grandmother. This is why he loves comms.
STH_hero_mechanics.215.name: R.A. Bryce
STH_hero_mechanics.22.desc: George Samuel Kirk, Jr. was born the son of George and Winona Kirk in Riverside, Iowa on Earth. He is the brother of famed Starfleet Captain James T. Kirk; who believes he alone calls his brother by the nickname 'Sam'.
STH_hero_mechanics.22.name: So you've met my Brother?
STH_hero_mechanics.23.desc: Doctor Tracy Pollard was a female Human Starfleet officer in the 23rd century and later in the 32nd century. She was assigned to the USS Discovery in the 2250s as a physician.
STH_hero_mechanics.23.name: Doctor Pollard
STH_hero_mechanics.24.desc: This is the USS Discovery. My name's Commander Landry. I'm Chief of Security here. I see we're unloading all kinds of garbage today. Even Starfleet's first mutineer. On me.
STH_hero_mechanics.24.name: Ellen Landry
STH_hero_mechanics.25.desc: Commander Adreek-Hu was an 24th century Aurelian Starfleet command division officer who served as first officer aboard the USS Protostar.
STH_hero_mechanics.25.name: Commander Adreek-Hu
STH_hero_mechanics.26.desc: Commander Tysess was a male Andorian command division officer who served as the first officer of the USS Dauntless and the USS Voyager-A under Vice Admiral Kathryn Janeway in the late 24th century. He was on the bridge in 2384 when the Dauntless's sensors detected a third proto-warp signature originating from the USS Protostar.
STH_hero_mechanics.26.name: Commander Tysess
STH_hero_mechanics.302.name: Michael Eddington
STH_hero_mechanics.303.name: Hey, batter, batter, batter, batter, batter
STH_hero_mechanics.304.name: From now on, I'll make sure to give you special attention
STH_hero_mechanics.305.name: I've dreamed of this for so long. Eject.
STH_hero_mechanics.306.name: Congratulations, you look like a scratching post
STH_hero_mechanics.307.name: Vulcan as a...
STH_hero_mission.1.desc:
El Servicio Diplomático de [Root.GetName] ha organizado una conferencia de alto nivel con la administración de [diplomomatic_target1.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [diplomomatic_target1.Owner.GetRulerName] en [diplomatic_target1.GetName]. 

El [diplomacyHeroFleet1.GetFleetName] bajo el comando [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] se ha seleccionado para transportar la delegación [Root.GetName] y ofrecer soporte completo mientras la conferencia está en curso.
STH_hero_mission.1.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.10.desc:
La conferencia sobre [diplomate_target1.GetName] ha concluido con éxito, dejando las relaciones entre el [Root.Owner.GetName] y el [diplomomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] mejorado. 

Cuando las sesiones iniciales sufrieron reveses iniciales y parecían insinuar una incapacidad para llegar a un acuerdo sobre una serie de acuerdos mutuamente beneficiosos entre las dos potencias, al final de la segunda semana quedó claro que los principales objetivos de la conferencia serían Se reunió en parte debido a los esfuerzos del capitán [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] para facilitar las negociaciones.
STH_hero_mission.10.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.11.desc:
Una conferencia diplomática liderada por [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] en [diplomatic_target1.GetName] ha concluido con éxito, dejando las relaciones entre el [Root.GetName] y el [diplomomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] mejorado. 

Cuando las sesiones iniciales sufrieron reveses iniciales y parecían insinuar una incapacidad para llegar a un acuerdo sobre una serie de acuerdos mutuamente beneficiosos entre las dos potencias, al final de la segunda semana quedó claro que los principales objetivos de la conferencia serían Se reunió en parte debido a los esfuerzos del capitán [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] para facilitar las negociaciones.
STH_hero_mission.11.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.12.desc:
La conferencia sobre [diplomática_target1.GetName] ha superado las expectativas iniciales, dejando sustancialmente mejoradas las relaciones entre [Root.Owner.GetName] y [diplomomatic_target1.Owner.GetName]. 

Las sesiones iniciales fueron productivas y dieron a entender una serie de acuerdos mutuamente beneficiosos entre las dos potencias, mientras que al final de la segunda semana quedó claro que los principales objetivos de la conferencia se cumplirían debido a los colosales esfuerzos de Capitán [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] para facilitar las negociaciones.
STH_hero_mission.12.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.13.desc:
Una conferencia diplomática liderada por [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] sobre [diplomatic_target1.GetName] ha superado las expectativas iniciales, dejando las relaciones entre el [Root.GetName] y el [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] mejorado sustancialmente. 

Las sesiones iniciales fueron productivas y dieron a entender una serie de acuerdos mutuamente beneficiosos entre las dos potencias, mientras que al final de la segunda semana quedó claro que los principales objetivos de la conferencia se cumplirían debido a los colosales esfuerzos de Capitán [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] para facilitar las negociaciones. 

So impresionado con la delegación [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] fueron muchos en [diplomática_target1.GetName], que [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] está bajo presión de los diplomáticos para ofrecer una cooperación más sustancial, desde el comercio Derechos a los programas de intercambio de funcionarios.
STH_hero_mission.13.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.15.desc:
Tras el extraordinario éxito de la conferencia diplomática sobre [diplomatic_target1.GetName], el [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] ha autorizado un programa de intercambio de oficiales entre las dos potencias. 

El primer oficial para unirse al esquema es el científico [giftedLeader.GetName], que ahora está disponible para el servicio.
STH_hero_mission.15.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.16.desc:
Tras el extraordinario éxito de la conferencia diplomática sobre [diplomatic_target1.GetName], el [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] ha autorizado un programa de intercambio de oficiales entre las dos potencias. 

El primer oficial a unirse al esquema es el Almirante [giftedLeader.GetName], que ahora está disponible para el servicio.
STH_hero_mission.16.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.17.desc:
Tras el extraordinario éxito de la conferencia diplomática sobre [diplomatic_target1.GetName], el [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] ha autorizado un programa de intercambio de oficiales entre las dos potencias. 

El primer oficial a unirse al esquema es General [giftedLeader.GetName], que ahora está disponible para el servicio.
STH_hero_mission.17.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.18.desc: Al no haber transportado la delegación diplomática a [diplomatic_target1.GetName] en el tiempo asignado, las relaciones entre [Root.GetName] y el [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] se han visto gravemente afectadas, como [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetRulerName] reacciona enojado al insulto percibido.
STH_hero_mission.18.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.19.desc: A falta de transporte de un equipo de la delegación diplomática a [diplomatic_target1.GetName] en el tiempo asignado, las relaciones entre el [Root.GetName] y el [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] se han visto gravemente afectados, como [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root. GetRulerName] admistration reacciona enojado con el insulto percibido.
STH_hero_mission.19.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.2.desc:
La conferencia sobre [diplomate_target1.GetName] ha terminado desastrosamente, dejando las relaciones entre [Root.Owner.GetName] y [diplomomatic_target1.Owner.GetName] tensas. 

Los primeros días fueron productivos y parecían sugerir un acuerdo mutuamente beneficioso entre las dos potencias. Sin embargo, para el final de la primera semana el negociador principal en el equipo diplomático de [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [diplomatic_target1.Owner.GetRulerName] llegó a los golpes con el capitán [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] después de concluir aparentemente que [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetSheHe] Estaba románticamente involucrado con el cónyuge del negociador.

Defing su capitán, un número de [Root.GetFleetName] tripulación fueron arrestados como la pelea engullido el centro de conferencias.
STH_hero_mission.2.name: Extensión Diplomática
STH_hero_mission.20.desc: As our teams prepare to leave the conference a group of rebel ships opposed to the recent conference appear from an undisclosed location intent on attacking our vessels to disrupt the conference.
STH_hero_mission.20.name: Rebels attack!
STH_hero_mission.22.desc: A group of rebels frustrated with our invitation to invite a third party to our system have managed to get access to a small fleet of ships and are looking to disrupt proceedings. Our security services have requested that we deal with these rebels quickly.
STH_hero_mission.22.name: Rebels attack!
STH_hero_mission.3.desc:
Una conferencia diplomática liderada por [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] en [diplomate_target1.GetName] ha terminado desastrosamente, dejando las relaciones entre el [Root.GetName] y el [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] tensas. 

Los primeros días fueron productivos y parecían sugerir un acuerdo mutuamente beneficioso entre las dos potencias. Sin embargo, al final de la primera semana, el negociador líder en el equipo diplomático [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] llegó a los golpes con el capitán [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetName] después de concluir que aparentemente [diplomacyHeroLeader1.GetSheHe] El cónyuge del negociador. 

Algunos miembros de la [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Fleet.GetFleetName] fueron arrestados mientras la pelea engullía el centro de conferencias. 

El [diplomacyHeroLeader1.Owner.GetName] todavía tiene que disculparse formalmente por el incidente.
STH_hero_mission.3.name: Extensión Diplomática
