STH_klingon_story.2004.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] the Klingon Empire has called for aid in defending the Khitomer system from attack, it is rare that the Empire seeks help from outsiders, so the situation must be dire. A fleet and one of our finest leaders must be sent to the system at once.
STH_klingon_story.2004.name: Klingons call for aid
STH_klingon_story.2005.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] the aid from our so called allies arrived too late to ward off the attack against the planet, Early indications show widespread devastation and loss of life. Efforts to rebuild the colony could take many years and many in the medical division do not believe that we can help those in immediate peril without inviting the orbiting rescue fleet the chance to prove their worth.
STH_klingon_story.2005.name: Khitomer: Arrived too late
STH_klingon_story.2006.desc: Despite the best efforts of our fleet we did not arrive in time to ward off the attack against Khitomer, initial scans show huge devastation to the main settlement and heavy loss of life. From this range we cannot tell who instigated this attack, but it is clear that all is not well within the Klingon High Command. However, our chance to help is not over, the Klingon authorities have asked us for additional help in assessing the damage and providing aid to those in immediate risk on the planet's surface.
STH_klingon_story.2006.name: Khitomer: Arrived too late
STH_klingon_story.2007.desc: Despite the best efforts of our fleet we did not arrive in time to ward off the attack against Khitomer, initial scans show huge devastation to the main settlement and heavy loss of life. From this range we cannot tell who instigated this attack, but it is clear that all is not well within the Klingon High Command. The Klingons are refusing any further help and have 'politely' asked us to leave their space before they consider us a target. We should leave before they turn their anger out on us. The people on the planet will need to fend for themselves.
STH_klingon_story.2007.name: Khitomer: Arrived too late
STH_klingon_story.2008.desc: Sir, our fleet in the Khitomer system have arrived just in time to catch the perpetrators in the act. It appears a fleet of Romulan warships are preparing for a fresh assault against the surface. The ships match no known Imperial warbirds, which could suggest they belong to the infamous Tal Shiar, if this is the case the Romulan senate will deny all knowledge of the attack. Our forces are in position to help repel the attack, but this will endanger [Root] lives and possibly future relations with the Romulan Star Empire. Failing to help will be seen as an act of dishonour by the Klingons.
STH_klingon_story.2008.name: Khitomer: Attack in progress
STH_klingon_story.2015.name: Khitomer defended
STH_klingon_story.2016.desc: [rescueCountry.GetLeaderName] All Tal Shiar forces have been defeated, as expected they have left no trace of evidence that the ships originated from Romulus and no prisoners were taken during the assault, many voices from within are urging us to condemn the sneak attack and publicly blame the Romulans. Additionally we have received word from Q'ono'S that they would welcome an away team down the main colony to help look for survivors.
STH_klingon_story.2016.name: Khitomer defended
STH_klingon_story.2017.desc: [rescueCountry.GetLeaderName] All Tal Shiar forces have been defeated, as expected they have left no trace of evidence that the ships originated from Romulus and no prisoners were taken during the assault, many voices from within are urging us to condemn the sneak attack and publicly blame the Romulans. In true Klingon fashion their homeworld has declined any further interference from outside forces and we have been asked to leave their space quickly. It appears we have done all we can here.
STH_klingon_story.2017.name: Khitomer defended
STH_klingon_story.2018.desc: Our away teams are ready to head to the planet's surface, our preliminary analysis suggests that the romulans were after specific intel and research that appears to have been underway. With the disarray that is taking place on the planet we have the opportunity to obtain this information and boost our standings with the Romulans or continue our mission of peace and look to cement a better relationship with the Klingons.
STH_klingon_story.2018.name: Send a team to Khitomer
STH_klingon_story.2019.desc: Thanks to the dedication and tireless efforts by our teams we have managed to salvage a lot of the infrastructure on the surface and rescue a great many lives that would have otherwise perished. The colony should be back on its feet in relatively short order. One of our teams also found a small orphaned Klingon boy amongst the ruins, he has asked to stay with us and is seemingly quite attached to our way of life. What we have achieved here today should go along way to building bonds between our two worlds.
STH_klingon_story.2019.name: Khitomer: Aid delivered successfully
STH_klingon_story.2020.desc: Our efforts have made a small headway in repairing the damage to Khitomer, which should speed up the time it takes for the planet to fully recover from the damage done during the sneak attack. The Klingons are mildly thankful for our efforts and it looks like this will go some way to building a better relationship between our worlds.
STH_klingon_story.2020.name: Khitomer: Sufficient help provided
STH_klingon_story.2021.desc: Our efforts to help have failed to provide sufficient help to those on the planet's surface, the damage done to the infrastructure was worse than our initial scans unveiled and our plans to help have only made a bad situation worse. The Klingons have reacted poorly to this news and we have failed to secure the boost to our relationship that many back home hoped for.
STH_klingon_story.2021.name: Khitomer: Further damage done
STH_klingon_story.2022.desc: We have managed to secure the data that the Tal Shiar was after, right underneath the Klingon's noses, plus we have managed to cover our tracks so the authorities have no clue that we have managed to complete the work started by the agents. Our contacts in the Romulan secret agency will be eager to hear from us and would pay a small future to obtain this data.
STH_klingon_story.2022.name: Khitomer: Klingon research data found
STH_klingon_story.2030.desc: Our fleet has arrived at the edge of the Khitomer system, we can see that the planetary defense systems have been powered down, it is unclear why or what happened to allow this to take place. Even at this distance we can see that the focus of the attack appears to be the Klingon settlement on the planet Khitomer and our long range scans can see fires raging on the world's surface. We cannot find any evidence of who is responsible for the attack, all we can do now is wait for a response from the High Command.
STH_klingon_story.2030.name: Arrived at Khitomer
STH_klingon_story.2031.desc: Chancellor! A monumental effort has gone into helping the survivors of Khitomer our allies, the [rescueCountry.GetName] have done a truly honourable job in aiding those in need. Songs will song of the deeds done here today and the new allies we have made here today forged in battle and in defending the weak. As feared all evidence of the attack was destroyed by the assailant, but many suspect this was the work of the honourless Tal Shiar. This has been a major event in the course of the quadrant.
STH_klingon_story.2031.name: Aid sent to Khitomer
STH_klingon_story.2032.desc: Chancellor! The combined efforts of our forces and the aid provided from the outsiders have managed to render enough aid to the colony on Khitomer that should mean any lingering damage will not take long to undo. Our thoughts turn to revenge and many in the council chambers would rather focus on reclaiming our honour instead of focusing on the united efforts to save lives. This has been a major event shaping the future of the beta quadrant.
STH_klingon_story.2032.name: Aid sent to Khitomer
STH_klingon_story.2033.desc: Chancellor! Despite our best efforts and those of our so-called allies the death toll and damage done to the infrastructure of Khitomer continues to climb, this truly is a disaster. Anger and a desire for revenge against friend and foe alike is high. Our warriors demand a chance to strike back against those who have wronged us.
STH_klingon_story.2033.name: Aid sent to Khitomer
STH_klingon_story.2034.desc: [rescueCountry.GetTitle] [rescueCountry.GetLeaderName] the attack against the Klingon world appears to have been devastating, and the death toll is still climbing. Unfortunately we were unable to identify the attackers and they have fled the scene. The Klingons have always been a insular race so it is only appropriate we wait for a decision from them before we make any further decisions.
STH_klingon_story.2034.name: Devastating Attack in Khitomer System
STH_klingon_story.2040.desc: Our operatives in the Tal Shiar have compiled a report on a secret unsanctioned mission deep into Klingon space. They obtained the planetary defence codes from a source within the Klingon government and were able to send a task force into the their space to attack the planet and secure critical research data from a hidden research outpost.
STH_klingon_story.2040.name: Report from the Tal Shiar
STH_klingon_story.2041.desc: The young orphan calls himself Worf and he is eager to repay the debt in saving his life. He has asked that we sponsor his attendance at our military academy and has promised to server with honour.
STH_klingon_story.2041.name: Potential new recruit
STH_klingon_story.2042.desc: The young orphan calls himself Worf and he is eager to repay the debt in saving his life. He has asked that we sponsor his attendance at our military academy and has promised to server with honour. He would make a fine warrior in the KDF.
STH_klingon_story.2042.name: Potential new recruit
STH_klingon_story.2043.desc: [rescueCountry.GetTitle] [rescueCountry.GetLeaderName] after completing his training and proving himself multiples times, the first Klingon officer is ready to join our ranks as a new heroic admiral.
STH_klingon_story.2043.name: Worf, New Hero graduates
STH_klingon_story.2044.desc: [rescueCountry.GetTitle] [rescueCountry.GetLeaderName] after completing his training and proving himself multiples times, the new Klingon officer is ready to join our ranks as a heroic admiral. This is a glorious day for the empire as the son of Mogh joins the battle.
STH_klingon_story.2044.name: Worf, New Hero graduates
STH_klingon_story.21.desc:
Their Bat'leths cutting a path through the dense foliage, the expedition force have located the remains of a hospital facility and pharmaceutical research centre. The building complex has been gutted of equipment. 

The expedition force comes across a group of aliens with smooth bald heads and light orange skin, cowering in a cellar. They're forced to the surface and interrogated brutally by the expedition leader. 

The aliens are survivors from starship that crashed on this world months ago. They found the facility as empty as we did with one exception, a single paper book which is now ours. 

After careful study, the book is revealed as little more than a medical journal...
STH_klingon_story.21.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.22.desc:
While at first the medical journal seemed to be a dead end in the quest, it has in fact given us a new location to investigate. 

Deep in the pages of the journal a Hur'q author makes reference to the location and travel times between five Hur'q bases in this part of the galaxy. 

We know all of them except one, a seafloor research facility on an ocean world. By process of triangulation and correction for stellar drift we are able pinpoint its location.
STH_klingon_story.22.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.30.desc: The approximate location of the underwater Hur'q facility on [swordOfKahless3Target.GetName] has been identified.
STH_klingon_story.30.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.3001.desc:
It comes a time that the Empire must celebrate the role that our warriors play in furthering the Empires interests, and a warrior from the Great House of Mogh has demonstrated his valor in a number of border skirmishes along our border with the Romulans. 

The planet [narendra_planet.GetName] will host a number of celebrations in our hnour of our glorious warriors.
STH_klingon_story.3001.name: Celebration of a Local Hero
STH_klingon_story.3002.desc:
My Praetor, I am [romulan_narendra_leader.GetName] and I bring you a report from our Tal Shiar operatives within Klingon Space.

Those brutish fools are currently engaging in a celebration of some foolish warrior's supposed victory against the might of the Imperial Navy. These continued insults against us are now erroding the public support for both the Imperial Navy and the Tal Shiar. We have taken it upon ourselves to prepare an attack against this colony that thanks to our intel gathered will not lead back to us.
STH_klingon_story.3002.name: Disrespect from the Klingons
STH_klingon_story.3003.desc: Our agents report that they have successfully delivered their attack against the Klingon colony, the first wave of the attack has dealt a devastating blow to the colony's defenses and military installations. The strike force remains undetected and will launch a further attack the moment the next window arrives.
STH_klingon_story.3003.name: Attack Successfully completed
STH_klingon_story.3004.desc:
Our defenses on [narendra_planet.GetName] are reporting they have been overwhelmed by a sneak attack by unknown forces. The initial wave of the attack has destroyed our defenses, leaving the civilians vulnerable to a further attack. 

We must call for aid.
STH_klingon_story.3004.name: [narendra_planet.GetName] is under attack!
STH_klingon_story.3005.desc: With our forces close to [narendra_planet.GetName] damaged and unable to render aid, we must do the honourable thing and protect the lives of those who cannot fight and call for help allowing for our warriors to regroup and fight like true Klingons!
STH_klingon_story.3005.name: [narendra_planet.GetName] is under attack!
STH_klingon_story.3006.desc:
To anyone who can hear our message, I am [klingon_sos_leader.GetName] of the Klingon Empire, our planet is under attack from an unknown foe, they have breached our defenses and are preparing to deal the final blow against civilians. 

We call on any ship in the vicinity to aid the Empire in its time of need.
STH_klingon_story.3006.name: Klingons Call for Help
STH_klingon_story.3007.desc: Only one foreign power received our SOS call, and the Federation has refused to answer our call to arms. We must now deal with this threat on our own.
STH_klingon_story.3007.name: No help coming
STH_klingon_story.3008.desc:
[This.GetName] stands ready to aid the Klingons at [narendra_destination.GetName], intel on the situation is limited, but we do know a large force of cloaked vessels are preparing a final attack on the helpless colony. 

The odds of defeating the enemy ships is low and the likelihood of survival is not in our favour, but whatever time we can bring to allow the Klingons to evacuate and bring in reinforcements will save lives!
STH_klingon_story.3008.name: [This.GetName] ready to aid the Klingons
STH_klingon_story.3009.desc:
As [narendra_ship.GetName] arrives at the scene of the devastation, it is clear from the ash clouds covering the planets that the attack had been devastating and that the colony would not be able to stand any more of the assault. 

Suddenly the [narendra_ship.GetName] picks up a decloaking fleet or warbirds on a direct course with the planet, with only the Starfleet ship standing in their way. 

The [narendra_ship.GetName] must hold the line until help can arrive.
STH_klingon_story.3009.name: Battle of [narendra_destination.GetName]
STH_klingon_story.3010.desc:
The destruction of [FromFrom.GetName] will be felt across the Federation, the ship and crew gave their lives defending civilians, holding out long enough for the Klingons to send reinforcements to take out the warbirds. 

Their sacrifice will live on in history as upholding some of the truest values of Starfleet. [sacrificed_leader.GetName] will live on as a hero.
STH_klingon_story.3010.name: [FromFrom.GetName] destroyed defending the Klingons
STH_klingon_story.3011.desc:
We have received word from our forces in Klingon Space, it appears the humans once interfered in our affairs with their Flagship sacrificing itself to defend the Klingons. 

Once again the Federation has caused us problems, one day they will truly pay for their insolence.
STH_klingon_story.3011.name: Starfleet Intervenes
STH_klingon_story.3012.desc:
Chancellor [Root.ruler.GetName] it pleases me to report that our forces have fended off the attack on [narendra_destination.GetName], however, I must say that our forces would not have been able to reach the colony in time if it was not for an act of true honour and bravery from the Captain and crew of one Starfleet ship which sacrificed itself to hold off the attackers. 

This act would have granted any Klingon passage to the halls of Sto-Vo-Kor, yet for it to be done by outsiders is truly a noble act and maybe demonstrates we have been wrong about the hearts of our Federation neighbours.
STH_klingon_story.3012.name: Colony Saved
STH_klingon_story.3013.name: Incoming Message from Qo'noS
STH_klingon_story.3020.desc:
Our forces have successfully routed the attack against the Klingon colony, saving the lives of the civilians on the planet below. 

The Empire has not been forthcoming in explaining what has prompted this attack, or who was behind the assault on their planet. 

In true Klingon fashion we shall wait to see if we even receive a thank you.
STH_klingon_story.3020.name: Attacking Force Defeated
STH_klingon_story.3021.desc: Chancellor, I am pleased to report that a combined force from our military and Starfleet has defeated the attackers threatening our colony. The honoured dead have been avenged and Starfleet did us a good service by fighting well and allowing us to bring our forces in to finish the battle.
STH_klingon_story.3021.name: Starfleet Aids us in Battle
STH_klingon_story.3022.desc:
We have received word from our forces in Klingon Space, it appears the humans once interfered in our affairs and with the help of the Klingons they have destroyed our fleet. 

Once again the Federation has caused us problems, one day they will truly pay for their insolence.
STH_klingon_story.3022.name: Starfleet defeats our ships
STH_klingon_story.3023.name: Incoming Message from Qo'noS
STH_klingon_story.3024.desc: Our failure to attack the Klingons represents a missed opportunity to deal those fools a real blow, However there will always be more chances to inflict harm upon our foes.
STH_klingon_story.3024.name: Attack Failed
STH_klingon_story.3025.desc: Our failure to send ships to aid the Klingons represents a shameful stain on our reputation within the galaxy, we can only hope that the death toll does not become to high.
STH_klingon_story.3025.name: Failed to provide Aid
STH_klingon_story.3026.desc: Despite being promised aid by the Federation, no help has arrived and we must defend our colony on our own, but this will give our warriors a chance to earn all the glory and honour and send these cowards to Gre'thor!
STH_klingon_story.3026.name: Help Fails to Arrive
STH_klingon_story.31.desc:
Klingons were not made to scuttle along the sea bed like VeS GhotI!' the expedition Combat Engineer says over the comm link. The research facility was found in days of arrival, and while there are no signs of life an energy shield still protects the building, forming a bubble of breathable air Kellicams below the surface of the ocean. 

The expedition is split on whether to continue the hunt for alternative access into the facility, or to blast the shielding away and risk damaging the data we seek. 

In the third month a junior officer devises an alternative approach: using our own ship's Shields to create a shell around the facility, while bombarding the Hur'q shield with sustained by low energy disruptor fire. 

A week later the Hur'q shield has collapsed and warriors begin to search the facility.
STH_klingon_story.31.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.32.desc:
We've located another semi-functional vault of Hur'q access codes, along with terraquads of biological research data. Applying these new access codes with our existing data highlights the location of an abandoned Hur'q civilian colony on a desert world. 

The underwater research facility is destroyed shortly after the expedition ship reconfigured its Shields to their standard configuration, the enormous water pressure blasting the building into rubble.
STH_klingon_story.32.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.40.desc: The approximate location of the Hur'q colony on [swordOfKahless4Target.GetName] has been identified.
STH_klingon_story.40.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.41.desc:
The sands have eroded most of the city outskirts, but the inner kellicam radius appears to have survived the elements by virtue of an electrostatic barrier. How the power source for the barrier has survived so long is a mystery, but it provides the expedition force an opportunity to hunt for more clues to the location of the sword. 

It looks as if the city was abandoned in a hurry, with vehicles and refuse strewn through the streets. Several civilian datapads can be found, all unlocked but only displaying a single message - the evacuation order. We will need time to study this.
STH_klingon_story.41.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.42.desc: The Hur'q evacuation documentation is extensive, listing the routes back to Hur'q space that each transport ship was to take, apparently by way of a wormhole. One item stands out: a cargo ship with a manifest labelled 'alien artefacts', its destination listed as a storage facility on an uninhabitable world far from here.
STH_klingon_story.42.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.50.desc: The approximate location of the Hur'q storage facility on the colony has been identified.
STH_klingon_story.50.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.51.desc:
Tras meses de debate en el Consejo Superior, el [rebeldeCountry1.GetName] ha declarado abierta revuelta contra el gobierno de [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] de su bastión en [rebelCountry1.Capital.GetName]. 

Aunque hasta ahora ninguna otra Cámara se ha comprometido a la causa de [rebeldeCountry1.GetName], los guerreros de todo el Imperio se regocijan de la oportunidad de demostrar su valía en combate.
STH_klingon_story.51.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.52.desc:
Tras meses de debate en el Consejo Superior, el [rebeldeCountry1.GetName] ha declarado abierta revuelta contra el gobierno de [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] de su bastión en [rebelCountry1.Capital.GetName]. 

Cuando las noticias llegaron a [Root.Capital.GetName] antes de que otro golpe fuera dado a la administración de [Root.GetRulerTitle] con una declaración similar del [rebelCountry2.GetName] en [rebelCountry2.Capital.GetName] . Mientras que hasta ahora ninguna otra casa se ha comprometido a las casas rebeldes, los guerreros a través del imperio se regocijan en la oportunidad de probar su valor en combate.
STH_klingon_story.52.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.60.desc:
It has been several weeks since the expedition force under [Root.GetLeaderName] signalled the Imperial Fleet that they had located the Sword of Kahless. The armada sent to [From.From.GetName] to escort the blade back to the homeworld raced through the stars, and now at last an honour guard has beamed into the Council Chambers hand it to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]. 

[Root.Owner.GetRulerName] has vowed to use the Sword to unite all the houses and throughout the Empire there is much rejoicing.
STH_klingon_story.60.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.61.desc:
It has been several weeks since the expedition force under [Root.GetLeaderName] signalled the Imperial Fleet that they had located the Sword of Kahless. The armada sent to [From.From.GetName] to escort the blade back to the homeworld raced through the stars, and now at last an honour guard has beamed into the Council Chambers hand it to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]. 

[Root.Owner.GetRulerName] has vowed to use the Sword to unite all the houses, but immediately it is clear that not all are happy to see the Sword remain in [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]'s hands. Fighting breaks out between a number of smaller houses, and the Imperial Fleet remains vigilant against the threat of civil war.
STH_klingon_story.61.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.62.desc:
It has been several weeks since the expedition force under [Root.GetLeaderName] signalled the Imperial Fleet that [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] had located the Sword of Kahless. The armada sent to [From.From.GetName] to escort the blade back to the homeworld raced through the stars, and now at last an honour guard has beamed into the Council Chambers hand it to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]. 

As the transport cycle finishes it is clear that something is wrong. [Root.GetLeaderName] and a force of fifty warriors storm through the hall, cutting aside all in their path. Within moments [Root.GetLeaderName] is before [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] with the Sword of Kahless at the [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]'s throat. 

'Kahless chose ME!' [Root.GetLeaderName] bellows. 'You should feel honoured to die by his blade!'. 

In the hours that passed news spread throughout the homeworld. The Sword has returned, and with it a leader with the strength to lead the Empire to glory.
STH_klingon_story.62.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.63.desc:
It has been several weeks since the expedition force under [Root.GetLeaderName] signalled the Imperial Fleet that they had located the Sword of Kahless. The armada sent to [From.From.GetName] to escort the blade back to the homeworld raced through the stars, and now at last an honour guard has beamed into the Council Chambers hand it to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]. 

As the transport cycle finishes it is clear that something is wrong. [Root.GetLeaderName] and a force of fifty warriors storm through the hall, cutting aside all in their path. Within moments [Root.GetLeaderName] is before [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] with the Sword of Kahless at the [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]'s throat. 

'Kahless chose ME!' [Root.GetLeaderName] bellows. 'You should feel honoured to die by his blade!'. 

In the hours that passed news spread throughout the homeworld. The Sword has returned, but in the hands of an usurper more concerned with science than combat. 

Immediately it is clear that not all are happy to see the Sword remain in [Root.GetLeaderName]'s hands. Fighting breaks out between a number of smaller houses, and the Imperial Fleet remains vigilant against the threat of civil war.
STH_klingon_story.63.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.64.desc:
It has been several weeks since the expedition force under [Root.GetLeaderName] signalled the Imperial Fleet that they had failed in their quest to find the Sword of Kahless. Several weeks since the confrontation in the Hur'q treasure vault. 

[Root.GetLeaderName] held fate of the Empire in hands weighed by the competing wills of the Combat Engineer and the Loremaster. 

Seeing how quickly their own expedition was turn on each other for the glory of the Sword, [Root.GetLeaderName] made a decision no Klingon should ever have to have made. 

Convincing the expedition first by argument, and where that failed by combat, [Root.GetLeaderName] drew vows from all remaining. The Sword would be buried again, transporters set to beam it to a random location beneath [From.From.GetName]. 

All agreed to accept the burden of shame the expedition failure would draw, if it meant the survival of the Empire.
STH_klingon_story.64.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_lonely_among_us.11.desc:
After the crew of [Root.GetName] has blocked the transport of [Root.GetLeaderName] as energy to the energy cloud [Root.Leader.GetHeSheCap] reveals to them, that during the scanning process of the energy nebula and the energy discharges observed on the ship an energy being was accidentally picked up aboard and is now sharing [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] body. To safely break up this connection [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests setting up a portable scanner for the energy being to leave [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] body and to transport back to the cloud.

It seems that this option is acceptable for both the crew of [Root.GetName] and to the energy being, although the energy creature insists on monitoring the transporter setup and only leaving [Root.GetLeaderName]´s body for the device once transport is in progress. Finally with the transport complete [Root.GetLeaderName] is back to normal and the energy cloud once received the transport accelarates to warp speed and exits the system.
STH_lonely_among_us.11.name: Transport blocked
STH_lonely_among_us.12.desc: We have received a message originating somewhere in [lonely_leader_pick_up.Solar_System.GetName] system using some of our decades-old communication codes. The message itself is a little vague, but it says that one of our former leaders has returned from exploring the galaxy and awaits to be picked up on board a derelict freighter ship having enough food and supplies for over a year.
STH_lonely_among_us.12.name: Strange communication received using old codes
STH_lonely_among_us.13.desc:
After arriving at the location of the strange message in [lonely_leader_pick_up.Solar_System.GetName] system [Root.GetName]´s crew locate the derelict freighter ship there with one lifeform aboard.

 After transporting the lifeform aboard [Root.GetName] it is discovered that the individual in question is in fact one of our former scientists who has returned from the travels with the energy nebula bringing wast amounts of new information about the galaxy.

 After passing rigorous medical tests aboard [Root.GetName] the rescued leader is allowed to assume the command of the vessel.
STH_lonely_among_us.13.name: A long lost leader returns
STH_lonely_among_us.14.desc: After spending considerable time wandering in the [lonely_among_us.Solar_System.GetName] system the strange nebula-like phenomenon seems to have left the system. Our sources in the system state that the nebula seemed to accelerate to warp-like speeds when it exited the system.
STH_lonely_among_us.14.name: The white nebula has disappeared
STH_lonely_among_us.15.desc: All attempts at establishing further communications with whoever was transmitting from the derelict freighter in one one of our star systems have failed. Leaving the mystery unsolved.
STH_lonely_among_us.15.name: Communications with the derelict freighter ceases
STH_lonely_among_us.2.desc: A white nebula-like phenomenon has appeared all of a sudden in [lonely_among_us.Solar_System.GetName] system. Although the nebula seems to pose no particular danger for our operations in the system it is recommended to send a science ship to explore this unusual phenomenon.
STH_lonely_among_us.2.name: Unusual white nebula detected
STH_lonely_among_us.3.desc:
After scanning what originally appeared to be a white nebula-like phenomenon in [lonely_among_us.Solar_System.GetName] system it is discovered that the unknown object actually contains considerable energy in ever-changing patterns. It is also capable of traveling at warp-like speeds, which would explain its sudden appearance in this star system.

During the scanning process it is reported that one member of the [Root.GetName]´s crew has been killed as a sudden energy spike from a console hit them.

With the possible dangers of continuing the scans further seeming real the question now becomes whether we should still continue or would it be better to just leave and not risk any more incidents?
STH_lonely_among_us.3.name: First results of the nebula scan are in
STH_lonely_among_us.4.desc:
Additional scan of the energy cloud reveals only very little extra information about the patterns of the energy currents inside the cloud and while the scan is ongoing several additional energy dischargers are reported all over the ship´s systems even appearing at the bridge. However this time luckily no one is dead or severely injured.

Despite these clear signs of danger [Root.GetLeaderName] still seems oddly fascinated with the phenomenon ordering the ship to move even closer to it so nothing is missed.
STH_lonely_among_us.4.name: Additional scan complete
STH_lonely_among_us.5.desc:
With the obvious risks associated with the energy nebula, as one crew member is already dead during the initial scan, [Root.GetLeaderName] orders the ship to leave the area. While the crew is plotting a new course sudden energy discharges are observed in the ship systems, briefly hitting even some of the bridge interfaces. However no faults in the ships systems are detected afterwards or further injuries among the crew reported and it seems the discharges disappeared as quickly as they first appeared.

With the sudden energy discharges ending and the ship systems being fully functional [Root.GetName] is just about to head on its new course when [Root.GetLeaderName] suddenly belays the order and insists on moving the ship instead closer to the nebula in case the first scan missed something. These new orders seem to be completely at odds with [Root.GetLeaderName]´s initial orders and also disregard the earlier safety concerns of continuing the scanning operation.
STH_lonely_among_us.5.name: Belay that order!
STH_lonely_among_us.6.desc: With the ship almost inside the energy cloud now [Root.GetLeaderName] continues [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] odd behaviour and expresses the desire to beam inside the cloud as energy only. This strange wish from [Root.Leader.GetHerHim] is met with severe objections from the crew of [Root.GetName] as beaming as energy only to the energy cloud would most likely kill [Root.GetLeaderName] and because of this and [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] earlier out of-character behaviour the crew locks the transporter controls as a precaution.
STH_lonely_among_us.6.name: Beam me to the cloud
STH_lonely_among_us.7.desc:
With the ship almost inside the energy cloud now [Root.GetLeaderName] all of a sudden tells the crew to prepare for a site to site transport from [Root.GetName] to inside the nebula and also that [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] will be personally handling the transport from one of the transporter rooms. Confused by these orders the bridge crew inquires if some sort of probing device should also be prepared for the transport, but [Root.GetLeaderName] just tells them to follow the orders and leaves the bridge.

Monitoring the transport process from the bridge it soon becomes obvious to the crew that [Root.GetLeaderName] is configuring the transporter for a very specific matter to energy personnel transport to the energy cloud with no one but [Root.Leader.GetHerHim] being in the transporter room. Seeing this the bridge crew contacts [Root.GetLeaderName] to enquier about what is happening, but the only respond they get is that [Root.GetLeaderName] is joining the cloud to explore the galaxy as energy followed by the communication being cut and both the transporter controls and room door being locked.

With it now becoming obvious that [Root.GetLeaderName] is indeed trying to transport to the energy cloud the question becomes should the crew do whatever it takes to abort the transport or allow [Root.Leader.GetHerHim] to join the energy cloud despite the potential significant risks of the operation?
STH_lonely_among_us.7.name: Beam me to the cloud
STH_lonely_among_us.8.desc: After [Root.GetLeaderName] has transported to the energy cloud the cloud changes its heading, accelerates to warp speed, and exits the system. Leaving the [Root.GetName]´s crew wondering if [Root.GetLeaderName] will never be heard from again.
STH_lonely_among_us.8.name: Energy cloud leaves
STH_malon_flavour.10.desc: [Root.GetLeaderTitle]! Our waste management services must report the destruction of one of our transport vessels the [waste_destroyed_ship.GetName] following a catastrophic breakdown of their containment systems. The ship and crew were lost with all hands.
STH_malon_flavour.10.name: Accident onboard waste disposal ship
STH_malon_flavour.100.desc:
Our scientists have been working tireless for a means of disposing of the theta radiation that is produced as a waste material from our antimatter technology and after many years of trying they have made a significant breakthrough. 

At significant cost we can invest in this new technology and apply it to our waste management processes to enable us to remove this harmful situation.
STH_malon_flavour.100.name: Antimatter disposal breakthrough
STH_malon_flavour.101.desc: Our engineers and scientists have completed their efforts to convert our technology to the more eco friendly solution that we discovered. This has now eliminated the need to dispose of the waste products from our worlds and will provide a greener, cleaner future for our people.
STH_malon_flavour.101.name: Antimatter disposal breakthrough
STH_malon_flavour.11.desc: Planetside collection agents have prepared waste for collection on [waste_collection_planet.GetName], we must send a ship to collect and dispose of the waste before the containment fields start to break down and the deadly theta radiation is released.
STH_malon_flavour.11.name: Waste ready for collection
STH_malon_flavour.13.desc: Reports are in from our waste exporting fleet [dumping_run_ship.GetName] and the results are mixed. The controller reports that the waste material was successfully dumped at the destination, but our presence was detected by the systems owner, [dumping_loc_owner.GetName], we are waiting to hear any official word from their officials, but our diplomatic teams are all set to deny any involvement and tell them to clean up their own mess.
STH_malon_flavour.13.name: Fleet caught dumping waste.
STH_malon_flavour.14.desc: Our local patrols have caught the Malon's dumping waste in one of our systems [dumping_location.GetName] in a horrendous act of vandalism. We have already begun efforts to clean up the mess that has been left, including damage to any neighbouring planets. Our diplomatic and military leaders are standing by to respond.
STH_malon_flavour.14.name: Malon ship caught leaving flytipping
STH_malon_flavour.15.name: Foreign response to our actions
STH_malon_flavour.2.desc: Our usage of Anti-matter to power our colonies has allowed us to grow strong and powerful, however our efforts to recycle the waste products has long eluded us. As a result the harmful theta radiation has risen to a point where it needs to be dumped, we should task one of our dutiful Waste export ships with the role of removing and disposing the waste somewhere else. Failure to do so will result in a dangerous build up of Theta radiation on our worlds, judging by our usage we can expect these levels to build every five years.
STH_malon_flavour.2.name: Waste Management
STH_malon_flavour.3.desc: Failure to take action and tackle our build up in antimatter waste resulted in harmful levels of radiation around the planet [waste_planet.GetName]. This caused our citizens to suffer for a number of years, but now thankfully the levels of radiation have reduced back to safe levels. Should we fail to take action again these conditions could return.
STH_malon_flavour.3.name: Theta radiation subsides
STH_malon_flavour.4.desc: Our waste management collection experts have collected their hazardous cargo ready for it to be dumped and become someone else's problem. Our experts have identified three potential targets to deposit the waste, the first is within our own borders and is the safest option. The second two lie within the territory of other empires, this increases the risk of getting caught but the financial rewards are that much higher.
STH_malon_flavour.4.name: Theta Radiation ready to be dumped
STH_malon_flavour.5.desc: Our waste management controller has confirmed that they have successfully dumped the toxic waste at the agreed location. The Theta radiation is now someone else's problem. The Malon Sanctity is clean once again.
STH_malon_flavour.5.name: Waste run complete
STH_malon_flavour.6.desc: Our environmental scientists have picked up a deposit of Theta radiation that has been dumped in one of our systems, this harmful radiation could spread to one of our nearby worlds and would decrease the living conditions on the world until it can be appropriately cleared. Our security services could find no evidence of who has used our space as a dumping ground.
STH_malon_flavour.6.name: Theta Radiation detected in our space
STH_malon_flavour.7.desc: Failure to complete the task of removing the waste products from are planet has resulted in a catastrophic breakdown of our containment systems and a spillage of waste product out onto the planets surface. Conditions on the planet's surface have been harmed by our failure to react.
STH_malon_flavour.7.name: Failure to dispose of radiation
STH_malon_flavour.8.desc: Our waste management controller has confirmed that they have successfully dumped the toxic waste at the agreed location in a neighbour system and we have been compensated accordingly. Our waste management teams have confirmed that they operation was complete without being detected. The Theta radiation is now someone else's problem and they will have to deal with the fallout.
STH_malon_flavour.8.name: Waste run complete
STH_maquis_dmz_story.10.desc: Our operatives in the [Root.GetSpyService] report that the [From.GetName] has been arming its citizens in the DMZ, which is in direct violation to the agreements used to establish the Zone.
STH_maquis_dmz_story.10.name: Tension in the DMZ Continues
STH_maquis_dmz_story.11.desc: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has made a public address offering [From.Leader.GetHerHis] support to the [From.GetSpeciesName] settlers in the DMZ condemning the [Root.GetName] for its lack of action to address what [From.Leader.GetSheHe] describes as terrorist activity taken out in the name of the [Root.GetName]'s.
STH_maquis_dmz_story.11.name: Tension in the DMZ Continues
STH_maquis_dmz_story.12.desc: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has made a rare public address condemning the violence on both sides of the divide in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName].
STH_maquis_dmz_story.12.name: Tension in the DMZ Continues
STH_maquis_dmz_story.2.name: Tensions in the DMZ
STH_maquis_dmz_story.30.desc:
Almost unthinkable our citizens in the Federation-Cardassian DMZ have declared their independence and established a new state, the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

Dissatisfied with years of attacks by agents of the [From.GetName], they have vowed to defend their homes no matter the cost even if it means going against their former state.
STH_maquis_dmz_story.30.name: The Maquis
STH_maquis_story.10.desc: We have received reports from the [Root.GetSpyService] that the [From.GetName] has been arming its citizens in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], in violation of the terms of the treaty establishing it.
STH_maquis_story.10.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.11.desc: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has made a public address offering [From.Leader.GetHerHis] support to the [From.GetSpeciesName] settlers in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], condemning the [Root.GetName] for its lack of action to address what [From.Leader.GetSheHe] describes as terrorist activity taken out in the name of the [Root.GetName]'s.
STH_maquis_story.11.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.12.desc: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has made a rare public address condemning the violence on both sides of the divide in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName].
STH_maquis_story.12.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.2.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.20.desc: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName] has made a public address condemning the violence on both sides of the divide in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName].
STH_maquis_story.20.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.21.desc: We have received reports from the [Root.GetSpyService] that the [From.GetName] has increased economic support to the worlds in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName].
STH_maquis_story.21.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.22.desc: We have received reports from the [Root.GetSpyService] that the [From.GetName] has been arming its citizens in the [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], in violation of the terms of the treaty establishing it.
STH_maquis_story.22.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.3.name: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.30.desc:
Almost unthinkable our citizens in the [FromFromFrom.GetName] have declared their independence and established a new state, the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

Dissatisfied with years of attacks by agents of the [From.GetName], they have vowed to defend their homes no matter the cost.
STH_maquis_story.30.name: The [FromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.31.desc:
Almost unthinkably [From.GetSpeciesName] terrorists in the [FromFromFrom.GetName] have declared their independence and established a new state, the [FromFrom.GetName]. 

They have vowed to defend their homes no matter the cost to innocent lives. 

Many on [Root.Capital.GetName] urge support for our own colonists in the region, whether by granting them independence to fight the [FromFrom.GetName] aggressors, or by demonstrating the full might of the [Root.GetName] and crushing them.
STH_maquis_story.31.name: The [FromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.32.desc: The [From.GetName] has announced the independence of what is now the [FromFromFrom.GetName]. Almost immediately upon the formalisation of the split, the [FromFromFrom.GetName] declared war against the [FromFrom.GetName], in what it describes as an act of self defence.
STH_maquis_story.32.name: The [FromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.33.desc:
The [From.GetName] has declared war against the [FromFrom.GetName], referring to what it claims are the [FromFrom.GetName]'s numerous crimes against the [From.GetSpeciesName] people. 

Without outside support it is unlikely the [FromFrom.GetName] will survive.
STH_maquis_story.33.name: The [FromFrom.GetName]
STH_maquis_story.34.desc: Are you sure you wish to become [FromFrom.GetName]? This action is not reversible.
STH_maquis_story.34.name: The [FromFrom.GetName]
STH_mars.1.name: Sueños de un planeta azul
STH_mars.111.desc:
¡Señor!' gritó uno de los xenopaleobotonistas más abajo de la cueva. Estaban ubicados a dos kilómetros debajo de la superficie marciana, no lejos de los bordes del cráter Garni. Toda la formación de la cueva se reveló recientemente, después de un terremoto especialmente fuerte que siguió a un ataque de un cometa derribó las paredes que lo cubrían. La estructura geológica atrajo inmediatamente la atención de los equipos científicos locales porque la cueva contenía oligoelementos de una molécula especialmente importante: el agua. 

Paul Boone, líder de la iniciativa de terraformación de Marte, siguió la llamada más profundamente dentro de la cueva. Un pequeño grupo de investigadores estaba agachado cerca de un pequeño pilar que se estrechaba, susurrando con entusiasmo. A medida que se acercaba, podía ver el haz de luz iluminando un pequeño charco de agua poco profundo, cubierto por un brillo metálico de aspecto orgánico. Los biólogos movían sus tricorders una y otra vez. Allí, en el agua salada, había millones de insectos fosilizados. Evidencia de que Marte llevaba vida, alguna vez.
STH_mars.112.desc:
El equipo de control de tierra miró impotente a los monitores. '¡Envía una orden de evacuación!' gritó alguien, pero otros simplemente estaban sacudiendo la cabeza aturdidos. "Es demasiado tarde" murmuró alguien más. 

Hace una hora, fue simplemente otro día de rutina en el centro de control de la Iniciativa de Marte, con no menos de cinco cometas programados para chocar contra la capa de hielo. Luego, poco después del contacto con la atmósfera ahora más espesa, una bolsa de volátiles no mapeada en un cometa estalló, enviando al cometa a girar. A medida que el cometa se hundió hacia la superficie marciana, más y más bolsas de gas estallaron. El cometa se estaba destrozando, ahora en una trayectoria hacia la Nueva Base Armstrong. Algunos vehículos terrestres lograron escapar de la cúpula de la base a tiempo, pero ni siquiera sobrevivieron a la explosión nuclear resultante cuando un fragmento de cometa golpeó Marte con la fuerza de 300 megatones de TNT. Cincuenta mil personas murieron en lo que se conocería en el peor desastre de terraformación de este siglo.
STH_mars.121.desc:
La tensión en la sala de control era palpable. Una flotilla de remolcadores estaba colocando los últimos segmentos del espejo en su posición, e incluso una desalineación milimétrica del complejo de 5 kilómetros de ancho podría arruinar el gran montaje. Boone caminaba de un lado a otro a lo largo de la pequeña cámara, haciendo una pequeña hendidura en la alfombra. El controlador lo miró, irritado, pensó en pedirle que volviera a sentarse, lo pensó mejor y continuó su trabajo. 

Diez minutos después, sin embargo, ya no había necesidad de preocuparse. La cuadrícula del sensor informó que cada segmento estaba alineado correctamente. Ponderamente, los chorros de plasma Xeon se activaron, haciendo el ajuste final. Entonces el espejo se inclinó exactamente así, y de repente, la luz solar pura y bendecida atravesó la superficie marciana, reflejada desde arriba. Ya, las temperaturas superficiales estaban subiendo. Boone sonrió al monitor y se apresuró a informar a sus superiores. El controlador sacudió la cabeza, mentalmente cambiando su enfoque al siguiente complejo de espejos en construcción.
STH_mars.122.desc:
La infestación comenzó hace más de dos meses, en los confines remotos de Malea Planum. La capa de hielo del sur se sembró con una bacteria anaeróbica altamente modificada, que inyectó contaminantes en el agua helada, liberando una pequeña cantidad de calor en el proceso. Había muchas garantías genéticas y una cadena de ADN muy simplista debería haber sido una protección adecuada contra la mutación. No fue. 

Un cambio anormal en la activación de alelos permitió que las bacterias inyectaran moléculas orgánicas más complejas. En el pasado, el desolado Marte ofrecería muy poco material orgánico, pero la superficie de Marte ha sido sembrada con otras cepas de bacterias que fertilizaron el suelo. En una semana, las bacterias de la capa de hielo subsumieron todas las demás cepas, extendiéndose como un incendio forestal a lo largo de las llanuras vacías del sur de Marte. Cuando finalmente se descubrió, era casi demasiado tarde: las bacterias estaban en todas partes, cubriendo la superficie con una delgada corteza gris. El daño al ecosistema es enorme: puede retrasar el proyecto durante años.
STH_mars.130.desc:
Una pequeña delegación de investigadores abandona el laboratorio Terraforming. A lo lejos, se escuchan explosiones, transportadas a través de la delgada atmósfera. El ingeniero Boone mira su reloj: el cometa ZA2112-B se estrelló contra la capa de hielo del polo norte justo a tiempo. Los temblores menores sacuden la superficie y se disipan rápidamente, y los géiseres de vapor sobrecalentado a kilómetros de altura se extienden a la atmósfera. Boone mira la vista y sonríe, antes de agarrar firmemente los sellos de sus máscaras de respiración y liberarla. El resto de la delegación lo mira con cautela. Por eso vinieron aquí, pero el riesgo sigue siendo grande. 

Paul Boone es el primer ser humano en respirar aire fresco marciano. Después de años de trabajo, la atmósfera es finalmente lo suficientemente espesa como para que un humano la respire sin ayuda. Todavía hay mucho por hacer antes de que Marte sea realmente un paraíso, pero este es un paso monumental para la Humanidad.
STH_mars.140.desc:
Representantes de todo Marte estaban incómodos en un rincón del comedor de la Base Schiaparelli mientras los asistentes se apresuraban a arrastrar más asientos. La sala no era adecuada para una ocasión tan distinguida, pero Marte aún no ha fabricado nada que pueda albergar una reunión tan grande. Finalmente, a todos se les permitió entrar. 

El planeta rojo ya no existe, reemplazado por algo que parece casi verde. Miles de migrantes de la Tierra acuden aquí, y la población está en auge. Está claro para todos que se debe hacer algo. 

 Poco tiempo después, una vez que comenzó la reunión, John Hammerlich, ahora viejo y distinguido, se colocó frente al podio corto. Era el representante de Gundersdottir's Dome, una de las más grandes de las 22 colonias de Marte, y su voz áspera hablaba por todos. 

 'Estamos aquí, no muy diferente de lo que lo hicieron nuestros antepasados ​​en la gran ciudad vieja de Filadelfia, no para lanzar tiranía pero para abrazar la libertad. Hoy damos el primer paso al hacer las Declaraciones Fundamentales de las Colonias Marcianas '.
STH_mars.140.name: Declaraciones fundamentales de las colonias marcianas
STH_mars.141.desc:
Fue uno de los artículos más ambiciosos en las Declaraciones fundamentales de las colonias marcianas. A medida que avanzaba el proceso de terraformación, más y más recursos se trasladaron a Marte. El aire todavía era escaso, pero la gente podía caminar sin ayuda en la superficie y realmente domesticar este nuevo mundo. Las colonias marcianas confederadas han decidido que iniciarán un proyecto de construcción que rivalizará con todo eso en la Tierra. 

Un sorteo escogió la colonia Utopia, una pequeña aldea en el plano de lava Utopia Planitia, como el sitio. En un mes, el pequeño pueblo se transformó. En dos meses, los cimientos de una superestructura se colocaron a 16 mil kilómetros sobre la colonia, en órbita sincrónica. Ahora, los patios de la flota de Utopía Planitia llenan el cielo con docenas de diques secos gigantes.
STH_mars.142.desc:
Fue uno de los artículos disputados más acalorados en las Declaraciones Fundamentales de las Colonias Marcianas. Marte se estaba transformando bajo el aluvión de cometas de la Iniciativa de Marte, convirtiéndose en un paraíso para la humanidad, pero ¿a qué precio? Esa fue, al menos, la pregunta que estaba haciendo un grupo vocal llamado 'los conservadores'. Llamaron a la terraformación una abominación, el hombre ejerce su influencia sobre otra tierra virgen, una que no tiene derecho a llamar hogar. A medida que los Preservadores ganaron poder, el nuevo senado de las Colonias Marcianas Confederadas se preocupó. 

 Finalmente y bajo la presión constante del público, el senado acordó una amplia gama de regulaciones que limitarán severamente el alcance de la Iniciativa de Marte. Nadie parecía contento con la solución, y la terraformación de Marte se ha retrasado durante años.
STH_mars.143.desc:
Hace años, cuando todavía había un Papa en Roma, cuando murió el último Papa, los cardenales se reunieron y debatieron sobre quién sería su sucesor. No se les permitió irse hasta que se pudiera tomar una decisión. Una vez, casi tomó tres años ... gracias a Dios, esta vez no tardó tanto. Solo se sentía así, dijo Hammerlich con pesadez, con una risa cortés. En verdad, todos se sintieron nerviosos: las negociaciones, que inicialmente se esperaba que fueran breves y cordiales, rápidamente se volvieron feas. 

Sin embargo, al final, se acordaron las disputas clave: acceso a vías fluviales futuras, y desde allí, las cosas progresaron rápidamente y se llegó a un acuerdo. Marte ahora tiene su propia constitución y gobierno federal, independiente pero siempre vinculado a la Tierra. El destino de un mundo se decidió, y por una vez en la historia de la humanidad, no se decidió con sangre.
STH_mars.151.desc:
La falta de una magnetosfera se había considerado durante mucho tiempo como una de las barreras más importantes para la colonización a largo plazo de Marte. Tras el desarrollo de los deflectores, se hizo posible implementar una serie de dispositivos de este tipo en todo el planeta para realizar la misma función, aunque a un gran costo. 

El proyecto de terraformación marciana ha desplegado con éxito una matriz de este tipo, eliminando una fuente de pérdida atmosférica al tiempo que aumenta la seguridad de los colonos que desafían la superficie abierta.
STH_mars.152.desc:
En retrospectiva, no estaba claro de qué se trataba la rebelión. Marte estaba floreciendo bajo la Iniciativa, pero los antiguos colonos, aquellos que vivieron en Marte durante docenas de años antes del diluvio de migrantes de la Tierra, se volvieron aún más resentidos. ¿Se trataba de tierra? ¿Controlar? ¿Poder? ¿Preservar las viejas costumbres? Todo lo anterior, o ninguno? Todo lo que sabemos es que casi de la noche a la mañana, el planeta estaba en frenesí, disturbios en cada cúpula. 

El abrumado gobierno local trató de controlar la situación, pero antes de que nadie se diera cuenta, un grupo armado de colonos locales asaltaron el complejo Verteron Array, obteniendo acceso a un arma de terrorífico terror. Con un solo acto desafiante, cerraron la Iniciativa, deteniendo el proyecto y reuniendo a los rebeldes en todo el planeta.
STH_mars.154.desc:
La huelga, cuando llegó, terminó rápidamente. Lo que llevó varias semanas de planificación cuidadosa, duró menos de una hora violenta e intensa. Un equipo de M.A.C.O se infiltró en el compuesto Verteron Array en varios lugares al mismo tiempo utilizando una técnica de transporte que omitió el campo inhibidor. A pesar de algunas bajas, la mayoría de los rebeldes se rindieron en el acto. 

El resto de la rebelión marciana no duró mucho más. Algunos enclaves resistieron, pero la mayoría se rindió cuando llegaron noticias de la caída del complejo. Las colonias marcianas volvieron a estar en paz, y en unos pocos días se reanudó la terraformación. 

 Sin embargo, las semillas del descontento no desaparecerán tan rápidamente. Uno solo puede esperar que no crezcan y se infecten.
STH_mars.160.desc:
Está lloviendo en Marte. Por supuesto, la primera gota aterriza indocumentada, a muchos kilómetros del ser humano más cercano. Todos pueden caminar libremente y sin ayuda en la superficie, pero la población sigue siendo de pocos millones y aún no se ha extendido a todos los rincones del planeta. El vasto sistema de monitoreo del clima, por supuesto, está cuidadosamente ajustado para seguir las tormentas violentas, no una suave llovizna de verano. 

Pero hoy está lloviendo en Marte, y no será la última vez.
STH_mars.160.name: Proyecto de desarrollo de Marte
STH_mars.170.desc:
No ha habido una tormenta de arena en la cara de Marte durante semanas. Las tormentas eléctricas gigantes ahora frecuentemente ruedan por las llanuras rojas, torrentes gigantes de lluvia cayendo. El Hellas Planitia se convirtió en un verdadero mar, ya que el agua vivificante lo llenó hasta el borde. A un millón de kilómetros de distancia, en órbita sincrónica, los espejos orbitales gigantes reflejaban el sol hacia la superficie, elevando la temperatura. 

 Paul Boone mira con orgullo desde la órbita de Fobos. Marte nunca será una verdadera Tierra: es demasiado pequeña, demasiado lejos del sol. Pero tiene una belleza propia, y pronto, millones de nuevos colonos llegarán a apreciar esa belleza, como lo ha hecho en los últimos años. El planeta rojo ya no es tan rojo.
STH_mars.180.desc:
La Iniciativa ha cumplido su propósito; Marte es ahora un planeta hermano de la Tierra, una gema azul que brilla en el cielo. Pero aún queda mucho trabajo por hacer antes de que el planeta alcance su máximo potencial. Tenemos la oportunidad de invertir en el futuro del planeta, para desbloquear instalaciones especiales, bonificaciones y mejoras. 

Este evento te permite gastar recursos para adquirir cualquier bonificación beneficiosa que te hayas perdido durante el evento de terraformación de Marte.
STH_mars.180.name: Proyecto de desarrollo de Marte
STH_mars.190.desc:
En docenas de años, esta nueva instalación de investigación brillante ya no será el Instituto de Tecnología Carl Sagan. Richard Daystrom en toda su gloria deslumbrante, enloquecedora y brillante reformará la galaxia y adquirirá el nombre para sí mismo. Pero mucho antes de eso, el venerable anexo ya será un bastión de investigación y academia. 

 Inspirados por el espíritu pionero de la antigüedad y la avalancha de inversiones materiales de la Tierra, los marcianos locales han decidido que deben ser capaces de rivalizar con la Tierra no solo en la industria, pero también en su contribución a la humanidad. Esta visión duró en el futuro, convirtiendo a Marte en uno de los institutos científicos más respetados de la galaxia.
STH_mars.191.desc:
La tensión en la sala de control era palpable. Una flotilla de remolcadores estaba colocando los últimos segmentos del espejo en posición, e incluso una desalineación milimétrica del complejo de 5 kilómetros de ancho podría arruinar el gran montaje. 

Diez minutos después, sin embargo, ya no había necesidad de preocuparse. La cuadrícula del sensor informó que cada segmento estaba alineado correctamente. Ponderamente, los chorros de plasma Xeon se activaron, haciendo el ajuste final. Luego, el espejo se inclinó exactamente y, de repente, la luz del sol pura y bendecida atravesó la superficie marciana, reflejada desde arriba. Ya, las temperaturas de la superficie estaban subiendo, y otros espejos esperaban para colocarse en posición. Marte ha cambiado para siempre.
STH_mars.192.desc:
Nadie sabía por qué la colonia Utopía, uno de los asentamientos más pequeños de Marte, fue finalmente elegida para este proyecto. Sin duda hubo una gran cantidad de política detrás de la decisión, un intento de promover las fronteras de los planetas recién establecidos. Las colonias marcianas confederadas han decidido que iniciarán un proyecto de construcción que rivalizará con todo eso en la Tierra. 

Sin embargo, era una pequeña aldea en el avión de lava de Utopia Planitia que se convertiría en el sitio del patio principal de la flota de la flota estelar. Dentro de un mes del proyecto, la pequeña ciudad se transformó. En dos meses, los cimientos de una superestructura se colocaron a 16 mil kilómetros sobre la colonia, en órbita sincrónica. Ahora, los patios de la flota de Utopía Planitia llenan el cielo con docenas de diques secos gigantes.
STH_mars.193.desc:
Para las mentes militares de la Flota Estelar, Marte ofrece una ventaja estratégica única. Ahora está totalmente terraformado y accesible, pero no es un objetivo tan frágil o sensible como la Tierra. Algunos comandantes sugirieron que las defensas del planeta Sol del sistema interno se trasladaran a Marte, y la idea se extendió entre el comando de la Flota Estelar como un incendio forestal. A partir de eso, nació el Perímetro de Defensa de Marte. 

El proyecto requiere una amplia gama de unidades de vigilancia automáticas sub-ligeras, construidas y controladas desde Marte, convirtiendo el planeta en una verdadera fortaleza. Una vez aprobado, el proyecto avanzó rápidamente.
STH_mars.194.desc:
¡Señor!' gritó uno de los xenopaleobotonistas más abajo de la cueva. Estaban ubicados a dos kilómetros debajo de la superficie marciana, no lejos de los bordes del cráter Garni. Toda la formación de la cueva se reveló recientemente, durante un estudio recientemente financiado del planeta. 

El científico principal en la escena siguió la llamada más profundamente dentro de la cueva. Un pequeño grupo de investigadores estaba agachado cerca de un pequeño pilar que se estrechaba, susurrando con entusiasmo. A medida que se acercaba, podía ver el haz de luz que iluminaba un pequeño charco de agua poco profundo, cubierto por un brillo metálico de aspecto orgánico. Estaba claro por qué se sintieron atraídos por este hallazgo, ya que la terraformación había una gran cantidad de agua en la superficie de Marte, pero ¿tan lejos bajo tierra? Los biólogos estaban moviendo sus tricorders una y otra vez sobre el agua, ya que encontraron más que solo H2O antiguo. Allí, en el agua salada, había millones de insectos fosilizados. Evidencia de que Marte llevaba vida, alguna vez.
STH_mars.200.desc: The combined efforts and resources of the United Federation of Planets have breathed a new life into the small colony on the Planet of Weytahn/Paan Mokar. Demonstrating to the people of the planet Vulcan and Andoria the benefits of uniting in this new alliance of worlds.
STH_mars.200.name: Weytahn
STH_mars.201.desc: The United Federation of Planets was seen as a risk by many on both Andoria and Vulcan, but as their citizens stand back and admire the efforts to transform Waytahn from a small bleak rock, to thriving world, it stands as a testimony to what the united resolve and combined efforts of many civilisations can achieve together.
STH_mars.201.name: Weytahn
STH_megastructures.1.desc: The decommissioned Starship [disbanded_ship.GetName] has arrived at our Starfleet Surplus station ready to be broken down and scrapped. Our teams will attempt to recover and return as much of the constituent parts to our resource pool as possible.
STH_megastructures.1.name: Starship Reclamation
STH_megastructures.20.desc:
We have now reached a technology level where we can now build a fleet disbanding centre. This megastructure will generate a small amount of resources for our empire, but its primary function will be to reclaim a small amount of resources from each ship that we disband to be re-used by our empire. 

Our engineers will look focus on the core components of the ship and will help get the crews back into service as soon as possible.
STH_megastructures.20.name: Starship Disbanding and Recycling
STH_megastructures.21.desc: We can now update our Fleet decommissioning centre, which will enable us to gather more resources from each ship that we disband.
STH_megastructures.21.name: Starship Disbanding and Recycling
STH_megastructures.3.desc: The [disbanded_ship.GetName] has completed its service for the Empire, the vessel will be pulled apart and turned into resources to aid the Empire in it's future battles.
STH_megastructures.3.name: Vessel Retirement
STH_megastructures.5.desc: The [disbanded_ship.GetName] has completed its service for the Empire, the vessel will be broken down and turned into resources that the Imperial Navy can use in the future.
STH_megastructures.5.name: Starship Reclamation
STH_megastructures.7.desc: Asset [disbanded_ship.GetName] no longer services the collective, begin automation and breakdown process, vessel will be broken down and it's resources will continue to serve the collective.
STH_megastructures.7.name: Asset Reclamation
STH_megastructures.9.desc: Our ship [disbanded_ship.GetName] has been marked for decommissioning and has arrived at our recycling station, our engineering teams will breakdown the ship and strip out and make any resources available for [disbanding_country.GetName] to re-use.
STH_megastructures.9.name: Vessel Recycling Centre
STH_memorial_event.1.desc: Después de escanear [From.GetName], el [Root.GetFleetName] ha detectado y transferido con éxito depósitos sustanciales de $ sr_dilithium $ desde la superficie, a la bahía de carga del barco.
STH_memorial_event.1.name: Superficie $ sr_dilithium $ Depósitos
STH_memorial_event.10.desc:
Al inspeccionar el trabajo de mantenimiento de un miembro prometedor de la tripulación de [Root.GetFleetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha sufrido un ataque de pánico. 

Aparentemente aturdido [Root.Leader.GetHerHim] en un conducto de EPS parcialmente sin blindaje, el personal médico confinó el [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] a la enfermería mientras se realiza una investigación.
STH_memorial_event.10.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.100.desc: Con el monumento en [From.GetName] reparado, los arqueólogos de [Root.GetName] desean estudiar el mundo para descubrir más sobre la masacre que tuvo lugar allí, hace siglos. Las razas y facciones involucradas siguen siendo un misterio que muchos ahora desean resolver.
STH_memorial_event.100.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.2.desc:
[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha informado de una serie de pesadillas vívidas y disruptivas, que han comenzado a afectar el rendimiento de [Root.Leader.GetHerHis]. 

 Creyendo que [Root.Leader.GetHerHim] se involucra en una operación militar que rápidamente se convierte en una masacre de civiles desarmados, [Root.GetLeaderName] no tiene explicación para los sueños reales.
STH_memorial_event.2.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.20.desc:
Mientras comía con la tripulación del [Root.GetFleetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha sufrido un episodio alucinante, tomando como rehén a un oficial subalterno. 

Después de ser aturdido por un equipo de seguridad que respondió, el personal médico confinó el [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] a la enfermería mientras se realiza una investigación.
STH_memorial_event.20.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.21.desc:
Mientras comía con la tripulación de [Root.GetFleetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha sufrido un episodio alucinante, tomando como rehén a un oficial subalterno y matando a otro mientras intentaban intervenir. 

Después de ser aturdido por un equipo de seguridad que respondió, el personal médico confinó el [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] a la enfermería mientras se realiza una investigación.
STH_memorial_event.21.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.50.desc:
Mientras que [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] se recuperó de la ruptura de [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] en la enfermería, más y más tripulantes de [Root.GetFleetName] han reportado extrañas pesadillas que han comenzado a afectar su día trabajo de hoy. 

 Muchos están convencidos de que ellos mismos participaron en una masacre en Tarakis, el nombre que creen que ahora los colonos alienígenas que se fueron le dieron a [From.GetName], a pesar de la imposibilidad de estar involucrados. 

El Oficial Ejecutivo ha recomendado un análisis adicional del mundo para identificar mejor una resolución.
STH_memorial_event.50.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.60.desc:
Escaneos más detallados de [From.GetName] han revelado la presencia de lo que parece ser un obelisco conmemorativo que emite radiación neurogénica. 

El dispositivo parece estar diseñado para transmitir recuerdos de remordidos soldados alienígenas que participaron en una masacre de civiles en el mundo varios siglos antes. Lo siguiente está inscrito en su base: \ n' Las palabras por sí solas no pueden transmitir el sufrimiento. \ NLas palabras por sí solas no pueden evitar que lo que sucedió aquí vuelva a suceder. \ NMás allá de las palabras yace la experiencia. \ NMás allá de la experiencia yace la verdad. \ NHaz que esta verdad sea tuya.  '

El monumento parece estar funcionando parcialmente mal.
STH_memorial_event.60.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.70.desc: El monumento en [From.GetName] finalmente ha fallado, apagándose inofensivamente. Con él va el recuerdo de los colonos alienígenas masacrados varios siglos antes.
STH_memorial_event.70.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.71.desc: El monumento en [From.GetName] finalmente ha fallado, detonando con un estallido mortal de radiación neurogénica. Con esa devastación va el recuerdo de los colonos alienígenas masacrados varios siglos antes.
STH_memorial_event.71.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.80.desc:
El monumento en [From.GetName] ha sido reparado con éxito. 

Mientras los recuerdos dolorosos transmitidos por el dispositivo permanecen, ya no se presentan fuera de servicio y, en cambio, forman una narración coherente. 

La mayoría de quienes lo experimentan se ven profundamente afectados por el mensaje.
STH_memorial_event.80.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.81.desc: Las reparaciones del monumento en [From.GetName] han fallado catastróficamente, detonando el obelisco con un estallido mortal de radiación neurogénica. Con esa devastación va el recuerdo de los colonos alienígenas masacrados varios siglos antes.
STH_memorial_event.81.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.90.desc:
El monumento en [From.GetName] ha sido destruido con éxito. 

Aunque los recuerdos dolorosos transmitidos por el dispositivo presentan un mensaje poderoso, ya no se verán obligados a los visitantes y habitantes de [From.GetName].
STH_memorial_event.90.name: monumento
STH_memorial_event.91.desc: La destrucción del monumento en [From.GetName] ha resultado en una detonación catastrófica, lo que lleva a una explosión mortal de radiación neurogénica. Con esa devastación va el recuerdo de los colonos alienígenas masacrados varios siglos antes.
STH_memorial_event.91.name: monumento
STH_militaryship.1.desc: [Root.GetRulerName], the recent crime wave on planet [selected_crime_planet.GetName] has gotten out of hand and the law abiding people on the planet demand action to help reduce crime on the planet. Our advisers have suggested two options, we can task the captain and crew of one of our finest ships to intervene. Alternatively the army has offered to to get involved as a matter of pride, they are willing to help fund the mission, but sending in troops could alienate the population.
STH_militaryship.1.name: Crime at an all time high
STH_militaryship.101.desc: We have been contacted by our diplomatic contacts within the [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] and [militarymission_escort_country2.GetName] who wish to meet to improve their relationship. They have asked us to mediate the event and expressed an interest in [militarymissionLeader1.GetName]'s assistance as a mediator, although they will accept another recommendation if we prefer. One of our diplomatic envoys [militarymissionEnvoy1.GetName] will represent our envoys during the mission. We must first report to [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName]'s homeworld to begin the discussions.
STH_militaryship.101.name: Diplomat Escort
STH_militaryship.102.desc: Initial talks with [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] have not gone well, [militarymission_escort_country1.GetRulerName] was not satisfied that our diplomatic team could successfully protect the interests of the their people or provide satisfactory protection for their envoys. They will not be enlisting our help as mediators and escorts and in further bad news this incident has harmed relations between us and our hosts.
STH_militaryship.102.name: Diplomat Escort
STH_militaryship.103.desc: Initial talks with [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] did not go well and despite many hours of talks from both sides our diplomatic team have deemed the endeavour a failure leaving parties on both sides disappointed and relationships strained, this has been a complete failure from the team sent by the [Root.GetName].
STH_militaryship.103.name: Diplomat Escort - Failure
STH_militaryship.104.desc: Initial talks with [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] did not go well and despite many hours of talks from both sides our diplomatic team have deemed the endeavour a failure leaving parties on both sides disappointed and relationships strained, however thankfully famed hero [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] was able to step in at the last minuit to salvage the conference and allow it to continue.
STH_militaryship.104.name: Diplomat Escort - Failure
STH_militaryship.106.desc: Initial talks with [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] have gone well thanks mainly to the efforts of both teams at the conference, our diplomatic service are recommending we trust [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] to deliver the envoys to [militarymission_escort_country2.GetRulerName] homeworld to begin the next phase of the talks.
STH_militaryship.106.name: Diplomat Escort - Success
STH_militaryship.107.desc: Initial talks with [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] have gone well thanks to the efforts of both teams at the conference, [militarymission_escort_country1.GetRulerTitle] [militarymission_escort_country1.GetRulerName] has recommended that we lead the mission and deliver the diplomats to [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] for the second round of the negotiations. This is a very good start to proceedings.
STH_militaryship.107.name: Diplomat Escort
STH_militaryship.108.desc: Our diplomats are now in the care of [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] and are on their way to meet with at the conference on [militarymission_escort_country1.Capital.GetName], we have put a lot of trust in this mission and it must succeed.
STH_militaryship.108.name: Diplomat Escort
STH_militaryship.109.desc: We have received communications from the delegation heading our way, we must prepare the conference for their arrival it could bring about lasting peace.
STH_militaryship.109.name: Diplomat Escort
STH_militaryship.110.desc: The failure to turn up at the conference has angered leaders on both sides of the negotiating table and has only served to unite both sides against us and damaged the reputation of both [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] and [Root.GetName]. This is a massive opportunity to influence the state of the galaxy wasted.
STH_militaryship.110.name: Diplomat Escort - Disaster
STH_militaryship.111.desc: The failure of [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] to turn up at the conference has caused widespread anger amongst our ruling bodies. Our trust in them has been seriously hampered and this insult will not soon be forgotten.
STH_militaryship.111.name: Diplomat Escort - Disaster
STH_militaryship.112.desc: Despite the pleas of both our diplomats and those from [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] the ruling parties within [militarymission_escort_country2.GetName] have rejected and further advanced talks and have refused our diplomatic pressure to continue the conversation. This will be seen as an insult by [militarymission_escort_country1.GetRulerTitle] [militarymission_escort_country1.GetRulerName].
STH_militaryship.112.name: Diplomat Escort - Rejected
STH_militaryship.114.desc: Initial talks with [militarymission_escort_country1.GetName] have gone well thanks mainly to the efforts of both teams at the conference, our diplomatic service are recommending we trust [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] to deliver the envoys to [militarymission_escort_country2.GetRulerName] homeworld to begin the next phase of the talks.
STH_militaryship.114.name: Diplomat Escort - Success
STH_militaryship.115.desc: Feedback from our teams on [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] is overwhelmingly positive with officials from both worlds responding positively to the hard work of our diplomatic teams under [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] and [militarymissionEnvoy1.GetName] there has been a significant boost in public opinion between all countries at the table. Our diplomatic standing in the galaxy will surely rise from this grand success.
STH_militaryship.115.name: Diplomat Escort - Mission completed!
STH_militaryship.116.desc: Feedback from our teams on [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] is overwhelmingly positive with officials from both worlds responding positively to the hard work of the diplomatic teams lead by [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] and [militarymissionEnvoy1.GetName]. We should consider this conference a total success.
