STH_militaryship.116.name: Diplomat Escort - Mission completed!
STH_militaryship.117.desc: Feedback from our teams on [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] is encouraging, with officials from both worlds responding positively to the hard work of the diplomatic teams lead by [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] and [militarymissionEnvoy1.GetName]. Whilst many would have hoped for slightly better results, we should consider this conference worth the effort.
STH_militaryship.117.name: Diplomat Escort - Mission completed!
STH_militaryship.118.desc: Feedback from our teams on [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] is encouraging, but not spectacular. Officials from both worlds responding well to the hard work of the diplomatic teams lead by [militarymissionLeader1.GetName] and [militarymissionEnvoy1.GetName] whilst we could have hoped for more, the work done over the last few weeks is a good start.
STH_militaryship.118.name: Diplomat Escort - Mission completed!
STH_militaryship.119.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle]! This is a disaster, the conference on [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] has descended into chaos with the delegations from both sides coming to blows over the delicate trade discussions. Regrettably there is further bad news, in an attempt to get between the brawling parties our envoy [militarymissionEnvoy1.GetName] was killed. The loss of this member of our diplomatic service has sent waves of anger through our worlds and ripples through the quadrant.
STH_militaryship.119.name: Diplomat Escort - Total Failure!
STH_militaryship.120.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle]! This is a disaster, the conference on [militarymission_escort_country2.Capital.GetName] has descended into chaos with the delegations from all sides coming to blows over the delicate trade discussions. It seems that the envoy from [Root.GetName] was also killed during the incident.
STH_militaryship.120.name: Diplomat Escort - Total Failure!
STH_militaryship.131.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we have received a distress call from one of our research outposts which has been working on breakthrough technologies. It appears there has been a reactor accident and the station is in danger of exploding, destroying the research and the crew of 200. We must send a ship to investigate and stabilize the situation and save the research.
STH_militaryship.131.name: Station in Danger
STH_militaryship.132.desc: Despite leaving the station to its own fate, the crew were able to avert the crisis and save the station from exploding, whilst the crew on the station are unaware that they were abandoned many senior members within our government are displeased with the handling of the situation.
STH_militaryship.132.name: Station Abandoned
STH_militaryship.133.desc: As expected the research station's reactor was destroyed and without the support of our rescue teams the station and its research has been lost with all hands.
STH_militaryship.133.name: Station Destroyed
STH_militaryship.134.desc: Reports from our fleet have come in, thankfully through the skilled efforts of the captain and crew the research station and the valuable research was saved. The lead scientist was able to recover additional valuable resources from the experiment which we can add to our stockpile.
STH_militaryship.134.name: Station saved
STH_militaryship.135.desc: Reports from our fleet have come in, the crew were able to save the research station, but unfortunately most of the research was lost when the computer core went offline. The lead scientist was able to recover additional valuable resources from the experiment which we can add to our stockpile.
STH_militaryship.135.name: Station saved
STH_militaryship.136.desc: It appears the distress call was sent in error, either raised from faulty equipment or by a careless operations officer. Thankfully the research and station were never under any risk and can carry on operating normally.
STH_militaryship.136.name: False Alarm
STH_militaryship.137.desc: Terrible news, the Captain and crew of the rescue fleet were unable to prevent the reactor from going critical and destroying the station. Thankfully we were able to rescue the crew and save most of the valuable research.
STH_militaryship.137.name: Station destroyed
STH_militaryship.138.desc: Terrible news, the Captain and crew of the rescue fleet were unable to prevent the reactor from going critical and destroying the station. Despite every effort being made we were unable to salvage the research making this a total loss of property, life and research.
STH_militaryship.138.name: Station destroyed
STH_militaryship.140.name: Station saved
STH_militaryship.142.desc:
After arriving at the scene it becomes clear that the research station is in no real danger. 

Soon after the station's head scientist contacts the rescue fleet, a little annoyed of their late arrival, and explains that they are on the verge of a great discovery and urgently need added computer power for it. But after receiving none from the government despite several pleads they made the false distress call in hopes that the rescue fleet would arrive in time and provide it. 

What should we do?
STH_militaryship.142.name: No emergency detected
STH_militaryship.143.desc: With the help of the added computer power and the analyzing capabilities of the rescue fleet the head scientist is able to complete the experiment which yields great results.
STH_militaryship.143.name: Research project successful
STH_militaryship.144.desc: Although the added computer and analyzing power provided by the rescue fleet proves useful and much added data is collected the final breakthrough that the head scientist was expecting to make is not achieved.
STH_militaryship.144.name: Research project completed
STH_militaryship.145.desc: From the get-go it becomes clear that the systems onboard the rescue fleet and the research station are challenging to combine and the issue is not improved by the at times bad communication between the two crews. As a result much of the potential data is lost and the head scientist is displeased.
STH_militaryship.145.name: The combined project is a disaster
STH_militaryship.147.name: Positive results gained
STH_militaryship.148.desc: It has become clear that the head scientist lied about the emergency and diverted valuable resources from were they could otherwise been used to this system. An example must me set that this kind of behaviour is not tolerated.
STH_militaryship.148.name: This kind of behaviour is not tolerated
STH_militaryship.151.name: Station SOS call
STH_militaryship.152.desc: The situation at the Starbase is now under control and any damage to our station has been successfully repaired without any further damage or loss of life. The crew of the Starbase express their gratitude for the prompt assistance.
STH_militaryship.152.name: Station SOS call
STH_militaryship.153.desc: The situation at the Starbase has progressed negatively and the damage quickly escalated resulting in minor damage to the Starbase. This will cause a set back to our operations in this system, but we should be able to recover in fairly short order.
STH_militaryship.153.name: Station SOS call
STH_militaryship.154.desc: The situation at the Starbase has progressed quickly and the damage was more significant than expected resulting in major damage to the Starbase. This will more severely hamper our efforts in this system, but with time and resources our teams should be able to recover.
STH_militaryship.154.name: Station SOS call
STH_militaryship.156.desc: One of our key Starbases has requested additional supplies to continue some vital work they are doing in the system, our military command have asked us to dispatch a ship to provide the resources to allow the work to continue.
STH_militaryship.156.name: Station requesting additional supplies
STH_militaryship.157.desc: We are getting reports that one of our Starbases is in distress, they have suffered a reactor breach in their main power plant, this has caused a complete loss of power in the station - including life support. The station commander reports that unless they can get the situation under control the damaged reactor may go critical and explode resulting in widespread damage to the station and our interests in the system.
STH_militaryship.157.name: Station SOS call
STH_militaryship.158.desc: One of our Starbases is reporting that a civilian transport has suffering from an impending warp core breach and that their engines have failed within the shield radius of our station. They are seeking urgent aid from the nearest starship to provide aid as the radiation from ship is disrupting attempts to move the ship outside of the danger zone.
STH_militaryship.158.name: Station SOS call
STH_militaryship.159.desc: The supplies have been undocked at the Starbase and the commander of the base has thanked us for providing these resources. As a bonus for aiding the researchers they have provided a small reward for our services.
STH_militaryship.159.name: Supplies received
STH_militaryship.160.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we have picked up an urgent distress call from [external_starbase_country.GetName] one of their outposts has suffered a serious issue and is in dire need of emergency aid. They are requesting any vessels in the area to come urgently.
STH_militaryship.160.name: SOS received from neighbouring system
STH_militaryship.161.desc: [external_starbase_country.GetName] are thankful for our prompt assistance and for saving the crew on the station, they have offered a small reward and their opinion of us have risen thanks to the efforts of our fleet.
STH_militaryship.161.name: Outpost saved
STH_militaryship.170.desc: We are receiving a priority one distress call from one of our ships the [ship_in_distress.GetName] they report that they are adrift with life support, engines and shields failing. The message broke up before we could find out more information on their situation, but it looks like they are in a dangerous predicament. We must send aid before it is too late.
STH_militaryship.170.name: Distress call received
STH_militaryship.171.desc: Our fleet arrived in time to investigate the distress call from [ship_in_distress.GetName] which was adrift but thankfully had not sustained too much damage. With combined help from both sets of crews the vessel was completely repaired and cleared to return to service.
STH_militaryship.171.name: Distress call received
STH_militaryship.172.desc: On arriving at the scene and investigating the damaged [ship_in_distress.GetName] it is clear they were attacked by unknown assailants. Unfortunately no evidence could be found to identify who attacked our ship. After some effort the crews were able to restore life support and minimal engine power to allow the ship to limp back to a friendly shipyard.
STH_militaryship.172.name: Distress call received
STH_militaryship.173.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we must report that we could not save the [ship_in_distress.GetName] the damage done to its engines was too great and the overload quickly cascades through the main power grid resulting in complete destruction of the ship. We examined the wreckage but were unable to find any trace of what caused the issue. The loss of the ship and crew will be felt throughout the fleet.
STH_militaryship.173.name: Distress call received
STH_militaryship.174.desc: It was immediately clear on investigating our damaged ship that this was work of dastardly pirates operating clandestinely within our borders. It is certain that our arrived caused the pirates to flee, but thanks to the quick work by the crew on our crippled ship they were able to scan the Ion trail left behind and determine the destination the pirates fled to. We must dispatch a fleet to that location to put an end to this threat.
STH_militaryship.174.name: Distress call received
STH_militaryship.175.desc: It was immediately clear on investigating our damaged ship that this was work of dastardly pirates operating clandestinely within our borders who have attempted to use the distress call as an opportunity to ambush our forces. We must make short work of these pirate vessels and track down their base of operations to end this threat for good. But first we must defend ourselves.
STH_militaryship.175.name: Distress call received
STH_militaryship.176.desc: We have tracked down the location of the pirate base of operations to an abandoned mining outpost on an asteroid within our borders. It is clear the pirates were not expecting our arrival as they have not fled. This leaves us with two opportunities to eradicate these pests. Our first officer recommends a clean strike from orbit to blow the pirates away, but this would result in their deaths and the loss of most of their stolen treasures. Our security officer recommends calling in a military transport and one of our generals to lead a ground assault allowing us to capture prisoners and recover more goods.
STH_militaryship.176.name: Pirate den found
STH_militaryship.177.desc: Our troops have successfully raised the pirate base, recovering the stolen good from the attack on our ships as well as a number of other raids they appear to have completed over the last few months. The remaining pirates were rounded up and have been taken our to our penal facilities where justice can be served.
STH_militaryship.177.name: Pirate base raided
STH_militaryship.178.desc: It looks like the pirates detected our arrival and have abandoned their facility in a hurry, leaving only a few small signs that they were there. Whilst it would have been preferable to catch them and bring them to justice at least we have put an end to this groups attacks against our ships.
STH_militaryship.178.name: Pirate den found
STH_militaryship.180.desc:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. 

One of our leading Doctors [leader_doctor.GetName] has been invited to attend a medical conference by [leader_doctor_country.GetName] to attend as the keynote speaker. The conference will be held on [doctor_conf_location.GetName] and is open to medical professionals across the quadrant, whilst Dr [leader_doctor.GetName] has been requested by name, we are free to send a replacement.
STH_militaryship.180.name: Medical Conference
STH_militaryship.181.desc: The Medical Conference was a success with medics across multiple states coming together to share knowledge and ideas. The experience proved to be a worthwhile experience for [leader_doctor.GetName] and has provided a nice boost to our research.
STH_militaryship.181.name: Medical Conference
STH_militaryship.182.desc: The Medical Conference proved to be a bit of a waste of time, with too many doctors wanting to talk and not listen. Whilst our doctor [leader_doctor.GetName], was not able to get a great amount from the event, it was still an experience.
STH_militaryship.182.name: Medical Conference
STH_militaryship.183.desc: The Medical conference was a brilliant opportunity to get many experts together in the same venue and as the conversation got flowing, ideas started to be generated and the group have come close to making a huge breakthrough in the treatment of one of the galaxies harmful diseases. [leader_doctor.GetName] has asked to say a few extra days to help provide this breakthrough.
STH_militaryship.183.name: Medical Conference
STH_militaryship.184.name: Medical breakthrough achieved
STH_militaryship.20.desc: The suffering of the people of [Root.GetName] on [planetDevastationTarget.GetName] cannot be ignored any longer. We must send a relief mission to aid the planet and help as many of the population as possible.
STH_militaryship.20.name: Planetary Devastation Relief Mission
STH_militaryship.201.desc:
The term second contact is used to describe the subsequent official encounter between representatives of two species or governments following first contact and can be critical to building a new relationship, however it is not the most glamorous assignment and is often left to the support vessels whilst the heroes take on more exciting missions. 

Second contact was seen as important as it allowed the facilitation of continued communication and to ensure that all administrative documentation were complete and correct. 

When it comes to selecting an Admiral for this mission sometimes it pays to be on the lower decks.
STH_militaryship.201.name: Second Contact Mission
STH_militaryship.202.desc:
The term second contact is used to describe the subsequent official encounter between representatives of two species or governments following first contact and can be critical to building a new relationship, however it is not the most glamorous assignment and is often left to the support vessels whilst the heroes take on more exciting missions. 

Second contact was seen as important as it allowed the facilitation of continued communication and to ensure that all administrative documentation were complete and correct and our recent contact with [second_contact_country.GetName] has led to an opportunity to send a second contact team. 

When it comes to selecting an Admiral for this mission sometimes it pays to be on the lower decks.
STH_militaryship.202.name: Second Contact Mission
STH_militaryship.203.desc: The mission was completed successfully and second contact was a uneventful but productive. Our diplomatic team have managed to complete the required pleasantries and establish the infrastructure required for an ongoing relationship with [second_contact_country.GetName] a good job well done by all involved.
STH_militaryship.203.name: Second Contact Mission Successful
STH_militaryship.204.desc: Whilst first contact is a dangerous event that can lead officers into the unknown, second contact doesn't come with the same risks, but the opportunity to fail still exists and it appears that has happened on this occasion. A number of faux pars were made and relations have suffered as a result. We can only hope future relations between us and [second_contact_country.GetName] go better than this.
STH_militaryship.204.name: Second Contact Mission Failed
STH_militaryship.205.desc: Failing to complete the Second Contact mission has not gone unnoticed and has deprived us of an opportunity to further our diplomatic relations and set up an on going line of communications.
STH_militaryship.205.name: Second Contact Mission Not Complete
STH_militaryship.21.desc: Thanks to the hard work of our relief aid teams most of the damage to [planetDevastationTarget.GetName] has been repaired and whilst those lost can never be brought back, we have at least made the lives of those that remain on the planet much better.
STH_militaryship.21.name: Planetary Devastation Relief Mission
STH_militaryship.22.desc: Thanks to the hard work of our relief aid teams a dent has been made into the total devastation on [planetDevastationTarget.GetName]. The work is not complete but the population are at least out of immediate danger.
STH_militaryship.22.name: Planetary Devastation Relief Mission
STH_militaryship.23.desc: The efforts required to reduce the devastation to the planet were more than we anticipated and during our attempts to salvage the situation we appear to have caused additional harm to the planet and lowered the morale of those already impacted by the recent events.
STH_militaryship.23.name: Planetary Devastation Relief Mission
STH_militaryship.24.desc: [Root.GetRulerName], our efforts to stabilize [planetDevastationTarget.GetName] has gone terribly wrong it appears we did not prepare or provide enough resources. Faulty equipment has misfired and triggered further damage to the planet and potential further consequences.
STH_militaryship.24.name: Planetary Devastation Relief Mission
STH_militaryship.25.desc: Once again our engineers have worked miracles and proved their undoubted worth to us, managing to render aid and repair ahead of schedule!
STH_militaryship.25.name: Miracle Worker
STH_militaryship.250.desc: Our fleet carrying our diplomatic envoys has been ambushed by mercenaries intent on capturing or destroying our ships and taking our diplomats hostage for some unknown group. We must defend our envoys.
STH_militaryship.250.name: Diplomatic Convoy under siege
STH_militaryship.3.desc: There is a reason why [sth_crime_figher_leader.GetName] is one of the best in the business, they were successfully able to infiltrate and arrest the head of the local crime faction and deal the criminal underworld a massive defeat. The planet and its citizens can consider themselves much safer tonight.
STH_militaryship.3.name: Criminal faction defeated
STH_militaryship.4.desc: [sth_crime_figher_leader.GetName] and their crew have managed to secure a victory against one of the biggest crime factions on the planet, and whilst they were unable to capture the leader they have set organised crime back significantly.
STH_militaryship.4.name: Criminal faction dealt a blow
STH_militaryship.5.desc: [Root.GetRulerName], our efforts to tackle crime on [selected_crime_planet.GetName] has failed and worse still appears to have strengthened the criminal organisations hold over the planet. The Captain barely escaped with their life and could carry the psychological scars of this encounter for years to come.
STH_militaryship.5.name: Unable to defeat criminals
STH_militaryship.8.desc: As feared the army charged into the situation with little finesse and the criminal gangs were able to out-smart our general, the criminal masterminds behind the gangs were able to draw the confrontation out into the public, who were horrified to see all out warfare on their streets. Our troops were forced to retreat leaving the crime gang to continue unchecked.
STH_militaryship.8.name: Army causes a mess on [selected_crime_planet.GetName]
STH_militaryship.9.desc: Our forces performed a precision strike against the criminal gangs leadership, successfully eliminating the top criminal bosses and dealing the crime factions a massive defeat. The planet and its citizens can consider themselves much safer tonight.
STH_militaryship.9.name: Criminal faction defeated
STH_minor_anomaly.1.desc:
Después de varias horas de búsqueda, la tripulación del [Root.GetName] parece estar a punto de abandonar la búsqueda de la misteriosa señal. Sin embargo, el Oficial Científico detecta un cambio muy sutil en el subespacio que indica la presencia de un objeto oculto a simple vista. 

El Oficial Científico sugiere que una emisión concentrada de taquiones del plato deflector principal de [Root.GetName] puede ser suficiente para revelar el objeto, ya que el cambio del subespacio tiene muchas similitudes con la tecnología de ocultación existente.
STH_minor_anomaly.1.name: Objetos en el espacio
STH_minor_anomaly.100.desc:
Al inspeccionar las ruinas alienígenas en [From.GetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] y [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] equipo de distancia pueden establecer que las estructuras tienen al menos diez mil años de antigüedad. 

La encuesta tardará varios días en completarse, pero los resultados ya son fascinantes.
STH_minor_anomaly.100.name: Ruinas alienígenas
STH_minor_anomaly.101.desc:
Se descubrió un obelisco en el centro de las ruinas de la plaza más grande en [From.GetName]. Los escaneos revelan una matriz morfogénica inusual dentro de la estructura. 

Reporting este hallazgo nuevo a [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] es instruido para preparar el obelisco para el transporte rápido como para ser analizado en una instalación más totalmente equipada.
STH_minor_anomaly.101.name: Ruinas alienígenas
STH_minor_anomaly.102.desc:
Se descubrió un pequeño relicario en los campos fuera de las ruinas de la plaza más grande en [From.GetName]. Los escaneos revelan una matriz morfogénica inusual dentro del relicario. 

Reportando este hallazgo de nuevo a [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] tiene instrucciones de preparar el relicario para el transporte que se analizará en una instalación más equipada.
STH_minor_anomaly.102.name: Ruinas alienígenas
STH_minor_anomaly.103.desc: La encuesta de las ruinas antiguas en [From.GetName] está completa. Si bien no se descubrieron artefactos notables, los escaneos y los registros menores descubiertos mantendrán a los científicos de [Root.Owner.GetName] ocupados durante meses.
STH_minor_anomaly.103.name: Ruinas alienígenas
STH_minor_anomaly.2.desc:
La explosión del taquión revela con éxito el objeto. Parece ser similar en función a una sonda [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj], completa con algún tipo de tecnología de ocultación para ocultarla de la mayoría de los intentos de detección. 

 Al detectar que se ha descubierto, la sonda intenta activar un mecanismo de autodestrucción, sin duda una medida de seguridad para evitar la adquisición. Sin embargo, el rápido pensamiento del Oficial Táctico del [Root.GetName] coloca una descarga de baja intensidad [Root.Owner.GetMainEnergyWeapon] en la fuente del pico de poder suficiente para desactivar pero no destruir la sonda. 

La sonda se introduce en la bodega de carga donde los equipos de Ciencia e Ingeniería de [Root.GetName] pueden examinarla. 

Después de varias horas, creen que han accedido a su núcleo de memoria principal y a los datos que contiene. La sonda en sí parece ser antigua, tanto que las especies que la lanzaron ya no existen. 

Los datos están dañados y muy fragmentados, pero la tripulación puede reconstruir una parte de la memoria de navegación de la sonda.
STH_minor_anomaly.2.name: Objetos en el espacio
STH_minor_anomaly.200.desc: Al establecerse cerca de la concentración de gravitón más alta, el equipo visitante de [Root.GetFleetName] no tardó en confirmar el potencial minero de [From.GetName]. La sonda estándar de la capa superior del suelo reveló rápidamente ricas vetas de mineral de duranio. La combinación de esto con las lecturas del campo de gravedad reveló que las venas penetran profundamente en el núcleo de [From.GetName].
STH_minor_anomaly.200.name: Anomalía Gravitacional
STH_minor_anomaly.201.desc:
"Un mal funcionamiento del sensor", informó el geólogo principal de [Root.GetFleetName] desde la superficie de [From.GetName]. 

El equipo visitante no ha podido localizar nada que explique la anomalía gravitacional, ya que el análisis del suelo reveló que el mundo no tiene nada de notable. 

Las investigaciones posteriores sugirieron que las lecturas defectuosas fueron causadas de hecho por un mal funcionamiento del interferómetro nadion en el conjunto de sensores de [Root.GetFleetName].
STH_minor_anomaly.201.name: Anomalía Gravitacional
STH_minor_anomaly.202.desc:
Las lecturas de superficie de [From.GetName] revelaron que el asteroide estaba en un estado casi constante de flujo de gravitón. El seguimiento de la anomalía hasta su origen llevó al equipo de distancia de [Root.GetFleetName] a una grieta muy por debajo de la superficie. 

 Allí, en el origen de la anomalía, encontraron algo sorprendente. Pequeños racimos de cristales de cuarzo prometeano brillando débilmente, emitiendo un brillo misterioso a través del abismo como si estuviera iluminado por velas. 

Los escaneos de los cristales no revelaron una conexión con el flujo de gravitón, y poseían el excepcional índice de alta densidad molecular y refracción esperado del cuarzo prometeano. 

 [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] recomienda que se envíen a un laboratorio de investigación en [alien_eggs_planet.GetName] para su posterior estudio, aunque teniendo en cuenta su belleza excepcional, es posible que no estén fuera de lugar en un museo.
STH_minor_anomaly.202.name: Anomalía Gravitacional
STH_minor_anomaly.203.desc:
Las caídas de energía intermitentes, aparentemente el resultado de picos periódicos en el consumo de energía que sobrecargan la red de distribución de energía, han interrumpido la actividad económica en [Root.GetName]. 

Mientras intentaban diagnosticar el problema, los ingenieros locales detectaron un estallido de gravitón localizado anómalo.
STH_minor_anomaly.203.name: Fallas de la red eléctrica en [Root.GetName]
STH_minor_anomaly.204.desc: La actividad económica en [Root.GetName] continúa siendo interrumpida, ya que la fuente del drenaje y las explosiones de gravitón asociadas aún no se han descubierto. Peor aún, las explosiones de gravitón han aumentado en intensidad hasta el punto de que han desencadenado actividad sísmica en todo el planeta.
STH_minor_anomaly.204.name: Fallas de la red eléctrica en [Root.GetName]
STH_minor_anomaly.210.desc:
Solo cuando se detectó una explosión de gravitón alrededor de uno de los nodos de potencia afectados por los drenajes de energía periódicos en [Root.GetFleetName] se hizo evidente lo que estaba sucediendo; algo estaba desviando la energía de la red eléctrica y convirtiéndola en gravitones. 

Con la conexión entre los dos fenómenos se ha determinado, los sensores de [Root.GetFleetName] pudieron aislar la causa del consumo de energía; Un gran fragmento de lo que parece ser cuarzo prometeano.
STH_minor_anomaly.210.name: Fallas de la red eléctrica en [From.GetName]
STH_minor_anomaly.211.desc:
Transferir el cristal de cuarzo prometeano al [Root.GetFleetName] fue un error desastroso. Cuando se materializó, el cristal inmediatamente comenzó a drenar la fuente de alimentación de la nave, mientras que las explosiones de gravitón desestabilizaron el núcleo de la urdimbre. 

En cuestión de segundos, el núcleo se rompió, matando a todos a bordo del [Root.GetFleetName].
STH_minor_anomaly.211.name: Cristal de gravitón
STH_minor_anomaly.212.desc:
La rematerialización del cristal de cuarzo prometeano en el espacio fue acompañada por un destello de luz visible. 

De esto surgió un extraterrestre espacial, que brillaba intensamente a la luz de los gravitones en descomposición que se desprendían de su piel. 

Análisis confirmó que lo que se pensaba que era cuarzo prometeano era de hecho un huevo extraño. Las perturbaciones de la red eléctrica se teorizaron como resultado del embrión que se nutría de su entorno hasta que había madurado lo suficiente como para eclosionar. 

Transportar el huevo al espacio parece haber desencadenado la eclosión de la criatura, salvando al planeta de un daño considerable en curso.
STH_minor_anomaly.212.name: Cristal de gravitón
STH_minor_anomaly.213.desc: Intentar destruir el cristal de cuarzo prometeano ha resultado desastroso. Cuando el cristal se fracturó, los gravitones contenidos en él se liberaron instantáneamente causando una onda de choque masiva. Cientos murieron y miles resultaron heridos.
STH_minor_anomaly.213.name: Cristal de gravitón
STH_minor_anomaly.220.desc:
Un destello brillante iluminó el cielo de la ciudad capital en [Root.GetName] antes de desvanecerse primero en la oscuridad y luego un tenue resplandor azul del gas ionizado. Los servicios de emergencia rápidamente determinaron que uno de los muchos drenajes de energía recientes en [Root.GetName] coincidió con una explosión de gravitón que golpeó la instalación de almacenamiento de energía primaria de la ciudad, destruyéndola. 

Mientras que los campos de fuerza automáticos contenían gran parte de la explosión, varios talleres cercanos colapsaron reduciendo la onda de choque, matando a doce.
STH_minor_anomaly.220.name: Fallas de la red eléctrica en [Root.GetName]
STH_minor_anomaly.221.desc:
En una explosión de gravitones, una gran parte de la ciudad capital en [Root.GetName] se ha nivelado. Al salir de la devastación, una gran criatura parecía luchar para desenredarse de los edificios en ruinas, brillando a la luz de los gravitones en descomposición que se desprendían de su piel. 

Después de extender sus alas a todo su ancho, la criatura pareció impulsarse a sí misma en órbita, antes de salir del sistema [Root.Solar_System.GetName]. 

Aunque la devastación de [Root.GetName] fue sustancial, los problemas que afectaban a la red eléctrica se detuvieron después de la partida del alienígena.
STH_minor_anomaly.221.name: Fallas de la red eléctrica en [Root.GetName]
STH_minor_anomaly.3.desc: Después de horas de escaneo del sistema circundante, no se puede encontrar ninguna señal de la fuente de la señal que detectó [Root.GetName]. El Capitán [Root.Leader.GetName] ordena a la tripulación que regrese a su patrón de inspección anterior.
STH_minor_anomaly.3.name: Objetos en el espacio
STH_minor_anomaly.300.desc:
Después de varios días escaneando la superficie de [From.GetName], se ha descubierto que la fuente de los pulsos de cronitones no es más que un programa de capacitación de oficiales científicos, activado por error por [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] . 

Que tomó tanto tiempo identificar el error es una fuente de vergüenza para todos los involucrados.
STH_minor_anomaly.300.name: Pulsos de croniton
STH_minor_anomaly.301.desc:
Después de varios días escaneando la superficie de [From.GetName], el [Root.GetFleetName] ha acumulado un volumen sustancial de datos sobre la naturaleza de los pulsos de cronitones detectados. 

Los pulsos disminuyeron rápidamente en intensidad y ahora son indetectables. Lo que los causó sigue siendo un misterio.
STH_minor_anomaly.301.name: Pulsos de croniton
STH_minor_anomaly.302.desc:
Después de varios días escaneando la superficie de [From.GetName] el [Root.GetFleetName] ha detectado el punto focal de los pulsos del cronitón, un cadáver encontrado en medio de una llanura estéril. 

El cuerpo cuando se analizó mostró que era un híbrido de ADN [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] y varias fuentes extrañas desconocidas. 

Con los pulsos de radiación del cronitón detenidos poco después de que el cuerpo fue recuperado, el origen del cuerpo sigue siendo un misterio.
STH_minor_anomaly.302.name: Pulsos de croniton
STH_minor_anomaly.305.desc:
Los escaneos orbitales de [From.GetName] han demostrado ser incapaces de determinar la ubicación exacta de los pulsos del cronitón, aunque los indicadores principales sugieren que es probable que la fuente sea subterránea. 

Sin ningún signo de disipación, se propone una encuesta completa para aislar y estudiar la fuente de la radiación de cronitón.
STH_minor_anomaly.305.name: Pulsos de croniton

STH_minor_anomaly.4.desc:
Después de varias horas de búsqueda, el Oficial Científico de [Root.GetName] informa que han localizado algo en los sensores, y propone una corriente modulada contra protones que puede revelar más información. 

Captain [Root.Leader.GetName] lo aprueba y el haz antiprotón se dispara a las coordenadas del conjunto de deflectores principal. 

Momentos después, algo aparece en los sensores. Parece ser una sonda, aunque está armada y alimentando armas.
STH_minor_anomaly.4.name: Objetos en el espacio
STH_minor_anomaly.400.desc:
Después de varios días escaneando la superficie de [From.GetName], se ha descubierto que la fuente de los pulsos de cronitones no es más que un programa de capacitación de oficiales científicos, activado por error por [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] . 

Que tomó tanto tiempo identificar el error es una fuente de vergüenza para todos los involucrados.
STH_minor_anomaly.400.name: Pulsos de croniton
STH_minor_anomaly.401.desc:
Después de varios días escaneando la superficie de [From.GetName], el [Root.GetFleetName] ha acumulado un volumen sustancial de datos sobre la naturaleza de los pulsos de cronitones detectados. 

Los pulsos disminuyeron rápidamente en intensidad y ahora son indetectables. Lo que los causó sigue siendo un misterio.
STH_minor_anomaly.401.name: Pulsos de croniton

STH_minor_anomaly.450.desc: Sensors have located a curious biosignature hidden under the surface on [From.Planet.GetName]. The recovered strands bear some resemblance to life found on other worlds in the galaxy, which is statistically improbable, however not impossible. Researchers may find this useful.
STH_minor_anomaly.450.name: DNA Strands
STH_minor_anomaly.451.desc:
Sensors have located a curious biosignature hidden under the surface on [From.Planet.GetName]. The recovered strands bear some resemblance to life found on other worlds in the galaxy, which is statistically improbable, however not impossible.

Further scans detect a small [Root.GetSpeciesName] transport drifting nearby, registered to an archeologist.

Upon investigating further, the ships hull has been breached after having been struck by energy weapons and the flash frozen body of the archaeologist drifts nearby. The ship appears to have been ransacked, though one time delayed capsule floats nearby emitting a weak signal.

Upon investigating the capsule, a message from the archaeologist begins to play concerning an embedded genetic pattern that is constant throughout many different species, and they speculate was left by an early race that pre-dates all other known civilizations. Coordinates for the hidden dig site are contained within.
STH_minor_anomaly.451.name: DNA Strands
STH_minor_anomaly.5.desc:
La explosión del taquión revela con éxito el objeto. Parece ser similar en función a una sonda [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj], completa con algún tipo de tecnología de ocultación para ocultarla de la mayoría de los intentos de detección. 

 Al detectar que se ha descubierto, la sonda intenta activar un mecanismo de autodestrucción, sin duda una medida de seguridad para evitar la adquisición. Sin embargo, el pensamiento rápido del Oficial Táctico del [Root.GetName] coloca una descarga rápida [Root.Owner.GetMainEnergyWeapon] en la fuente del pico de poder suficiente para desactivar pero no destruir la sonda. 

La sonda se introduce en la bodega de carga donde los equipos de Ciencia e Ingeniería de [Root.GetName] pueden examinarla. 

Después de varias horas, creen que han accedido a su núcleo de memoria principal y a los datos que contiene. La sonda en sí parece ser antigua, tanto que las especies que la lanzaron ya no existen. 

Los datos están dañados y muy fragmentados, tanto que no se puede recuperar nada de valor.
STH_minor_anomaly.5.name: Objetos en el espacio
STH_minor_anomaly.500.desc: The signal we intercepted was a distress call from a ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The ship is not giving off any heat signatures and seems to be drifting. A Special Project has been issued to investigate what has happened to the crew.
STH_minor_anomaly.500.name: Lost in Space
STH_minor_anomaly.501.desc: The crew of the derelict ship has been found dead, many from life support failure, but others seemingly acted suicidally in their final moments. Some members of our away team have begun to act strangely on their return, and scientist [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered what looks like a brain parasite in one of the scans of the dead.
STH_minor_anomaly.501.name: Lost in Space
STH_minor_anomaly.502.desc: The ship in orbit around [From.From.From.GetName] seems to have been crippled, and our away team was nearly killed by the maddened crew apparently responsible. After a quick escape, they found a small group deep in the ship with an apparent cure for the contagious illness. The aliens seem to need our help to restore life support to disperse it before the ship is completely destroyed.
STH_minor_anomaly.502.name: Lost in Space
STH_minor_anomaly.503.name: Chaos Clothed
STH_minor_anomaly.504.desc: Scientist [Root.GetLeaderName] was able to organize quarantining the away team and those they came in contact with to the ship in orbit around [From.From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, while only some were infected, they all died along with the security personnel assigned when one of them managed to overload the derelict's main engines. Despite the loss, it is clear that if we had allowed them to stay on our ship, it may have been lost as well.
STH_minor_anomaly.504.name: Severed Chaos
STH_minor_anomaly.505.desc: As maddened crew were about to breach the laboratory, scientist [Root.GetLeaderName] finally managed to get a cure into the ventillation system. The parasites have left the survivors' brains with stroke-like effects. While the ship's hull can be easily repaired, scientist [Root.GetLeaderName] has lost many of the skills they possessed. The one bit of good news is that the recovering science officer believes the undamaged sensor logs on the derelict could be used to trace its origin.
STH_minor_anomaly.505.name: Scarred by Chaos
STH_minor_anomaly.506.desc: Scientist [Root.GetLeaderName]'s efforts were insufficient, and in the chaos of the mad crew, the main engines were overloaded. All hands were lost.
STH_minor_anomaly.506.name: Consumed by Chaos
STH_minor_anomaly.600.desc:
From the earliest days of space flight for our empire, our ancient explorers set their eyes on landing on [From.GetName], hoovering tantalizingly close to our homeworld, just within touching distance. It became a goal for our early ventures off the surface of [From.Owner.capital_scope.GetName]. 

Now are scientists have found a site of historical importance, the location where the first of our species landed on an offworld site.
STH_minor_anomaly.600.name: One Small Step
STH_minor_anomaly.601.desc: The expedition team has located the site and has begun investigating, looking for signs of our early spaceflight to this planet. Scanners trained on any signs of the metals used to construct the spacecraft used to reach this planet, with local news reports keeping a close eye on the progress being made.
STH_minor_anomaly.601.name: One Small Step
STH_minor_anomaly.602.desc:
Our archeology teams have successfully uncovered the site of vast historical significance, the site of our first landing on this world, a fantastic discovery. 

As our teams prepare to handover to historians, this serves as a reminder of how far we have come as a species.
STH_minor_anomaly.602.name: One Small Step
STH_minor_anomaly.610.desc: On investigatng [This.GetName] can confirm the downed ship once belonged to a long-forgotten race of space farers, the ship appears to have been an archive of their civilization, there is very little left of the archive, except a small DNA Archive, unusable but contains some interesting elements for our scientists.
STH_minor_anomaly.610.name: Crashed Archive Ship
STH_mirrorMirror_event.1.desc:
El capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante se dirigen hacia [From.GetName] para explorar el planeta. Las interesantes composiciones minerales parecen justificar un estudio más profundo, sin embargo la tormenta de iones que se aproxima obliga al equipo visitante a regresar al barco antes de que el análisis geológico pueda ser completado. 

 Con la creciente interferencia, el jefe del transportista casi pierde los patrones de los equipos del equipo visitante, pero es capaz de emitir el capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante hasta el [Root.GetFleetName] de forma segura. 

Después de su regreso, el capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y los miembros del equipo visitante parecen estar actuando extrañamente, enojados y violentos con otros miembros de la tripulación con poca provocación. 

El Oficial Ejecutivo se ha preocupado de que pueda haber algo malo en el equipo visitante y cree que debe ser examinado por el médico del buque, justificando las acciones del equipo visitante como resultado de un extenso tiempo en el espacio profundo.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.1.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.10.desc:
El Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante se dirigen hacia [mirrorPlanet.GetName] para explorar el planeta. Las valiosas composiciones minerales justifican un mayor estudio, sin embargo, la tormenta de iones que se aproxima obliga al equipo visitante a regresar al barco antes de que un equipo de ocupantes ilegales que ocupan varios sitios mineros principales pueda ser eliminado. 

Con la interferencia que aumenta rápidamente, el jefe de transporte casi pierde el los patrones de transporte del equipo visitante, pero pueden enviar al Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y al equipo visitante hasta el [Root.GetFleetName] de forma segura. 

Siguiendo su regreso, el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y los miembros del equipo visitante parece estar actuando de manera extraña, tratando de resolver las disputas entre la tripulación utilizando la diplomacia y la lógica. 

El Oficial Ejecutivo se ha preocupado de que pueda haber algo mal con el equipo visitante y cree que deben seguirse de cerca; Si la interferencia externa ha afectado al Capitán y al equipo visitante, deben ser eliminados a toda costa.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.10.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.11.desc:
Después de seguir al Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName], el Oficial Ejecutivo descubre que el Capitán y el equipo visitante no son de este universo y son impostores de una dimensión paralela. Intentan secretamente regresar a su lugar de origen, pero el Oficial Ejecutivo cree que pueden intentar regresar luego con refuerzos para imponer su ideología retorcida a la gente de [Root.Owner.GetName]. 

Después de emboscar al Capitán y al equipo visitante, el Oficial Ejecutivo sufre una lesión grave. Sin embargo, el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] se niega a dejar morir al Oficial Ejecutivo e intenta revivirlo a costa de perder la oportunidad de volver a su propio universo. 

Cuando el Oficial Ejecutivo recupera la conciencia, presiona al Capitán y al fuera del equipo para obtener más detalles de su universo, y por qué sacrificarían su intento de llegar a casa por la vida de alguien que los detendría por cualquier medio necesario ...
STH_mirrorMirror_event.11.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.12.desc:
Un ingeniero senior ha intentado asesinar al Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName], ya que sus acciones recientes para promover la paz son vistas por la tripulación como un signo de debilidad. Sin embargo, el Capitán y el equipo visitante pueden frustrar el intento de asesinato y neutralizar al posible asesino sin matarlos. 

Con el protocolo, el Capitán perdona la vida de los amotinados. El Oficial Ejecutivo ahora tiene motivos suficientes para justificar la remoción del Capitán del mando, ya que estas no son las acciones normales de un comandante de nave espacial.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.12.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.13.desc:
El Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] es ordenado por el Comando de Flota [Root.Owner.GetName] para obligar a los ocupantes ilegales en [mirrorPlanet.GetName] a entregar los minerales apuntando a su campamento y lanzando un bombardeo orbital del planeta. Sin embargo, el Capitán desobedece estas órdenes y en su lugar trata de hablar con ellos y hacer que cambien de opinión. 

El Oficial Ejecutivo ahora tiene motivos para relevar al Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] del comando y asumir el comando del [Root.GetName], por desobedecer las órdenes. Sin embargo, será difícil acercarse al Capitán para detenerlos o para detenerlos o asesinarlos.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.13.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.14.desc:
El Capitán y el equipo visitante del universo paralelo son escoltados por el Oficial Ejecutivo a la sala de transportadores, donde intentan repetir el proceso que los llevó a este universo y enviaron a su propio Capitán y equipo visitante al otro. 

Antes de desmaterializarse, el Capitán del otro universo le dice al primer oficial de este universo que el [Root.Owner.GetName] está destinado a desmoronarse y ser conquistado si no adoptan formas pacíficas. 

El Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante de este universo se materializan en la plataforma del transportador, y se ven muy aliviados de haber regresado. 

Regresan con historias de una versión pacífica de [Root.GetName], donde no encajaban y fueron rápidamente detenidos y encarcelados. 

A pesar de la experiencia, el Oficial Ejecutivo ahora comienza a creer que el Capitán del otro universo tenía un punto, y que tal vez su futuro se encuentre en un camino más pacífico ...
STH_mirrorMirror_event.14.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.15.desc:
El Capitán y el equipo visitante del universo paralelo son escoltados por el Oficial Ejecutivo a la sala de transportadores, donde intentan repetir el proceso que los llevó a este universo y enviaron a su propio Capitán y equipo visitante al otro. 

Antes de desmaterializarse, el Capitán del otro universo le dice al primer oficial de este universo que el [Root.Owner.GetName] está destinado a desmoronarse y ser conquistado si no adoptan formas pacíficas. 

Hay un problema con el transportador y se acorta durante el ciclo de transporte. El oficial ejecutivo intenta recuperar la señal, pero ahora se ha ido para siempre. Es probable que ambas versiones del Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y los miembros del equipo visitante se hayan perdido durante el transporte. 

Aunque es lamentable que el Capitán y el equipo visitante de ambos universos se hayan perdido, el Oficial Ejecutivo ahora comienza a creer que el Capitán del otro universo tenía un punto, y que tal vez su futuro se encuentre en un camino más pacífico. ..
STH_mirrorMirror_event.15.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.16.desc:
El Oficial Ejecutivo decide que sería demasiado peligroso dejar que el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante vivan. Pretendiendo llevarlos a la sala de transportadores, en su lugar, son llevados a la esclusa de aire más cercana donde son arrojados al espacio. 

Con el asesinato del Capitán y el equipo visitante, el Oficial Ejecutivo ahora asume el mando de [Root.GetName ] y promete garantizar que las ideas peligrosas del universo paralelo no se propaguen aquí y causen disensión.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.16.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.17.desc:
El Oficial Ejecutivo decide que sería demasiado peligroso dejar que el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante vivan. Pretendiendo llevarlos a la sala de transportadores, los llevan a la esclusa de aire más cercana. 

Sin embargo, el Capitán y el equipo visitante logran escapar de esta trampa y llegar a la sala de transporte y regresar a su universo. El Capitán de este universo [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante aparecen en su lugar. 

 Llegan con historias de una versión pacífica de [Root.GetName], donde no encajaban y fueron rápidamente detenidos y encarcelados. Tanto el Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] como el Oficial Ejecutivo de [Root.GetName] creen que las ideas del otro universo son peligrosas y no se debe permitir que se arraiguen aquí.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.17.name: Espejo, Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.2.desc:
El médico del buque ha realizado un examen médico completo del capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y del equipo visitante. Por lo que el médico puede decir, no hay nada malo con ninguno de ellos y no explination se puede proporcionar para explicar su comportamiento violento. El oficial ejecutivo tiene el capitán y el equipo de distancia confinados al bergantín hasta que puedan determinar la causa de su cambio en el comportamiento y cómo se puede resolver. 

Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] finalmente confía en el Oficial Ejecutivo que no son de este universo, y han transpuesto lugares con sus opuestos aquí. El Capitán había ordenado al equipo visitante que siguiera con la pretensión hasta que pudieran determinar una forma de regresar a su propio universo, pero las diferencias entre los dos universos lo hicieron imposible. 

El jefe del transportista cree que puede haber una manera de devolver el equipo visitante a su propio universo, y esperemos recuperar a su propio capitán y equipo visitante en el proceso. Sin embargo hay la posibilidad de que el enfoque puede fallar, y que terminaría perdiendo ambos equipos fuera.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.2.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.3.desc:
Un miembro fuera del equipo ha sido atrapado tratando de asesinar a otro tripulante. Esto ahora ha obligado a la mano del primer oficial a ordenar a su oficial superior ya sus compañeros miembros de la tripulación a ser examinados médicamente. 

Un equipo de seguridad se ve obligado a luchar con el Capitán y, a la larga, a aturdir al Capitán ya los miembros del equipo y llevarlos a la enfermería inconsciente. El médico ahora puede realizar un examen médico para tratar de descubrir lo que ha sucedido con el equipo visitante y les ha hecho tan bárbaro y violento.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.3.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.4.desc:
El capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] ordena al oficial táctico de [Root.GetFleetName] que abra el fuego en un conjunto de coordenadas en la superficie de [From.GetName]. Cuando el oficial pregunta por qué el Capitán ha ordenado este ataque, [Root.GetLeaderName] dibuja un phaser y ejecuta al oficial por desobedecer órdenes. 

Ahora el Oficial Ejecutivo no tiene más remedio que ordenar la seguridad para arrestar, detener y obligar al Capitán y al equipo visitante a someterse a un examen médico para determinar lo que les sucedió y lo que los ha hecho tan bárbaros y violentos .
STH_mirrorMirror_event.4.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.5.desc:
El capitán y el equipo visitante del universo paralelo son escoltados por un equipo de seguridad a la sala de transporte, donde el jefe de transporte intenta repetir el proceso que los llevó a este universo y envió a su propio capitán y equipo de distancia a la otra. Antes de desmaterializar, el capitán del otro universo le dice al primer oficial de este universo que este universo es débil y maduro para la conquista, y que se desmoronarán como lo hacen todas las civilizaciones débiles. 

Capitan [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante de este universo se materializan en la almohadilla del transportista, pareciendo muy aliviado estar de vuelta.

El regreso con historias de horror de una versión torcida y bárbara del [Root.GetFleetName], donde la tortura y la violencia se utiliza para controlar y asesinar es la forma normal de ascender filas. El capitán más tarde confía en el oficial ejecutivo que en el otro universo había otra versión de ellos, y que el capitán esperaba que un discurso de salida dado al oficial ejecutivo de ese universo podría tener un efecto duradero.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.5.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.6.desc:
El capitán y el equipo de distancia del universo paralelo son escoltados por un equipo de seguridad a la sala de transporte, donde el jefe de transporte intenta repetir el proceso que los llevó a este universo y envió a su propio capitán y equipo de distancia a la otra. Antes de desmaterializar, el capitán del otro universo le dice al primer oficial de este universo que este universo es débil y maduro para la conquista, y que se desmoronarán como lo hacen todas las civilizaciones débiles. 

Hay un problema con el transportador, y se corta durante el ciclo de transporte. El jefe del transportista trata de recuperar la señal, pero ahora se ha ido para siempre. Es probable que ambas versiones del Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y los miembros del equipo fuera de casa se perdieran durante el transporte. 

El jefe del transportador aturdido promete corregir el error que llevó a que este incidente tenga lugar, pero no traerá de vuelta al capitán o perdió a los miembros de la tripulación.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.6.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.7.desc:
La otra versión del universo de Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] y los miembros del equipo fuera de casa deben ser transferidos a una instalación segura donde se mantendrán indefinidamente. 

Ellos son demasiado peligrosos para que se les permita salir libres, ya que se teme que puedan encontrar una manera de regresar a su universo brutal y regresar con refuerzos. 

 Si bien es una pérdida trágica que no podamos devolver al capitán y al equipo visitante de este universo, la información que obtendremos de sus homólogos del otro universo será, sin duda, de gran valor. También trabajaremos para asegurar que el accidente no se repita mejorando los procedimientos del transportador.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.7.name: Espejo Espejo
STH_mirrorMirror_event.8.desc:
La otra versión del universo del Capitán [Root.GetLeaderName] y los miembros del equipo fuera de casa debían ser transferidos a una instalación segura, pero durante el proceso de transferencia dominaron a su equipo de escolta de seguridad y tomaron sus armas. 

Después de luchar en su camino a la sala de transporte, lograron transportar de vuelta a su universo, y en el proceso devolvió el capitán original y el equipo de distancia. 

Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] y el equipo visitante regresaron con historias de terror de una versión torcida y bárbara del [Root.GetFleetName], donde la tortura y la violencia se utiliza para controlar y asesinar es la forma normal de ascender filas. 

El Capitán más tarde confía en el Oficial Ejecutivo que en el otro universo había otra versión de ellos, y que el Capitán esperaba que un discurso de despedida dado al Oficial Ejecutivo de ese universo pudiera tener un efecto duradero.
STH_mirrorMirror_event.8.name: Espejo Espejo

STH_mirror_invasion.0.desc:
Subspace telescopes across [Root.GetName] space have detected a massive surge in zeta radiation localised around the [mirror_universe_portal_system_1.GetName] black hole. 

The Science Council has requested Starfleet dispatch a vessel to the anomaly.
STH_mirror_invasion.0.name: Unusual Radiation Surge
STH_mirror_invasion.1.desc:

STH_mirror_invasion.1.name: Unusual Radiation Surge

STH_mirror_invasion.11.desc:
Ah, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName]... My name is [terran_empire_vanguard_leader.GetName] and I come from the universe on the Other Side. 

Let's get straight to the point. Your time in this world is short, so try not to make it even shorter by getting in my way.

You can leave this system now, and you have my word my fleet won't venture beyond the singularity's sphere of influence. Remaining will be considered a hostile act.

STH_mirror_invasion.19.desc:
The last Terran Empire ship in this universe has been destroyed, and with it the immediate threat to the [Root.GetName] has abated. 

While there is no guarantee that the threat from the Other Side will not re-emerge again in the future, their defeat in this universe is widely believed to have weakened the Terran Empire's war capacity considerably.
STH_mirror_invasion.19.name: Broken Mirror
STH_mirror_invasion.2.desc:
The surge in zeta radiation detected from the [mirror_universe_portal_system_1.GetName] black hole has yet to be investigated, but recently complications have emerged when a vessel containing a single occupant was intercepted on a course for [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

The occupant, a [Root.GetSpeciesName] named [mirror_universe_escapee.GetName] claims to have crossed over from a 'mirror' universe via the [mirror_universe_portal_system_1.GetName]. Further, [mirror_universe_escapee.GetSheHe] claims to have information vital to the security of the [Root.GetName].
STH_mirror_invasion.2.name: Unusual Radiation Surge
STH_mirror_invasion.20.name: Broken Mirror

Join us, and together we can carve up their worlds between us.

STH_naval_museum.5000.desc:
Every fleet reaches a point where operationally maintaining it becomes unproductive, especially as new vessels are commissioned. 

Mothballing a fleet allows you to power down and put the vessel into storage within drydock, ready to be activated at a later date or converted into a museum ship. Mothballed fleets cannot be used until they are reactived, but have a significantly lower upkeep compared with active ships.
STH_naval_museum.5000.name: Fleet Mothballing Operations
STH_naval_museum.5001.desc: [This.GetName] has reached the Starfleet Naval Museum and the crews have disembarked and been reassigned, over the next few weeks and months Starfleet Corp. of Engineers will begin removing systems and packing away items onboard the ships.
STH_naval_museum.5001.name: Fleet Ready for Mothballing
STH_naval_museum.5003.desc:
Placing a mothballed fleet back into service takes place here, there could be many reasons to reactive a fleet, such as defense or an offensive campaign. Reactivated Fleets will take some time to get back up to operational standards, so make sure you plan ahead. 

Dev Note: Make sure you rename the fleet you plan to reactive to help identify it from the list.
STH_naval_museum.5003.name: Reactivate a Mothballed Fleet
STH_naval_museum.5004.desc: Our engineers have confirmed that [This.GetName] is now operational, albeit operating with a skeleton crew and with a number of systems still undergoing maintenance. It will take a little while for the ships to get up to full speed.
STH_naval_museum.5004.name: [This.GetName] Now Active
STH_naval_museum.5010.desc:
A mothballed fleet can be converted into a museum fleet and dispatched into the orbit of one of our colonies. A museum fleet can provide the colony with a big boost in popularity, as history fans flock in to view a piece of Starfleet history. 

Once the fleet is converted into a museum it can no longer serve as an active part of fleet operations. n
Dev Note: Make sure you rename the fleet you plan to reactive to help identify it from the list.

STH_naval_museum.5011.desc: Now that a fleet has been selected to be converted into a museum fleet, we must decide which of our colonies should accept this honour.

STH_naval_museum.5012.desc: The Fleet museum above [This.GetName] is now open to all who wish to come and experience some of Starfleet's finest vessels preserved for all to visit and marvel at.

STH_nemesis.1.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], after years of sulking in their dark pits on that pitiful rock of a planet Remus, we have been approached by a group of Remans represented by an individual who only refers to himself as the 'Viceroy'. They are requesting equal rights within the [Root.GetName] and the same status as the ordinary Romulan citizen. Granting them these rights would appease the Reman population, but would cause uproar across the Romulan Empire and massive discontent within our Romulan population, who would never approve of being considered equal to these Reman veruul! 

Our military leaders have also reminded us that this would also hit our Dilithium production and rid us of valuable foot soldiers.
STH_nemesis.1.name: Reman Discontent
STH_nemesis.10.desc: The Romulan military was far too powerful for the small band of attack ships that the Remans were able to produce and they were quickly overwhelmed and destroyed. With the destruction of their small rebellion the Reman's returned to the shadows and dark tunnels within the near endless mines on Remus, defeated but unrepentant in their quest to emerge from under the wings of the Romulan raptor.
STH_nemesis.10.name: Reman forces destroyed
STH_nemesis.100.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] we have concerning news, those foul beasts from Remus have turned their backs on us and have dared to declare war against us in a bid to gain their independence. We have mobilized our fleets and will crush these foul beasts and return them to that black rock from which they came.
STH_nemesis.100.name: Reman's battle for indepance
STH_nemesis.101.desc: The Reman's have declared war on their former masters the Romulans in a quest for freedom. The Galaxy will soon see who is the stronger side.
STH_nemesis.101.name: Remans declare war!
STH_nemesis.11.desc: It seems a small rebellion that started on the planet Remus and spread to the skies above Romulus was crushed by the Romulan military. It is unclear what provoked the small band of Reman soldiers to attack the superior Romulan forces, but whilst their bravery was not in question they stood little chance against the might of the Romulan Navy.
STH_nemesis.11.name: Reman forces destroyed
STH_nemesis.2.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], news is escaping the Romulan Star Empire, it appears the long oppressed Reman people made a bold move to speak out against their living conditions and requested more freedom from their Romulan overlords. 

However as expected these freedoms were quickly rejected. The Romulan people rarely afford equality on those they consider beneath them.
STH_nemesis.2.name: Reman equal status rejected
STH_nemesis.20.desc:
My [Root.GetRulerTitle], please let me introduce yourself, I am Senator Tal'Aura and I approach you now to ask for an audience to finally put the question on the Reman situation to an end once and for all. The discontent amongst the Reman population on Remus continues to grow whilst the output from the Dilithium mines continues to shrink. I have the backing of a number of high ranking Senators who now wish for this concern to be removed for good. 

We await your presence on the homeworld to conclude this discussion.
STH_nemesis.20.name: The Reman Question
STH_nemesis.21.desc: With the decision to overrule and disregard the request from Senator Tal'Aura and the high ranking officials to discuss the plight of the Reman's in the Romulan senate, all that remains is to dispatch a fleet of the Empire's most powerful warbirds to put the Reman's back in their place once and for all.
STH_nemesis.21.name: Time to end the Reman threat
STH_nemesis.23.desc: You may not know or recognize me Romulan, I am Shinzon of Remus, a discarded plot that found a home amongst the discarded and abandoned deep within the Dilithium mines of Remus. For too long have my brethren and I suffered at the cruel whip of our Romulan masters... but no longer. We are desperate and desperation brings courage. Prepare to meet the Scimitar as we turn it's mighty weapons on the jewel that is Romulus.
STH_nemesis.23.name: Message from Shinzon of Remus
STH_nemesis.24.desc:
With a mighty explosion the mighty Reman Warbird Scimitar is destroyed taking with it the last hope the Reman's have, along with their leadership and beloved Shinzon. 

The last outstanding questions is what should become of the remaining Reman population on the planet's surface. Purging them from the surface will serve as a stark reminder to all subjects of the empire that rebellions will not be tolerated, as well as a better understanding of how to build a replacement for the Scimitar - however it is unlikely the galactic community will take kindly to this action. 

Sparing them will boost our Dilithium output and demonstrate we are not nothing like the mindless Klingon's who would surely not hesitate to wipe out their foes.
STH_nemesis.24.name: Shinzon defeated
STH_nemesis.25.desc: Our tactical reports indicate that their has been a final showdown between the Romulan and Reman people. An uprising by an individual that our intelligence services can only identify as a Reman named Shinzon was put down by the Romulan fleet. What followed appears to have been a massacre, with Romulan forces wiping out the remaining Reman's dwelling on their homeworld.
STH_nemesis.25.name: Reman population slaughtered
STH_nemesis.26.desc: Our tactical reports indicate that their has been a final showdown between the Romulan and Reman people. An uprising by an individual that our intelligence services can only identify as a Reman named Shinzon was put down by the Romulan fleet. In an unexpected measure of mercy it appears the remaining Reman lives were spared any further punishment. Although many commentators suspect working conditions within the mines will become a lot less pleasant, if that is even possible!
STH_nemesis.26.name: Reman population slaughtered
STH_nemesis.3.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], in surprising news it appears the long oppressed Reman people made a bold move to speak out against their living conditions and requested more freedom from their Romulan overlords. 

In a shock move it appears the Romulan senate granted the Reman's this request and have made them equal within the Star Empire.
STH_nemesis.3.name: Reman equal status granted
STH_nemesis.30.desc: As organised by Senator Tal'Aura and a number of high ranking military and political figures, the case for further integration of the Reman population into the Romulan empire was put forward. With assistance from the Reman forces the group believe the Star Empire could be in a position to challenge any empire in the Alpha or beta quadrant within the next few months, but only if a full alliance was struck with the Reman's and granting their representative, a mysterious figure only referred to as Shinzon, a high ranking position in the Senate.
STH_nemesis.30.name: The Reman Problem
STH_nemesis.31.desc:
Before any further discussion or argument could take place, a number of Senators and military leaders stand and make their way from the Romulan Senate room, clearly believing that the discussion was indeed over. Further indication that the Reman's were inferior and without the wit or wisdom to last within the complex and cut throat world of Romulan politics. 

Just as [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was about to move onto to discuss a proposal from the delegation from Celus III, a small device left behind by one of the departed opens, sending a cascade of greenish energy particles over the room.
STH_nemesis.31.name: The Reman Problem
STH_nemesis.32.desc: Confused, the Praetor calls for security to bring the group back to the Senate room, but it is too late, the entire Senate begin to decay from inside, and the Praetor himself topples to the ground and crumbles into dust.
STH_nemesis.32.name: The Reman's Revenge
STH_nemesis.35.desc: We have been approached by our contacts within the Romulan Star Empire. It appears there has been a Coup d'état within the Star Empire beginning with the elimination of the previous Praetor and most of former senate. The new government appears to be closely linked to the Reman's, an elusive caste within the Romulan empire. The spokesperson for the new regime, a high ranking Senator named Tal'Aura has specifically requested we send a delegation to meet with the new leadership, a Romulan named Shinzon, and he has asked that we send [nemesis_leader.GetName] in exchange the Romulans promise a lucrative future.
STH_nemesis.35.name: Urgent Message from Romulus
STH_nemesis.36.desc: On reaching the designated coordinates [nemesis_leader.GetName] and their crew have received no communications from Praetor Shinzon or from the Romulan government. The senior officers look out across the empty void, nervously awaiting a message from their hosts, keenly aware they are a long way from the protection of [Root.GetName].
STH_nemesis.36.name: Waiting in the Raptors Nest
STH_nemesis.37.desc:
Just as the crew were about to abandon the wait and return to [Root.capital_scope.GetName] a massive vessel decloaked in front of [nemesis_fleet.GetName]. The massive ship could only be described as a predator, armed to the teeth and built with a single purpose and protected by the most perfect cloak that [nemesis_leader.GetName] had ever seen. 

The beep beep of the incoming hail rang out in sharp contrast to the overwhelming silence that was on the bridge.
STH_nemesis.37.name: Out of the Shadows
STH_nemesis.38.desc: Greetings [nemesis_leader.GetName], I hope you'll forgive the darkness. ...We're not comfortable in the light, please let me introduce myself ... I am Shinzon of Remus, proud leader of the Reman people. You may ask what we seek & I say unity, Captain! ...Tearing down the walls between us to recognise that we are one. ...I'm talking of the thing that makes us the same. ...Peace. We want peace. ...Right now, you're thinking this all sounds too good to be true? But you're also thinking that the chance of peace is too promising to ignore. ...Am I right?
STH_nemesis.38.name: Nemesis
STH_nemesis.39.name: Nemesis
STH_nemesis.4.desc:
In the early hours of the morning a small branch of the Romulan military, potentially supported by the Tal Shiar and an organised civilian group destroyed a Reman habitat on Remus in protest against the decision to grant the Reman's equal rights within the Empire. The group calling themselves 'The true Romulan way' have demanded that the Remans are once again forced into slavery and any notion of granting them freedom is removed. 

Our loyal military commanders believe they have enough evidence to destroy this faction or we can bow to their demands.
STH_nemesis.4.name: Reman population attacked
STH_nemesis.40.desc: The First Officer knew that [nemesis_leader.GetName] would not want to put their crew at risk to save their life, but also that they would lay down their life for any member of their crew. The chief of security presents an ambitious plan to rescue the [nemesis_leader.GetName], but it would be risky and risk their chances of a surprise escape. Alternatively making a surprise bid for freedom and heading towards the nearest system free from the communications blackout set up by the Scimitar would greatly increase the chances of escaping the clutches of Shinzon and his ship.
STH_nemesis.40.name: Nemesis
STH_nemesis.41.desc: In a daring rescue the crew of [nemesis_ship.GetName] were able to trace the transporter signal and locate and rescue [nemesis_leader.GetName] from the clutches of Shinzon and the Reman guards holding them captive. The extraction team were able to cause a small amount of damage to the Scimitar before escaping via a number of light attack ships. With [nemesis_leader.GetName] safely back onboard the [nemesis_ship.GetName] is free to rendezvous with the fleet at [nemesis_battle.GetName].
STH_nemesis.41.name: Nemesis - Leader rescued!
STH_nemesis.42.desc: Unfortunately for the the crew of [nemesis_ship.GetName] the rescue of [nemesis_leader.GetName] was a failure and the Remans were able to fend off the attempt killing [nemesis_leader.GetName] in the process. With their leader dead First Officer [nemesis_leader_1.GetName] is forced to step into the command chair and attempt to escape to rendezvous with the fleet at [nemesis_battle.GetName].
STH_nemesis.42.name: Nemesis - Rescue Failed
STH_nemesis.45.desc: Failing to reach the rendezvous point in time to mount a significant defense from the Scimitar left [nemesis_ship.GetName] vulnerable to the powerful Thalaron weapons harboured onboard Shinzon's vessel. With the ship destroyed Shinzon and his Reman forces are free attack the surrounding systems and create havoc.
STH_nemesis.45.name: Ship Fails to escape
STH_nemesis.46.name: Reman Scimitar Victorious
STH_nemesis.47.desc: As [nemesis_ship.GetName] approaches the coordinates at [nemesis_battle.GetName] the astrometrical display flickers ominously, seeking clarity on the situation the communications officer explains that they are approaching a naturally occuring sensor blind spot and that should clear shortly. Spotting the danger quickly [nemesis_leader.GetName] calls out for Red Alert, shortly before torpedoes hammer into the ships hull. The Scimitar has tracked them and having had the chance to call for backup whilst the CO was rescued bears down on the [Root.GetName] vessels weapons raised and ready to destroy all that stand in its way.
STH_nemesis.47.name: Nemesis - Battle at [nemesis_battle.GetName]
STH_nemesis.48.desc: As [nemesis_ship.GetName] approaches the coordinates at [nemesis_battle.GetName] the astrometrical display flickers ominously, seeking clarity on the situation the communications officer explains that they are approaching a naturally occuring sensor blind spot and that should clear shortly. Spotting the danger quickly [nemesis_leader.GetName] calls out for Red Alert, shortly before torpedoes hammer into the ships hull. The fast escape means that the Scimitar was unable to call for any further Reman backup, but even on its own the deadly Reman Warbird poses a deadly adversary.
STH_nemesis.48.name: Nemesis - Battle at [nemesis_battle.GetName]
STH_nemesis.49.desc:
As the battle was beginning to intensify, a new fleet decloaked ready to join the battle. A young romulan Subcommander named Donatra hailed the [Root.GetName] fleet. 

It seems the Romulan's see this as an internal matter and Donatra and her fleet have been sent to see that the matter remains discreet.
STH_nemesis.49.name: Romulan Backup arrives
STH_nemesis.5.desc:
It appears all is not well within the Romulan Empire since the decision to grant the Reman people equal status within the Empire. One of our covert operations teams provided us with evidence that the Romulan military had to put down a small uprising against the Reman people. 

It looks like the Romulan government are now back in control of the situation, but this is clearly a situation they would prefer to have avoided.
STH_nemesis.5.name: Dissatisfaction amongst the population of Romulus
STH_nemesis.50.desc: The battle was fierce and many lives were lost as the fleets clashed, but finally the Scimitar lay defeated and with its Thalaron core going critical exploded into countless pieces of debris bringing an end to the rebellion and the threat that Shinzon posed to the galaxy.
STH_nemesis.50.name: Shinzon defeated
STH_nemesis.51.name: Shinzon defeated
STH_nemesis.52.desc: Hello [Root.GetRulerTitle] let me get straight to the point, we Reman's are a proud people and it is hard for us to approach you with this request. We have fought and died to obtain our freedom and the right to live our lives free from the Romulan whip and the darkness that is Remus. All we ask is for what you take for granted, the opportunity to rule ourselves. Please add your voice to ours and maybe Romulus will finally listen.
STH_nemesis.52.name: Incoming hail from Remus
STH_nemesis.53.desc: After years of struggle against the Romulans, the people of Remus can finally call themselves free, having won their independence from the Star Empire. They were granted the planet [reman_new_world.GetName] as part of a historic treaty with the Romulan [romulan_star_empire.GetRulerTitle] [romulan_star_empire.GetRulerName]. Time will now see how the Reman's fare in the future.
STH_nemesis.53.name: The Reman Free State
STH_nemesis.54.desc: Despite international pressure from multiple states the Romulan Empire has rejected the proposals to set the Reman's on Remus free. With all their options now exhausted the Remans must now resign themselves to remain second class citizens within the Empire.
STH_nemesis.54.name: Reman freedom rejected
STH_nemesis.55.desc: After many years of struggle the Reman's have forced their freedom from their Romulan oppressors and have been granted a small world of their own with the freedom to choose their own destiny.
STH_nemesis.55.name: Reman freedom granted
STH_nemesis.56.desc:
Terrible news! Despite putting up a valiant fight against Shinzon [nemesis_leader.GetName] and their ship were defeated in battle. 

Shinzon is now free to continue his reign of terror.
STH_nemesis.56.name: [nemesis_leader.GetName] killed in action
STH_nemesis.6.desc: It looks like the decision to grant the Reman's equal rights within the Romulan Star Empire was short lived according to our spy network. Following a brief uprising against the Remans on the planet Romulus the Praetor has once again rescinded the Reman's liberty.
STH_nemesis.6.name: Reman returned to slavery
STH_nemesis.7.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] 

I am Viceroy [reman_rebel_leader.GetName] representing the Reman's of Remus, for too long we have been condemned to the dark and forced to dig the Dilithium that powers the empire, whilst we are treated little better than the machines that toil those deep mines. No longer will we be subject to your oppression, we demand the same rights as any Romulan or you will know our fury.
STH_nemesis.7.name: A demand from the Reman Free State
STH_nemesis.8.name: Reman's back down
STH_nemesis.9.desc: The audacity of those Reman traitors knows no bounds, it appears they have managed to secure a number of attack ships from various sources and have launched an attack on our capital system. Whilst it appears only a very small section of the Reman population has dared to join in on this attack, we must not let this threat to our authority go unpunished.
STH_nemesis.9.name: Under attack from Reman Forces
