STH_notifications.100.desc:
Un número de científicos a través de la [Root.GetName] creen que han detectado signos de un cambio en la línea de tiempo, después de una ola de radiación cronitón que se detecta barrido a través del cuadrante a velocidades superluminal. 

Ahora nadie ha podido identificar los supuestos cambios.
STH_notifications.100.name: Anomalía Temporal
STH_notifications.101.desc:
Un número de científicos a través de la [Root.GetName] creen que han detectado signos de un cambio en la línea de tiempo, después de una ola de radiación cronitón que se detecta barrido a través del cuadrante a velocidades superluminal. 

Aun así, nadie ha sido capaz de identificar los supuestos cambios, aunque dada la amplitud de la onda de radiación cronitónica, se espera que los cambios sean sustanciales.
STH_notifications.101.name: Anomalía Temporal
STH_observation.100.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], los esfuerzos diplomáticos de [Root.GetName] han logrado convencer a mi gente de participar más plenamente en los asuntos galácticos. 

Aunque habíamos renunciado a la explotación de la tecnología warp para enfocar nuestras energías hacia los asuntos en [FromFrom.GetName], las tecnologías subyacentes nos son conocidas desde hace algún tiempo. Creo firmemente que nuestros pueblos pueden prosperar juntos, en paz.
STH_observation.100.name: Éxito diplomático en [FromFrom.GetName]
STH_observation.150.name: Arte del trato
STH_observation.152.name: Tratos ocultos
STH_observation.153.name: Impacto de ofertas ocultas
STH_observation.154.name: Impacto de ofertas ocultas
STH_observation.200.desc:
Después de infiltrarse en todas las facetas del cuerpo gobernante en [From.GetName], los operativos de Tal Shiar han logrado convencer al gobierno provisional de [primitive_civ.GetName] de que unirse al Imperio Romulan Star es lo mejor para un lugar seguro y estable futuro. 

 Como sujetos de [Root.GetName], se convertirán en ciudadanos de segunda clase y estarán sujetos a la regla [Root.GetSpeciesName]. La disidencia no es una opción.
STH_observation.200.name: Infiltración Tal Shiar
STH_observation.300.desc:
La Autoridad de Comercio Ferengi ha estado apuntando selectivamente a los mercados económicos en [From.GetName] durante muchos meses, y finalmente ha ganado el control sobre muchos de los principales oficios e industrias del planeta. 

 Aprovechando los mercados de [primitive_civ. GetName], los Liquidadores ahora tienen la propiedad de gran parte del organismo rector y de los mercados mundiales, que en su sabiduría infinita han decidido que unirse a [Root.GetName] es preferible a la ruina económica. Los operadores están acudiendo en masa a [From.GetName] para aprovechar las nuevas oportunidades.
STH_observation.300.name: Civilización monopolizadora
STH_observation.400.desc:
Después de infiltrarse en todas las facetas del cuerpo gobernante en [FromFromFrom.GetName] y destruir cierta infraestructura selectiva, los operativos de la Orden de Obsidiana han convencido con éxito al gobierno provisional de [primitive_civ.GetName] que permite que nuestras tropas desembarquen para restablecer el orden y someterse a [Root.GetName] es lo mejor para un futuro seguro y estable. 

Con nuestras tropas en posición en cada momento clave, ahora estarán sujetas a nuestra regla.
STH_observation.400.name: Ocupación completa
STH_observation.600.desc:
Nuestros diplomáticos en [From.GetName] han pasado años ensalzando las virtudes de la Federación y preparando a las personas insulares [primitive_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] para la Membresía de la Federación, y hoy es el día de la ceremonia de firma. Después de la ceremonia, se convertirán en un miembro de pleno derecho de [Root.GetName], una ocasión trascendental. 

Mientras sean miembros de pleno derecho de [Root.GetName], manejarán sus propios asuntos mundanos.
STH_observation.600.name: Membresía de la Federación
STH_observation.700.desc: Our Generals confirm that the planet [From.GetName] is now under our control, their primitive armies stood no chance against the forces of [Root.GetName]. The primitive [From.Owner.GetName] is no more!
STH_observation.700.name: Planet now under our control
STH_observation.701.desc: Our attempts to integrate this world into our Empire has failed, and we must now wait until we can re-attempt the process.
STH_observation.701.name: Integration Ended
STH_occupation_situation.1.desc:
Years of neglect and over taxation of the skant resources of Cardassia Prime have finally caught up with the people of the Cardassian Union and now a period of harsh stellar activity from the Cardassian sun has ruined the crop growth for this season and put a strain on the already over worked food replication power grids. 

Environmentalists have been warning about this day from behind the scenes for many years, but have been ignored by those in power. 

Experts are predicting unless more drastic action is taken Cardassia Prime will struggle for a number of years.
STH_occupation_situation.1.name: Starvation strikes Cardassia Prime
STH_occupation_situation.10.desc: The Cardassian Union has made its intentions clear, they convert the resources from the planet Bajor and they are prepared to take them by force.
STH_occupation_situation.10.name: Cardassia wishes to annex Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.101.desc: ¡Alabado sea los profetas! Después de declarar la guerra, muchos sintieron que el poder de Cardassia sería demasiado para que nuestras escasas fuerzas se defendieran, pero el espíritu del pueblo bajorano no será derrotado y nuestra prolongada opresión finalmente ha terminado. Las fuerzas cardassianas en retirada implementaron una política de tierra arrasada y llevará algunos años recuperarse, pero nuestro futuro está de vuelta en nuestras propias manos.
STH_occupation_situation.101.name: Se acabó la ocupación de Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.102.desc: La gente del planeta Bajor ha estado oprimida durante mucho tiempo bajo una brutal ocupación de su mundo natal, parece que ya no desean vivir en estas condiciones y una serie de células de resistencia han comenzado a levantarse contra sus señores supremos. Nuestros informes de inteligencia indicaron que ha habido una ola de bombardeos y ataques contra objetivos extranjeros en el planeta. \ n \ nLa resistencia bajorana ha exigido formalmente la retirada de todas las fuerzas extranjeras del planeta en un plazo de 48 horas.
STH_occupation_situation.102.name: La ocupación bajorana
STH_occupation_situation.103.desc: La Guerra entre Bajor y Cardassia ha terminado y, a pesar de su potencia de fuego superior, la Unión Cardassiana ha declarado formalmente su retirada de Bajor. Las tácticas de guerrilla desplegadas por la resistencia parecen haber derribado a las fuerzas cardassianas y parece que el Comando Central ya no considera que el planeta valga la pena el esfuerzo de mantenerlo. \ n \ nLa gente de Bajor puede regocijarse hoy, pero parece que hay mucho trabajo por hacer para que el planeta se recupere.
STH_occupation_situation.103.name: Se acabó la ocupación de Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.105.desc: Ha llegado el momento de librar a nuestro hogar de los [bajoran_overlords.GetName], las células de la resistencia han logrado avances significativos en sus defensas y hemos asegurado un número adicional de pequeñas naves para complementar a nuestros asaltantes. Los Profetas nos guían por este camino y el camino hacia un Bajor libre. Nuestro hogar volverá a ser nuestro.
STH_occupation_situation.105.name: La ocupación debe terminar
STH_occupation_situation.106.desc: Cardassians, this is your final chance to withdraw your forces from Bajor, your illegal occupation and plunder of our world ends here and now.
STH_occupation_situation.106.name: Bajoran Freedom
STH_occupation_situation.107.desc: Los cardassianos han rechazado nuestra demanda de que se vayan, esto nos deja sin otra opción. Si queremos ser libres, entonces debe ser la guerra.
STH_occupation_situation.107.name: Guerra declarada
STH_occupation_situation.108.desc: En una decisión impactante, el gobierno civil cardassiano nos ha notificado que su "ayuda" y "amistad" ya no se ofrecerá al pueblo bajorano. Sus fuerzas han comenzado a evacuar, destruyendo todos y cada uno de los equipos que pueden tener en sus manos, incluidos los vastos campos de la provincia de Dahkur y la matanza de Gallitep. La antigua estación de procesamiento de minerales Terok Nor ahora nos pertenece a pesar del daño masivo que le hicieron cuando los cardassianos se fueron.
STH_occupation_situation.108.name: Cardassia se retira de Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.109.desc: Después de años de ocupación, los cardassianos se han retirado de Bajor. La causa exacta del retiro es en gran parte una cuestión de opinión; mientras que los bajoranos lo atribuyeron a los esfuerzos de la resistencia bajorana, los cardassianos lo consideraron como una decisión enteramente política. En los días previos a la retirada, los cardassianos desviaron los buques de guerra de Bajor en un intento de apuntalar sus territorios fronterizos.
STH_occupation_situation.109.name: Cardassia se retira de Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.11.desc:
The people of Bajor are in dire need of the firm supportive hands that we can offer and their backwater beliefs and outlook cries out for the appointment of a Prefect. 

A number of standout candidates have put themselves forward for the role, which we may now appoint to secure our interests on Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.11.name: A Prefect for Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.110.desc: El último de nuestros transportes ha regresado al espacio cardassiano tras nuestra decisión de abandonar a los campesinos bajoranos en su planeta atrasado. Pronto aprenderán el significado de cruzar al pueblo cardassiano y sin duda volverán arrastrándose hacia nosotros pidiendo nuestra ayuda.
STH_occupation_situation.110.name: Cardassia se retira de Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.112.desc: Hoy es un día humillante para ser cardassiano, el gobierno civil ha firmado el acuerdo de retirada que nos obliga a dejar atrás el planeta y sus preciados recursos. Se trata de un golpe humillante para la Unión y que debemos ver vengado. Los bajoranos no nos han visto por última vez.
STH_occupation_situation.112.name: Fuerzas cardassianas derrotadas
STH_occupation_situation.113.desc: After years of living under the rule of the Cardassian Union, it appears the Bajoran people have had enough and led by their resistance movement have declared war on Cardassia in a bid to create a free Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.113.name: Bajor Breaks from Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.115.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] esos traicioneros tontos bajoranos han traicionado la generosa oferta de paz y reconciliación que les hemos ofrecido. \ n \ nUn explosivo colocado en la [nave_asesinada.GetName] destruyó la nave y nuestro delegado [assassinated_cardassian.GetName]. Hay fuertes reclamos de Cardassia de que hemos sido demasiado indulgentes y debemos reaccionar con venganza cardassiana.
STH_occupation_situation.115.name: Conferencia de paz saboteada
STH_occupation_situation.116.desc: Las conversaciones de paz con los líderes bajoranos han tenido éxito y, a cambio de una mayor posición dentro de nuestra gran Unión, los ministros bajoranos y los vedeks han acordado ceder la ubicación de las diversas células de resistencia ubicadas en todo el planeta. \ n \ nObtener la lealtad del liderazgo bajorano es verdaderamente un triunfo del poder cardassiano. \ n \ nAhora podemos mantener nuestra palabra y permitir que Bajor se convierta en un verdadero súbdito de Cardassia o seguir el consejo de muchos de nuestros Legados mayores y traicionar a los bajoranos y convertirlos en esclavos.
STH_occupation_situation.116.name: Paz alcanzada en Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.117.desc: Después de años de ocupación, los cardassianos y bajoranos han llegado a un entendimiento y Bajor se ha sometido formalmente al gobierno cardassiano. La ocupación ha terminado y la resistencia ha sido derrotada.
STH_occupation_situation.117.name: Bajor y Cardassia se unen
STH_occupation_situation.118.desc: A pesar de años de resistencia, el movimiento de libertad bajorano ha terminado en un acto de traición del ejército cardassiano que ha dejado a los bajoranos como poco más que esclavos a la voluntad de la máquina cardassiana.
STH_occupation_situation.118.name: Los cardassianos esclavizan a los bajoranos
STH_occupation_situation.12.desc:
Our acquisition of the Bajoran world has opened up new possibilities and new opportunities for us, but I put it to you that we cannot achieve these goals unless we fully occupy the planet with a fully armed military presence. 

This occupation will help ensure that the Bajorans continue to serve the needs of our people, and of course our troops will play their part in aiding our Bajoran friends.
STH_occupation_situation.12.name: The Occupation
STH_occupation_situation.121.desc: Uno de nuestros barcos ha sufrido un mal funcionamiento inesperado que resultó en una rotura del reactor que destruyó el barco. Si bien no tenemos pruebas que lo demuestren, los miembros de alto rango de la Orden de Obsidiana creen que no fue una coincidencia que el barco hubiera recibido recientemente un cargamento que se originó en Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.121.name: Barco saboteado
STH_occupation_situation.122.desc: Uno de nuestros líderes [kill_leader.GetName] ha sido encontrado muerto mientras estaba en tierra, parece que fueron asesinados por el grupo terrorista que se hace llamar la Resistencia Bajorana. No son más que criminales y pagarán por sus acciones.
STH_occupation_situation.122.name: Ciudadanos cardassianos asesinados
STH_occupation_situation.123.desc: Un miembro de alto rango del consejo civil ha desaparecido mientras viajaba de regreso del sistema bajorano, fue inspeccionada en las instalaciones de procesamiento de minerales en la estación Nor-Class que orbita Bajor y no ha informado a su oficial superior.
STH_occupation_situation.123.name: Barco saboteado
STH_occupation_situation.124.desc: Uno de nuestros transportes que transportaba carga valiosa ha desaparecido mientras viajábamos por las tierras baldías, ahora hemos perdido el transporte y la carga crucial que se transportaba a Cardassia desde Bajor. Sospechamos que esto es obra de la Resistencia Bajorana.
STH_occupation_situation.124.name: El transporte desaparece
STH_occupation_situation.13.desc:
Greetings citizens of Bajor, my name is [bajoran_occupation_prefect.GetName] and I will be your new Prefect and we want to welcome in a new era of peace and prosperity between our two worlds. 

Do not be afraid of the troops landing across the planet, they are here to help rebuild Bajor and ensure our interests are met. 

May this be the start of a long and prosperous future for our worlds.
STH_occupation_situation.13.name: Cardassian Occupation Begins
STH_occupation_situation.130.desc: Después de meses de trabajo de negociadores cardassianos, diplomáticos e intervenciones selectas de la Orden de Obsidiana, el pueblo bajorano ha sido pacificado y su liderazgo ha sido persuadido de seguir el gobierno cardassiano. Ahora podemos considerar verdaderamente a Bajor como un sirviente leal de [Root.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.130.name: Población bajorana pacificada
STH_occupation_situation.14.desc:
The time has come to assign a new Prefect to oversee the Bajoran Occupation. 

A list of candidates has been put forward and one mus be selected to continue our interests on Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.14.name: A New Bajoran Prefect
STH_occupation_situation.15.name: Report from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.16.desc: A list of replacement candidates for the role of the Bajoran Prefect has been made available to Central Command for their approval.
STH_occupation_situation.16.name: A New Bajoran Prefect
STH_occupation_situation.17.desc: Our mines and labour camps are now ready to turn over the resources that we have collected from Bajor, we shall approach the Bajoran government to arrange for the transportation of these resources to our orbital facilities.
STH_occupation_situation.17.name: Harvest Resources
STH_occupation_situation.18.desc:
Attention Bajoran Workers! It is once again time to lay down your tools and allow your Cardassian overseers the chance to collect the efforts of your labours. 

Any attempt to prevent us from completing this activity will be met with severe force and punishment for you and your families.
STH_occupation_situation.18.name: Resource Collection
STH_occupation_situation.19.name: Resource Collection
STH_occupation_situation.2.desc:
Through careful management of the remaining resources and the hard work by planetary environmentalists and leading agricultural experts we have made a significant dent in the impact in the global starvation that has been plaguing Cardassia Prime.

The government has officially declared the crisis on the homeworld as over.
STH_occupation_situation.2.name: Cardassia Starvation Over
STH_occupation_situation.22.desc: The first wave of Cardassian Troops have landed on our soil bringing with them their weapons and prowess. A sense of fear and concern washes over our population centres, but our Cardassian contacts continue to assure us that these forces are here to protect us and help build our infrastructure. For now we must trust this is true, but there is little we could do either way.
STH_occupation_situation.22.name: Foreign Troops on our soil
STH_occupation_situation.24.desc:
As we continue to progress our plans for Bajor, our military and expansion advisors recommend installing a new more agreeable regime that is more supportive of our goals for the planet. 

The 'Bajoran Occupational Government' will continue to serve the interests of all parties and legitimise our occupation of the planet in the eyes of our galactic neighbours.
STH_occupation_situation.24.name: A puppet state
STH_occupation_situation.25.desc:
Greetings Bajorans and greetings from your friends on Cardassia, as part of our continued friendship we have decided that it would be in your best interests if we helped provide you with a new stable government and leadership. 

From this moment onwards the Bajoran Republic will be run by the newly created 'Bajoran Occupational Government' and together we will build a better future for our people.
STH_occupation_situation.25.name: A new Regime
STH_occupation_situation.26.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] I bring you greetings and blessings from your loyal subjects on Bajor, the new governing body is now in place and ready to serve you in all things, just as the Prophets would desire.
STH_occupation_situation.26.name: Greetings from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.27.desc:
Children of the Prophets, I speak for the downtrodden and voiceless, for we are all loved by the Prophets... this partnership with the Cardassians is a shame, we live under occupation as our freedoms are eroded and our way of life is slowly taken from us. 

I urge all of us to stand united and in a single voice ask the Cardassians to leave our world.
STH_occupation_situation.27.name: Religious Leader Speaks Out
STH_occupation_situation.28.desc:
It appears that a notable Bajoran religious leader has started actively speaking out against our presence on Bajor, this would not normally be a cause for concern, but those spiritualistic fools have started listening to these words risking unrest amongst those working the fields and mines. 

We should instruct our planetary forces to act.
STH_occupation_situation.28.name: Bajoran Dissent
STH_occupation_situation.29.desc: Bajorans! Our forces have today arrested [BajoranReligiousLeader.GetName] for causing civic unrest, now is a time for unity among our people and the type of rhetoric being spouted will no longer be tolerated, let this be a lesson to all who wish to cause trouble, it will not be allowed!
STH_occupation_situation.29.name: Vedek Arrested
STH_occupation_situation.3.desc: Citizens from across the Union grow eager for Central Command to put our newest acquisition to good use, the fertile lands and rich mineral deposits of Bajor are ripe for use by the hardworking Cardassian's in need of the bounty.
STH_occupation_situation.3.name: Time to put the Bajoran's to Work
STH_occupation_situation.30.desc:
Bajorans! You will no doubt now be aware that Cardassian forces moved in to arrest and detain Bajoran dissidents causing unrest and sowing ill will between our governments, they mean to harm our special relationship and they will face Cardassian justice. 

Let this be a lesson to anyone who wishes to speak out against us.
STH_occupation_situation.30.name: Population Arrested
STH_occupation_situation.31.desc:
Bajorans! Today Cardassian troops moved in and executed known troublemaker [BajoranReligiousLeader.GetName] for crimes against Cardassia and Bajor. Troublemakers will not be tolerated and it will not stand. 

I hope this is the last I must speak to you on this subject.
STH_occupation_situation.31.name: [BajoranReligiousLeader.GetName] Executed
STH_occupation_situation.32.desc:
Bajoran Citizens we know that there are those amongst you speaking out against our partnership, we offer this as a one-time warning, we will not tolerate this type of behaviour from this point forward religious gatherings will no longer be permitted. 

Consider yourself lucky that we were feeling benevolent.
STH_occupation_situation.32.name: A message from Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.33.desc:
Reports are coming in from the Kendra Province that a group of unarmed protesters were rounded up and arrested by Cardassian troops following a peaceful protest. 

There has been no official word from our Cardassian Prefect on why they were arrested or where the protesters were taken following their arrest.
STH_occupation_situation.33.name: Pacifists Voice their Concern
STH_occupation_situation.34.desc: News coming in from Rakantha Province that there have been explosions at one of the Cardassian Military bases, the Cardassians are claiming that the matter was purely an internal incident and that there was no breach in security, however this has not stopped rumours circulating that a band of Bajoran youths manages to sneak into the base and ignite an ammunitions cache.
STH_occupation_situation.34.name: Explosions Heard
STH_occupation_situation.35.desc: Rumors are circulating that a group of Vedeks were able to successfully convince a local merchant guild to call off a protest against the trade restrictions imposed by Cardassian officials in the Kendra Valley, fearing that the Cardassian Military would intervene the Vedeks were able to persuade the merchants to take their goods and complaints elsewhere.
STH_occupation_situation.35.name: Riots Averted
STH_occupation_situation.4.desc: For too long now our people have looked out across the stars to the blue world of Bajor and the rich resources that in unfairly holds, the recent poor harvests on Cardassia Prime have led to a number of food shortages and discontent amongst the population. Military command believe the solution to our problems can be resolved with the help of the abundances of riches that Bajor holds. Annexing Bajor and bringing them into the Cardassian Union will provide us with the raw materials we need to sustain our way of life and provide the backwater Bajorans with a more evolved means of existence.
STH_occupation_situation.4.name: Resources low on Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.40.desc: Legates and honourable members of Central Command, I bring to you a suggestion on how we can boost our dwindling gains from Bajor, our industrialists propose the construction of a new Nor-Class starbase in Orbit of the planet, with state-of-the-art ore processing facilities. What better way of constructing the station than using the most expendable resources in the system... the Bajorans themselves!
STH_occupation_situation.40.name: Terok Nor
STH_occupation_situation.41.desc: People of Bajor, as of this morning the Cardassian Union has granted permission to construct our newest orbital facility, which we have named 'Terok Nor' We will be rounding up and selecting those we need to help construct the starbase and work within its state of the art ore processing bays to ensure that your world continues to remain useful to the Cardassian Union.
STH_occupation_situation.41.name: Terok Nor
STH_occupation_situation.42.desc: Cardassia has proudly announced the construction of its latest orbital ore processing facility above the annexed world of Bajor, boosting an ability to process resources at an ever-increasing rate and proclaiming the station to be the pinnacle of Cardassian engineering and mastery.
STH_occupation_situation.42.name: Terok Nor
STH_occupation_situation.43.desc:
In horrifying news reports are coming in across Bajor that the Cardassians have opened up several Labor Camps across the planet, pulling in Bajoran's as slaves from local farms and population centres far and wide. 

We are now little more than slaves on our planet forced to work in the most terrible of conditions.
STH_occupation_situation.43.name: Labor Camps Open
STH_occupation_situation.44.desc: Exciting news from Bajor, the 1st of our new labor camps has now opened across the surface of Bajor the output from the planet's enslaved population will be increased as a result.
STH_occupation_situation.44.name: Labor Camps Open
STH_occupation_situation.45.desc: Our latest labor camp, Gallitep is ready to open its doors to a Bajoran workforce for the first time, this marks a new and exciting period in our occupation of Bajor as both a reminder to the natives that we are their better in every way and that there are fates worse than death when it comes to disobeying our commands.
STH_occupation_situation.45.name: Gallitep labor camp
STH_occupation_situation.46.desc: A terrifying new horror has been inflicted upon us by the Cardassians, at Gallitep close to the Dakhur Hills, a new forced labor camp has been opened up. Conditions in the camp are considered to be brutal and hostile and a death sentence to many sent there.
STH_occupation_situation.46.name: Gallitep labor camp
STH_occupation_situation.47.name: News from Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.48.desc: My fellow members of the [resistance_cell.GetName], we cannot stand and allow the atrocities at Gallitep to remain unchallenged, the time has come to make a stand, to fight back against the Cardassians. I propose that we liberate Gallitep and burn the camp to the ground as a symbol that Bajor will no longer be oppressed.
STH_occupation_situation.48.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.49.desc:
Events at Gallitep can be told in many ways, for the Bajorans it was an act of Freedom, for the Cardassians an act of terrorism... But what is known is that a small Resistance Cell was able to infiltrate and tear down one of the most brutal camps on the planet. 

A clear message that the Bajoran people will no longer taking the occupation lying down.
STH_occupation_situation.49.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.5.desc: The audacity of the Bajoran government! They have reject our gracious offer. For their own good we have no choice but to provide our protection we must take what is ours by force.
STH_occupation_situation.5.name: Invitation to join Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.50.desc: Despite the best efforts of the Resistance Cell the camp guards can fend off the attack, with many members of the cell captured or killed in the assault, a new attack will need to be arranged, but it will take some time for Resistance to regain it's strength in this region.
STH_occupation_situation.50.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.51.desc: Reports from Bajor have come in, with the most concerning news, it appears that a rag-tag group of Bajoran extremists have targeted our camp at Gallitep killing hundreds of Cardassians and inflicting countless amounts of damage to our interests.
STH_occupation_situation.51.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.52.desc: Reports from Bajor have come in, with the most concerning news, it appears that a rag-tag group of Bajoran extremists attempted to target our camp at Gallitep however our brave troops were able to repel the attack and inflict considerable damage to the Resistance.
STH_occupation_situation.52.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.6.desc: The audacity of the Bajoran government! They have reject our gracious offer. For their own good we have no choice but to provide our protection we must take what is ours by force.
STH_occupation_situation.6.name: Declare War on the Bajoran Republic
STH_occupation_situation.60.desc: My fellow Bajorans! It is time that we stood up and rid ourselves of the oppressing force that is the Cardassian Union, for too long they have stolen our lands, our culture, and our lives, I say no more! We must resist, for a free Bajor for every Bajoran!
STH_occupation_situation.60.name: The Bajoran Resistance
STH_occupation_situation.61.desc:
The Bajoran peasants and farmers have taken up arms against us and banded together to form an organised Resistance movement! 

These terrorists are now capable of harming our interests on Bajor and inflicting serious harm to our operations there.
STH_occupation_situation.61.name: Bajor Rises Up
STH_occupation_situation.62.desc:
The Bajoran people have taken up arms against the Cardassians in the form of a planetary resistance movement. 

We shall soon see whether they have the strength of will and character to repel their oppressors.
STH_occupation_situation.62.name: Bajor Rises Up
STH_occupation_situation.63.desc:
It appears the Bajorans attempted to form a resistance movement, however it looks like their resolve faltered as they ran scared of the power of Cardassia. 

Any hit of an organised resistance is over.
STH_occupation_situation.63.name: Bajor is ours
STH_occupation_situation.7.desc: The Bajorans never stood a chance against our fleets and we have crushed them, our troops now walk on across their open fields and our generals lay claim to their property. However they have one last untapped resource which we should put to use, their people are excellent workers and will serve our us well in the labor camps and in the new ore processing centre built in orbit. We shall treat them well and they shall be grateful for all the benefits we will provide them.
STH_occupation_situation.7.name: Bajor belongs to us
STH_occupation_situation.70.desc: My fellow Bajorans! It is time that we stood up and rid ourselves of the oppressing force that is the Cardassian Union, for too long they have stolen our lands, our culture, and our lives, I say no more! We must resist, for a free Bajor for every Bajoran!
STH_occupation_situation.70.name: Bajoran Freedom
STH_occupation_situation.71.desc:
[This.GetName] Occupiers, the people of Bajor demand our freedom and the end to your wrongful occupation of our world, you have misunderstood the nature of the Bajoran people if you believe that we will continue to take this imprisonment of our world lying down! 

Free Bajor in the name of the Prophets!
STH_occupation_situation.71.name: Bajoran Freedom
STH_occupation_situation.72.desc: Bajor's bid to ask for its freedom has been granted, only time will tell what this means for the Bajoran people and their occupiers.
STH_occupation_situation.72.name: Bajoran Freedom Granted
STH_occupation_situation.73.desc: Bajor's bid to ask for its freedom has been rejected, only time will tell what this means for the Bajoran people and their occupiers.
STH_occupation_situation.73.name: Bajoran Freedom Rejected
STH_occupation_situation.79.desc: Our resistance team has picked up an additional opportunity, upon reaching the subspace station, the team located an outbound transport to an orbital communications station, with enough explosives to reduce the station to debris the team took the chance to set a trap for the inbound Cardassian team.
STH_occupation_situation.79.name: A further oppertunity
STH_occupation_situation.8.desc: The Cardassian Union have declared war on Bajor, it looks like the barren world seeks to harvest the riches and make them its own.
STH_occupation_situation.8.name: Cardassia claims Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.80.desc:
Se han detectado extrañas lecturas del subespacio en la ciudad capital de nuestra nueva colonia [Root.GetName] recién adquirida. Estas interferencias irregulares bloquean una parte sustancial de nuestros canales de comunicación subespaciales y, por lo tanto, reducen nuestra capacidad de comerciar con el mundo. 

Debemos averiguar dónde están ubicados los dispositivos de interferencia en la superficie para restaurar los canales al comando central en [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.80.name: Interferencias subespaciales
STH_occupation_situation.81.desc:
Después de un mes de investigación de las células de resistencia subterráneas [bajoranSpecies.GetName], finalmente hemos rastreado la base de operaciones de la milicia local en las afueras de la provincia de Rakhanta. 

Para interrogar aún más al líder de la resistencia, nuestro equipo visitante ha adquirido inteligencia que sugiere otra operación de sabotaje dirigida a [Root.Solar_System.Starbase.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.81.name: [bajoranSpecies.GetName] Resistencia
STH_occupation_situation.82.desc:
Al llegar a [Root.Solar_System.Starbase.GetName], el transporte de tropas apenas logra evadir los enormes pilones y los escombros estructurales que flotan alrededor del sol de [Root.GetName]. Brillando intensamente por la explosión masiva, indican la pérdida completa de la estación. 

Después de transmitir las inquietantes noticias al comando central en [Root.Capital.GetName], se envió un barco de construcción para la reconstrucción inmediata de [Root.Solar_System.Starbase.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.82.name: Interferencias subespaciales
STH_occupation_situation.83.desc: The Bajoran people have suffered for too long at the hands of [bajoran_overlords.GetName], they plunder our world, enslave our people forcing them into concentration camps or into mining camps stealing our natural resources and committing genocide in the name of enlightening our people. The resistance movement has gathered enough support an with galactic opinion now swinging against the forced occupation of Bajor, now is our time to strike back and push [bajoran_overlords.GetName] from our home and with the Prophets on our side to guide our way we shall be victorious.
STH_occupation_situation.83.name: The Occupation must end
STH_occupation_situation.84.desc: The explosion could be seen from the majority of population locations across Bajor and sparked quiet celebrations from our downtrodden people, a clear signal of intent, that Bajor is free!
STH_occupation_situation.84.name: Cardassian Forces Destroyed
STH_occupation_situation.85.desc: Our long-range scans have picked up evidence of fighting on the remote world of Bajor, our intelligence reports suggest that the local Bajorans are fighting back against the occupying Cardassian forces that have beset their homeworld for many years.
STH_occupation_situation.85.name: Trouble brewing on Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.86.desc: Our embassy on [prev.capital_scope.GetName] has received an official message of condemnation from [prev.GetName] against our occupation of Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.86.name: Galactic Condemnation
STH_occupation_situation.9.desc: The Cardassian Union has annexed Bajor in an audacious attempt to bolster their own resources. The galactic community has largely condemned the act, but so far no action has been taken by any of the major empires
STH_occupation_situation.9.name: Cardassia annexes Bajor
STH_onaction.1020.desc: Our new vassal [This.GetName] has a long-renowned tradition of space exploration, which has resulted in them collecting and recording star maps from their earliest ventures into space, they are now offering us those maps as a sign of respect.
STH_onaction.1020.name: Ancient Starmap
STH_onaction.7030.desc: Citizens of [Root.GetName] are going to the polls to elect a new [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_onaction.7030.name: Elections Open
STH_onaction.7031.desc: Polls are now closed in [Root.GetName] elections to vote in a new [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_onaction.7031.name: Elections Closed
STH_onaction.900.desc:
La reciente muerte del destacado líder [leaderTarget.GetName] se ha sentido a través de [Root.GetName]. 

 Muchos en la comunidad [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] sienten que los logros de [leaderTarget.GetName] fueron tan buenos que renombrar una nave estelar en la memoria es un signo apropiado de respeto.
STH_onaction.900.name: Muerte de [From.GetName]
STH_onaction.901.desc:
El Capitán [oldLeader.GetName] falleció dejando abierta la cuestión de la capitanía del [USS_Defiant.GetName]. 

Después de muchas luchas internas entre la tripulación de [oldLeader.GetHerHis], el oficial favorito de [oldLeader.GetName], [defiant_leader.GetName] ha tomado el mando.
STH_onaction.901.name: Muerte de [oldLeader.GetName]
STH_operation.1407.name: Operation Report. Begin Operation
STH_operation.1408.desc: Our attempts to sabotage and destroy our target was unsuccessful and the ship continues to function with minimal damage. Our operatives are working to ensure that this cannot be traced back to us.
STH_operation.1408.name: Operation Failure
STH_operation.1409.desc: Our agents have confirmed the destruction of our target, which was destroyed with the loss of all hands. Our enemy is none the wiser that we were responsible for the vessels loss, a fine victory for our espionage agency.
STH_operation.1409.name: Operation Success
STH_operation.1410.desc: Our operatives were unable to identify a suitable target that we could destroy without compromising our own security.
STH_operation.1410.name: Unable to find a target
STH_operation.1411.desc: Our military services have reported the sad loss of the [target_ship.GetName] with the unfortunate loss of all hands. It appears that a major system failure occured and cascaded through the ship, our internal services are investigating but it appears there is very little evidence remaining.
STH_operation.1411.name: Ship Destroyed!
STH_operation.1412.desc: We have received a report from [target_ship.GetName] it appears the ship had a narrow escape, the chief engineer identifed a potential ship threatening issue, that left unchecked could have resulted in the destruction of the ship.
STH_operation.1412.name: Disaster averted
STH_operation.1501.desc: Mighty Founders, our operative within [Target.GetName] has identified a list of targets that we can send in a Founder to replace them with. Should we wish to target higher profile targets we may need to increase our efforts with a change of policy.
STH_operation.1501.name: Dominion Security. Targets Observed
STH_operation.1510.name: Dominion Security - Neutralise Target
STH_operation.1521.name: Dominion Security - Operation Success
STH_operation.1701.desc:
Keeping [Root.Capital.GetName]'s neighbours disunited is a time-tested method of ensuring [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] superiority over local space. 

By leaking falsified diplomatic messages, staging attacks on enemy vessels using disguised assets and other disruptive actions, we are able to sour our target's relations.
STH_operation.1701.name: Operations Surveillance Report
STH_operation.1801.desc: All resources are now in place to begin the operation.
STH_operation.1801.name: Operations. Begin Mission
STH_operation.2014.desc: Our operatives have successfully struck a blow against the ability of [fromfrom.GetName] to detect our cloak operations in [target.solar_system.GetName]. [spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s team has been successful and has done a significant service for our Empire.
STH_operation.2014.name: [fromfrom.GetName] Starbase Cloak Detection Sabotaged
STH_operation.2015.desc: [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.
STH_operation.2015.name: Anti-Cloak Sabotage Aborted
STH_operation.2016.name: Anti-Cloak Equipment Sabotaged at [target.GetName]
STH_operation.2501.desc: Our infiltrator within [Target.GetName] has identified a list of targets that we can replace. The higher profile the target the greater the risk and higher the reward.
STH_operation.2501.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2510.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2521.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2572.desc:
After conducting a thorough sweep of the [Root.GetName] security network, Maestro espía [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having found no evidence of any widespread [from.target.GetAdj] spy network operating within our borders.

With no foreign operations detected, our operative was able to focus on boosting our internal security practices, with several notable improvements being made.
STH_operation.2572.name: Counter-Intelligence
STH_operation.2575.name: [target_country.GetAdj] Operations Disrupted
STH_operation.2576.name: Operations Disrupted
STH_operation.3023.name: Remove Criminal Organsation
STH_operation.3024.name: Branch Office Removed!
STH_operation.3025.desc: Due to the changing situation in the [fromfrom.target.GetName], our agents are unable to complete their objective. Maestro espía [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has shut down our operation, and has reassigned our agents elsewhere.
STH_operation.3025.name: Operation Canceled
STH_operations_fail.100.desc: We have concerning news from our field operatives involved in the mission to replace a hostile leader. We have lost contact with the team and the Founder they were protecting. It is possible that counter-intelligence forces are behind the loss of contact.
STH_operations_fail.100.name: Contact lost with infiltration team
STH_operations_fail.110.desc: Our special forces teams have managed to recover the Founder and our espionage team from underneath the eyes of our enermy forces. Allowing to resume our operations in this sector.
STH_operations_fail.110.name: Contact Reestablished
STH_operations_fail.111.desc: Despite our efforts we have failed to reestablish contact with our teams and should consider them lost.
STH_operations_fail.111.name: Failed to recover our team
STH_operations_fail.112.desc: Our security teams have uncovered a potential changeling infiltration plot against one of our high ranking officials. We were unable to detain the team, but we were able to stop their plot against us.
STH_operations_fail.112.name: Changeling infiltrator uncovered
STH_operations_fail.120.desc: Our Internal Security forces have detected some suspicious activity on one of our planets. Our Maestro espía believes that the [from.target.GetAdj] agents have become aware of our counter-intelligence investigation and are attempting to secure their security network.
STH_operations_fail.120.name: Suspicious Activity Detected
STH_operations_fail.121.desc: Our operatives have discovered a significant security leak during a routine inspection of one of our encrypted networks. Our agents have drawn up plans to close this particular security gap; however, our Maestro espía has also suggested using the leak to draw in unsuspecting foreign agents.
STH_operations_fail.121.name: Security Leak Identified
STH_operations_fail.122.desc:
After conducting a thorough sweep of the [Root.GetName], Maestro espía [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having found no evidence of a widespread [from.target.GetAdj] spy network operating within our borders.

With no foreign operations to thwart, our $role_spymaster$ turned [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHerHis] attention inward, meticulously assessing the state of our internal security. Several suggested improvements have been included in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHerHis] report.
STH_operations_fail.122.name: Internal Security Operations Completed
STH_pirate.2.desc:
We have received an SOS call from [gorn_target_ship.GetName], the last transmission we received was the following. 

We are under attac... from an unidentified shi..p. They did not respond to our hails.. hissing... snarling... please send help immediately.
STH_pirate.2.name: SOS call received
STH_pirate.21.name: Our raiders grow restless
STH_pirate.22.name: Raiders Detected approaching [raiding_target_planet.GetName]
STH_pirate.23.desc:
We have word back from our raiding force, their targets were too scared to face the force of their weapons and waved the white flag in surrender. 

We have taken their resources and wealth... now we celebrate.
STH_pirate.23.name: Raid Target Surrenders
STH_pirate.24.desc: Our raiding party has met a foe that is willing to fight to protect their wealth, our privateers shall now battle and teach them a lesson.
STH_pirate.24.name: Raid Target willing to fight
STH_pirate.25.desc: Our refusal to back down from the threat posed by the raiding party has led to an attack on the planet [raiding_target_planet.GetName]. should the raiding fleet reach the planet they will begin to plunder resources. We must muster a defense and prevent these raiders from taking our resources.
STH_pirate.25.name: System under raiding attack
STH_pirate.28.desc: We were unable to prevent the raiders from pillaging [raiding_target_planet.GetName], the Raiders have made off with a great deal of valuable resources and disappeared into warp, leaving chaos and destruction in their wake.
STH_pirate.28.name: [raiding_target_planet.GetName] Raided!
STH_pirate.29.desc:
Our raiding party has successfully bypassed the would-be defenses standing in their way and returned to us with riches galore! 

It is time for the captains to divide up the rewards and celebrate with their crews.
STH_pirate.29.name: Raid Successful
STH_pirate.3.desc: [gorn_pirate_rescue_leader.GetName] in command of [gorn_pirate_rescue_ship.GetName] have arrived on the scene. The transport ship is adrift with its power levels failing fast, sensors are picking up faint life signs. The attackers are not currently in the vicinity, but all the signs point towards a trap, in order to rescue the survivors we must lower our shields, but this will almost certainly provoke a large attack against the [gorn_pirate_rescue_ship.GetName].
STH_pirate.3.name: Transport under attack
STH_pirate.30.desc:
Our forces have successfully destroyed the Raiders threatening our planet. 

We have managed to retrieve part of the privateer's cargo, which has been taken from another faction. We can return it or keep it for ourselves.
STH_pirate.30.name: Raiding Force Defeated
STH_pirate.31.desc:
Our raiding fleet has been destroyed without achieving their goal of pirating and plundering. 

We shall soon see if our target now turns and seeks revenge on us.
STH_pirate.31.name: Raiding Force Defeated
STH_pirate.4.name: Pirates Attack!
STH_pirate.5.desc: Our failure to come to the aid of the transport has resulted in the pirates destroying the ship with the loss of all hands.
STH_pirate.5.name: Transport Destroyed
STH_pirate.6.name: Pirate raiders defeated in battle
STH_policy.10.name: Galactic Politics
STH_policy.100.desc:
Allows users to select and deselect extra country data logging on and off for game.log. 

This data is stored on your computer in: 
Documents/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/logs/game.log (on Windows). 

It can be analysed by using the Star Trek: New Horizons Wiki page feature STNH Log Analyser. All logs and saves used with STNH Log Analyser are processed there entirely locally in your browser. No data is ever sent to a server. 

A link to the Star Trek: New Horizons Wiki can be found from Contacts in-game. 

The game.log logging logs in-game stats about the various game countries including the player's, the selected map, the game start Q-settings and generates a random game id number for a game.
STH_policy.100.name: Country game stats logging options
STH_policy.110.name: Coalition Realignment
STH_policy.111.name: A Quiet Political Offer
STH_policy.112.desc: [From.GetName] has agreed to abandon their current Coalition and join ours. Their old partners will not soon forgive either of us, but the realignment is complete.
STH_policy.112.name: Coalition Defection Secured
STH_policy.113.desc: [From.GetName] has agreed to abandon their current Coalition and align with us directly. They have entered into an alliance with us, and we can now elevate that relationship into a full Coalition through the normal diplomacy flow when we are ready.
STH_policy.113.name: A New Bloc Begins
STH_policy.114.desc: [From.GetName] refused our offer. They will remain with their current Coalition, and our overture has damaged relations.
STH_policy.114.name: Coalition Approach Rejected
STH_policy.116.name: A Member Is Being Courted
STH_policy.118.desc: [From.GetName] has rejected the overture from [FromFrom.GetName] and will remain within our Coalition. The attempt has failed, at least for now.
STH_policy.118.name: Our Member Remains
STH_policy.119.desc: [From.GetName] has accepted the overture from [FromFrom.GetName] and departed our Coalition. Their departure will leave a political scar across our coalition
STH_policy.119.name: A Coalition Member Defects
STH_policy.20.desc: Conflict creates instability and this ripples across the Quadrant threatening the peace that we have deemed important to our future plans. Our admiralty has prepared a list of ongoing wars in the known galaxy, presenting us with the choice on which to focus the [Root.GetName]'s diplomatic attention upon.
STH_policy.20.name: Condemn a War
STH_policy.21.desc:
Our Intelligence services and Admirals have prepared a dossier covering the [From.GetName] - [FromFrom.GetName] war, with details on the origins, casualties and potential outcomes of the ongoing war. 

Giving us a number of potential options.
STH_policy.21.name: Condemn a War
STH_policy.22.desc: The [From.GetName] has issued a condemnation of our conflict with the [FromFrom.GetName] to the wider galactic community, calling on us to negotiate a peace settlement with the enemy.
STH_policy.22.name: War Condemnation
STH_policy.23.desc: The [From.GetName] has issued a condemnation of the [FromFrom.GetName] and their conflict against us to the wider galactic community, calling for a swift end to the [FromFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] aggression.
STH_policy.23.name: War Support
STH_policy.25.desc:
Our diplomatic service has identified a number of Empires that harbor a negative view of us, one that has deteriorated steadily over the last couple of years. 

The recommendation is to invite them to a conference and attempt to smooth over any ill feeling between our two nations.
STH_policy.25.name: Improve Relations
STH_policy.26.desc: We have received a communique from [Prev.GetName] they wish to invite us to a diplomatic conference in a bid to repair the deteriorating relationship between our two empires.
STH_policy.26.name: Inbound Communications
STH_policy.27.desc: Dear [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we acknowledge that the relationship between our worlds has reached a low point and we welcome this chance to mend this relationship. The planet [poorRelationPlanet.GetName] would make an ideal location to host this conference.
STH_policy.27.name: Improve Relations
STH_policy.28.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we see no need to change the current relationship between our worlds and suggest you focus your attention elsewhere, should you run the risk of further provoking our annoyance.
STH_policy.28.name: Improve Relations
STH_policy.30.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] I am pleased to report that the conference between our world and [poorRelationEvent.GetName] has been a success, with both sides making positive strides towards improving communications and trust. 

Whilst there maybe some ways to go before the relationship can be considered friendly, this is a significant step forward in our relations.
STH_policy.30.name: Update from Conference
STH_policy.31.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] I regret to inform you that the conference between our world and [poorRelationEvent.GetName] has been not been the success we had hoped for. The gulf between our two worlds could not be bridged during the Conference and has potentially widened further.
STH_policy.31.name: Update from Conference
STH_policy.33.desc: Over the years we have managed to create rivalries and whilst we have nothing to fear from these empires our diplomatic services are urging us to put some of this bad blood behind us and look to put an end to these ongoing rivalries.
STH_policy.33.name: Rivals
STH_policy.34.desc: We have been approached by [Prev.GetName] who are looking to call us into a diplomatic conference to discuss our ongoing rivalry in a bid to put aside our past differences and build a better future.
STH_policy.34.name: Incoming Communications
STH_policy.35.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we are willing to accept your offer to meet and discuss our ongoing hostilities, we agree to your location on [poorRivalPlanet.GetName] and will send an envoy to meet with your delegation.
STH_policy.35.name: Diplomatic Response
STH_policy.36.desc:
Attention [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we have heard your plea to meet with us to end our ongoing rivalry. 

Consider your offer refused, we see no need to change the nature of our relationship. 

Be pleased that we do not worsen the relationship.
STH_policy.36.name: Diplomatic Rejection
STH_policy.38.desc: Sirs, we can report back that our diplomatic team has just exited from their meeting with our rivals with positive news, both sides have agreed to put aside past issues and look to forge a better future.
STH_policy.38.name: Diplomatic Conference Concluded
STH_policy.39.desc: Our rivals have stormed away from the conference in fury it appears the conference has not ended well and the relationship has gotten worse!
STH_policy.39.name: Diplomatic Conference Concluded
STH_policy.40.desc: When war spreads out across the Quadrant it threatens every world, the lives of countless, the safety of our allies, and the security of our own borders. Whatever reason most compels us to act we have a chance to use our power and influence to attempt to end an ongoing war.
STH_policy.40.name: Peacekeeping
STH_policy.41.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle], your war is unjust and your continued assaults against the innocent must not continue, we urge you to cease this campaign, should you not take this friendly advice you may find that you are forced to under the firepower of our starships.
STH_policy.41.name: End the War!
STH_policy.42.desc: The ongoing [Root.From.GetName] cannot continue, the cost of the war is too high and spreads out across worlds outside of your own. We have convinced [Root.From.attacker.GetName] to lay down their weapons, we now ask that you put your weapons aside and end this conflict.
STH_policy.42.name: End the War!
STH_policy.43.desc: Unfortunately, [From.Attacker.GetName] has not responded well to our demand to call a ceasefire and the bloodshed is set to continue. We can join the defenders directly, or prepare a separate intervention war of our own.
STH_policy.43.name: No Ceasefire
STH_policy.44.desc:
Despite calls for a ceasefire in the ongoing conflict, it appears that neither side is prepared to stand down and negotiate a ceasefire. 

The War rages on.
STH_policy.44.name: No Ceasefire
STH_policy.45.desc:
Thanks to the timely intervention by an outside party the ongoing [From.GetName] has arrived at a ceasefire, with all parties withdrawing their forces back behind their borders and powering down their weapons. 

Only time will tell how long this will last, but many are calling for the opportunity to give peace a chance.
STH_policy.45.name: Ceasefire Comes into Effect
STH_policy.46.desc: A ceasefire has been called to end the current hostilities between on worlds involved in the [FromFrom.GetName] conflict. All vessels must return to their own territory immediately.
STH_policy.46.name: Ceasefire in place
STH_policy.47.desc: Despite the best efforts of our ambassadors and envoys, they were unable to persuade [From.Defender.GetName] to abandon the war, it is regretable that peace was so close, yet could not be achieved on this occassion.
STH_policy.47.name: War will continue
STH_policy.48.desc:
Following a failed attempt to end the war, the negotiating party has joined the war on the side of the defenders. 

This could prove to turn the war in their favour, only time will tell.
STH_policy.48.name: The War continues
STH_policy.55.desc: We were unable to enter the existing conflict directly on the side of the defenders. A special intervention casus belli has therefore been issued against [From.Attacker.GetName], allowing us to open a separate war if we still wish to defend our allies.
STH_policy.55.name: Direct Intervention Blocked
STH_policy.50.desc:
Our ongoing [playerWar.GetName] continues to cost lives, ships, planets and resources with no end in sight. 

Our diplomats urge us to reach out to our neighbours and request they join us in defeating our enemies.
STH_policy.50.name: War Support
STH_policy.51.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we are willing to accept your offer to meet and discuss our ongoing hostilities, we agree to your location on [poorRivalPlanet.GetName] and will send an envoy to meet with your delegation.
STH_policy.51.name: War Support
STH_policy.52.desc: We regret to inform you that we cannot aid you in your ongoing wars, this is a battle you must win on your own. To drag us into your struggles is to put our own borders at risk, and that is not something we can afford right now.
STH_policy.52.name: War Support Rejected
STH_policy.53.desc: We hear your call for aid and the armies of [Root.GetName] will fly to your aid and together we shall be victorious!
STH_policy.53.name: War Support Accepted
STH_policy.54.desc: It appears our war enemy has decided that they cannot defeat us by themselves and have enlisted the help of [fromfromfrom.GetName] in a bid to defeat our forces.
STH_policy.54.name: New Party joins the war!
STH_policy.60.desc: We should establish a truce with one of our powerful and dangerous neighbours to secure our borders and prevent an attack. By reaching out to their envoys we can ask if they will be open to peace talks.
STH_policy.60.name: Establish a Truce
STH_policy.61.desc: We have been approached by [Prev.GetName] who are looking to call us into a diplomatic peace conference to discuss establishing a truce between our empires and the start of peace between our worlds.
STH_policy.61.name: Establish a Truce
STH_policy.62.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we are here to inform you that the people of [from.GetName] have no interest in your offer of peace and a truce. We would welcome the chance to challenge you in combat should it come to this.
STH_policy.62.name: Truce has been rejected
STH_policy.63.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], we have listened to your offer and are open to further discussions on the topic of a short-term truce. We have opened our borders and will host an envoy at our capital to further discuss this proposal.
STH_policy.63.name: Open to peace talks
STH_policy.64.desc: We have listened to your representatives and we agree that peace is in the best interest of both our worlds at this point in time and we will sign a short-term truce and ensure that no hostilities erupt between our forces whilst this truce is in effect.
STH_policy.64.name: Truce Established
STH_policy.65.desc: We have listened to your representatives and we do not agree that peace is in the best interest of both our worlds at this point in time. This proposal is too restrictive and we are not inclined to offer you assurances that our forces will not defeat you in combat.
STH_policy.65.name: Truce Rejected
STH_policy.66.desc:
The Treaty of Algeron has constrained the Federation's access to cloaking technology for years, but the political settlement forged in the aftermath of Tomed is no longer sacrosanct to everyone within the Council. 

By repealing the treaty restrictions we will lift the ban on Federation cloaking research and formally signal to the Romulan Star Empire that we no longer consider ourselves bound by that portion of the agreement. Such a decision will almost certainly provoke a response from Romulus.
STH_policy.66.name: Repeal the Treaty of Algeron
STH_policy.67.desc:
The United Federation of Planets has formally repealed the cloaking restrictions imposed by the Treaty of Algeron. Starfleet is no longer bound by the settlement that helped preserve the balance along the Neutral Zone, and the Senate is already demanding a firm response to this act of defiance. 

We may answer this insult with fury, hold our hand for the moment while keeping reprisals ready, or settle the matter immediately by force.
STH_policy.67.name: Federation Repeals the Treaty of Algeron
STH_policy.68.desc: Romulus has answered our repeal of the Treaty of Algeron with open fury. The Senate has denounced the Federation's decision, trust between our governments has collapsed, and the Romulan Star Empire is now preparing reprisals under a formal casus belli.
STH_policy.68.name: Romulan Condemnation
STH_policy.69.desc: The Romulan Star Empire has chosen not to respond immediately to our repeal of the Treaty of Algeron. Despite the public silence, our diplomatic corps warns that Romulus has treated this as a grave betrayal and has retained a casus belli against the Federation.
STH_policy.69.name: Romulan Watchfulness
STH_policy.70.desc: The Romulan Star Empire has rejected all restraint following our repeal of the Treaty of Algeron. Their Warbirds are moving to battle stations and the crisis has escalated into open war.
STH_policy.70.name: Romulan Declaration of War
STH_policy.80.desc: Greetings, this is where you can manage the ongoing expeditions and multi-year missions that are currently in progress.
STH_policy.80.name: Expedition Menu
STH_policy.81.desc: Greetings sir, please find a summary of the ongoing activity within our expedition to the Lembatta Cluster, allowing you to add extra ships, remove ships or recall and end the expedition.
STH_policy.81.name: Manage Lembatta Cluster Expedition
STH_policy.90.desc: This taskforce is dedicated to checking for Assimilated Pops Groups within our borders, use this screen to run an ad hoc check across our population.
STH_policy.90.name: Assimilated Pops
STH_prodigy.10.desc:
[prodigy_target_country.GetName] we are the Vau N'Akat Order from the world of Solum, a world that returns to take its vengeance and I am the Diviner... Note that we bring you your destruction at the hands of one of your vessels of peace. 

Prepare for the revenge of the Vau N'Akat.
STH_prodigy.10.name: The Protostar arrives
STH_prodigy.100.desc:
Our monitoring stations have picked up the incoming signal of what can only be a vessel equipped with a Proto-Drive, which in this case can only be the missing USS Protostar. 

A local task force fleet was sent to intercept the ship, but we have lost contact, we should send another fleet to investigate.
STH_prodigy.100.name: Proto-Warp Signal Detected
STH_prodigy.101.desc: On board the Protostar Dal and the ETH frantically attempt to shut down the Proto-drive before the ship reaches its destination, knowing that the ship now carries unwanted intruders, looking to attack [Root.GetName].
STH_prodigy.101.name: Supernova
STH_prodigy.102.name: Supernova
STH_prodigy.103.desc: The Drednok lies crumpled and defeated, overpowered by its attack, allowing Rok-Tahk to reach the computer core's main panel, reaching it they can unlock the mechanism, unfortunately, the Drednok has already been able to prevent the core from being overloaded and destroyed... but at least they can do no further damage.
STH_prodigy.103.name: Drednok Defeated
STH_prodigy.104.desc:
Drednok stands over the still form of Rok-Tahk, the gentle Brikarian no longer moving or able to take any further action to help her friends. 

Drednok moves towards the computer core ready to unleash the Living Construct on the [Root.GetName] Fleet.
STH_prodigy.104.name: Drednok Wins the Battle
STH_prodigy.105.desc: Jankom Pog knows that the Living Construct needs to open communication channels with the other vessels to spread its virus throughout the approaching fleet, if Jankom Pog can disable the Protostar's communication array then the damage could be limited and the number of reinforcements could be reduced significantly.
STH_prodigy.105.name: Supernova
STH_prodigy.106.desc: Jankom Pog clenches his fist in celebration, only an engineer with Jankom Pog's unique skills could have accomplished the task, as the Tellarite looks over the 'disabled' communication relay, the strength of the Vau N'Akat's forces should be depleted as a result.
STH_prodigy.106.name: Jankom Pog to the rescue
STH_prodigy.107.desc: Jankom Pog slams his fist against the comms panel, the signal has already been sent and the message has left the Protostar, despite the Tellarite's efforts Jankom Pog was moments too slow.
STH_prodigy.107.name: Jankom Pog Defeated
STH_prodigy.108.desc: On the Bridge of the USS Protostar Zero hears the thoughts in Dal's head before he vocalizes it, the only way to prevent the Construct Virus from spreading is to destroy the Protostar and everyone onboard. An idea springs into Zero's mind, the Protostar need not be destroyed if Zero can trigger an electromagnetic surge to shut down all of the Protostar's systems in a single event.
STH_prodigy.108.name: Supernova
STH_prodigy.109.desc:
Zero manages to generate a large EMP burst using the local sun's solar flares, as the lights onboard the Protostar go dark, rapidly followed by all the consoles throughout the ship. 

The Protostar is out of the fight, but the Construct Virus can cause no further harm to nearby fleet.
STH_prodigy.109.name: Zero Successful
STH_prodigy.11.desc: As the Vau N'Akat's plans begin to come into effect as they declare war against us, the Construct's virus begins to take effect on a number of our ships, with their systems quickly succumbing and the vessels joining the Vau N'Akat's fleets against us.
STH_prodigy.11.name: Fleets compromised by the Construct
STH_prodigy.110.desc:
The attempt to disable the Protostar was unsuccessful, the EMP burst was just not powerful enough to overcome the Protostar's shielding. 

With no choice left Dal sets the auto-destruct and orders a full evacuation of their ship and home.
STH_prodigy.110.name: Zero Unsuccessful.
STH_prodigy.111.desc: Gwyn can sense her father's presence onboard the Protostar as he stalks Dal on the bridge, Gwyn leaps forward and uses her heirloom to deflect the Diviner's attack against her friend. The two warriors begin to battle, Gwyn fully aware that should she lose nothing will be able to stop the Diviner and the Order's plans for revenge.
STH_prodigy.111.name: Supernova
STH_prodigy.112.desc: After a furious battle between father and his progeny, the Diviner lies wounded and defeated. Reaching out to Gwyn the Diviner lays down his weapon and surrenders .
STH_prodigy.112.name: The Diviner Defeated
STH_prodigy.113.desc: Gwyn collapses to the floor, mortally wounded by her father blade, as the Diviner cries out in shock and horror, unable to contemplate what he has done to his progeny.
STH_prodigy.113.name: The Diviner Victorious
STH_prodigy.114.name: Supernova
STH_prodigy.115.desc: Using all their skills the Starfleet officer manages to reach the Vau N'Akat Order, using an impassioned speech, the Vau N'Akat Order agree that now is not the time for further escalation of the ongoing conflict and agree that for now, they will leave the Diviner to his plans.
STH_prodigy.115.name: Escalation Avoided
STH_prodigy.116.desc: The situation only escalates, the Order members are not convinced by [Root.GetName]'s efforts and their resolve to join the Diviner in Battle has only hardened.
STH_prodigy.116.name: Situation Escalates
STH_prodigy.117.name: Supernova Part II
STH_prodigy.118.name: Supernova Part II
STH_prodigy.119.name: Supernova Part II
STH_prodigy.12.desc: As the Construct's effect makes its way through the fleet, our engineers propose a solution that involves cutting all intra-ship communications. to halt the spread of the Construct virus, at the short-term effect of our battle effectiveness.
STH_prodigy.12.name: Ships fall prey to the Construct
STH_prodigy.121.desc: With the battle over Dal watches as the remaining [Root.GetName] ships begin their search for the Protostar in a bid to try and salvage the ship and rescue what remains of his young crew.
STH_prodigy.121.name: The Protostar is safe
STH_prodigy.122.desc: With the battle over Dal watches as the remaining [Root.GetName] ships begin their search for the young crew of the Protostar in their escape pods.
STH_prodigy.122.name: The Protostar has been destroyed
STH_prodigy.123.desc: As the debris floats over the site of the battle, A message echoes across subspace, Solum will be avenged for the crimes the [Root.GetName] will commit against our people... the Diviner may have been defeated but the Vau N'Akat Order has been awakened and are coming for you.
STH_prodigy.123.name: Harsh Words from Solum
STH_prodigy.124.desc:
As feared following the attack by the Diviner, the Vau N'Akat are declaring war on us for a perceived attack that they believe we would have committed in the future. 

The tunnel that was opened by the Protostar has been stabilised and now offers a route between our worlds and a way fot them to attack us.
STH_prodigy.124.name: War with the Vau N'Akat
STH_prodigy.125.desc: As the preverbal dust settles in the aftermath of the Diviners attack on our fleets, a message comes in from Solum, it appears our Captain's message of peace has, for now, reached calmer ears. The Order appears to be content to leave us in peace for the moment.
STH_prodigy.125.name: A message of Peace from Solum
STH_prodigy.127.desc: Greetings all, I am [tempLeader] and I wanted to thank you for your efforts in resolving the Protostar crisis and time to reward these young leaders with a pace amongst our ranks.
STH_prodigy.127.name: Prodigy
STH_prodigy.2.desc:
We have received an emergency message from the USS Protostar, which had to abandon the test of its proto-warp jump. It appears an instability in the protostar drive almost generated a temporal incursion, resulting in an emergency shutdown. 

Results of the test have been fed back to Starfleet who will roll out the fix to all ships of this class within the fleet.
STH_prodigy.2.name: USS Protostar Survives Proto-Warp jump
STH_prodigy.20.desc:
On the remote slave-mining asteroid of Tars Lamora, the cruel overlord known only as The Diviner holds sway over his prisoners and slaves, using them to dig for a treasure greater than minerals. 

Amongst all the slaves one young adventurer, named Dal R'El makes an amazing discovery... an abandoned Starship.
STH_prodigy.20.name: Lost and Found
STH_prodigy.21.desc: Dal R'El, you stand before your Diviner and his progeny, my Gwyndala - my daughter. We are aware of your find within our mines and I demand that you take my Gwyn to its location. Failure to do as I command will see not only a punishment for yourself, but for your fellow prisoners.
STH_prodigy.21.name: Lost and Found
STH_prodigy.22.name: Fugitive Zero
STH_prodigy.23.name: Rok-Tahk and Jankom Pog
STH_prodigy.24.desc:
Dal, Jankom & the Brikar, who identify themselves as Rok-Tahk, the moment that they enter the bridge of the strange alien vessel, look around in excitement as interior lighting and control panels come to life. Dal looks around at his new crew, this is our chance to escape he yells. 

The crew looks to Gwyn, the young Vau N'Akat jumps to one of the consoles and powers up the ship's engines. 

It seems like we are in this together.
STH_prodigy.24.name: Lost and Found Part 2
STH_prodigy.25.desc:
Dal and those he gathered reach the bridge of the vessel, which lights up to greet them, the chance to escape before them Dal looks to Gwyn, imploring her to join him. 

The young Vau N'Akat warrior slowly shakes her head and taps her communicator.... 'Father I have the ship'.
STH_prodigy.25.name: Lost and Found Part 2
STH_prodigy.26.desc: Dal and Gwyn arrive on the bridge of the Protostar, which lights up to greet them, the chance to escape before them the pair look at each other, Gwyn looks out the viewport towards the approaching waves of Drednok warriors and calls to Dal, 'I have to escape my Father, I can no longer be apart of his cruel plans'.
STH_prodigy.26.name: Lost and Found Part 2
STH_prodigy.3.desc:
Our long-range scans have picked up the debris from a small starship that appears to have exited Proto-Warp under an emergency, the ship can only be the USS Protostar, which was testing the new drive system. 

There are no signs of any survivors from the ship and all remaining black box information has been passed back to Starfleet Engineering to attempt to prevent a repeat of this tragedy.
STH_prodigy.3.name: USS Protostar Destroyed
STH_prodigy.30.desc:
The Protostar saws clear of Tars Lamora, its powerful phasers clearing the Diviner's battle units from its path, as the crew cheered and celebrated, the Diviner looked on with an angry look. 

Back on the Protostar Dal takes the centre seat and the adventure begins.
STH_prodigy.30.name: Prodigy Begins!
STH_prodigy.31.desc:
The Protostar attempts to clear the surface of Tars Lamora, but the Diviner's forces swarm the ship, working their way through the hull and into the vital systems of the ship. 

As Dal orders the ship to engage its powerful engineers a crucial system fails and a fatal cascade begins which ends with a catastrophic explosion that engulfs and destroys the Protostar, ending its journey early.
STH_prodigy.31.name: Prodigy Ends!
STH_prodigy.4.desc:
In concerning news, the USS Protostar has vanished while undertaking its first Proto-warp jump, our long-range scans cannot find any evidence of debris or signs from the Protostar's small crew. 

We can however see signs of a small temporal anomaly that appeared briefly following the disappearance of the ship.
STH_prodigy.4.name: USS Protostar vanishes in Protowarp Flight
STH_prodigy.40.desc: Six young heroes, former detainees at a mining colony overseen by the mysterious Diviner, discoverered the derelict Starfleet ship, the USS Protostar, hidden within the asteroid. This inexperienced crew launches a harrowing getaway aboard the starship. Together the escapees learn that the ship came from a far-off alliance of peaceful galactic explorers known as the Federation. They resolve to set a course for Starfleet, but the Diviner is hot on their trails. Their journey takes them on a wild adventure where they encounter strange new life and civilizations, learn about Starfleet's ideals, and hope to find a better future for themselves on the far side of the galaxy.
STH_prodigy.40.name: Prodigy Begins!
STH_prodigy.41.desc: The crew hear a strange noise emanating from the back of the bridge, on investigating they find a small, but friendly gelatinous being who calls himself Murf!
STH_prodigy.41.name: Murf
STH_prodigy.45.desc: As the Protostar exits a period of Proto-Warp with the drive requiring an extended period of cooldown, the crew finds themselves with some downtime. Exploring the ship Dal finds a holodeck and an interesting holodeck program named the Kobayashi Maru scenario - a test of a captains leadership skills.
STH_prodigy.45.name: Kobayashi
STH_prodigy.46.desc: The holographic simulation loads up placing Dal and the centre of a Starship bridge, with an incoming hail from a freighter in danger. Arriving at the scene the freighter is quickly attacked and destroyed by a fleet of Warbirds ending the simulation with the dreaded phrase.
STH_prodigy.46.name: Kobayashi
STH_prodigy.47.desc: As the number of attempts racks up, Dal's frustration levels only increase, at what point does this simulation become an unwinnable scenario? Is this what the simulations is trying to tell him or is the thing broken?
STH_prodigy.47.name: Kobayashi, 42 attempts later!
STH_prodigy.5.desc: Emerging from a wormhole, torn through space by the Protostar's malfunctioning drive core, the powerless ship comes crashing down on the distant planet of Solum in the Delta Quadrant.
STH_prodigy.5.name: Protostar crashes on Solum
STH_prodigy.50.desc: Landing on a planet named Murder World, the crew begins to investigate their surroundings and collect samples from the local fauna. Gwyn who has been questioning her decision to abandon her father and side with the crew of the Protostar takes a small land vehicle named the 'Runaway' for a drive to clear her mind.
STH_prodigy.50.name: Dream Catcher
STH_prodigy.51.desc:
Gwyn picks up a series of messages from the rest of the crew, it appears the whole planet is one giant superorganism, racing back to the crew she finds Dal and Murf bound by thick red vines. Grabbing her heirloom and rushing forward, Gwyn is stopped by a familiar voice... her father! 

The Diviner calls out concerned for Gwyn's safety, 'come with me my Gwyndala' he pleads...
STH_prodigy.51.name: Dream Catcher
STH_prodigy.52.desc: Emergency Training Hologram's log, It has been almost a week since the cadets on this ship departed to explore the planet, and now I can no longer read their life signs, I can only assume they have been killed in the line of duty. With no hope of rescue, I am powering down the Protostar I can only hope one day this ship is found on this remote world and I can tell the story of these brave cadets.
STH_prodigy.52.name: Crew of the USS Protostar Lost
STH_prodigy.53.desc: Father... it cannot be you, what are you doing here? Shaking her head to try and clear the image of her father from her mind, the Diviner would never be this concerned about her wellbeing, unless he has changed?
STH_prodigy.53.name: Dream Catcher
STH_prodigy.54.desc: With the image of the Diviner cleared from her mind, Gwyn races towards Dal and the rest of the crew struggling for their lives. Using her heirloom to free the others, the crew race back to the Protostar and escape from this nightmare world.
STH_prodigy.54.name: Dream Catcher
STH_prodigy.55.desc: With Gwyn's loyalty to the crew of the Protostar secured and the crew safely rescued from Murder World, the Protostar once again sets course for Federation space.
STH_prodigy.55.name: Dream Catcher
STH_prodigy.6.desc:
Starfleet, I am [vau_nakat_order_leader.GetName] of the Vau N'Akat, we see that you have returned to finish off what you started so many years ago! The civil war that you started nearly destroyed our world, but we prepared for your return and to inflict our revenge upon you and your [prodigy_target_country.GetName]. 

Captain [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName] you and your crew are now our prisoners and your vessel will become home to our 'Construct' a powerful weapon that will turn your ships against you as we wipe your people from the galaxy.
STH_prodigy.6.name: Message from the Vau N'Akat
STH_prodigy.60.desc:
All is not well on the USS Protostar, as the crew discovers the living Construct hidden within the computer core, Rok-Tahk and Murf were exploring the lower levels of the ship when they came across the Construct, a weapon hidden within the ship providing their salvation that could destroy those they were seeking to flee to.
