The thoughts and concerns of the crew were interrupted by the incoming presence of a massive Tachyon storm.
STH_prodigy.60.name: Time Amok
STH_prodigy.61.desc:
As the crew begins preparations, Rok-Tahk reflects her role within the team, for so long she has been seen as the 'muscle' appreciated only for her size and strength and not her mind. 

Suddenly there is a warning from the Proto-Core that something within the storm has set off a major failure within the drive with an explosion imminent. 

As the storm hits the core explodes and the ship explodes...
STH_prodigy.61.name: Time Amok
STH_prodigy.62.desc:
The crew find themselves split across timezones with time itself splintered and fractured moving at differing rates across each section of the ship. Some meer seconds away from the core breach, others with time moving so slowly that seconds seem like hours. 

The command training hologram appears to be the only one immune from the effects, as she moves across the sections of the fractured vessel. 

Building a new warp matrix to repair the damaged one might be the only hope the ship has.
STH_prodigy.62.name: Time Amok
STH_prodigy.63.desc:
As each member of the crew does their part it is left to Rok-Tahk whose section moves the slowest to complete the build. As time moves very slowly in this phase, a lonely Rok tries to reconnect to her absent friends by bidding their empty bunks good night when she goes to sleep each 'night' and hugging a small toy representation of Murf. 

Rok-Tahk channels her inner cadet to complete the build, knowing that once complete she has a long time to wait alone by herself.
STH_prodigy.63.name: Time Amok
STH_prodigy.64.desc: An anti-matter warp core breach leaves very little in its wake, but this pales in comparison to the detention of a Proto-core drive, which atomises the ship and all aboard in the blink of an eye.
STH_prodigy.64.name: Protostar Destroyed
STH_prodigy.65.name: Time Amok
STH_prodigy.66.desc:
After a few days of Murf acting strangely the young crew finds the young alien cocooned in a shell of his own making, clearly undergoing some form of metamorphosis! 

With no one knowing the outcome this could pose a risk to the ship.
STH_prodigy.66.name: Murf's Metamurfphosis
STH_prodigy.67.desc: Murf emerges from the cocoon transformed into a new form, a very capable new life and very grateful and loyal to those who cared for him.
STH_prodigy.67.name: Murf's Metamurfphosis
STH_prodigy.7.desc:
Captain [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName] and their First Officer take their chance to escape knowing that should the USS Protostar return to Earth it would bring about the destruction of [Root.GetName]. 

The duo make it to the ship and forcing their way to a command panel successfully send the Protostar through the still open portal to parts unknown and with it the dangerous weapon hidden onboard.
STH_prodigy.7.name: Protostar Escapes to far off Asteroid
STH_prodigy.70.desc:
The Protostar answers a distress call from Planet 0042692 and the crew are greeted by representatives of the colony of New Enda-Prize. A colony who were visited by the crew of the Enterprise and grew up idolising the ways of 'Those Old Scientists'. 

The colony is suffering from a mysterious plague, from the mysterious Gallows.
STH_prodigy.70.name: All the World's a Stage
STH_prodigy.71.desc:
Jankom Pog, the Protostar defacto engineer, was the logical choice to investigate the gallows. On inspection, they find a crashed Type-F shuttlecraft the Galileo leaking warp plasma into the environment. 

Knowing that no one else could repair the damage, Jankom Pog leaps onto the Shuttle. 

With two options availale to Jankom Pog, he can either repair the comms relay, force the shuttle into the pit to seal the leak and beam away, or attempt to fix the plasma leak himself.
STH_prodigy.71.name: All the World's a Stage
STH_prodigy.72.desc:
The Shuttle begins it's final decent into the cavern, and just as Jankom Pog is about to give up hope, the familiar hum of the transporter rings out as Dal and the Enda-Prizians beam him to safety. 

With the colony safe. Jankom Pog having learned a valuable lesson the crew resumes the journey to Federation space.
STH_prodigy.72.name: All the World's a Stage
STH_prodigy.73.desc:
The Shuttle begins it's final descent into the cavern, Jankom Pog looks on and the Shuttlecraft breaks up around him, knowing that once again his sacrifice has saved lives. 

The crew of the Protostar having saved the colony, but lost a member of their family continue their voyage to Federation space.
STH_prodigy.73.name: All the World's a Stage
STH_prodigy.74.desc:
Jankom Pog frantically completes the repairs to Galileo's damaged warp core meer seconds before the core goes critical and dumps its toxic warp plasma into the biosphere of the planet. 

Jankom Pog falls to the floor relieved at having saved the day before the hum of the Protostar's transporter whisks him away and the ship resumes its journey back to Starfleet.
STH_prodigy.74.name: All the World's a Stage
STH_prodigy.75.desc:
Jankom Pog frantically completes the repairs to Galileo's damaged warp core meer seconds before the core goes critical and dumps its toxic warp plasma into the biosphere of the planet. 

Jankom Pog falls to the floor his body shaking from the toxic effects of the warp plasma exposure, knowing the signs of the overdose all too well, the engineer smiles and closes his eyes knowing that at least his sacrifice saved the colony. 

The crew of the Protostar having saved the colony, but lost a member of their family continued their voyage to Federation space.
STH_prodigy.75.name: All the World's a Stage
STH_prodigy.8.desc:
Captain [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName] and their First Officer take their chance to escape knowing that should the USS Protostar return to Earth it would bring about the destruction of [Root.GetName]. 

The duo make it back to where the Protostar was being held. but despite their efforts, they could not remotely free the ship, with no choice remaining the Captain sets the auto-destruct and the pair waits for the inevitable destruction of their ship and with it the weapon that could have caused so much impact.
STH_prodigy.8.name: Protostar Explodes
STH_prodigy.80.desc: As the crew debate options to remove the Living Construct from the Protostar, their scanners detect the presence of a large dormant Cuboid ship, which their Training Hologram identifies as a Borg Cube. Excited by the prospect of using the advanced technology of the Borg to defeat the Construct the crew prepare to board the Borg vessel.
STH_prodigy.80.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.81.desc:
The crew wonder through the black corridors, feeling with each step that they are being watched by the rows and rows of sleeping drones. 

As a Medusan Zero begins to hear the voice of the collective calling out seeking to know more about the young individuals who may pose a new threat to the collective.
STH_prodigy.81.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.82.desc: Zero leads the crew to the Borg Vinculum and brief discussion later it is clear that only Zero would be able to withstand the power of the Collective. As dangerous as it would be Zero needs to go into the mind of the Borg and look for the information they need.
STH_prodigy.82.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.83.desc: Zero and the crew reach the Protostar as the Cube springs back into life, the Borg Cube reaches out with it's tractor beam, but the Protostar is just too quick and leaps into warp before the Borg can react further... But it looks like the young rookies have alerted the Borg to the Federations possession of Proto-Warp and made Starfleet a target.
STH_prodigy.83.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.84.desc:
Zero and the crew reach the Protostar, but the Borg Cube is already powering up and lashes out with a tractor beam and before the kids can react a dozen Borg Drones beam onto the ship, they say assimilation is painless... they were wrong. 

As the Borg collective add other crew to their collective, Starfleet once again becomes of interest to the Collective.
STH_prodigy.84.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.85.desc:
The lure of the Collective is all-encompassing, the pull of the hive, the embrace of the many... 

 Resistance is Futile, we are Borg.
STH_prodigy.85.name: The Collective
STH_prodigy.86.desc: We are the Borg, your distinctiveness will join us, become one with us, be part of our hive, our collective, perfection.
STH_prodigy.86.name: The Collective
STH_prodigy.87.desc:
As the crew of the Protostar await for the return of Zero, they receive a communication from the Cube. 

The assimilated form of Zero appears on screen and utters the chilling phrase 'You will be assimilated'. 

As the Borg collective add other crew to their collective, Starfleet once again becomes of interest to the Collective.
STH_prodigy.87.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.88.desc:
Breaking free of the Collective's hold was difficult but Zero manages it, whilst putting the Collective back into their slumber. 

The Borg may not hold the answers to the Construct, but Zero found an inner strength and belief in themselves.
STH_prodigy.88.name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
STH_prodigy.9.desc: The Vau N'Akat's plan is quickly put into effect, with the Protostar sent back through the wormhole and sent on a direct course for the very centre of [Root.GetName] carrying the Construct program and its ability to remote hijack friendly vessels and turn them against their former masters.
STH_prodigy.9.name: Protostar sent back to [Root.GetName]
STH_prodigy.90.desc:
As the crew of the Protostar nears Federation space, they pick up a distress call originating from the distant world of Solum, from none other than [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName] held captive at the hands of the Vau N'Akat. 

The original Captain of the Protostar is out there asking for help. Should we turn the ship around or abandon them?
STH_prodigy.90.name: Last Flight of the Protostar
STH_prodigy.91.desc: The Protostar exits warp over Solum, and scanning the planet picks up the life signs of [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName], it will take as many of the crew as possible to pull of the rescue.
STH_prodigy.91.name: Last Flight of the Protostar
STH_prodigy.92.desc:
The rescue is complete and a battered and bruised [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName] safely recovering in the Protostar's medical bay, Dal and the Protostar are free to return to Starfleet and warn them of the threat the Vau N'Akat bring. 

However, the threat of the Living Construct must be overcome...

Just as the crew are about to celebrate their success, the Intruder Alert alarm signals, a team from Solum has infiltrated the ship and set the Protostar on a course back to [Root.GetName] space.
STH_prodigy.92.name: Last Flight of the Protostar
STH_prodigy.93.desc:
The crew looks down at the body of [prodigy_hero_leader.GetName] the mission a complete failure, perhaps if the crew was better placed, or more able, but that doesn't matter now, it is time to return to Starfleet and bring the mission to an end. 

Just as the crew are about to calculate their next move, the Intruder Alert alarm signals, a team from Solum has infilatrated the ship and set the Protostar on a course back to [Root.GetName] space.
STH_prodigy.93.name: Last Flight of the Protostar
STH_qpedia.1.desc:
Ah, so you have seen sense and have come to your favorite omnipotent being, Uncle Q for help?

Well you are in the right place, I know all there is to know about everything, especially the STNH modiverse. Have a look at the list of questions below, the list will be continuously updated and of course feel free to let the Qs know if something is missing.
STH_qpedia.1.name: The Q Continuum
STH_qpedia.10.desc:
I had a bet with my good pal Jean-Luc about how long it would take for a question on his precious Federation of Planets would take to come in .

The UFP has some of the mods most exciting and oldest mechanics and once you get used to them you'll be Federating the galaxy in no time, just like the Borg... but with a nicer smile!
STH_qpedia.10.name: The Humans
STH_qpedia.100.desc: Perfection. So close yet still so very very far for you. Take it from someone who knows. Now with what knowledge would you wish to improve yourself today?
STH_qpedia.100.name: The Borg Collective
STH_qpedia.11.desc: As of our 3.6 update, you can summon the UFP council to Starbase one for a meeting to discuss key events and help manage the Federation and its member worlds. Some worlds will appreciate the support, while others might become frustrated with the micro-management. To open this mechanic simply click on the UFP emblem next to Starbase one or contact them via the contacts tab.
STH_qpedia.11.name: Starbase One
STH_qpedia.1111.name: Locked out system [From.GetName].
STH_qpedia.1112.desc:
Dev Note: As part of our 4.0 release, we have examined several performance improvements and decided that we need to modify how the decision techs operate. These techs, once researched, enable you to select from multiple specialisations. 

In the 4.0 update, these will now be checked every 3 months, which will cause a small delay between the research being completed and the decision being made. 

If you would like to force the event to run earlier, then run STH_custom.51 from the console.
STH_qpedia.1112.name: Decision Techs
STH_qpedia.12.desc:
You may have noticed that an extra pop-up appeared after you formed the Federation, well that formed the council, as well as giving you lots of planets, leaders, and cool new ships.

If you look over Neptune in the Sol system or one of your gas giants if you are not playing as Earth you will see a new megastructure that resembles Starbase One, as seen in Discovery and Strange New Worlds... click on it, just like you would click on another countries ships to talk to them.
STH_qpedia.12.name: Starbase One
STH_qpedia.13.desc: Now that the Council has assembled you have a number of options to manage your members and run the Federation as you wish.
STH_qpedia.13.name: The Federation Council
STH_qpedia.2.desc:
The Q Continuum is bursting with knowledge and has introduced a new means of helping players play the many unique features of ST:New Horizons. 

The Q-pedia contains the collective knowledge of the Q with handy questions on how certain mechanics work and is worth a peak if you get stuck! 

If you need to open the help section, contact Q from the Contacts tab and there via Adv Diplomacy which now not only allows you to change the starting conditions but also find these helpful articles.
STH_qpedia.2.name: Q-pedia
STH_qpedia.200.desc: Oh the Undine with their famous motto, 'the weak shall perish.' Such hostile creatures to visitors in their space. But if you are going to keep up with that attitude there might be some useful things for you to know.
STH_qpedia.200.name: The Undine
STH_qpedia.300.desc: Ah the Dominion, a bunch of shape-shifters who can do cute little form tricks while playing as gods for those species that cannot. How cute. What do you want to know about them?
STH_qpedia.300.name: The Dominion
STH_qpedia.50.desc: Well glory to you and to your tiny house and all that other Klingon nonsense. What do you wish to know more about?
STH_qpedia.50.name: The Klingon Empire
STH_qpedia.70.desc: War... what is it good for? Well as it turns out, it's good for rather a lot. Whether you want to take some territory, defend yourself, or those many human words you have just don't seem as much fun as firing a torpedo at a helpless hull. Here you can find enough bits of info on war to make Sun Tzu want to write a second book.
STH_qpedia.70.name: War! What is it good for?
STH_qpedia.71.desc: This section of the Q-pedia list the requirement for each Casus Belli in STNH.
STH_qpedia.71.name: How do Casus Belli Work?
STH_qpedia.90.desc: Ah the Romulans, always scheming and plotting something in secrecy aren't you? Well as it turns out I know all of your petty little secrets, so just ask away.
STH_qpedia.90.name: The Romulan Star Empire
STH_redemption.10.desc: Ambassador K'Ehleyr from the Federation has confirmed that the Federation is sending one of their warriors to meet with us to discuss the Rite of Succession, and whilst they proclaim they will not directly interfere they will hear our ask.
STH_redemption.10.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.11.desc: Our failure to attend our own conference has no doubt led to confusion within our own ranks and frustration within the decks of the Starfleet vessel that was waiting to rendezvous with us.
STH_redemption.11.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.12.desc: The Klingons have never been known as a patient people and our failure to attend the agreed meeting has nothing to improve relations and will have harmed our efforts to build a peaceful quadrant.
STH_redemption.12.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.13.desc: It appears the Klingons have failed to attend the arranged meeting with the Federation Flagship, a baffling and cowardly act from the Klingons, however one can never fathom the actions of such a foolish species. It does however. put an end to our schemes in this area.
STH_redemption.13.name: Klingons Fail to Attend
STH_redemption.14.desc: The Federation has demonstrated a lack of honour by failing to attend the agreed meeting, perhaps we have miss-judged them.
STH_redemption.14.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.15.desc: The Klingons have never been known as a patient people and our failure to attend the agreed meeting has nothing to improve relations and will have harmed our efforts to build a peaceful quadrant.
STH_redemption.15.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.16.desc: It appears the Federation have failed to attend the arranged meeting with the Klingon Flagship, a rather baffling and cowardly act from Starfleet, which puts an end to our schemes in this area.
STH_redemption.16.name: Federation fail to Attend
STH_redemption.17.desc: Commander [klingon_redemption_1_leader.GetName] has successfully delivered Chancellor [klingon_leader.GetName] to their meeting with the Federation Flagship, now begins a hazardous situation for the Klingon Empire as a new ruler must be selected to guide them Empire through this new era.
STH_redemption.17.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.18.desc: As I predicted Praetor the Klingon Empire has run to his Federation betters to seek help with aiding in the selection of a new Chancellor, now is our chance to not only place a puppet on the throne of the Empire but destroy their relationship with Starfleet and plunge them into chaos.
STH_redemption.18.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.19.desc: Captain [federation_redemption_1_leader.GetName] and the [federation_redemption_1_ship.GetName] have arrived at the coordinates, as a Klingon Battlecruiser the IKS Vor'cha, pride of the Klingon fleet decloaks in front of them carrying the Klingon Chancellor eager to meet and discuss the situation ahead.
STH_redemption.19.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.2.desc: Greetings Praetor, I bring you a grave warning from the Tal Shiar.. we have been working with one of your up-and-coming Imperial Commanders who is requesting an audience with the council to discuss a matter which could impact the very security of the Empire.
STH_redemption.2.name: Message from the Tal Shiar
STH_redemption.20.desc:
Greetings [federation_redemption_1_leader.GetName] you bring great honor to yourself in joining us here today and I offer you my thanks. 

The great Klingon Empire stands on a D'k tahg edge... my time remaining is limited, forces cough have been working against me from the shadows and I cannot let these agents rule the Empire when I am gone. 

There are two leading candidates to replace me, both have strong support... cough Gowron commands the loyalty of those who wish to see the status quo remain, whilst Duras has the support of the ambitious forces within the Empire cough I know you cannot directly interfere, but you can help me put the right person in the Chancellor's seat, help me find out who has killed me.
STH_redemption.20.name: The Klingon Succession Crisis
STH_redemption.21.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerName] from the United Federation of Planets, I am [ufp_leader.GetName] and I am here to answer the call for assistance from the Klingon High Council. 

As requested my Chief Medical Officer has looked at your medical report and can confirm that the Veridium Six poisoning will soon take your life, our understanding is that two rival leaders stand ready to challenge for the leadership of the Empire. Gowron offers a stable option, whilst Duras desires power above all else. One of these is likely to have taken their desire to lead the empire to treacherous levels, we will attempt to judge who the culprit is.
STH_redemption.21.name: The Klingon Succession Crisis
STH_redemption.22.desc: Praetor, Command Sela reporting in, our spies from the House of Duras have confirmed that the meeting between the Starfleet Captain and the Klingon Chancellor has taken place, we have the perfect opportunity to sabotage this meeting and sow confusion and tension within both parties, laying the way for our puppets in the House of Duras to take control of the Empire.
STH_redemption.22.name: The Klingon Succession Crisis
STH_redemption.24.desc:
As the meeting comes to an end, the deafening sound of an explosion rings out across the meeting room. Security Officers from Starfleet and KDF dive to protect their leaders and sirens bellow while the emergency lights flicker hopelessly. 

It is clear that some force does not want this meeting to have taken place.
STH_redemption.24.name: Explosion Rocks the Chamber!
STH_redemption.25.desc:
Captain, this is K'Ehleyr the Federation Ambassador to the Klingon Empire, the Federation Council has tasked me with aiding you in this investigation into this attack given my knowledge of the current state of Klingon affairs.

I need not warn you that the Empire stands on the edge of a civil war that could drag in powers from across the quadrant, I have my suspicions on who is responsible here, but we cannot act without evidence and a wrong move could easily turn the average Klingon warrior against us.
STH_redemption.25.name: Investigate the Bombing
STH_redemption.26.desc:
Unfortunately, we must report back with bad news, despite a thorough investigation of the bomb site we have been unable to find any more evidence to suggest who was behind the attack. 

I cannot offer any additional information for you at this point.
STH_redemption.26.name: No Evidence Found
STH_redemption.27.desc:
Our investigation has been completed and we have made a startling discovery, it appears the substance used in the bomb carries a unique signature which has been known to have been used by Romulan agents and appears to have been carried in the meeting by a member of the Duras household guard. 

What makes this even more interesting is that we were able to go through our records and find similar readings also present at the site of the Khitomer Massacre. 

This implies a connection between Duras, the Romulans and the events at Khitomer all those years ago.
STH_redemption.27.name: Evidence Found
STH_redemption.28.name: Evidence against Duras
STH_redemption.29.name: Duras finds K'Ehleyr alone
STH_redemption.3.desc:
Greetings Praetor [Root.GetLeaderName], my name is Commander Sela and I have been working on fostering a relationship with the leadership of one of the Great Houses within the Klingon Empire my source has revealed that the relationship between the Klingon Empire and the Federation is continuing to grow at an alarming pace since they signed the treaty at Khitomer. 

My contact within the House of Duras is ready to make a bid for the leadership of the Empire, but they will need our support and a little help ensuring the current leader of the High Council meets an 'unfortunate' end...
STH_redemption.3.name: A meeting with Sela
STH_redemption.30.desc: Duras! I am here to claim the Right of Vengeance for your actions here today, you will die at my hands here today and pay for your crimes against K'Ehleyr and for the sins of your father against the House of Mogh.
STH_redemption.30.name: Right of Vengance
STH_redemption.31.desc: The two Klingons are locked in fierce combat, one fighting for vengeance and fueled by the rage of the injustices caused by the other. As the sounds of battle echos around, one man emerges triumphant, Worf, while Duras lies dead at his feet.
STH_redemption.31.name: Worf Emerges Victorious
STH_redemption.32.desc: The two Klingons engage in combat, with both warriors fighting for their lives, Duras moves quickly to his right feigning an attack and drawing Worf into a lunge enabling Duras to capitalise and stab Worf in the back ending the battle with Duras standing victorious.
STH_redemption.32.name: Duras Emerges Victorious
STH_redemption.33.desc:
Worf, you stand before the High Council, whilst you were in your rights as Klingon to enact the Right of Vengence, with it lies any chance of clearing your family name. If we may speak off the record... your father knew too well that challenging Duras at this time would lead to open revolt within the Empire. The House of Duras is too strong right now to challenge and the death of their leader at the hands of a member of Starfleet only strengthens the backing they have. 

For the good of the Empire we need you to bear this disgrace a while longer whilst the future of the Empire is solidified.
STH_redemption.33.name: Discommendation
STH_redemption.34.desc:
As the meeting comes to an end, the deafening sound of an explosion rings out across the meeting room. Security Officers from Starfleet and KDF dive to protect their leaders and sirens bellow while the emergency lights flicker hopelessly. 

It is clear that some force does not want this meeting to have taken place.
STH_redemption.34.name: Bomb Explodes
STH_redemption.35.desc: As planned by Sela and her team, an explosion has rocked the conference being held by the Klingons and Federation the resulting chaos has hampered the succession process, and built support for our puppets in the House of Duras.
STH_redemption.35.name: Bomb Explodes at UFP-Klingon Conference
STH_redemption.36.desc: Our plans to plant Duras as head of the Klingon Empire have suffered a serious blow, as it appears the fool was killed in single combat against a Starfleet officer. Only in Klingon society could an act of such barbarism be tolerated, we will need to re-assess and adapt our plans without the fool Duras.
STH_redemption.36.name: Duras Dead
STH_redemption.37.desc:
Despite the bombing, the Klingons are insisting on a decision, the Rite of Succession must be completed and a recommendation must be put forward. 

What has been made clear is that no matter the victor today this matter is far from settled and both sides will not take the decision lightly. We cannot directly influence the internal matters of the Empire, but we can make a judgment on who has been trying to kill the Chancellor.
STH_redemption.37.name: Time to Decide
STH_redemption.38.desc: The time has come to make a judgment on the next Chancellor of the Klingon Empire. Our investigations have shown that Duras, working with the Romulans, attempted to sabotage the meeting and kill his rivals in a very un-Klingon display. However, it is clear that Duras has the backing of a large number of the 'old-guard' and his family name carries a lot of weight within the noble families. Whereas Gowron offers stability, a clear career politician he lacks the big family name and military history, but he is in no rush to take the Empire to war. The Chancellor wants to know who is working against the Empire, which answer should we give?
STH_redemption.38.name: Time to Decide
STH_redemption.39.name: The Arbiter Has Spoken
STH_redemption.4.desc:
Qapla' it is with great concern I must report that my health continues to deteriorate, the greatest doctors within the Empire feel my passage to Sto-vo-kor rapidly approaches. 

I speak now grave words for I fear that treachery runs deep within the Empire and I will be reaching out to our allies in the Federation to play a part in the Arbiter of Succession ritual for I can no longer trust the warriors within these halls.
STH_redemption.4.name: High Council Meeting
STH_redemption.40.desc: The Klingon's have reached a decision and Gowron will be the new leader of the Klingon Empire on the death of their current Chancellor.
STH_redemption.40.name: Gowron the Heir to the Empire
STH_redemption.41.desc: The Klingon's have reached a decision and Duras will be the new leader of the Klingon Empire on the death of their current Chancellor.
STH_redemption.41.name: Duras Heir to the Empire
STH_redemption.42.desc:
Our Federation liaison has contacted our security teams, they regret to inform us that Duras entered into single combat with the son of Mogh and was slain as an act of Vengence for killing the Federation Ambassador. 

It is amusing that the Federation is so concerned about this act, they forget we are Klingons and the right of vengence and combat is in our blood.. We shall await the son of Mogh presenting himself to us for judgment.
STH_redemption.42.name: Duras killed in Combat
STH_redemption.45.name: The Chancellor is Dead...
STH_redemption.46.desc: Our spies in the Klingon Empire have confirmed that their Chancellor has finally succumbed to the poison that our agents have been pumping into the fool's Bloodwine. The next phase of our plan comes into effect.
STH_redemption.46.name: Klingon Chancellor Dies
STH_redemption.47.desc: It is time to confirm the position of Chancellor [Root.GetRulerName] in front of the Klingon High Council and our allies. We should send out invites and begin a new era in the Empires grand history.
STH_redemption.47.name: The New Chancellor
STH_redemption.48.desc:
Qapla' to our allies! I invite you to travel to Qo'noS to celebrate in my ascension to my rightful position as ruler of the Klingon Empire, no thanks to the help that you provided. 

I look forward to showing your representative a true Klingon welcome!
STH_redemption.48.name: Message from the Klingon Empire
STH_redemption.5.desc: Greetings I am K'Ehleyr, Federation Ambassador to the Klingon Empire, I've been approached by my counterpart from the Empire to ask for our attendance at an important meeting, it appears the Chancellor of the Empire is in dire health and has asked for one of our finest to act as the Arbiter of Succession in the upcoming ceremony. This act will go a long way in cementing our relationship with the Empire and ensuring that the best possible outcome is reached for future Federation-Klingon relations.
STH_redemption.5.name: Inbound Message from the Klingon Ambassador
STH_redemption.50.name: Rebel Attack
STH_redemption.52.desc: The Rebel fleet has been destroyed, but not before allowing the rebel leaders to escape the planet's surface. Could this be the first skirmish in a Klingon Civil War?
STH_redemption.52.name: Rebel Fleet Destroyed
STH_redemption.53.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.54.desc:
It is now unfortunately clear that the situation within the Klingon Empire is only heading one way... towards a civil war between the Houses of Duras and Gowron. However, whilst this remains quite clear, what is concerning is how the rebel faction is managing to build up a rapid supply of ships, weapons and resources well beyond their means. 

The influence of another major empire working behind the scenes is now all but confirmed.
STH_redemption.54.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.56.desc: Exposing the House of Duras has started a chain of events that has set in motion a Klingon Civil War, far earlier than anyone could have expected and has forced the hand of the Romulans, pulling them into the war. Now we shall see which faction is strong enough to lead the Empire as a true Klingon!
STH_redemption.56.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.57.desc:
As many predicted, forcing the House of Duras' hand has resulted in the Klingon Empire descending into a potentially brutal civil war. 

We shall soon see which House is strongest and who will lead the Empire.
STH_redemption.57.name: Klingon Empire Decends into Civil War
STH_redemption.58.desc: It appears the fools within the House of Duras, having been humiliated in front ot their allies have taken the foolish move to begin the planned Klingon Civil war far too early, in their desperation they appear to have named our involvement and dragged us into their war!
STH_redemption.58.name: Klingon Empire Decends into Civil War
STH_redemption.6.desc:
Having worked with the Klingons and gained their respect, I am willing to speak with the Empire regarding the Rite of Succession. It would be remiss of me if I did not flag my concern about involving ourselves in the internal affairs of the Klingon Empire and we will have to inform them that whilst we can observe the event our role must remain neutral. 

Remaining on good terms with the Empire will be a key outcome of this meeting and ensuring stability along our borders.
STH_redemption.6.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.60.desc:
Our military council grows ever more concerned that our enemy is managing to build up its forces at an alarming rate, they must be getting help from an outside power, most likely those Romulan cowards, who would never dare confront us directly! 

With all our forces searching for the rebels we must once again turn to the humans to help.
STH_redemption.60.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.61.desc: Qapla' [Root.GetRulerName] the cowardly Romulans are clearly attempting to bolster the fighting power of our rebel factions, over the past weeks weapons, ships and resources have found their way into the Rebel's hands. We seek the aid of our friends to stop this from happening.
STH_redemption.61.name: Incoming Message
STH_redemption.62.desc: The Federation has responded to our ask and agreed to set up a Tachyon Dection Grid along our border, whilst it would have been better for them to have provided ships and torpedos, this action should remove the Romulan threat.
STH_redemption.62.name: Federation agrees to help
STH_redemption.63.desc: The Federation has sent their regrets that they cannot involve themselves in 'internal Klingon matters' and they will not be offering to help us. We must deal with this situation on our own.
STH_redemption.63.name: Federation refuses to help
STH_redemption.64.desc:
The fleet continued to scan the border for any sign of ships attempting to cross the border, suddenly one of the ships broke formation and fired a volley of low-yield torpedoes into a seemingly empty section of space. 

All of a sudden a shimmer and energy spike is seen on viewers, this can only be a cloak fleet attempting to break the border blockade!
STH_redemption.64.name: Cloak Ship Detected
STH_redemption.65.desc: The fleet continues to scan the border for any sign of ships attempting to cross the border to aid the Klingon rebels. Several hours pass with no sign of any ships attempting to breach the blockade. It appears our attempt to stop the Romulans crossing the border has either failed or the Romulans have thought better of it.
STH_redemption.65.name: No sign of any ships
STH_redemption.66.desc: The Federation's attempts to prevent our ships from delivering resources to the Klingon Rebels has failed to prevent us from crossing the borders, once again displaying the superiority of Romulan technology and leadership.
STH_redemption.66.name: Fleet Breaches the Blockade
STH_redemption.67.desc: The Starfleet ships are locking weapons onto our cloak fleets, they must have detected us with that Tachyon Grid. Continuing to press on could result on them firing on us whilst our shields are down!
STH_redemption.67.name: Fleet Detected!
STH_redemption.68.desc: No, Captain. I am Commander Sela. The woman you knew as Tasha Yar was my mother. Deploying an invasion fleet along our border is a clear act of aggression.
STH_redemption.68.name: ... Tasha?
STH_redemption.69.desc: There has been no answer to our attempts to hail the cloaked fleet and subsequent scans have failed to reveal any further sign of the cloaked ships. It appears they were in no mood for confrontation and have retreated.
STH_redemption.69.name: Cloaked Fleet Retreats
STH_redemption.7.desc: Our sources within the Klingon High Council have made us aware that the Federation has been approached to assist the Empire in replacing the leader we have poisoned. Commander Sela assures us that this unexpected twist will be 'handled' by her team.
STH_redemption.7.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.70.desc: Our faith in Starfleet has been rewarded! The Federation fleet has reported in that they have successfully deterred a suspected Romulan fleet from crossing into our space to aid our foes.
STH_redemption.70.name: Federation Repel Romulans
STH_redemption.71.desc: Sela, we are in no position to offer you a fight today, nor do we wish to engage in a conflict with the Romulan Star Empire on this occasion. We urge you to reconsider your interfering in this internal matter for the Klingons as it will only lead to war.
STH_redemption.71.name: Starfleet Backs Down
STH_redemption.72.desc: It appears that the Starfleet blockade was in no mood for a fight against the Romulans and has backed down allowing them to cross into Klingon territory.
STH_redemption.72.name: Starfleet Backs Down
STH_redemption.73.desc:
Be advised Romulan Commander, we are not looking to start a war here today, nor are we massing on the border looking for conflict, but we cannot allow interference in a matter for the Klingon Empire. 

Knowing the Klingons as we do, I suspect any public knowledge of your involvement will cause an adverse effect on the faction you are looking to support.
STH_redemption.73.name: Incoming Message
STH_redemption.74.desc: You may have the victory today Starfleet, but rest assured we will not forget how you have interfered within our matters here today. Until we meet again... Sela out.
STH_redemption.74.name: Romulans Backs Down
STH_redemption.75.desc: It appears a fleet of Starfleet ships were involved in an altercation along the border when a fleet or Romulan warbirds attempted to cross into our territory to deliver aid to the rebel factions. It seems the Starfleet captain involve was able to 'convince' the Romulans to head home with their tails between their legs.
STH_redemption.75.name: Starfleet Exposes a Romulan theat
STH_redemption.8.desc: Our spies within the Klingon Empire have advised us that the Empire attempted to seek the help of Starfleet, who rejected their request for help. Whilst this action will no doubt damage the relationship between both sides it does not aid our attempts to gain influence within the High Council
STH_redemption.8.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.80.name: The Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.81.desc:
Our cloaked vessels watching the events unfolding in Klingon space have picked up the opening shots in the start of the Klingon Civil War. 

Now we wait to see if our rebel-backed faction wins. throwing their relationship with the humans into disarray!
STH_redemption.81.name: The Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.9.desc:
We have been advise by the Federation Ambassador that they will be sending no Captain to support our request to aid with the Rite of Succession. 

It seems our trust in the Federation was miss-placed and they have no honour after all.
STH_redemption.9.name: Rite of Succession
STH_relic_hunters.110.desc:
We have finished curating the [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName] for maximum viability. We recovered what relics we could from the extraneous exhibits. Our Curators have decided on this exhibit description based on the species' appearance, culture, and former civilization:

[STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesMuseumDescription]
STH_relic_hunters.111.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an artifact! It appears to be a set of scrolls discussing the formation of governments.
STH_relic_hunters.112.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an artifact! It appears to be a set of metaphors and aphorisms around the acquisition of material wealth.
STH_relic_hunters.113.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an artifact! It appears to be an ancient clay pot with fungus growing inside of it.
STH_relic_hunters.114.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an artifact! It appears to be a set of writings of an ancient Vulcan philosopher.
STH_relic_hunters.115.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered several artifacts! They appear to be serveral written works of Cardassian propaganda.
STH_relic_hunters.116.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered several dangerous artifacts! They appear to be hourglass-shaped energy fields that defy analysis. Several curators have gone unconscious or died attempting to analyze them.
STH_relic_hunters.117.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered several military artifacts! They appear to be weapons and armor made out of primitive materials that even our earliest armaments would penetrate.
STH_relic_hunters.118.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an interesting weapon! It appears to be a 5-pointed curved blade made of a resilient material.
STH_relic_hunters.119.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an interesting artifact! It appears to be a communications badge with a weapon piecing a planet.
STH_relic_hunters.120.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an interesting artifact! It appears to be a communications badge with an avian hovering over a three-pointed star with a central V.
STH_relic_hunters.121.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered a pair of interesting weapons! They appear to be an ornate sword and an explosive projectile weapon.
STH_relic_hunters.201.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on supplying the necessary £ crews to power the warships of the [From.GetName]. With trained crews, our vessels operate more efficiently in space and the demand for weaponry and transport grows. This is entirely exemplified within one rule.
STH_relic_hunters.201.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.202.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on supplying the necessary £ latinum to ensure the [From.GetName] has enough working capital to operate with. With enough capital all our needs can be accomplished. This is entirely exemplified within one rule.
STH_relic_hunters.202.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.203.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring the health of the population is maintained within the [From.GetName]. With enough healthy workers, profit is assured.
STH_relic_hunters.203.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.204.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring a well fed population amongst the [From.GetName]. With enough £ food distributed amongst the workers, profit is assured.
STH_relic_hunters.204.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.205.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring that we can expand our influence throughout the galaxy. With enough £ influence our businesses can grow.
STH_relic_hunters.205.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.206.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring that we can expand our research and development throughout the [From.GetName]. With enough research our businesses can maintain their edge.
STH_relic_hunters.206.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.207.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit.One principle says that we should focus on ensuring that we have enough basic resources throughout the [From.GetName] to deal with thirst. With enough water our worlds can ensure the population never wants for something that is so common at home.
STH_relic_hunters.207.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.301.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked a massive resurgence in our engineering divisions research reads similar to Kiri-Kin-Tha's teachings that 'Nothing unreal exists', a logical expression of how mathematics takes place abstractly. If you attempt to model something in reality with maths and logic then sometimes one can end up drawing absurd conclusions about reality itself.

By stating outright 'Nothing unreal exists' and accepting this as part of our philosophy, it serves as a reminder that as soon as we start thinking abstractly we lose relevance. It is not so much an axiom as a warning to unnecessary abstraction.
STH_relic_hunters.301.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.302.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked a massive resurgence in our sociologists research reads similar to the teachings in the Kol-Ut-Shan, or more commonly known as IDIC - Infinite Diversity in Infinite Combinations. If you attempt to close off any part of diversity simply because you do not like it, you close off infinite possible combinations.

By embracing the Kol-Ut-Shan which symbolises the vast variables and elements in the galaxy that create truth and beauty, it serves as a reminder that we should not close ourselves off to any path just because it is different, and instead we should embrace the differences between us.
STH_relic_hunters.302.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.303.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked a large following within our populace reiterates part of what we already teach - 'The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few, or the one', one of the cornerstones of our philosophy.

By embracing this teaching we can ensure all who come to serve within the Vulcan Expeditionary Group or the Science Academy are serving the entirety of Vulcan. This should boost recruitment substantially.
STH_relic_hunters.303.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.304.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked been discovered appears to be an early version of T'Plana-Hath's statement that 'Logic is the cement of our civilisation with which we ascend from chaos using reason as our guide'.

By understanding these teachings we can understand how the Vulcans ancestors and history have progressed to create the future we live in now. The logical extension of these teachings is that whilst logic may not solve all our problems, as long as it remains a foundation upon which we may build our society and research we may deepen our understanding of the universe.
STH_relic_hunters.304.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.305.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such heavily damaged section that has recently been restored by a student has sparked a discussion stating that Logic is not the be all and end all of the Vulcan philosophy. It states that pure logic will make Vulcan's weak and helpless, something that their rituals and traditional Kahs-wan seeks to prevent.

The discovery of this section has caused members of society from all branches to return many luxuries to society and live out a more simple life.
STH_relic_hunters.305.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.500.desc: The writings of 'The Never-Ending Sacrifice' are considered by many scholars to be the epitome of Cardassian literature and of the repetitive epic. The novel covers seven generations of the same family as they overcome the trials facing the Cardassian state as they live selfless lives working for the betterment of the State.
STH_relic_hunters.500.name: Literature Review
STH_relic_hunters.501.desc: The writings of 'Enigma Tales' by Shoggoth are considered by many scholars to be a fine example of mystery within the repetitive epic. The novel covers numerous suspects, all being found guilty of similar crimes, but the mystery lies in the discovery of who exactly was guilty of what.
STH_relic_hunters.501.name: Literature Review
STH_relic_hunters.502.desc: The wartime epic 'Meditations of a Crimson Shadow' by Eleta Preloc is considered to be a prime example of the collective state overcoming vast and vicious Empires across the galaxy, each more vicious and unruly than the last. The novel covers invasions of nearby Empires such as the United Federation of Planets and Klingons, and features propaganda in how it portrays how each seeks the destruction of the Cardassian Union.
STH_relic_hunters.502.name: Literature Review
STH_relic_hunters.700.desc: If we want to plunder the wealth of the Galaxy, we must first select a target.
STH_relic_hunters.7000.desc: The [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] has hired a team of relic hunters to steal our cultural treasures! Fortunatly, our brave [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetInternalSecurityName] forces were able to stop them!
STH_relic_hunters.7001.desc: A routine inspection of our vaults has discovered that one of our cultural relics has been stolen! Forensic examiners have turned up nothing!
STH_relic_hunters.7002.desc: The [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] has hired a team of relic hunters to steal our cultural treasures! Our [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetInternalSecurityName] forces were unable to stop them!
STH_relic_hunters.7003.desc: Our intelligence agency has uncovered that the [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] was the one who hired a team of relic hunters to steal our cultural treasures!
STH_relic_hunters.701.desc: Now that we have decided to take the cultural riches of the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], we must find persons of an adventurous and amoral nature that are willing to take the job. We have made contact with several groups, each with their own specialties:
STH_relic_hunters.702.desc: Now that we have selected a group of specialists to take the cultural riches of the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], we must decide how much we want to pay them for the job, as well as how much backing (both financial and material) we wish to give them:
STH_relic_hunters.8001.desc: We have obtained the cultural relics of the [LastKilledCountryName] to be placed in out vaults!
STH_relics_flavour.1001.desc: El uso del inyector modificado en las altas concentraciones de radiación metafásica dentro de los anillos de Ba'ku ha proporcionado una gran cantidad de partículas metafásicas que se pueden utilizar para avanzar en la ciencia médica y extender la vida útil a través de [Root.GetName].
STH_relics_flavour.1001.name: Reacción termolítica
STH_relics_flavour.101.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han formado la base de nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. ¡Nuestro principio rector a lo largo del Gran Río Material debería centrarse en suministrar el necesario £ crew £ crews para impulsar los buques de guerra de [From.GetName]. Con tripulaciones capacitadas, nuestras embarcaciones operan de manera más eficiente en el espacio y la demanda de armamento y transporte crece. Esto se ejemplifica por completo dentro de una regla.
STH_relics_flavour.101.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.102.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han formado la base de nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. ¡Nuestro principio rector a lo largo del Gran Río Material debería centrarse en suministrar el necesario £ latinum £ latinum para garantizar que [From.GetName] tenga suficiente capital de trabajo para operar. Con suficiente capital se pueden cumplir todas nuestras necesidades. Esto se ejemplifica por completo dentro de una regla.
STH_relics_flavour.102.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.103.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han formado la base de nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. Nuestros principios rectores deben centrarse en garantizar que la salud de la población se mantenga dentro de [From.GetName]. Con suficientes trabajadores sanos, el beneficio está asegurado. El Gran Río Material nos proveerá.
STH_relics_flavour.103.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.104.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han formado la base de nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. Nuestros principios rectores deben centrarse en garantizar una población bien alimentada entre [From.GetName]. Con suficiente £ food £ food distribuido entre los trabajadores, el beneficio está asegurado. El Gran Río Material nos proveerá.
STH_relics_flavour.104.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.105.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han guiado a nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. Nuestros principios rectores deben centrarse en garantizar que podamos expandir nuestra influencia en toda la galaxia. Con suficiente £ influencia £ influence Nuestros negocios pueden crecer. El Gran Río Material nos proveerá.
STH_relics_flavour.105.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.106.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han formado la base de nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. Nuestros principios rectores deben centrarse en garantizar que podamos expandir nuestra investigación y desarrollo a lo largo de [From.GetName]. Con suficiente investigación, nuestras empresas pueden mantener su ventaja. El Gran Río Material nos proveerá.
STH_relics_flavour.106.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.107.desc: Nuestro estudio de las antiguas Reglas de Adquisiciones que han formado la base de nuestra civilización durante siglos finalmente ha dado sus frutos. Nuestros principios rectores deben centrarse en garantizar que tengamos suficientes recursos básicos en todo [From.GetName] para hacer frente a la sed. Con suficiente agua, nuestros mundos pueden garantizar que la población nunca quiera algo que es tan común en el hogar. El Gran Río Material nos proveerá.
STH_relics_flavour.107.name: Lectura Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.1300.desc:
Un comerciante humanoide se acercó a uno de los puestos avanzados de comercio de [Root.GetName] y nos ofreció un artefacto que supuestamente puede doblar el tiempo durante un período determinado. De dónde vino el artefacto o cómo funciona es un misterio. 

¿Qué debemos hacer?
STH_relics_flavour.1300.name: Comerciante que pasa
STH_relics_flavour.1301.desc:
El poder de doblar el tiempo, aunque dentro de una ventana límite, nos ofrece la capacidad única de lograr objetivos que de otra manera serían imposibles. 

 [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] los asesores han brindado numerosas opciones para el portador del dispositivo donde un ciclo de tiempo podría ser extremadamente efectivo.
STH_relics_flavour.1301.name: Dispositivo de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1302.desc: Después del estrés de su uso reciente, el dispositivo de cristal de tiempo parece haberse fracturado, fragmentando su energía varias veces. El dispositivo se ha vuelto inútil.
STH_relics_flavour.1302.name: Dispositivo de cristal de tiempo destruido
STH_relics_flavour.1303.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo a nuestro agente eludir todas las medidas de seguridad de un banco privado fuera del mundo. 

 Al derrotar las cerraduras magnéticas y memorizar y recitar el código de diez mil dígitos, se omitieron todas las defensas de la bóveda permitiendo el transporte de todos los bienes contenidos, algunos de los cuales son obras invaluables de cientos de civilizaciones. 

 El tesoro ha llegado a [Root.Capital.GetName] y está listo para [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] 's lectura concienzuda.
STH_relics_flavour.1303.name: Robo de dispositivo de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1304.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, lo que permite a nuestro agente eludir todas las medidas de seguridad menos estrictas de un banco privado fuera del mundo. 

 Al derrotar las cerraduras magnéticas y los escáneres visuales, se omitieron las defensas de la bóveda exterior permitiendo el transporte de algunos del latinum dentro. 

 El botín ha llegado a [Root.Capital.GetName] y está listo para el examen de [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName].
STH_relics_flavour.1304.name: Robo de dispositivo de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1305.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, lo que permite a nuestro agente eludir todas las medidas de seguridad menos estrictas de un banco privado fuera del mundo. 

 Al derrotar las cerraduras magnéticas y los escáneres visuales, se omitieron las defensas de la bóveda exterior permitiendo el transporte de algunos Sin embargo, la alarma se activó antes de que todo el botín pudiera ser transportado. 

 El agente recibió una herida y dañó el dispositivo de cristal de tiempo, que está siendo examinado para determinar si la explosión ha causado un daño irreparable.
STH_relics_flavour.1305.name: Robo de dispositivo de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1306.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo que [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] cuestione y desafíe repetidamente a todos aquellos en el círculo interno del gobierno, determinando mentiras y falsedades. 

Determinando quién está trabajando para quién , y en quién se puede confiar activamente, [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha iniciado una purga de todos los miembros desleales del gobierno. 

Los leales dentro de las filas ahora garantizarán que la estabilidad sea alta entre la población durante los próximos años. .
STH_relics_flavour.1306.name: Interrogatorios de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1307.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo que [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] cuestione y desafíe repetidamente a algunos de los miembros del círculo interno del gobierno, determinando mentiras y falsedades. 

Determinando quién está trabajando para quién , y en quién se puede confiar activamente, [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] ha iniciado una purga de algunos miembros desleales del gobierno. 

Los leales dentro de las filas ahora asegurarán que la estabilidad sea alta entre la población durante los próximos años. .
STH_relics_flavour.1307.name: Interrogatorios de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1308.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser valioso, permitiendo que [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] cuestione y desafíe repetidamente a algunos de los miembros del círculo interno del gobierno, en un esfuerzo por determinar mentiras y falsedades. 

 Desafortunadamente el dispositivo resultó dañado en un accidente, y la deslealtad no descubierta dentro de los detalles de seguridad asignados para purgar a los traidores ha permitido que muchos escapen al subsuelo. 

Estos traidores trabajarán activamente contra [Root.GetName] durante los próximos años.
STH_relics_flavour.1308.name: Interrogatorios de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1309.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo que [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] desafíe a todos los que se oponen a su regla y los derrote en combate único. 

Combate a los oponentes repetidamente hasta que se descubran sus debilidades, el [Root .GetLeaderTitle] ha prevalecido. 

Los leales dentro del gobierno ahora garantizarán que la estabilidad sea alta entre la población durante los próximos años.
STH_relics_flavour.1309.name: Time Crystal Combat
STH_relics_flavour.1310.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo que [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] desafíe a algunos de los que se oponen a su regla y los derrote en combate único. 

Combate a los oponentes repetidamente hasta que se descubran sus debilidades, o evita pelea con aquellos que [Root.GetLeaderTitle] no pudo vencer, [Root.GetLeaderName] ha prevalecido principalmente. 

Los leales dentro del gobierno ahora asegurarán que la estabilidad sea alta entre la población durante los próximos años.
STH_relics_flavour.1310.name: Time Crystal Combat
STH_relics_flavour.1311.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo inicialmente demostró ser valioso, permitiendo que [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] desafiara a algunos de los que se oponían a su regla y los derrotó en combate único, hasta que ocurrió el desastre. 

Un desafortunado duelo donde el dispositivo de cristal de tiempo fue golpeado por un arma del oponente, lo que provocó que el dispositivo se volviera temporalmente disfuncional y se abriera dentro de las defensas de [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], lo que resultó en su muerte.
STH_relics_flavour.1311.name: Time Crystal Combat
STH_relics_flavour.1312.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo a los científicos dentro de [Root.GetName] llevar a cabo experimentos peligrosos y letales sin tener en cuenta las medidas de seguridad. 

 Al probar repetidamente procesos volátiles, los científicos han logrado avances sustanciales en campos particulares \. n \ nLos resultados deberían estar disponibles para su lectura en breve.
STH_relics_flavour.1312.name: Experimentos de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1313.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser invaluable, permitiendo a los científicos dentro de [Root.GetName] realizar experimentos peligrosos y de otra manera letales sin tener en cuenta las medidas de seguridad. 

 Al probar repetidamente procesos volátiles, los científicos han logrado avances moderados dentro de campos particulares \. n \ nLos resultados deberían estar disponibles para su lectura en breve.
STH_relics_flavour.1313.name: Experimentos de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1314.desc:
El dispositivo de cristal de tiempo ha demostrado ser valioso, ya que permite a los científicos dentro de [Root.GetName] llevar a cabo experimentos peligrosos y de otro modo letales sin tener en cuenta las medidas de seguridad. 

Al probar repetidamente los procesos volátiles, los científicos han hecho pequeños avances en campos particulares, sin embargo un experimento dañó ligeramente el cristal del tiempo, lo que provocó que los experimentos llegaran a un final temprano. 

Los resultados deberían estar disponibles para su lectura en breve, mientras que el cristal entra para reparaciones.
STH_relics_flavour.1314.name: Experimentos de cristal de tiempo
STH_relics_flavour.1315.desc:
Los cristales de tiempo son minerales raros nativos de solo unos pocos lugares dentro de la galaxia, y a menudo están fuertemente protegidos. El poder de manipular el tiempo es un arma diferente a cualquier otro, y estos cristales deben nutrirse en nuestros planetas en lugar de explotarse. 

Después de plantar el dispositivo de cristal de tiempo en una antigua caverna en uno de nuestros mundos, ha comenzado a brotar: formando cristales de tiempo más pequeños pero aún viables de la roca cercana.
STH_relics_flavour.1315.name: Time Crystal Nurture
STH_relics_flavour.1400.desc:
La reactivación del dron Echo Papa hace que se mueva amenazadoramente y vibre con poder. Se detecta una señal que emana del dispositivo, y un vendedor holográfico aparece repentinamente como una proyección del dron. 

 Al escuchar la holoproyección, parece que este dron tiene una potencia bastante limitada, pero puede usarse temporalmente en un terreno o Rol espacial. Alternativamente, podríamos comprar el stock restante de estos drones y colocarlos en nuestros mundos, mejorando la efectividad de los ejércitos defensivos.
STH_relics_flavour.1400.name: Echo Papa Drones
STH_relics_flavour.1500.desc:
Esta máscara sirve como un recordatorio de cuándo el Archivo D'Arsay intentó reactivar y restaurar la antigua civilización D'Arsay que se creía perdida hace milenios. 

¿Qué puede hacer el archivo por nosotros ahora?
STH_relics_flavour.1500.name: Archivo D'Arsay
STH_relics_flavour.1601.desc:
Los extraterrestres que se retratan a sí mismos como un equipo de arqueólogos dicen que han descubierto un misterioso artefacto de poder inigualable del futuro. 

 Llamado '' ¡YTox Uthat '', Lo han fechado desde hace algunos siglos, y ellos creen que es un inhibidor de fase cuántica que puede causar que toda fusión dentro de una estrella cese, terminando efectivamente la vida de esa estrella. 

 Están ofreciéndola a la venta por una suma sustancial.
STH_relics_flavour.1601.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1602.desc: Contra todo pronóstico, nuestros servicios de seguridad no han podido detener a los arqueólogos y su artefacto conocido como Tox Uthat§ !. Parece que recibieron ayuda de dos Vorgons. Por ahora no hay duda de que se ha vendido a otro imperio.
STH_relics_flavour.1602.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1603.desc:
Dos ladrones han entrado en una de nuestras instalaciones de almacenamiento donde el Tox Uthat se lleva a cabo durante una visita de estado por [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName]. 

Con sus detalles de seguridad aturdidos a su alrededor, y con Vorgons armados presionándolos, [Root.GetLeaderName] tiene que tomar una decisión. ..
STH_relics_flavour.1603.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1604.desc:
Con el Tox Uthat aparentemente destruidos por [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] los Vorgons guardan sus armas y comienzan a explicarse. 

 Parece que han viajado desde el futuro como muestran sus registros [Root.GetLeaderName]. destruir el dispositivo, pero un tercero intentaba interferir. Al destruir el Tox Uthat aquí han asegurado el futuro para ellos mismos. 

Haciendo una salida rápida en un remolino de energía temporal, los Vorgon regresan al futuro, justo cuando los detalles de seguridad comienzan a recuperarse del aturdimiento.
STH_relics_flavour.1604.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1605.desc:
Después de muchos años almacenados de forma segura en un sitio seguro, el Tox Uthat se ha registrado que emana energía en una escala nunca antes vista. 

 Al aprovechar esta energía temporal podemos mejorar sustancialmente la velocidad de disparo del armamento en nuestros buques.
STH_relics_flavour.1605.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1606.desc:
Mientras que el Tox Uthat no parece estar totalmente alimentado, todavía produce una magnífica cantidad de energía. 

 Al aprovechar esta energía temporal, podemos mejorar la velocidad de disparo del armamento en nuestras naves sustancialmente durante un período.
STH_relics_flavour.1606.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1607.desc:
Con el Tox Uthat ahora en manos de los Vorgons, guardan sus armas y comienzan a explicarse. 

 Parece que han viajado desde el futuro, ya que sus registros muestran que [Root.GetLeaderName] fue el que almacenó el dispositivo de forma segura durante un tiempo , mientras un tercero intentaba interferir. Al destruir el Tox Uthat aquí han asegurado el futuro para ellos mismos. 

Haciendo una salida rápida en un remolino de energía temporal, los Vorgon regresan al futuro, justo cuando los detalles de seguridad comienzan a recuperarse del aturdimiento. Queda una gran suma de materiales valiosos, pago por un trabajo bien hecho.
STH_relics_flavour.1607.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1700.desc:
Un examen más detallado del núcleo de datos encriptados recuperados de la embarcación de la Sección 31 ha revelado algunos códigos de comunicación a escondrijos escondidos ubicados alrededor de la galaxia con lo que parece estar destruido o confiscado embarcaciones piratas. 

Las frecuencias cambian continuamente entre códigos conocidos y desconocidos, y una vez que se usa uno, los otros dejarán de funcionar por un tiempo. ¿Con qué sitio debemos intentar contactar?
STH_relics_flavour.1700.name: Códigos de inteligencia
STH_relics_flavour.1800.desc:
Un examen más detallado del núcleo de datos temporales encriptados recuperados de la nave enterrada que no era de nuestro tiempo ha revelado algunos códigos de comunicaciones a escondrijos escondidos ubicados alrededor de la galaxia con lo que parecen ser naves almacenadas. 

Las frecuencias cambian continuamente entre lo conocido y lo desconocido códigos, y una vez que se usa uno, los demás dejarán de funcionar por un tiempo.
STH_relics_flavour.1800.name: Cifrado temporal
STH_relics_flavour.2001.desc:
Un arqueólogo vulcano se ha acercado a nosotros, contando una historia de un dispositivo antiguo llamado '' ¡Piedra del Gol! ' que era un arma antigua concebida en Vulcano durante los tiempos turbulentos antes del Tiempo del Despertar. 

Hasta hace poco se creía que había sido destruida por los dioses Vulcanos, pero en realidad, el arma se desarmó en el Tiempo del Despertar y sus tres las piezas se han dispersado en grandes distancias del espacio. 

El arqueólogo busca reunir las piezas y estudiarlas, pero se asegurará de que recibamos la reliquia después.
STH_relics_flavour.2001.name: Arqueólogo vulcano
STH_relics_flavour.2002.desc:
La primera parte de la Piedra de Gol se encuentra en el planeta Vulcano, bajo la guardia de muchos monjes y sacerdotes. 

El arqueólogo nos presiona para que hagamos contacto para recuperar el artefacto.
STH_relics_flavour.2002.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.201.desc:
La destrucción del poderoso dispositivo de destrucción de planetas dejó trozos de material recuperable pero inerte para una mayor experimentación. Nuestro estudio del antiguo material del casco que se encuentra dentro de Doomsday Machine ha permitido a nuestros científicos obtener algunas ideas sobre su historia. 

Primero, en función de la trayectoria y el curso relativos de Doomsday Machine, podemos suponer que proviene de fuera de la galaxia . 

 En segundo lugar, el casco es de neutronio puro, un material que solo hemos observado en lo profundo de ciertas estrellas y cuya fabricación está mucho más allá de nuestra comprensión actual. 

 Finalmente, la prueba de fuego de armas contra el trozo de casco de neutrón ha proporcionado nosotros con valiosos comentarios sobre cómo reaccionan las armas a materiales casi invulnerables.
STH_relics_flavour.201.name: Doomsday Machine Fragment
STH_relics_flavour.2010.desc: El curador del museo se ha negado a prestarnos el artefacto. Hay numerosas opciones ante nosotros.
STH_relics_flavour.2010.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.2011.desc:
Después de algunos reveses, la primera parte de la Piedra del Gol está a nuestro alcance. El arqueólogo de Vulcan está extasiado con esta noticia, y muestra una rara muestra de exuberancia de Vulcan. 

 Al escanear la firma de carbono única de Stone, hemos localizado un segundo sitio que puede contener otra parte.
STH_relics_flavour.2011.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.202.desc:
La experimentación adicional sobre el Fragmento del Día del Juicio Final ha proporcionado información más profunda. Cada rama ha logrado descubrir nueva información sobre la máquina. 

Nuestros sociólogos y equipos de astrometría han logrado calcular un camino de destrucción a través de la galaxia que ha destruido mundos completamente y destruyendo numerosas civilizaciones anteriores a la urdimbre. Los equipos de ingenieros han descubierto algunos defectos de fabricación dentro de los fragmentos del casco, lo que demuestra que esto fue creado por seres tan falibles como nosotros. Finalmente, la fuerza del material es casi invulnerable al fuego de nuestras armas, sin embargo, parece que este es el casco interno de la máquina, con el casco externo despojado de milenios en el pasado. 

Estos hallazgos son bastante inquietantes, ya que parece que alguna vez existieron razas más grandes y poderosas.
STH_relics_flavour.202.name: Doomsday Machine Fragment
STH_relics_flavour.2021.desc:
A su llegada al mundo, las vastas selvas de abajo contrastan con las áridas llanuras de Vulcano. Se cree que la segunda parte de la Piedra está aquí, ubicada en un antiguo santuario de Vulcano. 

El arqueólogo explica que cuando los exiliados abandonaron Vulcano, algunos se separaron en recipientes más pequeños para vivir el resto de sus días aislados. 

 No pasa mucho tiempo antes de que los túneles se encuentren en la superficie, lo que lleva a las profundidades subterráneas.
STH_relics_flavour.2021.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.2022.desc:
Después de limpiar muchas de las cuevas que han sucedido en esta red de cavernas, está claro que alguien ya nos ha derrotado aquí. Un cadáver, expirado hace menos de un año, encontrado dentro de una de las cámaras murió a causa de una explosión disruptiva. 

 Afortunadamente, parece que quien estuvo aquí no encontró todo, ya que el arqueólogo puede señalar rápidamente habitaciones ocultas y cámaras ocultas lejos. Entre otros objetos de valor, se encuentra la segunda parte de la Piedra de Gol. 

 Volviendo a la superficie, uno de los equipos de seguridad nota un símbolo en el cadáver de los corsarios, tal vez una pista a la siguiente parte del artefacto ...
STH_relics_flavour.2022.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.203.desc:
La investigación en curso sobre el Fragmento del Juicio Final continúa brindando información profunda sobre la raza que una vez construyó este devastador buque. Cada rama tiene sus teorías, pero aquí están los últimos hallazgos. 

La Máquina del Juicio Final definitivamente vino de fuera de la Barrera Galáctica, potencialmente llegando desde la Galaxia de Andrómeda o más preocupante aún más lejos. La puntuación a lo largo del fragmento del casco sugiere numerosas batallas sostenidas contra armamento antiprotón. La cantidad de neutronio dentro del casco casi garantiza un nivel de ingeniería estelar mucho más allá de la tecnología actual. 

Las máquinas Doomsday parecen requerir una gran cantidad de material para reponerse, de ahí la destrucción de mundos enteros para alimentar sus fábricas internas. Teóricamente, el consumo de grandes recipientes debería ser posible y sería mucho más beneficioso que solo la materia prima. La investigación adicional sobre el fragmento probablemente proporcionará resultados a lo largo del mismo camino.
STH_relics_flavour.203.name: Doomsday Machine Fragment
STH_relics_flavour.2031.desc:
Localizar a los corsarios es una tarea simple con los recursos disponibles para [Root.GetLeaderName], pero a medida que el equipo visitante se prepara para partir hacia el sitio de aterrizaje, una antigua estructura en ruinas, un barco intenta escapar de la superficie. 

 Los sensores indican que la embarcación, que está marcada con el símbolo de los corsarios, no tiene la última parte de la Piedra de Gol a bordo. ¿Cuáles son sus órdenes a la tripulación antes de emitir a la superficie?
STH_relics_flavour.2031.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.2032.desc:
A medida que el equipo llega a la estructura, está claro que se ha vaciado a toda prisa, con muchos artículos personales y maquinaria dejados atrás. 

 Parece que el equipo estaba casi en la sala final, pero le faltaba el conocimiento vulcano sobre cómo hacerlo. Encuentra y abre las puertas ocultas. Con el arqueólogo vulcano con el equipo de búsqueda, se encuentra la última parte de la piedra. ¡Mientras [Root.GetLeaderName] entrega la última parte de la Stone of the Gol para que el arqueólogo vulcano lo examine, lo toman y ensamblan el antiguo dispositivo, que comienza a vibrar notablemente con poder. 

 ¡El arqueólogo recurre al equipo y exige que te rindas, o usarán el arma contra ti!
STH_relics_flavour.2032.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.204.desc: Whilst attempting to investigate the fragment it looks like a small self destruct sequence has been initiated and the fragment explodes in a small, but harmless burst of smoke and sparks.
STH_relics_flavour.204.name: Doomsday fragment destroyed
STH_relics_flavour.2041.desc: Cuando [From.GetLeaderName] y los detalles de seguridad sacan sus armas, el dispositivo estalla con una onda psiónica que se extiende y mata a todos los miembros del equipo. Cuando se envía una nueva tripulación desde [From.GetName] solo quedan cuerpos y no hay signos del arqueólogo vulcano o de la Piedra de Gol.
STH_relics_flavour.2041.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.2042.desc: El dispositivo comienza a emitir una onda psiónica que se detiene rápidamente cuando una explosión de [From.GetLeaderName] golpea al arqueólogo en el cofre, dejándolo caer al suelo - muerto. La Piedra del Gol golpea inofensivamente al suelo.
STH_relics_flavour.2042.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.2043.desc: [From.GetLeaderName] ordena a su equipo que suelte sus armas, ya que el arqueólogo dispara una explosión psiónica al equipo. Pasa inofensivamente al equipo ahora entregado, que se da cuenta de que no puede dañarlos. Antes de que la Piedra de Gol pueda usarse nuevamente, [From.GetLeaderName] toma su arma y aturde al arqueólogo. La Piedra del Gol golpea inofensivamente al suelo.
STH_relics_flavour.2043.name: Piedra de gol
STH_relics_flavour.2044.desc:
[From.GetLeaderName] ordena a su equipo que suelte sus armas, ya que el arqueólogo dispara una explosión psiónica al equipo. En pánico, el equipo alcanza sus armas, pero son alcanzados por la explosión psiónica antes de disparar, dejando sus cuerpos sin vida en el piso. 

Cuando se envía un nuevo equipo desde [From.GetName] solo quedan cuerpos y ninguna señal del arqueólogo vulcano o la piedra de Gol.
