STH_war.44.desc: Nuestro equipo de extracción ha recuperado con éxito al científico sin ser detectado por [war_country_defector.GetName], están siendo tratados por nuestros médicos y deberían estar listos para hablar con nosotros en breve.
STH_war.44.name: Defector recuperado con éxito
STH_war.45.desc: Nuestro equipo de extracción ha recuperado con éxito al científico sin ser detectado por [war_country_defector.GetName], están siendo tratados por nuestros médicos y deberían estar listos para hablar con nosotros en breve.
STH_war.45.name: Defector recuperado con éxito
STH_war.46.desc: Saludos [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], humildemente gracias por el rescate y por extraerme. Esta guerra ha durado demasiado y se están poniendo en peligro vidas inocentes, mi trabajo se está utilizando para prolongar el esfuerzo de guerra y no puedo ver el trabajo de mi vida de esta manera. Gracias por la ayuda
STH_war.46.name: Desertor desea hablar con nosotros
STH_war.47.desc: [Root.GetRulerName], su intervención oportuna ha llegado en el momento oportuno, mi investigación y mi vida son demasiado valiosas como para desperdiciarlas trabajando para mi antiguo imperio. Siento que puedo lograr mucho más con sus recursos, pero primero debemos ganar esta guerra y me aseguraré de que se haga. ¡Conmigo a tu lado no podemos perder! Pero mi lealtad tiene un precio, ¿no puedes esperar que arriesgue mi vida por nada ...?
STH_war.47.name: Desertor desea hablar con nosotros
STH_war.48.desc: Hemos completado con éxito la operación y recuperado el desertor del territorio enemigo, esto nos ayudará en nuestros esfuerzos de guerra. Deberíamos devolver nuestras flotas a nuestro espacio. Ahora podemos asignar al miembro más nuevo de nuestro equipo científico para que trabaje para nosotros.
STH_war.48.name: Operación del desertor completada con éxito
STH_war.49.desc: El desertor fue fiel a su palabra y nos ha proporcionado información de encuestas e investigaciones críticas que ayudarán en gran medida a nuestra investigación científica. Como parte del trato, han pedido que se les dé acceso a un transbordador y se les permita encontrar un hogar dentro de nuestras fronteras.
STH_war.49.name: Operación del desertor completada con éxito
STH_war.50.desc: El desertor nos traicionó, recibimos un mensaje codificado de una banda de piratas que nos regalaron nuestra ubicación, antes de que pudiéramos detenerlos, habían robado un transbordador y se habían ido a la flota pirata. Parece que traicionado está en su naturaleza. Solo podemos esperar que no hayan causado demasiado daño
STH_war.50.name: ¡Hemos sido traicionados!
STH_war.501.desc:
Following the defeat of [destroyed_fleet.GetName] our military experts have concluded that the war does not go well for us, recent defeats and an increasing exhaustion at the war have taken a heavy toll on our forces.

Many of our top military brass strongly recommend approaching one of our galactic allies to help ensure we are not defeated by [war_attacker_country.GetName].
STH_war.501.name: A call for help
STH_war.502.desc:
Our galactic neighbours [war_defender_country_1.GetName] have sent out an urgent SOS for help in their ongoing war with [war_attacker_country.GetName].

Recent defeats have severelly hit their military and they are at risk of losing the war. They have called on us for help. Should we go to their aid?
STH_war.502.name: A call for help
STH_war.503.desc:
After some deliberation it looks like [war_sos_help_country.GetName] has agreed to come to our aid and join the war alongside us.

Hopefully our combined forces will be able to turn the tide of this war and help us win.
STH_war.503.name: Aid in our darkest hour
STH_war.504.desc: After some deliberation it looks like [war_sos_help_country.GetName] has rejected our pleans for aid. If we are to win this war it will need to be with those already involved in the struggle.
STH_war.504.name: Abandoned by our neighbours
STH_war.505.desc: Our intelligence services have confirmed that [war_sos_help_country.GetName] has joined the war against us on the side of our enemies. We now fight multiple enemies in our efforts to defeat [war_defender_country.GetName].
STH_war.505.name: [war_sos_help_country.GetName] joins the war against us
STH_war.51.desc: El desertor dejó un explosivo de plasma sin ser detectado a bordo de una de las naves de rescate, el daño a nuestra nave fue extenso. El desertor ahora está a bordo de las navespiratas en el sistema. La elección es nuestra, regresar al espacio amigable o vengarse.
STH_war.51.name: El barco ha sido saboteado.
STH_war.52.desc: El desertor nos traicionó, recibimos un mensaje codificado de una banda de piratas que nos regalaron nuestra ubicación, antes de que pudiéramos detenerlos, habían robado un transbordador y se habían ido a la flota pirata. Desafortunadamente no hemos podido contactar al Capitán, parece que fueron asesinados. Con el desertor ahora a bordo de las naves piratas en el sistema. La elección es nuestra, regresar al espacio amigable o vengarse.
STH_war.52.name: ¡Hemos sido traicionados!
STH_war.53.desc: El desertor nos traicionó, recibimos un mensaje codificado de una banda de piratas que nos regalaron nuestra ubicación, antes de que pudiéramos detenerlos, habían robado un transbordador y se habían ido a la flota pirata. Nuestros escaneos muestran que una enorme flota pirata ha entrado en el sistema y en un curso directo con nuestras naves, no podemos perder más naves, debemos defendernos
STH_war.53.name: ¡Hemos sido traicionados!
STH_war.54.desc: La misión se ha completado, ahora podemos usar la información para un buen uso en la guerra en curso contra [war_country_defector.GetName]
STH_war.54.name: Misión cumplida
STH_war.99.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] hemos recibido una información táctica de nuestros exploradores de largo alcance, nuestros tácticos creen que una invasión estratégica de estos sistemas identificados podría proporcionarnos recursos adicionales que serán valiosos en nuestros esfuerzos de guerra en curso
STH_war.99.name: Sistema dirigido a la adquisición hostil
STH_war_story.10.desc:
As our ships drop out of warp, it is clear we have dropped into an ambush... by vessels flying the flag of [Root.GetName], how could this be? Someone is clearly trying to set us up... 

It matters not we must stop this attack and uncover what is going on here.
STH_war_story.10.name: Ambush!
STH_war_story.101.desc:
With the conclusion of the war, generals on both sides of the conflict have recommended the creation of a Neutral Zone situated in the space between the Romulan Star Empire and the Federation. 

This zone will create a neutral space between the two powers that act as a buffer that many hope will keep the peace, the only remaining decision is to decide how long the zone should remain established.
STH_war_story.101.name: The Neutral Zone
STH_war_story.11.desc: Reports are coming in from our remote drones, they have begun their attack on our foes disguised as a fleet from United Earth. We shall task the fleet with causing as much damage as possible before retreating to ensure that no evidence links the attack back to the Star Empire.
STH_war_story.11.name: Drone Mission Update
STH_war_story.12.desc:
The combined efforts of our fleet and our hosts have managed to repel the attack on our allies, it is clear from the manner in which the ships operate and our ability to account for all our ships, these ships cannot be part of our fleet. 

With the fleet in retreat [earth_rom_unity_attack_drone.GetName] spots something unusual, one of the ships appears to shimmer and revert back into a small green vessel covered in what appears to be a series of antennae. 

With its shields down, there is no better chance to send in a strike team and find out who is behind these attacks!
STH_war_story.12.name: System Defended
STH_war_story.14.desc: Our remote drone command centre has provided some very concerning news, one of our remote ships was damaged during its confrontation with the Coalition forces and as a result, lost its holo-camouflage disguise. Whilst we have no evidence at the moment that the Coalition members have linked the ship back to us this is a concerning development.
STH_war_story.14.name: Drone Ship Boarded
STH_war_story.15.desc:
As [earth_rom_unity_attack_drone.GetName] and their team make their way through the ship, it is clear that the vessel is devoid of any crew, and the abundance of exposed conduits and data transfer networks suggest that the vessel is controlled externally. The team begins to follow the pulsing conduits in a bid to find the ship's command centre. 

Suddenly the unmistakable sound of the ship going to warp rings out, the Drone has gone to warp.
STH_war_story.15.name: Inside the Drone
STH_war_story.16.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] we have managed to re-establish contact with the damaged drone ship only to find that the Coalition forces have managed to infiltrate the ship. They could track the ship back to us and undo our efforts to destabilise the region. 

Our only option is to attempt to isolate the crew and force them to cease their investigations.
STH_war_story.16.name: Intruders onboard
STH_war_story.17.desc: The team successfully makes their way to what appears to be the vessel's control room, noting that the power conduits and data nodes all terminate at a central control console. Leading off from this is what appears to be an engineering station behind an access door. [earth_rom_unity_attack_drone.GetName] heads through the access door, if they can disable the ship's warp drive and download the data core the mysteries of this alien ship could be revealed.
STH_war_story.17.name: Inside the Drone
STH_war_story.18.desc:
With the Drones onboard sensors back online we are able to track the intruder's movements, in a stroke of good fortune we can see that one member of the party has entered the small engineering bay, quickly sealing the bay and locking the alien officer inside and isolated from their team. The technical team recommends boosting the power through the closest conduit to the alien leader causing the radiation levels to rise. 

We should test how attached they are to their crew and issue an ultimatum. Restore our access to the ship or lose their leader.
STH_war_story.18.name: Intruders onboard
STH_war_story.19.desc:
Suddenly the door to the engineering alcove slams shut trapping [earth_rom_unity_attack_drone.GetName] inside. The plasma conduits inside the room begin to come to life, flooding the room with potentially lethal radiation... A voice crackles over the ship's intercom, Intruders, we give you a simple choice, restore our access to the ship or your officer dies, you have five minutes.  

The choice appears simple, restore the ship's power or let their Captain die.
STH_war_story.19.name: Inside the Drone
STH_war_story.2.desc:
Greetings senators I am [valdore_romulan_leader.GetName] chief military adviser to the Praetor, I must make you aware of trouble building on our borders. The burgeoning alliance between the Humans, Andorians, Tellarites, and our despised cousins on Vulcan has moved from being mere hearsay to an actual possibility. Any alliance they form will turn them into a potential superpower and putting our borders at risk. 

It is time you allowed me to unleashed the holo-projection technology that my team has been working on and turn these races against each other.
STH_war_story.2.name: Threats to Romulus
STH_war_story.20.desc:
In a surprise move, the Coalition forces decide to sacrifice their leader, in another lifetime we could have respected this move as almost Romulan. However, the leader must die and the ship must not be allowed to fall into enemy hands.

Overload the engines, destroy the ship...
STH_war_story.20.name: They sacrifice their leader
STH_war_story.21.desc: As predicted the Coalition soldiers show no backbone in electing to save their leader from a most painful death. The engineering tech indicates that power has been restored to the drone, however, the intruders cannot be permitted to survive, despite our promise, With power restored prepare to disable artificial gravity and engage the engines, it is a shame they will not be able to survive this maneuver.
STH_war_story.21.name: Power restored to the Drone
STH_war_story.22.desc:
As [earth_rom_unity_attack_drone.GetName] breathes their last breath the boarding party takes solace that at least they have captured the drone, suddenly one of the team members notices that whilst their attention was focused on their dying leader the ships masters have managed to gain access to the ship's engines and set them to overload.

In the last few moments before the ship explodes the team are able to transmit a few bits of non-vital information about the craft in the hope their lives were not given in vain.
STH_war_story.22.name: Drones engines overload
STH_war_story.23.desc:
With the Drones destroyed at least the suspicion and tension between the Coalition members can be brought to an end, however, the source of these attacks remains much of a mystery. 

It is clear that some antagonistic force is keen to end the burgeoning alliance that has formed and it is unlikely to be the last attempt they make.
STH_war_story.23.name: Drones destroyed
STH_war_story.24.desc:
As the door slowly slides open, the crew help [earth_rom_unity_attack_drone.GetName] to their feet, before the Captain can berate them for giving in to their captors, the security chief pushes the Captain to the ground shortly before the console explodes into a shower of sparks. The lights in the command centre immediately go dark. 

The crew rush from the bridge.
STH_war_story.24.name: Captain freed
STH_war_story.25.desc:
As the boarding party rush to get into their EV suits sounds of explosions echo throughout the ship as a cascade of explosions rings out spelling the end of the drone vessel. 

The away team reach an airlock and with the data they managed to get clear of the ship before it is destroyed.
STH_war_story.25.name: Escape
STH_war_story.26.desc:
With the crew retrieved [Root.GetName] are able to investigate the information obtained from the vessel, and whilst the data provided enough information about the vessel to prevent any repeated attacks the owner of the ship remains elusive. 

Our scientists and security experts have drawn a connection between materials used in this craft and those used in the minefield attack previously.
STH_war_story.26.name: Crew Recovered
STH_war_story.27.desc: Bits and pieces of information are starting to filter in from our lost drone, destroyed by sabotage, worryingly it seems the intruders managed to escape with some important scans of the ship, and whilst we have no evidence to suggest that the Coalition is aware of our involvement, the senate has mandated that we cease our Drone program and focus on more direct means of subterfuge.
STH_war_story.27.name: Drone Destroyed
STH_war_story.3.desc: We are receiving a distress call from [rom_earth_war_unity_ship_1.GetName], the ship appears to have been attacked whilst on a routine mission. At this stage we have no view of who carried out this attack, we must first secure our ship and ensure our people are ok.
STH_war_story.3.name: Distress call from [rom_earth_war_unity_ship_1.GetName]
STH_war_story.30.desc:
My Praetor, the threat that both the military and Tal Shiar have been warning you of has finally come to haunt us. The Coalition of our enemies has finally formally united to form a new major power, calling themselves the United Federation of Planets. A despicable name for a weak entity, but our intelligence reports clearly show that this Federation is still looking to recruit. Before long they will be the major power in the Alpha/Beta Quadrants and an unstoppable danger to the Star Empire. 

We demand that now is the time to act and inflict damage onto them whilst they are still unifying their efforts into a single body.
STH_war_story.30.name: Threats to the Raptors Rule
STH_war_story.32.desc:
The skies above our homeworld have been filled with terrible green disrupter fire and the horrifying sound of plasma torpedos destroying our buildings and burning our people. 

The attack came swiftly and without warning, we must call on our allies for help.
STH_war_story.32.name: Homeworld Attacked
STH_war_story.33.desc:
As the northern hemisphere of [ufp_attacked_planet.GetName] slept a savage and unprovoked attack rained down on the colony. A fleet of ships filled the sky firing bolt of plasma and disrupter energy at the settlement. 

The attack ends as suddenly as it starts with no messages from the attackers.
STH_war_story.33.name: [ufp_attacked_planet.GetName] Attacked
STH_war_story.34.desc: President [Root.GetRulerName], your Federation of Planets promised [new_member_planet_owner.GetName] safety and protection as part of your union, yet we have been targeted because we bringing our worlds closer. Your promised us protection, so now we ask you make good on this promise. Help us.
STH_war_story.34.name: Incoming Message
STH_war_story.35.desc: Our failure to aid the attacked colony has not only damaged our reputation and our colonist's conviction that we will aid them when they are in need, but also we may have lost any chance of getting a vital clue to find out who has been attacking us.
STH_war_story.35.name: Failed to aid planet
STH_war_story.36.desc:
The aid we were able to provide has greatly helped the colony recover from the attack. 

Whilst amongst the colonists' many reports catching a glimpse at the attacking ships, describing giant winged raptors or birds of prey, interesting these reports match up with previous incidents where we were attacked from the shadows.
STH_war_story.36.name: Aid provided to Planet
STH_war_story.37.desc:
Our sensors in orbit of [attacked_member_planet2.GetName] have picked up a potential early warning sign that this world is about to be attacked by the same foes that has attacked us repeatedly over the last few years. 

We should send a fleet to engage and defend our border world and hopefully uncover who is attacking us.
STH_war_story.37.name: Another Planet under attack!
STH_war_story.38.desc: The second of our planned assaults against the Federation colony worlds is about to begin, our fleets are on route to once again rain down destruction on those hapless fools.
STH_war_story.38.name: Attack on the Federation
STH_war_story.39.desc: Thanks to the early warning provided our fleet has arrived just in time to face off against the mysterious attackers. We must stand firm and defeat the invaders and if possible give our forces enough time to uncover who is behind this.
STH_war_story.39.name: Attack in Progress
STH_war_story.40.desc:
Praetor, it is with great delight that I can report our forces were successfully able to infiltrate Federation space and launch an attack against one of their worlds. 

This will act as a clear message to anyone that the Federation alliance is weak and if they cannot even protect themselves, how can they protect future members.
STH_war_story.40.name: Attack Successful
STH_war_story.41.desc:
Our failure to defend our colony has not gone unnoticed by those worlds in and outside of the Federation, our security experts point out that this makes us appear weak and ripe for invasion. 

What little advance we may have had to go on the front foot has now been lost. We can only wait and see what will happen next.
STH_war_story.41.name: Failed to Defend our Planet
STH_war_story.43.desc:
We have demonstrated the weakness and cowardice that the Federation demonstrate, they failed to raise the muster to defend their own borders which demonstrates their lack of confidence in their military. Now is our time to attack and put these upstarts back into their place. 

We urge you now is the time to declare war!
STH_war_story.43.name: Weak Federation
STH_war_story.44.desc: For too long now you have expanded into territory that rightfully belongs to the Romulan Star Empire. we have threatened and warned you, attacked and harmed your people and yet you continue your goal of federating this quadrant. It ends here and now, Consider this a declaration of war from your betters.
STH_war_story.44.name: Romulans Declare War
STH_war_story.5.desc: The first trial of our Drone Ship appears to have been an unprecedented success, it's first attack managed to destroy its target. We are now engaging in phase 2 and framing their ally for the attack.
STH_war_story.5.name: Update from our Drone Ship
STH_war_story.50.name: Attack Averted
STH_war_story.51.desc: Praetor [romulan_star_empire.ruler.GetName], your continued attacks against the United Federation of Planets has been noted and will stop now, you have endangered the lives of our citizens and caused significant damage to our property. The Federation might be new, but we are not weak and we will defend ourselves against any and all threats.
STH_war_story.51.name: Confront the Romulans
STH_war_story.52.desc:
Praetor [romulan_star_empire.ruler.GetName], your continued attacks against the United Federation of Planets has been noted and will stop now, you have endangered the lives of our citizens and caused significant damage to our property. The Federation might be new, but we are not weak and we will defend ourselves against any and all threats. 

Prepare for War!
STH_war_story.52.name: Message from Earth
STH_war_story.53.desc:
Sirs, as the War against the Romulan's rages on our intelligence services have 'uncovered' strong evidence that the Romulans are using the planet [planet_cheron.GetName] as a massive staging ground to launch a full-scale offensive against [Root.capital_scope.GetName] in a bid to end the war quickly and cripple any chance we may have of launching a counter-offensive. 

A victory at [planet_cheron.GetName] could go a long way in winning this war for either side.
STH_war_story.53.name: Battle of [planet_cheron.GetName]
STH_war_story.54.desc: The Fleet has arrived at [planet_cheron.GetName] [planet_cheron_leader.GetName] knows that victory could be key to ending this war.
STH_war_story.54.name: Battle of [planet_cheron.GetName]
STH_war_story.55.desc: Our fleet has defeated the Romulan Flagship dealing the Romulans a crippling blow in their ongoing war against us. Only time will tell if the victory here will be enough to turn the tide of the war.
STH_war_story.55.name: Victory at [planet_cheron.GetName]
STH_war_story.58.desc:
Your attacks against our worlds end now Romulans! We have long suspected you of causing the death and destruction of our people and property. 

On this occasion we are giving you a final warning, your fleets are denied access to our territory and any further incursions will be met with the full force of our fleet.
STH_war_story.58.name: Message from Earth
STH_war_story.59.desc: It appears that our threats against the Romulans have convinced them to stand down and war has been averted. Whilst many within our colonies remain fearful of a repeat attack, it seems the Star Empire have withdrawn behind their borders for the time being.
STH_war_story.59.name: Romulan Empire Stands Down
STH_war_story.6.name: Ambush
STH_war_story.7.desc: Our fleet has held off the attack by our supposed allies, but before we could scan the ships they appear to self-destruct! This behaviour is very out of character and extremely concerning, we should contact them immediately and demand an explanation.
STH_war_story.7.name: Attack Defeated
STH_war_story.8.desc:
Our field units have reported back another successful attack by our holo-drone, successfully sowing the seeds of doubt amongst our foes. 

We should proceed with the next stage of our test and launch an attack against one of their worlds.
STH_war_story.8.name: Battle Report
STH_war_story.9.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]! You must explain the meaning behind the hostile intent coming from a fleet of your ships. Our outlying sensor stations have picked up a fleet of your ships on an inbound course with their defenses up and weapons registering as active. 

You will explain this act or it will lead to a response in kind!
STH_war_story.9.name: Ally under attack
STH_war_story.99.desc: With the war complete, thoughts turn to how we can avoid further wars, a number of proposals are on the table.
STH_war_story.99.name: To Secure the Peace
STH_warpcapable.10.desc: The Bajoran Kai formally invites us to visit one of their temples on Bajor, we are told this is a rare honour and a chance to experience first hand the importance the Bajoran faith has on the populace.
STH_warpcapable.10.name: Bajoran Temple Visit
STH_warpcapable.11.desc: [bajor_visit_leader.GetName] returns from their trip from the Bajoran surface feeling refreshed and enlightened and whilst they didn't hear from the Prophets the peace and tranquility of the setting has given them a fresh energy and a valuable life experience.
STH_warpcapable.11.name: Bajoran Temple Visit
STH_warpcapable.12.desc: On returning from the visit to Ktaria our away teams noticed that many Ktarians were using a strange single-player headset device worn over the ears and using a visual interface. On questioning the locals it turns out it is a new game sweeping the planet, the game displayed a grid pattern on which the player had to direct hovering disks into cone shaped objects over the course of multiple levels. The ever friendly Ktarians offer us the game to take away.
STH_warpcapable.12.name: A mysterious game
STH_warpcapable.14.desc: The Ktarian game was an instant success and played across our planets and even during downtime on our military ships, and it has had a fantastic effect on our people and military greatly improving the moral of everyone who played the game. However with all crazes they come and go and now the next big thing has come along and taken the spotlight.
STH_warpcapable.14.name: The Game
STH_warpcapable.15.desc:
The Ktarian game very quickly became a big hit amongst our people and was played across our cities and military installations, picking the game up was easy, putting it down was more difficult and the addictive nature of the game became apparent when many found they could not put it down. Thankfully a young wizkid was able to devise a cure using an optical burst from a modified palm beacon to counter the effect of the device on their bridge crew, subsequently programming the ship's internal lighting to broadcast the same frequency throughout the ship. 

Following this near miss the game has been banned across [Root.GetName].
STH_warpcapable.15.name: The Game
STH_warpcapable.17.desc: The Caves of Mak'ala were a series of interconnecting underground caves on Trill. Deep within these caves were kilometers of interconnecting pools of a milk-like substance which was the natural environment of the Trill symbionts. An invitation to visit the caves from the Guardians, a group of unjoined Trill who had devoted their lives to making sure the pools were perfect for the symbionts, is a great privilege.
STH_warpcapable.17.name: The Caves of Mak'ala
STH_warpcapable.18.desc: The caves contained many unjoined symbionts containing hundreds of years of experience between them passed across generations. Much knowledge could be gleaned from the Trill if the right questions are asked.
STH_warpcapable.18.name: The Caves of Mak'ala
STH_warpcapable.2.name: First Contact with the [warp_cap_contact_empire.GetName]
STH_warpcapable.20.desc: The planet Xahea has an abundance of natural Dilithium, which the locals are experts in harvesting, resulting in some of the purest Dilithium anywhere in the Quadrant. The friendly Xahean Council are willing to provide us with a sample of this Dilithium in exchange for a small quantity of minerals.
STH_warpcapable.20.name: Natural Dilithium
STH_warpcapable.21.desc: At the request of [primitive_visit_country.GetName] we have been invited to join a host of notable leader, military experts and scientists as part of an exchange of knowledge and culture at a conference on [primitive_capital_loc.GetName]. This will be an opportunity to represent [Root.GetName] and build relations with the [primitive_visit_country.GetName] should we want to.
STH_warpcapable.21.name: Knowledge Sharing
STH_warpcapable.22.desc: The conference was packed with some of the best scientific minds from across the hosts planet and despite our technological advances there were a few pieces of information that would be of interest to our scientists back on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] making this a worthwhile outing.
STH_warpcapable.22.name: Knowledge Sharing
STH_warpcapable.23.desc:
Despite the best efforts of the hosts there was little [prim_mission_leader.GetName] found to be of any real benefit. 

However pleasantries were upheld and useful contacts made, so it was not a complete waste of time.
STH_warpcapable.23.name: Knowledge Sharing
STH_warpcapable.24.desc: Our hosts were thrilled with our attendance at their conference and found the whole experience really enlightening, so much so that they have offered us a small reward as a token of their thanks for coming to their planet and sharing some of our knowledge and culture with them.
STH_warpcapable.24.name: Knowledge Sharing
STH_warpcapable.25.desc: Designated as a 'pleasure planet', Risa was an inhabited planet orbiting the primary Risa, originally a dismal, rain-soaked, and geologically unstable planet covered with vast jungles and plagued by violent earthquakes. However, the planet was transformed by the native Risians with a technologically sophisticated weather control system created the perfect paradise and an ideal location for shore leave. The Risans have offered one of our ships and crew some rest and relaxation.
STH_warpcapable.25.name: Risan Shore Leave
STH_warpcapable.26.desc: [risa_captain.GetName] and the crew of [risa_ship.GetName] return to duty following a fantastic shore leave with glowing reviews of the beautiful Risan sunsets and clear blue seas. The captain and crew feel refreshed and ready for their next mission.
STH_warpcapable.26.name: Risan Shore Leave
STH_warpcapable.27.desc: Not every holiday can be a good one, and despite the idyllic conditions events transpired to ruin the perfect shore leave. Lost luggage, and a malfunctioning weather system meant rain and glum moods. The crew of [risa_ship.GetName] were only too happy to return to the warmth and dryness of their own cabins.
STH_warpcapable.27.name: Risan Shore Leave
STH_warpcapable.5.name: Warp-Capable Species Contact
STH_warpcapable.50.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerName], I am [barzans_leader.GetTitle] [barzans_leader.GetName] leader of the Barzan Planetary Republic. We understand you would like to join the bidding for unique Wormhole. We have no interest in such things, but the Latinum from the sale would work wonders for our small world.
STH_warpcapable.50.name: The Barzan Wormhole
STH_warpcapable.51.desc: Bidding for the Wormhole is about to begin, [Root.GetName] has been joined by [barzan_bid_rival_1.GetName], [barzan_bid_rival_2.GetName], [barzan_bid_rival_3.GetName] all bidding for the prize. Our financial advisers have suggested that we could make one of three bids.
STH_warpcapable.51.name: The Barzan Wormhole
STH_warpcapable.52.desc:
After a tense auction process, the Barzan leaders are pleased to announce that we have won the bid and now have first rights to examine this supposed Wormhole and see what mysteries lurk on the other side.

We should send a science expedition to the site provided by the Barzan delegates and attempt to claim the exlusive gateway.
STH_warpcapable.52.name: The winning bid!
STH_warpcapable.54.desc: Despite winning the bid to secure access to the wormhole our scientists were unable to secure the mouth of the Wormhole and make its mysteries ours.
STH_warpcapable.54.name: Successfully won the Barzan Bid
STH_warpcapable.55.desc:
It appears our bid was not high enough to secure the auction and we lost out on the chance to examine the wormhole. The Barzan delegate cheerfully informs us that [barzan_winner.GetName] were successful in winning the bid.

As our scientists scan their efforts to open the wormhole it appears that they have failed to capitalise on their successful bid and the wormhole's entrance remains locked.
STH_warpcapable.55.name: Auction Lost, but Wormhole remains closed
STH_warpcapable.56.desc:
Our scientists are proud to confirm that following our successful bid to secure the location of the Barzan Wormhole, we have been able to trace the location of the wormhole as it bounces around the Barzan system. 

By applying a tachyon field we were able to force the location of the wormhole to remain stable and direct it into our teritory. The wormhole has now opened in [barzan_winner_system.GetName] and terminates in the [barzan_wormhole_destination.GetName] system.
STH_warpcapable.56.name: Barzan Wormhole secured
STH_warpcapable.57.desc: Following a tightly fought bidding process, [barzan_winner_country.GetName] secured the rights to the Barzan Wormhole and using a tachyon pulse secured the entrance in the [barzan_winner_system.GetName] System. The wormhole appears to exit in the [barzan_wormhole_destination.GetName] System.
STH_warpcapable.57.name: The Barzan Wormhole
STH_warpcapable.58.desc:
A mysterious new wormhole which appears to originate in the distant Alpha Quadrant has opened up in the [barzan_wormhole_destination.GetName].

Only time will tell if this is a fortuitous occurrence or a threat to our borders.
STH_warpcapable.58.name: The Barzan Wormhole
STH_warpcapable.6.desc: This civilisation has not yet left their homeworld and developed faster than light capabilities, and whilst their potential is limitless right now they need to progress on their own journey towards leaving their own planet and beyond if they are to ever influence the wider galaxy.
STH_warpcapable.6.name: Pre-Warp Cultures
STH_warpcapable.60.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle]! The crew of [barzan_ship.GetName] have reported back with good news. [barzan_ship_leader.GetName] and their crew have secured the entrance to the Barzan Wormhole and confirmed that it leads to the distant [barzan_wormhole_destination.GetName]. This new stable means of travel opens up new possibilities and opportunities for [Root.GetName].
STH_warpcapable.60.name: The Barzan Wormhole
STH_warpcapable.61.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] our science advisers are saddened to announce that [barzan_ship_leader.GetName] and the crew of [barzan_ship.GetName] was lost with all hands whilst investigating the mouth of the Barzan Wormhole. It seems the entrance shifted on the crew whilst they were traversing, it seems the forces within the wormhole during the shift overwhelmed the ship destroying it. 

To make matters worse we can no longer find any sign of the Wormhole and it appears to have been lost forever.
STH_warpcapable.61.name: [barzan_ship,GetName] Lost exploring Wormhole
STH_warpcapable.62.desc:
This is a distress call from T'Jon of the Ornaran Freighter Sanction, we have been damaged by a solar disruption from our Delos, our local star, we are in need of urgent assistance. 

We are on an urgent mission to deliver urgent supplies to our homeworld, failure to return the supplies could cost the lives of thousands back home, we need this fix, I mean fixed.
STH_warpcapable.62.name: Symbiosis
STH_warpcapable.63.desc:
Hello [ROOT.GetRulerName] you have reached the Brekkian Alliance, we believe you have received a communication from a freighter bound for Brekka. 

We are afraid that until we receive our payment the shipment of Felicium remains with us... I am sure you understand that this is basic business sense?
STH_warpcapable.63.name: Symbiosis
STH_warpcapable.64.desc:
Our engineering team has successfully managed to fix the Ornaran freighter, and whilst the damage was quite severe you should never underestimate the resourcefulness of a determined engineer. 

T'Jon thanks us for our help and sets course to resume his strange mission to Brekka.
STH_warpcapable.64.name: Symbiosis - Ship Fixed
STH_warpcapable.65.desc:
Unfortunately, some ships are simply too damaged to be salvaged, and unfortunately, the Sanction was one such ship. 

Which unusual panic the Ornarans accept our apologies and frantically begin looking for help elsewhere.
STH_warpcapable.65.name: Symbiosis - Unable to fix
STH_warpcapable.66.desc:
The medical team that we sent to investigate the Ornaran disease has come back with mixed results, the lead consultant firmly believes the drug they are desperately seeking has long since cured any traditional illness but has left them with terrible addiction. 

Despite all efforts no cure could be found to help the Ornarans combat this long-term addiction, the only option for them is to choose to go cold turkey, but this is a choice they will have to make for themselves. 

At this stage we cannot interfere any further.
STH_warpcapable.66.name: Symbiosis - Unable to cure
STH_warpcapable.67.desc:
The medical team that we sent to investigate the Ornaran disease has come back with positive results, the lead consultant firmly believes the drug they are desperately seeking has long since cured any traditional illness but has left them with terrible addiction. 

The consultant has however managed to identify a substitute for the Felicium drug that with only a short treatment cycle can completely alleviate the side effects of the drug and give the Ornarans a new lease of life. 

Doing so will likely change the balance between the Brekkians and the Ornarans.
STH_warpcapable.67.name: Symbiosis - Cure found
STH_warpcapable.68.desc:
What have you done?! 

You will have ruined our economy and made an enemy of the Brekkian Alliance this day! 

You may come to regret this action.
STH_warpcapable.68.name: Symbiosis
STH_warpcapable.70.desc:
Our invasion of [FROMFROM.GetName] has been successful and we have defeated the [From.GetName] defense forces. Our armies now control the planet. 

We should now decide what to do with [FROMFROM.GetName].
STH_warpcapable.70.name: Invasion of [FROMFROM.GetName] Complete
STH_warpcapable.80.desc: The Federation of Planets has approached us, offering us the chance to join the great alliance that is the United Federation of Planets and take our place amongst the worlds of the galaxy.
STH_warpcapable.80.name: Federation Membership
STH_warpcapable.83.desc: Representatives of [From.GetName] has approached us and now wishes to integrate our small nation into theirs; the choice is ours.
STH_warpcapable.83.name: Offer to be Integrated
STH_warpcapable.84.desc: Our attempts to bring our target into our grasp has been rejected, will must now look at other ways to gain control of this minor power.
STH_warpcapable.84.name: Offer Rejected
STH_warpcapable.85.name: Offer Accepted
STH_xindi_mechanic.10.desc:
Tras la destrucción de Xindus al final del siglo de la guerra, las especies Xindi restantes se comprometieron a nunca más tomar las armas una contra la otra y unirse en la búsqueda de un nuevo mundo natal. 

El Consejo Xindi se formó para garantizar que se escucharan las voces de todos. 

Aunque la mayoría de los asuntos se acuerdan por mayoría de votos por los diez miembros del Consejo, un miembro es elegido para actuar como Presidente. La posición es principalmente de naturaleza ceremonial, pero el titular puede en la práctica dirigir algunas áreas de la política de Xindi por sí mismo. 

 Históricamente, el papel gira a una especie Xindi diferente al final del mandato del Presidente.
STH_xindi_mechanic.10.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.11.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.12.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.13.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.14.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.15.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.16.name: Consejo Xindi
STH_xindi_mechanic.20.desc: Las misteriosas esferas que una vez llenaron y contorsionaron la Expansión Délfica y casi nos trajeron nuestro segundo evento de extinción, nos han dejado el conocimiento de un arma de destrucción masiva. Este conocimiento se ha extendido entre las especies del Consejo. \Necesitaremos reunir a las especies Xindi para que cada una provea un componente para hacer esta arma y asegurar el futuro de las razas Xindi.
STH_xindi_mechanic.20.name: Un regalo del futuro
STH_xindi_mechanic.21.desc: Los Insectoides evolucionaron a partir de una mente colmena y pueden moverse y actuar como una sola. Esta capacidad de conexión en red se adaptaría perfectamente al arma y permitiría a una pequeña tripulación pilotar y controlar un arma de tamaño masivo. Investigar y añadir esta interfaz sería un paso importante para hacer realidad el arma.
STH_xindi_mechanic.21.name: El aguijón de los Insectoides
STH_xindi_mechanic.22.desc: A pesar de no ser la más fuerte ni la más grande de las especies Xindi, los Primates siempre han tenido una cierta habilidad para la destrucción, por lo que parece apropiado que el arma de disparo maestro se produzca a manos de un Primate. El dispositivo es capaz de disparar una carga sobrecargada de Kemocita haciendo que el núcleo de un planeta se desestabilice y explote, reduciendo un planeta a un cascarón roto. Un arma que podría acabar con una guerra incluso antes de que comience.
STH_xindi_mechanic.22.name: La fuerza de los Primates
STH_xindi_mechanic.23.desc: Los Arbóreos siempre han sido considerados la más perezosa de las especies Xindi, pero no dejes que esa apariencia te engañe. Lo que los Arbóreos no saben sobre el refinamiento de la Kemocita no vale la pena saberlo. El núcleo de energía que han producido alimentará el arma y la nave que la alberga.
STH_xindi_mechanic.23.name: El poder de los Arbóreos
STH_xindi_mechanic.24.desc: Los Reptiles fueron los primeros en ofrecerse para tripular el arma. Su determinación de asegurar la dominación de los Xindi alimenta cada uno de sus movimientos. Los Reptiles aceptaron entrenar y liderar un equipo de élite de Xindi de todas las especies para tripular la nave, sin importar si regresaban a casa con vida.
STH_xindi_mechanic.24.name: Los dientes de los Reptiles
STH_xindi_mechanic.25.desc: Los Acuáticos emigrarían muchos miles de kilómetros de vuelta a Xindus antes de la destrucción del mundo natal. Una vez que los Acuáticos salieron al espacio, su deseo de viajar grandes distancias continuó. Los estudios de las antiguas esferas permitieron a los Acuáticos dominar los vórtices y enviar el arma a grandes distancias.
STH_xindi_mechanic.25.name: El camino de los Acuáticos
STH_xindi_mechanic.26.desc: Las especies Xindi se han unido para producir un arma devastadora, con los mejores elementos de cada especie integrados en el diseño. Una vez que se haya investigado completamente, podremos construir una de estas armas y desatarla sobre nuestros enemigos.
STH_xindi_mechanic.26.name: El arma
STH_xindi_story.1.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.10.desc:
Incrustado en un trozo de veinte kilómetros de antiguo fondo marino, el [From.GetFleetName] ha descubierto los restos de una fortaleza Xindi-Aquatic. 

 Sorprendentemente, parece que la fortaleza sobrevivió a la destrucción de Xindus gracias a la presencia de cientos de generadores primitivos de campo de integridad estructural en su exterior. La cuadrícula de vigilancia interna muestra que la guarnición Xindi-Aquatic sobrevivió durante casi veinte años antes de que fallara el soporte vital tras el agotamiento de las reservas de energía de deuterio de la fortaleza. 

De las ruinas se recuperaron varios videos de entretenimiento Xindi-Aquatic y grabaciones de música.
STH_xindi_story.10.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.100.desc:
[Root.GetCaptainTitle] [From.Leader.GetName] a bordo del [From.GetFleetName] ha recuperado lo que parece ser un alijo de huevos Xindi-Avios congelados de los restos de un hospital militar incrustado en una bola de escombros de siete kilómetros de ancho. 

Las paredes del hospital parecen haber sido reforzadas con un campo primitivo de integridad estructural, evitando la destrucción del interior. 

Aunque ningún Xindi-Aviano escapó de la destrucción de Xindus, la posibilidad de restaurar la especie es demasiado importante como para ignorarla.
STH_xindi_story.100.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.11.desc:
[From.GetFleetName] descubrió los restos de un antiguo hábitat orbital Xindi-Arboreal. 

Mientras la estructura es completamente insalvable, se han recuperado varios contenedores intactos del almacenamiento seguro del hábitat. 

En el interior había una cantidad de papel documentos relacionados con diseños de medallas de propiedad inmobiliaria, matrimonio e iniciación entre la población Xindi-Arboreal.
STH_xindi_story.11.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.110.desc:
Los primeros huevos Xindi-Avios descongelados del alijo descubierto en las ruinas de Xindus no han podido incubar. 

Pocos esperaban que la reactivación de la especie fuera una cuestión simple, y queda una gran cantidad de huevos para intentar nuevamente, pero el costo del proyecto no es insignificante. 

Después de la emoción inicial del descubrimiento, algunos cuestionan si no es mejor enfocar nuestros recursos en aquellos que aún viven.
STH_xindi_story.110.name: Restauración Xindi-Aviar
STH_xindi_story.12.desc:
El [From.GetFleetName] ha descubierto los restos de una antigua estación de espionaje Xindi-Insectoide debajo de la superficie de un asteroide. El asteroide mismo es anterior al cataclismo, y según los registros de la estación de espionaje siguió una órbita con un alto grado de excentricidad antes de ser golpeado por los escombros de la destrucción de Xindus. 

Los registros contenían varios años de imágenes de alta resolución de la superficie de Xindus, y se encontró que las tiendas de alimentos de la estación contenían una gran cantidad de embriones de áfidos de Len'ka que alguna vez se consideraron un manjar entre los insectoides Xindi.
STH_xindi_story.12.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.120.desc:
Veinte de los huevos de Xindi-Avian descubiertos en el caché en Xindus han eclosionado con éxito. La restauración de la especie ha traído una nueva esperanza a todos los Xindi que creen que se ha alcanzado un punto de inflexión después del éxodo. 

 Criar a las crías Xindi-Avias y sus hermanos aún congelados no será fácil ni rápido.
STH_xindi_story.120.name: Restauración Xindi-Aviar
STH_xindi_story.13.desc:
Las montañas Ro Phan Ain una vez marcaron el límite de la nación Xindi-Primate de Elavu y la nación Xindi-Reptil de Lssan. Fuertemente fortificados por los Primates, los depósitos naturales de duranio hicieron que la cadena de bases subterráneas debajo del rango fuera casi impermeable al ataque. 

Una de estas bases ha sido descubierta intacta en uno de los fragmentos más grandes de Xindus. 

Aunque la guarnición parece haber muerto poco después del cataclismo, cada uno realizó una serie de grabaciones de video que detallaban sus vidas personales y sus historias familiares, en lo que consideraban la pequeña esperanza de que los arqueólogos alienígenas pudieran descubrirlos.
STH_xindi_story.13.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.130.desc:
Una generación de Xindi-Avians ha sido criada hasta la madurez, luego de la restauración de su raza a partir de un alijo de huevos congelados encontrados en las ruinas de Xindus. 

Mientras que las otras especies Xindi tienen la ventaja de preservar al menos parte de su cultura después del éxodo, los Aviares no tuvieron ese lujo. En cambio, se han sumergido en la cultura Xindi en su conjunto. 

De hecho, esta nueva cohorte demuestra poco de la faccionalidad que impregna la sociedad Xindi.
STH_xindi_story.130.name: Restauración Xindi-Aviar
STH_xindi_story.14.desc:
El [From.GetFleetName] ha descubierto lo que parece ser un antiguo observatorio solar Xindi-Reptiliano, intacto pero en una órbita en descomposición. 

 Estabilizando la estructura y alejándola del intenso calor del sol, la estación tarda varios días en enfriarse lo suficiente como para poder abordarla. 

El núcleo de la computadora ha sido casi completamente destruido por la radiación solar, pero un caché de archivos que contienen programas de comedia televisados aparentemente dirigidos a niños Xindi-Reptilianos ha sobrevivido sorprendentemente.
STH_xindi_story.14.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.15.desc:
Pocos recuerdan mucho de la cultura Xindi-Avian después de su extinción en el cataclismo, pero un mito parece tener alguna base en la realidad. 

Mientras los Avianos llenaban los cielos, se decía que aterrizarían a veces para enterrar su poesía segura en ataúdes metálicos. 

 Se han descubierto varios ataúdes encerrados en una bola de barro y roca de cinco kilómetros. 

El análisis de estos escritos antiguos llevará años.
STH_xindi_story.15.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.20.desc: La expedición de [From.GetFleetName] a los restos de Xindus ha descubierto un alijo de contenedores de almacenamiento de deuterio dispersos en uno de los fragmentos más grandes del mundo natal, aparentemente indemnes de la guerra civil.
STH_xindi_story.20.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.21.desc: La expedición de [From.GetFleetName] a los restos de Xindus ha descubierto un alijo de contenedores de almacenamiento de mineral de duranio dispersos en uno de los fragmentos más grandes del mundo natal, aparentemente indemnes de la guerra civil.
STH_xindi_story.21.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.30.desc:
[From.GetFleetName] ha localizado el marco intacto pero dañado de un barco que data de la guerra civil en una órbita excéntrica. 

Mientras que los sistemas básicos de propulsión y navegación se instalaron antes del cataclismo, los sistemas de armas están ausentes. Con una modesta cantidad de reacondicionamiento, la embarcación podría ingresar nuevamente al servicio.
STH_xindi_story.30.name: Regreso a Xindus
STH_xindi_story.31.desc:
El [From.GetFleetName] ha localizado el marco intacto pero dañado de un barco civil que data de la guerra civil en una órbita excéntrica. 

 Se instalaron sistemas básicos de propulsión y navegación antes del cataclismo y con una cantidad modesta de reacondicionamiento, la embarcación podría ingresar nuevamente al servicio.
STH_xindi_story.31.name: Regreso a Xindus
borg_first_contact.255.name: The Borg Threat
fallen_empires_awakening.2000.desc:
It began as a subtle shift in [From.GetAdjective] behaviour. Many within the Alliance have considered that the Qomar have sat on the sidelines for too long, contemplating their equations until the introduction of a simple song and music woke them from their slumber. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and powerful weapons brought online. For the first time in an age, the [From.GetName] are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

Their advance weapons combined with their belief that all other civilisations are inferior make them a concern for all in the region.
fallen_empires_awakening.2000.name: The Qomar join the Galaxy
nhTest.359.desc:
An alien vessel of cubical design has entered the [Root.Solar_System.GetName] system on a direct heading for [Root.GetName]. Attempts to hail proved unsuccesful until a single message was transmitted across multiple subspace bands: 

'We are the Borg. You will be assimilated. Your technological and biological distinctiveness will be added to our own.'
nhTest.359.name: Alien Cube
pirate.28.name: Estación de Jem'Hadar rebelde destruida
pirate.6.name: Unidades rebeldes
pirate.61.desc:
Un batallón completo de soldados Jem'Hadar ha desertado y ha comenzado una rebelión abierta contra [Root.GetName]. Aún dependientes de Ketracel White, los rebeldes atacan en las estaciones orbitales para asegurar nuevos depósitos de la droga para sostenerlos. 

Las líneas genéticas de los rebeldes Jem'Hadar se han aislado y eliminado de todas las instalaciones de cría, mientras que el Vorta La supervisión de las instalaciones más afectadas ha sido terminada.
pirate.61.name: Asalto de Jem'Hadar rebelde
pirate.62.desc: ¡Un grupo de piratas alienígenas se infiltró y se estableció en el  [pirate_system.GetName]  sistema, donde el Colectivo no tiene presencia. Parecen intentar asaltar nuestro territorio para financiar sus actividades imperfectas.
pirate.62.name: Piratas alienígenas
pirate.7.name: Unidades rebeldes
pirate.8.name: Rebelde Jem'Hadar
sth_borg_situation.200.desc:
Our security forces have detected active Borg Drones within our borders. These assimilated individuals still feel and heed the call of the Borg Collective and should be considered dangerous. 

Our scientists recommend setting up a task force to begin the process of either eradicating or de-assimilating these drones to resolve the situation.
sth_borg_situation.200.name: Active Borg Drones Detected
sth_borg_situation.201.desc: Our planetary authorities have now confirmed there are no longer any active Borg drones within our borders. The situation can now be considered resolved for now.
sth_borg_situation.201.name: No Active Borg Drones Detected
sth_borg_situation.25.desc:
Assimilation protocol modified, resources focused to prioritise the assimilation of the population of targeted planet. 

Input planet for assimilation drive to increase conversion to drone units.
sth_borg_situation.25.name: Planetary Populace Assimilation
sth_borg_situation.28.desc: Our drones have completed the assimilation of all non-borg units on the targeted planet, resuming standard assimilation protocols.
sth_borg_situation.28.name: Assmilation Drive Complete
sth_borg_situation.50.desc: The taskforce spun up to handle the Borg Drones within our borders is now reporting that there are no more drones under the control of the collective left, and our operation can stand down.
sth_borg_situation.50.name: Borg Situation Resolved
sth_chase_dig_site.1.desc:
After studying the ambiguous number blocks for hours, the discovery is made that these fragments are compatible DNA strands which have been recovered from different worlds all over the galaxy. [Root.Leader.GetName] believes that they have discovered an embedded genetic pattern that is constant throughout many different species, and speculates that this was left by an early race that pre-dates all other known civilizations. This would ultimately explain why so many races are humanoid.

Further investigation of the coordinates on the surface is warranted.
sth_chase_dig_site.1.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.11.desc: The civilisation on [From.Planet.GetName] was completely unaware of the large ancient facility hidden under the surface of the world, which is now only detectable thanks to the genetic tracker that [Root.Leader.GetName] has. The [Root.GetName] is focusing it's sensors to locate an entrance point for the team.
sth_chase_dig_site.11.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.12.desc: The facility on [From.Planet.GetName] appears to be mostly intact though in severe disrepair. Certain doorways appear to only open if the correct genetic sequences are entered, but the technology is far beyond our regular understanding. [Root.Leader.GetName] is attempting to override the systems.
sth_chase_dig_site.12.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.13.desc: [Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered new sections of the facility on [From.Planet.GetName], but some sections remain locked behind barely functioning security systems. The devices appears dysfunctional, and [Root.Leader.GetName] believes they should be able to bypass them.
sth_chase_dig_site.13.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.14.desc: [Root.Leader.GetName] has located a large genetic store room, which when scanned mark up new flags. It appears that different humanoid genomes were constructed within this chamber, some designed for harsh climates, some designed for watery domains. Some designs appear more viable than others, and many seem to bear a partial match to existing species within the galaxy.
sth_chase_dig_site.14.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.15.desc:
[Root.Leader.GetName] has managed to activate the final beacon within the facility, which points to a region of space not containing a planet.

Whilst many in the crew feel despondent, [Root.Leader.GetName] has determined that due to the ancient age of the facility that perhaps the facility was not mistaken - and instead the face of the galaxy has changed in the meantime. Beaming back up from the surface, the data is transmitted to the astrometrics department to uncover the next location.
sth_chase_dig_site.15.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.16.desc: The data from the dig site has been extrapolated and it appears that millions of years ago, the area of space which the signal pointed to was hit by a large shower of comets which could have potentially destroyed the worlds within the system and left them shattered. An investigation of the system has located a fragment that is large enough to contain another ancient facility.
sth_chase_dig_site.16.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.2.desc: [Root.Leader.GetName] and their away team beam to the coordinates under the surface of [From.Planet.GetName], where they have uncovered a ruined doorway of ancient origins. Bypassing the doorway is fraught with risk, as the structure is unsound and blocking any transporter locks.
sth_chase_dig_site.2.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.21.desc: The [Root.GetName] has entered orbit around the site of the ancient facility, and sensors are scanning for an entrance. [Root.Leader.GetName] is assembling their away team.
sth_chase_dig_site.21.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.22.desc: The facility is airtight, and remarkably well preserved considering the circumstances. Faint power still pulses through the walls, which provides interesting research opportunities but also causes many obstacles. The security system appears partially active, and force fields bar the way.
sth_chase_dig_site.22.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.23.desc: [Root.Leader.GetName] has bypassed the security forcefields to allow access to new sections of the facility on [From.Planet.GetName], but in doing so appears to have activated further security systems. Weapons appear to fire from numerous locations, and strange clouds of energy disperse and crackle throughout the corridors.
sth_chase_dig_site.23.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.24.desc: [Root.Leader.GetName] appears to be nearing the main source of the power in the facility as the defenses become stronger. The away team has to consistently solve advanced puzzles and collect DNA strands just to open and close every doorway, and force fields shimmer in and out of existence almost constantly.
sth_chase_dig_site.24.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.25.desc:
As soon as the final door is breached the defenses fall quiet, as [Root.Leader.GetName] enters the command center in the facility. The mummified remains of a humanoid lie in the center of the chamber, and upon scanning the body, [Root.Leader.GetName] appears to activate another holographic message.

It springs to life and a feminine voice begins 'You're wondering who we are, why we have done this, how it has come that I stand before you, the image of a being from so long ago. Life evolved on my planet before all others in this part of the galaxy. We left our world, explored the stars, and found none like ourselves. Our civilisation thrived for ages, but what is the life of one race, compared to the vast stretches of cosmic time? We knew that one day we would be gone, that nothing of us would survive. So, we left you. Our scientists seeded the primordial oceans of many worlds, where life was in its infancy. The seed codes directed your evolution toward a physical form resembling ours. This body you see before you, which is, of course, shaped as yours is shaped, for you are the end result. The seed codes also contained this message, which we scattered in fragments on many different worlds. It was our hope that you would have to come together in fellowship and companionship to hear this message. And if you can see and hear me, our hope has been fulfilled. You are a monument, not to our greatness, but to our existence. That was our wish, that you too would know life, and would keep alive our memory. There is something of us in each of you, and so, something of you in each other. Remember us.'

The message ceases and with that final message the facility begins to power down, leaving [Root.Leader.GetName] and their away team alone in the darkness, pondering the meaning of the message.
sth_chase_dig_site.25.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.26.desc: The information found within the archive is being used for our own purposes, advancing our technology substantially.
sth_chase_dig_site.26.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.27.desc: The data found within the archive detailing potentially where our races originated from has been shared freely, improving our reputation substantially amongst our peers.
sth_chase_dig_site.27.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.28.desc: By destroying the information found within the archive we have ensured that this information portraying other races as equals to our own can never be found. This has bolstered our supremacy within the galaxy.
sth_chase_dig_site.28.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.29.desc: By analysing the genetic information found within the archive we have found numerous weaknesses that are inherent to other races within the galaxy - and we can exploit it.
sth_chase_dig_site.29.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.3.desc: [Root.Leader.GetName] uncovers a small device from the chamber on [From.Planet.GetName], whilst the away team detects more types of DNA within the compound. The device appears dysfunctional but intact, and [Root.Leader.GetName] believes they should be able to power it up again.
sth_chase_dig_site.3.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.4.desc:
[Root.Leader.GetName] manages to power up the device, which suddenly activates and scans the entire room and the beings within it. Once done, a heavily fragmented holographic message begins to play briefly showcasing a strange humanoid being, before the device sputters and dies. [Root.Leader.GetName] notices that the already recovered data has been scanned and markers have been placed within the data, marking it as part of a smaller puzzle.

As that happens, the [Root.GetName] contacts [Root.Leader.GetName] and reports that warp signatures have been detected and are inbound to this location.
sth_chase_dig_site.4.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.5.desc:
[Root.Leader.GetName] and their away team beam back to the ship, as the warp signatures form into science vessels from neighbouring empires.

Opening hailing frequencies between the nearby vessels, a brief discussion begins where each vessel brings reports similar findings. Whether it will lead to a weapon of mass destruction, a great genetic breakthrough or just a mere curiosity.

A stalemate ensues, where no party is willing to trade information - but if the chase is to continue, then everyone must provide their own information to form a clearer picture. [Root.Leader.GetName] begins the negotiations...
sth_chase_dig_site.5.name: The Chase
sth_chase_dig_site.6.desc: Our scientists have collated the genetic information gathered from the first archaeological site and has determined that the next site is located on [theChase1Target.GetName].
sth_chase_dig_site.6.name: The Chase
sth_iconian_crisis.10.desc: [Leader.GetName] and their away team make their way to the entrance of the Iconian ruins, most of the structures have been lost to time, but the signal appears to be coming from one of the larger remaining buildings, which was thought to be part of the central command complex of the facility.
sth_iconian_crisis.10.name: Strange signals
sth_iconian_crisis.11.desc:
Previous excavations at this site indicated that this complex had been largely destroyed and that once upon a time it extended far beyond the original room and below ground. 

Previous attempts to explore further had been abandoned due to the damage to the structure. 

However it appears a recent event has resulted in a new passage being opened up with the signal clearly emanating from beyond the tunnel.
sth_iconian_crisis.11.name: A new passage
sth_iconian_crisis.12.desc:
The passage opens up into a new room with stations scattered across the room in various states of disrepair, the space appears to have been used as a staging area with rows of empty equipment lockers lying across the ground. A quick check by [Leader.GetName] finds that all of the lockers had been stripped of their content, but done in a tremendous hurry. 

The security chief suddenly calls out 'Captain the signal is coming from behind this door.'
sth_iconian_crisis.12.name: New Complex Discovered
sth_iconian_crisis.13.desc:
Looking at the room it is clear that this staging area funnels directly towards this large, blocked doorway. 

The strange readings are clearly coming from behind this doorway, but getting weaker with each passing moment.
sth_iconian_crisis.13.name: Blocked Doorway
sth_iconian_crisis.14.desc: Entering the final room, [Leader.GetName] quickly identifies the central object of the room, a large gateway with different locations clearly visible flashing through. This can only be an Iconian Gateway, the gateway spins through locations faster and faster until suddenly it goes dark. Moving to the console, nothing the away team can do will bring the gateway back to life, leaving the team with nothing to do but prepare the area for a full research team.
sth_iconian_crisis.14.name: Iconian Gateway
sth_iconian_crisis.15.desc: As [Leader.GetName] and [Leader.GetHisHer] team beam down to the site of the recent earthquake and the damage to the surrounding landscape is immediately clear. However, the shift in the earth has revealed part of an ancient hidden complex.
sth_iconian_crisis.15.name: Investigating the region
sth_iconian_crisis.16.desc: Archeologists had suspected that this planet had once been an ancient Iconian Empire outpost, this new discovery seems to confirm that theory. The architecture, despite being heavily damaged, clearly resembled previously discovered Iconian designs.
sth_iconian_crisis.16.name: An Ancient Ruin
sth_iconian_crisis.17.desc: Whilst running passive scans on the site [Leader.GetName] picks up a strange energy reading buried deep beneath the dig site. The reading is very faint but would suggest that somewhere amongst the ruins a piece of Iconian technology is still active.
sth_iconian_crisis.17.name: Mysterious Signal
sth_iconian_crisis.18.desc: Despite a frantic search from the away team, the signal provides one final burst before fading away, whatever was providing the source of energy within the ruins appears to have finally given up. We should take the research and hand the site over to the experts.
sth_iconian_crisis.18.name: Signal vanishes without a trace
sth_iconian_crisis.19.desc: [Leader.GetName] and the away team from [This.GetName] arrived at the location reported to them by the planetary survey team, located deep within an uncharted section of the planet's jungle a small pyramid-shaped complex sits buried underneath years of natural vegetational growth. The team will need to clear away the jungle to expose the find.
sth_iconian_crisis.19.name: Ancient Ruins
sth_iconian_crisis.2.desc: There has been an unusual increase in new Iconian dig sites being discovered over the last few weeks, prompting huge excitement from our archeological societies who are flocking to their locations to see what new discoveries can be made regarding this long forgotten empire.
sth_iconian_crisis.2.name: Iconian Dig Sites
sth_iconian_crisis.20.desc: After much hard work clearing away the vegetation away from the site, the shape of the complex starts to become much clearer. The building appears surprisingly solid for what appears to be a very old structure, with the entrance way now accessible the team can now explore the structure.
sth_iconian_crisis.20.name: The Jungle Cleared
sth_iconian_crisis.21.desc: The site appears to date back well over 200,000 years ago, which would make this a potential Iconian Empire outpost, a truly incredible find! The crew from [This.GetName] will make this site safe for further expeditions to be sent and continue the work done here on [From.Planet.GetName].
sth_iconian_crisis.21.name: An Iconian Site!
sth_iconian_crisis.32.desc:
Across the galaxy, reports are coming in that the strange readings have returned at sites of former Iconian Empire facilities. Scientist reports that technology once dormant and thought destroyed has suddenly come back to life and the mysterious Iconian Gateways appear to be coming back to life. 

It feels like something or someone is coming...
sth_iconian_crisis.32.name: Concerning Activity at Iconian Sites
sth_iconian_crisis.33.desc:
We have reports that the Iconian Gateway on [Root.GetName] has been activated and an unknown invasion force is pouring through the gateway and they seem determined to capture our planet. 

We should mount a defense or fall back and re-group. At this point we should consider every planet with Iconian Ruins at risk.
sth_iconian_crisis.33.name: Iconian Invasion
sth_iconian_crisis.35.desc: Further invasion troops from Iconian Empire are flooding through the Gateway on [Root.GetName], the planet is under siege and may soon fall to the invaders.
sth_iconian_crisis.35.name: Iconian Invasion
sth_iconian_crisis.36.desc: The ancient Iconian Empire, which many had thought had been destroyed over 200,000 years ago have returned to the Milky Way and appear ready to reclaim their fallen Empire.
sth_iconian_crisis.36.name: Iconian Invasion
sth_iconian_crisis.4.desc: Reports continued to come in regarding the increased activity around existing and previously undiscovered Iconian sites, and while many scientists are thoroughly excited by these finds, there are a few who are now questioning ... why now?
sth_iconian_crisis.4.name: Further Iconian Activity
sth_iconian_crisis.40.desc:
Our defenses on [FromFrom.GetName] have fallen and the Iconian Empire has taken control of our world. 

It appears they are using their advanced technology to create an Orbital Gateway, we can only assume they are planning to bring their fleets through to our space.
sth_iconian_crisis.40.name: [FromFrom.GetName] has fallen
sth_iconian_crisis.41.desc:
With victory on [Root.GetName] we move a step closer to pushing the Iconian invaders out of our territory and freeing our people from their clutches. 

With every planet that we reclaim across the galaxy their hold over us weakens.
sth_iconian_crisis.41.name: [Root.GetName] has been reclaimed
sth_iconian_crisis.43.desc:
Following many lives lost and the sacrifices made by our troops and those from other empires, the Iconian hold over their former territory has been weakened to the point that the ancient superpower has retreated back to its remaining stronghold at the centre of our galaxy. 

Whilst they remain dormant the threat is no longer active, but there might come a day when they once again re-awaken and threaten all our lives.
sth_iconian_crisis.43.name: Iconian Empire Defeated
sth_iconian_crisis.44.desc: {TRANSLATION} Pathetic minor races of the once glorious Iconian Empire, your masters have returned to reclaim what once belonged to us, your world, people, ships, and resources are now subjects to the might of Iconia. Submit and the process will be easy, but we do not promise you an easy life as our thralls... Defy us an we promise you only destruction. {END TRANSLATION}
sth_iconian_crisis.44.name: INCOMING TRANSMISSION
sth_iconian_crisis.6.desc: It can no longer be denied that this spate of new Iconian discoveries is most strange, the galactic community continues to be split between excitement and concern as these previously dormant ruins seem to be showing new signs of life.
sth_iconian_crisis.6.name: More Iconian Activity
sth_iconian_dig_site.1.desc:
[Leader.GetName] and their away team have reported that they are following the signals deep into the mountains on [From.Planet.GetName].

Nearing natural crevices and shafts, [Leader.GetSheHe] has discovered some bodies believed to be scavengers lying here half crushed by falling rocks. The bodies are of unknown species, but have been here for some years. A small functioning scanner on one of the bodies indicates a mysterious but weak energy signature coming from a cave entrance nearby.
sth_iconian_dig_site.1.name: Collapsed Rocks
sth_iconian_dig_site.2.desc:
The hidden entrance to a large cave system has been uncovered thanks to the alien scanner. [Leader.GetName] and their away team are beginning to clear away the rock falls and securing the entranceway deep underground.

The caves themselves appear to be sturdy enough, and upon closer inspection were not naturally formed. The technology to carve the rock so deep and precise shows an advanced level of engineering by the creators.
sth_iconian_dig_site.2.name: Hidden Entrance
sth_iconian_dig_site.3.desc:
[Leader.GetName] has reported they have uncovered a strange device on [From.Planet.GetName].

At a relatively shallow depth within the cave system, the away team have found an extremely odd device near a dead end. A light amount of power still passes through the device, and it bears some similarity to theoretical quantum transportation technology. The device appears to have enough power to operate a few more times before petering out, we should try to figure out how to use it.
sth_iconian_dig_site.3.name: Strange Device
sth_iconian_dig_site.4.desc:
[Leader.GetName] has reported in - the device has transported the away team deeper within a vast complex somewhere on [From.Planet.GetName]. From initial reports, the complex is extremely ancient but advanced, and may be Tkonian or Iconian in nature. Most of the equipment is decayed beyond repair, but some data is still recoverable and from what little data there is a story of what occurred here begins to take place.

A great calamity struck their ancient empire, and the population could no longer sustain themselves on this world.

With only limited support they used their gateway network to abandon the planet and sealed it under a large mountain - to prevent it falling into enemy hands.

The data indicates a small chamber somewhere towards the center of the complex.
sth_iconian_dig_site.4.name: Underground Complex
sth_iconian_dig_site.5.desc:
[Leader.GetName] has managed to uncover what is known as an 'Iconian gateway', a large arch like structure capable of transportation across the entire galaxy.

Physically the gateway appears literally as a 'door' through which was the destination. According to the data recovered, the gateway network used to span the galaxy and allowed the Iconians to travel throughout the galaxy without the use of starships and was the primary means through which they controlled their vast empire, earning them a reputation among their primitive subject peoples as 'Demons of Air and Darkness'.

[Leader.GetName] reports that further study of the gateway should now be possible and, when we understand the technology better, a site could be constructed on this planet to utilise the gateway itself.
sth_iconian_dig_site.5.name: Iconian Gateway
sth_krenim_flavour.1.desc: Descubrimos una boya de registro protegida por escudos temporales. Desafortunadamente, descubrimos después de desactivar los escudos que los datos estaban demasiado dañados. Tal vez podamos ajustar los escáneres para encontrar más boyas.
sth_krenim_flavour.1.name: Año del infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.10.desc: Bitácora del oficial médico superior. Fecha estelar 51558.6. En mil novecientos treinta y nueve, en mi calidad de oficial médico jefe, y de acuerdo con la Ordenanza Médica de la Flota Estelar 121, Sección A, la Capitán Kathryn Janeway ha sido formalmente relevada del mando de la nave espacial de la Federación Voyager. La cual no ha utilizado mucho. Le he comunicado al Capitán mi sospecha de que lleva semanas sufriendo un síndrome de estrés traumático. Los síntomas incluyen irritabilidad, insomnio, obsesión y comportamiento imprudente. Intentó justificar su comportamiento. Le pedí que se quedara unos días en mi enfermería temporal para observarla. Se negó. Cuando le recordé que tenía autoridad para relevarla de sus funciones, amenazó con desactivar mi programa. Debo señalar que se disculpó inmediatamente, pero el hecho de que siquiera considerara esta idea para mantener su puesto es una prueba más de su evidente agotamiento mental. Finalmente, confirmó mi orden y se negó a obedecerla. Aunque me avergüenza manchar el expediente de uno de los oficiales más fuertes, valientes y abnegados que conozco, es mi deber registrar este incidente en mi diario oficial. Si estos sucesos conducen a una acusación, serán otros los que decidan quién actuó apropiadamente por nosotros o si las acciones del Capitán son suficientes para liberarlo de la Flota Estelar.
sth_krenim_flavour.10.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.11.desc: Bitácora del Capitán. Capitán Janeway. Fecha estelar 51289.8. Gracias a los Escudos Temporales desarrollados por Siete, ahora podemos protegernos contra los torpedos de cronitones de los Krenim. Esto tuvo un efecto inesperado. El Teniente Kim detectó una onda de choque temporal a una distancia de 20 años luz. La nave de guerra Krenim que encontramos se transformó en una nave mucho más pequeña. Tengo los datos del sensor transferidos al Laboratorio Astrométrico para una mayor investigación.
sth_krenim_flavour.11.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.12.desc: Bitácora del Capitán, fecha estelar 51425.4: Nuestra condición nos ha dejado vulnerables a las anomalías espaciales y a cualquier especie alienígena ávida de una pieza de hardware. Nos hemos refugiado en una nebulosa de clase 9.
sth_krenim_flavour.12.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.13.desc: Nuestro análisis de los datos sugiere que la nave alienígena Voyager ha conseguido finalmente forzar y destruir la nave construida por Annorax en el espacio-tiempo normal. No podemos imaginar otro escenario que haya resultado en una restauración completa de la línea de tiempo que ahora conocemos. Ninguno de nuestros escaneos actuales muestra un rastro de la línea temporal a la que se refieren los registros. Se derrumbó por completo. Las boyas lanzadas y blindadas son los únicos registros de su existencia. El propio Annorax ha llevado una vida larga e increíblemente productiva y ha muerto tranquilamente en su casa de Kyana Prime hace casi doscientos años, rodeado de sus amigos y familiares. Sólo los que conocemos lo siniestros que pueden ser los otros caminos apreciamos realmente la luz en la que vivimos ahora.
sth_krenim_flavour.13.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.3.desc: Descubrimos otra firma Chroniton y deberíamos enviar un Agente Temporal.
sth_krenim_flavour.3.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.4.desc: Descubrimos otra firma de Chroniton y deberíamos enviar un Agente Temporal.
sth_krenim_flavour.4.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.5.desc: Descubrimos otra firma de Chroniton y deberíamos enviar un Agente Temporal.
sth_krenim_flavour.5.name: Año del Infierno
sth_krenim_flavour.50.desc: Annorax presenta uno de los mayores logros de los laboratorios de la Autoridad Temporal, los "Astilleros de Investigación y Construcción Temporal", que ofrecen el lugar perfecto para continuar el desarrollo de la Nave del Tiempo. \Con avanzados campos de fuerza y generadores temporales que permitirán que la investigación pase a la siguiente fase y, cuando llegue el momento, estos astilleros se utilizarán para construir la propia Nave del Tiempo.
sth_krenim_flavour.50.name: La Gran Nave del Tiempo
